metadata.arabic: وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ ٱلظَّالِمُ عَلَىٰ يَدَيْهِ يَقُولُ يٰلَيْتَنِي ٱتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ ٱلرَّسُولِ سَبِيلاً
metadata.Tafsir: (On the day when the wrong-doer) the disbeliever, i.e. 'Uqbah Ibn Ma'it (gnaweth his hands) his fingers, (he will say: Ah, would that I had chosen a way together with the messenger (of Allah)) would that I had chosen, and were upright in following the religion of the Prophet!

translation: And (remember) the Day when the Zâlim (wrong-doer, oppressor, polytheist) will bite at his hands, he will say: "Oh! Would that I had taken a path with the Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم).

metadata.arabic: يَٰوَيْلَتَىٰ لَيْتَنِي لَمْ أَتَّخِذْ فُلاَناً خَلِيلاً
metadata.Tafsir: (Alas for me! Ah, would that I had never taken such an one) Ubayy Ibn Khalaf (for friend) following his religion!

translation: "Ah! Woe to me! Would that I had never taken so-and-so as a Khalîl (an intimate friend)!

metadata.arabic: لَّقَدْ أَضَلَّنِي عَنِ ٱلذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَنِي وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَانُ لِلإِنْسَانِ خَذُولاً
metadata.Tafsir: (He verily led me astray from the Reminder) from Allah's divine Oneness and obedience (after it had reached me) after Muhammad (pbuh) reached me with Allah's divine Oneness. (Satan was ever man's deserter in the hour of need) he lets him down at the time of need.

translation: "He indeed led me astray from the Reminder (this Qur’ân) after it had come to me. And Shaitân (Satan) is to man ever a deserter in the hour of need." [Tafsir Al-Qurtubi]

metadata.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّسُولُ يٰرَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِي ٱتَّخَذُواْ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْآنَ مَهْجُوراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And the messenger) Muhammad (pbuh) (saith: O my Lord! Lo! mine own folk make this Qur'an of no account) they speak ill of it, they do not believe in it and do not act upon its teachings.

translation: And the Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) will say: "O my Lord! Verily, my people deserted this Qur’ân (neither listened to it, nor acted on its laws and teachings).

metadata.arabic: وَكَذَلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ عَدُوّاً مِّنَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ هَادِياً وَنَصِيراً
metadata.Tafsir: (Even so) just as We have appointed Abu Jahl as your enemy (have We appointed unto every Prophet) before you (an opponent from among the guilty) from the idolaters of his people; (but Allah sufficeth for a Guide) a Preserver (and Helper) and Defender against what they plot against you.

translation: Thus have We made for every Prophet an enemy among the Mujrimûn (disbelievers, polytheists, criminals). But Sufficient is your Lord as a Guide and Helper.

metadata.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوْلاَ نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقُرْآنُ جُمْلَةً وَاحِدَةً كَذَلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِ فُؤَادَكَ وَرَتَّلْنَاهُ تَرْتِيلاً
metadata.Tafsir: (And those who disbelieve) Abu Jahl and his host (say: Why is the Qur'an not revealed unto him all at once) just like the Torah was revealed all at once to Moses, and the Gospel to Jesus and the Psalms to David? ((It is revealed) thus) He says: We have sent Gabriel with the Qur'an in instalments (that We may strengthen thy heart therewith) that We may gladden your heart and preserve your heart; (and We have arranged it in right order) We exposited it by detailing the commands and prohibitions; it is also said that this means: We have sent Gabriel with the Qur'an in instalments verse after verse.

translation: And those who disbelieve say: "Why is not the Qur’ân revealed to him all at once?" Thus (it is sent down in parts), that We may strengthen your heart thereby. And We have revealed it to you gradually, in stages. (It was revealed to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم in 23 years.).

metadata.arabic: وَلاَ يَأْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلاَّ جِئْنَاكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And they bring thee) O Muhammad (no similitude) no description, proof or explanation (but We bring thee the Truth) with a description, exposition and proof that contradict their proof (and better (than their similitude) as argument) and better explanation and proof than their proof.

translation: And no example or similitude do they bring (to oppose or to find fault in you or in this Qur’ân), but We reveal to you the truth (against that similitude or example), and the better explanation thereof.

metadata.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُحْشَرُونَ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُوْلَـٰئِكَ شَرٌّ مَّكَاناً وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلاً
metadata.Tafsir: (Those who will be gathered) will be dragged (on their faces unto hell) i.e. Abu Jahl and his host: (such are worse in plight) they have a worse abode in the Hereafter and worse works in this worldly life (and further from the right road) from the Truth and guidance.

translation: Those who will be gathered to Hell (prone) on their faces, such will be in an evil state, and most astray from the (Straight) Path.

metadata.arabic: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُ أَخَاهُ هَارُونَ وَزِيراً
metadata.Tafsir: (We verify gave Moses the Scripture) the Torah (and placed with him his brother Aaron as henchman) as helper.

translation: And indeed We gave Mûsâ (Moses) the Scripture [the Taurât (Torah)], and placed his brother Hârûn (Aaron) with him as a helper;

metadata.arabic: فَقُلْنَا ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِآيَاتِنَا فَدَمَّرْنَاهُمْ تَدْمِيراً
metadata.Tafsir: (Then We said: Go together unto the folk who have denied Our revelations) those who disbelieved in Our nine signs, i.e. Pharaoh and his people, the Copts. (Then We destroyed them, a complete destruction) by drowning them.

translation: And We said: "Go you both to the people who have denied Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)." Then We destroyed them with utter destruction.

metadata.arabic: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُواْ ٱلرُّسُلَ أَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ آيَةً وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ عَذَاباً أَلِيماً
metadata.Tafsir: (And Noah's folk) and We destroyed the people of Noah, (when they denied the messengers) i.e. Noah and the rest of messengers, (We drowned them) by means of the flood (and made of them a portent for mankind) We made them an admonition for other people so that they do not follow their example. (We have prepared a painful doom) in the Fire (for evil-doers) for the idolaters, the idolaters of Mecca.

translation: And Nûh’s (Noah) people, when they denied the Messengers, We drowned them, and We made them as a sign for mankind. And We have prepared a painful torment for the Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers).

metadata.arabic: وَعَاداً وَثَمُودَاْ وَأَصْحَابَ ٱلرَّسِّ وَقُرُوناً بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ كَثِيراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And (the tribes of) 'Aad) and We destroyed the people of Hud (and Thamud) the people of Salih, (and the dwellers in Ar-Rass) the people of Shu'ayb, (and many generations in between) We destroyed them all, even though We have not mentioned them by name.

translation: And (also) ‘Âd and Thamûd, and the Dwellers of Ar-Rass, and many generations in between.

metadata.arabic: وَكُلاًّ ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ ٱلأَمْثَالَ وَكُلاًّ تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِيراً
metadata.Tafsir: (Each (of them) We warned by examples) We explained to each generation the chastisement We inflicted upon the generations before them, but still they did not believe, (and each (of them) We brought to utter ruin) one after the other.

translation: And for each (of them) We put forward examples (as proofs and lessons), and each (of them) We brought to utter ruin (because of their disbelief and evil deeds).

metadata.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَتَوْا عَلَى ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِيۤ أُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ ٱلسَّوْءِ أَفَلَمْ يَكُونُواْ يَرَوْنَهَا بَلْ كَانُواْ لاَ يَرْجُونَ نُشُوراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And indeed they) the people of Mecca (have passed by the township) the town of Lot (whereon was rained the fatal rain) a rain of stones. (Can it be that they have not seen it) have they not seen what was done to it and to its people, and thus refrain from disbelieving in you and in what you say? (Nay, but they hope for no resurrection) they do not fear resurrection after death.

translation: And indeed they have passed by the town [of Prophet Lût (Lot)] on which was rained the evil rain. Did they (disbelievers) not then see it (with their own eyes)? Nay! But they used not to expect any resurrection.

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْكَ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلاَّ هُزُواً أَهَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِي بَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولاً
metadata.Tafsir: (And when they) the disbelievers of Mecca (see thee (O Muhammad) they treat thee only as a jest) they only speak to you in jest and derision ((saying): Is this he whom Allah sendeth as a messenger) to us?

translation: And when they see you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), they treat you only in mockery (saying): "Is this the one whom Allâh has sent as a Messenger?

metadata.arabic: إِن كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنْ آلِهَتِنَا لَوْلاَ أَن صَبْرَنَا عَلَيْهَا وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْعَذَابَ مَنْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلاً
metadata.Tafsir: (He would have led us far away from our gods) from the worship of our deities (if we had not been staunch to them) if we had not been staunch in worshipping them. (They will know) this is a threat to them from Allah, (when they behold the doom, who is more astray as to the road) as to Religion and proof.

translation: "He would have nearly misled us from our âlihah (gods), had it not been that we were patient and constant in their worship!" And they will know when they see the torment, who it is that is most astray from the (Right) Path!

metadata.arabic: أَرَأَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَـٰهَهُ هَوَاهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلاً
metadata.Tafsir: (Hast thou) O Muhammad (seen him who chooseth for his god his own lust) who worshipped his god, i.e. al-Nadr and his host, out of the whim of his ego? (Wouldst thou) O Muhammad (then be guardian over him) a protector against going out for such corruption? But this was abrogated by the verse of jihad; it is also said that this means: would you be their protector from chastisement?

translation: Have you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) seen him who has taken as his ilâh (god) his own vain desire? Would you then be a Wakîl (a disposer of his affairs or a watcher) over him?

metadata.arabic: أَمْ تَحْسَبُ أَنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ أَوْ يَعْقِلُونَ إِنْ هُمْ إِلاَّ كَٱلأَنْعَامِ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلاً
metadata.Tafsir: (Or deemest thou) O Muhammad (that most of them hear) the Truth (or understand) such Truth when they listen to your words? (They are) in relation to understanding the Truth (but as the cattle) which know nothing but eating and drinking; they are with regard to the Truth like this, (nay, but they are farther astray) from proof and Religion! Because the cattle have no ability to understand proofs.

translation: Or do you think that most of them hear or understand? They are only like cattle - nay, they are even farther astray from the Path (i.e. even worse than cattle).

metadata.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ ٱلظِّلَّ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهُ سَاكِناً ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا ٱلشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلاً
metadata.Tafsir: (Hast thou not seen how thy Lord hath spread the shade) after sunrise and before sunset, from the East to the West. (And if He willed He could have made it) i.e. the shade (still) with no sun, (then We have made the sun its) the shade's (pilot) wherever one finds the sun one expects to find the shade before that; it is also said that this means: a guide which comes after it;

translation: Have you not seen how your Lord spread the shadow. If He willed, He could have made it still - But We have made the sun its guide (i.e. after the sunrise, the shadow shrinks and vanishes at midnoon and then again appears in the afternoon with the decline of the sun, and had there been no sunlight, there would have been no shadow).

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ قَبَضْنَاهُ إِلَيْنَا قَبْضاً يَسِيراً
metadata.Tafsir: (Then We withdraw it) i.e. the shade (unto Us, a gradual withdrawal) a slight-or as it is said: hidden-withdrawal?

translation: Then We withdraw it to Us a gradual concealed withdrawal.

metadata.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيلَ لِبَاساً وَٱلنَّوْمَ سُبَاتاً وَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ نُشُوراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And He it is Who maketh night a covering for you) which covers everything, (and sleep repose) for your bodies, (and maketh day a resurrection) a pursuit for your livelihood.

translation: And it is He Who makes the night a covering for you, and the sleep (as) a repose, and makes the day Nushûr (i.e. getting up and going about here and there for daily work, after one’s sleep at night, or like resurrection after one’s death).

metadata.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيۤ أَرْسَلَ ٱلرِّيَاحَ بُشْرَاً بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً طَهُوراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And He it is Who sendeth the winds, glad tidings heralding His mercy) rain, (and We send down purifying water from the sky) water which purifies and cannot be purified.

translation: And it is He Who sends the winds as heralds of glad tidings, going before His Mercy (rain); and We send down pure water from the sky.

metadata.arabic: لِّنُحْيِـيَ بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتاً وَنُسْقِيَهُ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَآ أَنْعَاماً وَأَنَاسِيَّ كَثِيراً
metadata.Tafsir: (That We may give life thereby to a dead land) a land that has no vegetation, (and We give many beasts and men that We have created to drink thereof.

translation: That We may give life thereby to a dead land, and We give to drink thereof many of the cattle and men that We had created.

metadata.arabic: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَاهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُواْ فَأَبَىٰ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلاَّ كُفُوراً
metadata.Tafsir: And verily We have repeated it) the rain (among them) year after year (that they may remember) that they may take heed, (but most of mankind begrudge aught save in gratitude) they refused and stayed firm in ingratitude towards Allah and His blessings.

translation: And indeed We have distributed it (rain or water) amongst them in order that they may remember (the Grace of Allâh,) but most men (refuse to accept the Truth or Faith and) accept nothing but disbelief or ingratitude.

metadata.arabic: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِي كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ نَّذِيراً
metadata.Tafsir: (If We willed, We could raise up) We could have sent (a warner) a warning messenger (in every village) to the people of every village. Instead, We have sent you to all mankind as a Messenger so that reward and honour will be all yours.

translation: And had We willed, We would have raised a warner in every town.

metadata.arabic: فَلاَ تُطِعِ ٱلْكَافِرِينَ وَجَاهِدْهُمْ بِهِ جِهَاداً كَبيراً
metadata.Tafsir: (So obey not the disbelievers) Abu Jahl and his host regarding hat which they ask of you, (but strive against them herewith) by means of the Qur'an (with a great endeavour) by the sword.

translation: So obey not the disbelievers, but strive against them (by preaching) with the utmost endeavour with it (the Qur’ân).

metadata.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ هَـٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَهَـٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخاً وَحِجْراً مَّحْجُوراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And He it is Who hath given independence to the two seas (though they meet); one palatable, sweet, and the other saltish, bitter; and hath set a bar) a barrier between the sweet and the salty (and a forbidding ban between them) preventing either one from transgressing against the other, such as to make the taste of either of them change.

translation: And it is He Who has let free the two seas (kinds of water): this is palatable and sweet, and that is salt and bitter; and He has set a barrier and a complete partition between them.

metadata.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ بَشَراً فَجَعَلَهُ نَسَباً وَصِهْراً وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And He it is Who hath created man from water) from the water of the male and female, (and hath appointed for him kindred by blood) who are unmarriageable (and kindred by marriage) who are marriageable, whether they are relatives or not; (for thy Lord is) in relation to the lawful and the unlawful which He created (ever Powerful.

translation: And it is He Who has created man from water, and has appointed for him kindred by blood, and kindred by marriage. And your Lord is Ever All-Powerful to do what He wills.

metadata.arabic: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لاَ يَنفَعُهُمْ وَلاَ يَضُرُّهُمْ وَكَانَ ٱلْكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِ ظَهِيراً
metadata.Tafsir: Yet they) the disbelievers of Mecca (worship instead of Allah that which can neither benefit them) in this world or in the next, if they worshipped and obeyed them (nor hurt them) in this world or in the next, if they were to disobey them and abstain from their worship. (The disbeliever) Abu Jahl (was ever a partisan) rebellious (against his Lord) it is also that this means: he is always a helper, through his disbelief, to the disbelievers against his Lord.

translation: And they (disbelievers, polytheists) worship besides Allâh that which can neither profit them nor harm them; and the disbeliever is ever a helper (of the Satan) against his Lord.

metadata.arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلاَّ مُبَشِّراً وَنَذِيراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And We have sent thee) O Muhammad to the people of Mecca (only as a bearer of good tidings) Paradise (and a warner) from the Fire.

translation: And We have sent you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) only as a bearer of glad tidings and a warner.

metadata.arabic: قُلْ مَآ أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِلاَّ مَن شَآءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلاً
metadata.Tafsir: (Say) O Muhammad to the people of Mecca: (I ask of you no reward) no payment or provision (for this) for professing Allah's divine Oneness and for the Qur'an, (save that whoso will may choose a way unto his Lord) through faith; it is also said that this means: save for the one who desires to profess Allah's divine Oneness and by means of this profession tread a way back to his Lord whereby he will find his reward.

translation: Say: "No reward do I ask of you for this (that which I have brought from my Lord and its preaching), save that whosoever wills may take a Path to his Lord.

metadata.arabic: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْحَيِّ ٱلَّذِي لاَ يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِ خَبِيراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And trust thou) O Muhammad (in the Living One Who dieth not) and do not trust in those living who die such as Abu Talib or Khadijah, nor trust yet in the dead who have no movement, (and hymn His praise) and pray by His command. (He sufficeth as the Knower of His bondmen's sins) He is aware of the sins of His bondmen,

translation: And put your trust (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) in the Ever Living One Who dies not, and glorify His Praises, and Sufficient is He as the All-Knower of the sins of His slaves,

metadata.arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ فَسْئَلْ بِهِ خَبِيراً
metadata.Tafsir: (Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them) of created beings and marvels (in six Days) of the beginning of creation, the length of each day was 1,000 years of the days that you count presently; the first day was Sunday and the last day Friday, (then He mounted the Throne. The Beneficent! Ask any one informed concerning Him) ask those who possess knowledge about Allah, and they will inform you!

translation: Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six Days. Then He (Istawâ ) rose over the Throne (in a manner that suits His Majesty). The Most Gracious (Allâh)! Ask Him (O Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم , concerning His Qualities: His rising over His Throne, His creations, etc.), as He is Al-Khabîr (The All-Knower of everything i.e. Allâh).

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱسْجُدُواْ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ قَالُواْ وَمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ أَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَأْمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُوراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And when it is said unto them) to the people of Mecca: (Adore the Beneficent) submit to the Beneficent through the profession of Allah's divine Oneness! (they say: And what is the Beneficent) we do not know anyone with this name except Musaylimah the liar? (Are we to adore whatever thou (Muhammad) biddest us) a manifest lie? (And it) i.e. the mention of the Beneficent; and it is said: the mention of the Qur'an; and it is said the call of the Prophet (pbuh) (increaseth aversion in them) from faith.

translation: And when it is said to them: "Prostrate yourselves to the Most Gracious (Allâh)! they say: "And what is the Most Gracious? Shall we fall down in prostration to that which you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) command us?" And it increases in them only aversion.

metadata.arabic: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجاً وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَاجاً وَقَمَراً مُّنِيراً
metadata.Tafsir: (Blessed be He) He is the Possessor of grace He (Who hath placed in the heaven mansions of the stars) and it is said that this means: mansions, (and hath placed therein) in the heaven (a great lamp) the sun shining during the day for the children of Adam (and a moon giving light) to the Children of Adam during the night!

translation: Blessed be He Who has placed in the heaven big stars, and has placed therein a great lamp (sun), and a moon giving light.

metadata.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ ٱلَّيلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةً لِّمَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرَادَ شُكُوراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And He it is Who hath appointed night and day in succession) to each other, (for him who desireth to remember) to take admonition in their succession, (or desireth thankfulness) or desires to do righteous works, whatever he left undone at night he does it during the day, and whatever he left undone during the day he does it at night.

translation: And He it is Who has put the night and the day in succession, for such who desires to remember or desires to show his gratitude.

metadata.arabic: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَىٰ ٱلأَرْضِ هَوْناً وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ الجَاهِلُونَ قَالُواْ سَلاَماً
metadata.Tafsir: (The (faithful) slaves of the Beneficent) the elite of the Beneficent (are they who walk upon the earth modestly) with humility from the fear of Allah, (and when the foolish ones) the disbelievers and sinners (address them answer: Peace) they answer with that which is good and say only nice words;

translation: And the (faithful) slaves of the Most Gracious (Allâh) are those who walk on the earth in humility and sedateness, and when the foolish address them (with bad words) they reply back with mild words of gentleness.

metadata.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ يِبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّداً وَقِيَاماً
metadata.Tafsir: (And who spend the night before their Lord) praying, (prostrate and standing) in the night prayer,

translation: And those who spend the night in worship of their Lord, prostrate and standing.

metadata.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَاماً
metadata.Tafsir: (And who say: Our Lord!) O our Lord! (Avert from us the doom of hell; lo! the doom thereof is anguish) binding and persistent;

translation: And those who say: "Our Lord! Avert from us the torment of Hell. Verily its torment is ever an inseparable, permanent punishment."

metadata.arabic: إِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرّاً وَمُقَاماً
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! it is wretched as abode and station) dwelling;

translation: Evil indeed it (Hell) is as an abode and as a place to rest in.

metadata.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُواْ لَمْ يُسْرِفُواْ وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُواْ وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ قَوَاماً
metadata.Tafsir: Allah then mentioned their spending, saying: (And those who, when they spend, are neither prodigal) they are not prodigal with regard to transgression (nor grudging) they do not withhold that which is right; (and there is ever a firm station) a middle ground (between the two) between prodigality and being miserly;

translation: And those who, when they spend, are neither extravagant nor niggardly, but hold a medium (way) between those (extremes).

metadata.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ لاَ يَدْعُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا آخَرَ وَلاَ يَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِي حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلاَّ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلاَ يَزْنُونَ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَاماً
metadata.Tafsir: (And those who cry not unto) worship not (any other god along with Allah) among the idols, (nor take the life which Allah hath forbidden) to kill nor declare it lawful to be killed (save in (course of) justice) through stoning, retaliation or apostasy, (nor commit adultery) nor deem adultery lawful (and whoso doeth this) i.e. deem it lawful (shall pay the penalty) a valley in the Fire; and it is said: a well in the Fire;

translation: And those who invoke not any other ilâh (god) along with Allâh, nor kill such person as Allâh has forbidden, except for just cause, nor commit illegal sexual intercourse - and whoever does this shall receive the punishment.

metadata.arabic: يُضَاعَفْ لَهُ ٱلْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيامَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِيهِ مُهَاناً
metadata.Tafsir: (The doom will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein) in the doom (disdained) humiliated (for ever;

translation: The torment will be doubled to him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein in disgrace;

metadata.arabic: إِلاَّ مَن تَابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلاً صَالِحاً فَأُوْلَـٰئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ حَسَنَاتٍ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُوراً رَّحِيماً
metadata.Tafsir: Save him who repenteth) from his disbelief (and believeth) in Allah (and doth righteous work) sincerely after he accepts faith; (as for such, Allah will change their evil deeds to good deeds) Allah will change them from the state of disbelief to the state of faith, from disobedience to obedience, from the worship of idols to His worship, and from evil to goodness. (Allah is ever Forgiving) He forgives whoever repents, (Merciful) He shows mercy towards whoever dies in a state of repentance.

translation: Except those who repent and believe (in Islâmic Monotheism), and do righteous deeds; for those, Allâh will change their sins into good deeds, and Allâh is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

metadata.arabic: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحاً فَإِنَّهُ يَتُوبُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَتاباً
metadata.Tafsir: (And whosoever repenteth) from sins (and does good) sincerely between him and his Lord, (he verily repenteth towards Allah with true repentance) he will find the reward of this with his Lord.

translation: And whosoever repents and does righteous good deeds; then verily, he repents towards Allâh with true repentance.

metadata.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ لاَ يَشْهَدُونَ الزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّواْ بِاللَّغْوِ مَرُّوا كِراماً
metadata.Tafsir: (And those who will not witness vanity) those who do not attend the sessions of false testimony, (but when they pass near senseless play) the assemblies of falsehood, (pass by with dignity) they avoid them out of clemency.

translation: And those who do not bear witness to falsehood, and if they pass by some evil play or evil talk, they pass by it with dignity.

metadata.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُواْ بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّواْ عَلَيْهَا صُمّاً وَعُمْيَاناً
metadata.Tafsir: (And those who, when they are reminded of) admonished about (the revelations of their Lord, fall not deaf) unable to hear (and blind) unable to see while being very capable of hearing and seeing (thereat) the signs of Allah.

translation: And those who, when they are reminded of the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of their Lord, fall not deaf and blind thereat.

metadata.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَاماً
metadata.Tafsir: (And who say: Our Lord!) O our Lord! (Vouchsafe us comfort of our wives and of our offspring) make our wives and offspring righteous so that we may find comfort in them, (and make us patterns for (all) those who ward off (evil)) make us righteous so that they emulate us.

translation: And those who say: "Our Lord! Bestow on us from our wives and our offspring the comfort of our eyes, and make us leaders of the Muttaqûn(the pious. See V.2:2)."

metadata.arabic: أُوْلَـٰئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ ٱلْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُواْ وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةً وَسَلاَماً
metadata.Tafsir: (They) those who have such traits (will be awarded the high place) the highest ranks in Paradise (forasmuch as they were steadfast) in obedience of Allah and in bearing poverty and misfortune, (and they will meet therein) in Paradise (with welcome) from Allah (and the word of peace) the angels will meet them in Paradise with greeting and peace from Allah,

translation: Those will be rewarded with the highest place (in Paradise) because of their patience. Therein they shall be met with greetings and the word of peace and respect.

metadata.arabic: خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرّاً وَمُقَاماً
metadata.Tafsir: (Abiding there for ever) they will remain in Paradise for ever, neither to die nor leave. (Happy is it as abode) as habitation (and station!) and dwelling!

translation: Abiding therein - excellent it is as an abode, and as a place to rest in.

metadata.arabic: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَأُ بِكُمْ رَبِّي لَوْلاَ دُعَآؤُكُمْ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَاماً
metadata.Tafsir: (Say) O Muhammad, to the disbelievers of Mecca: (My Lord would not concern himself with you) what would my Lord do with your bodies and forms (but for your prayer) if He commands you to profess Allah's divine Oneness. (But now ye have denied) you have disbelieved in Muhammad (pbuh) and in the Qur'an, (therefore) this is a threat to them from Allah (there will be judgement) the punishment of the Day of Badr through beating, killing and enslaving them; this is to say: you have disbelieved in your Prophet and, therefore, the chastisement must necessarily befall you'.

translation: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم to the disbelievers): "My Lord pays attention to you only because of your invocation to Him. But now you have indeed denied (Him). So the torment will be yours for ever (inseparable, permanent punishment)."

metadata.arabic: طسۤمۤ
metadata.Tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said about the interpretation of Allah's saying (Ta. Sin. Mim.): '(Ta. Sin. Mim.) He says: Ta stands for His might (tawluh) and power, Sin stands for His majesty (sana'uh), and Mim stands for His dominion (mulkuh); it is also said that (Ta. Sin. Mim.) is an oath by which Allah swore.

translation: Tâ-Sîn-Mîm.

metadata.arabic: تِلْكَ آيَاتُ ٱلْكِتَابِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (These are revelations of the Scripture that maketh plain) He says: I swear by this surah, the verses of the Qur'an, which make plain the lawful and the unlawful, the commands and prohibitions.

translation: These are the Verses of the manifest Book [(this Qur’ân), which was promised by Allâh in the Taurât (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel), makes things clear].

metadata.arabic: لَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ أَلاَّ يَكُونُواْ مُؤْمِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (It may be that thou tormentest thyself) it may be that you kill yourself with grief over them (because they believe not) because the Quraysh do not want to become believers. This is because he was very keen for them to become believers.

translation: It may be that you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are going to kill yourself with grief, that they do not become believers [in your Risalah (Messengership) i.e. in your Message of Islâmic Monotheism].

metadata.arabic: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِمْ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ آيَةً فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَاقُهُمْ لَهَا خَاضِعِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (If We will, We can send down on them from the sky a portent) a sign (so that their necks would remain bowed before it) in humiliation.

translation: If We will, We could send down to them from the heaven a sign, to which they would bend their necks in humility.

metadata.arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلاَّ كَانُواْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Never cometh there unto them a fresh) i.e. fresh in its coming, in succession (reminder) never did Gabriel bring revelation of the Qur'an to their Prophet (from the Beneficent One, but they turn away from it) except that they disbelieved in the Qur'an.

translation: And never comes there unto them a Reminder as a recent revelation from the Most Gracious (Allâh), but they turn away therefrom.

metadata.arabic: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُواْ فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنبَاءُ مَا كَانُواْ بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Now they have denied) Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an; (but there will come unto them tidings) the news (of that whereat they used to scoff) of chastisement; it is also said that this means: there will come to them the news of their derision of Muhammad (pbuh) and of the Qur'an.

translation: So they have indeed denied (the truth - this Qur’ân), then the news of what they mocked at will come to them.

metadata.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْاْ إِلَى ٱلأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Have they) the disbelievers of Mecca (not seen the earth, how much of every fruitful kind We make to grow therein?)

translation: Do they not observe the earth - how much of every good kind We cause to grow therein?

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّؤْمِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! Herein) in the different kinds of fruit (is indeed a portent) a sign and an admonition; (yet most of them are not believers) they were not believers, and all of them were disbelievers, i.e. those who perished at Badr.

translation: Verily, in this is an Ayâh (proof or sign), yet most of them (polytheists, pagans who do not believe in Resurrection) are not believers.

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty) in retribution against the disbelievers, (the Merciful) towards the believers.

translation: And verily your Lord, He is truly the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

metadata.arabic: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And when thy Lord called Moses) it is also said that this means: and when your Lord commanded Moses, (saying: Go unto the wrong-doing folk) the disbelieving folk,

translation: And (remember) when your Lord called Mûsâ (Moses) (saying): "Go to the people who are Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers) -

metadata.arabic: قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ أَلا يَتَّقُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (The folk of Pharaoh. Will they not ward off (evil)) and tell: will they not ward off the worship of other than Allah?

translation: "The people of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh): Will they not fear Allâh and become righteous?"

metadata.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّيۤ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
metadata.Tafsir: (He said) Moses said: (My Lord! Lo! I fear that they will deny me) I fear that they will disbelieve in the message I bring to them,

translation: He said: "My Lord! Verily, I fear that they will belie me,

metadata.arabic: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِي وَلاَ يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِي فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَارُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And I shall be embarrassed) because of their denial; it is also said that this means: and my heart will shrink from delivering the message, (and my tongue will not speak plainly) out of awe of him, (therefore send for Aaron (to help me)) send Aaron with me to support me; it is also said that this means: send Gabriel to Aaron so that he helps me.

translation: "And my breast straitens, and my tongue expresses not well. So send for Hârûn (Aaron) (to come along with me).

metadata.arabic: وَلَهُمْ عَلَيَّ ذَنبٌ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And they have a crime against me) they may retaliate against me because I killed the Copt, (so I fear that they will kill me) because of this Copt that I killed.

translation: "And they have a charge of crime against me, and I fear they will kill me."

metadata.arabic: قَالَ كَلاَّ فَٱذْهَبَا بِآيَاتِنَآ إِنَّا مَعَكُمْ مُّسْتَمِعُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (He said) Allah said: (Nay, verily) I will not set them against you to kill you. (So go ye twain with Our tokens) with Our nine signs: the hand, the staff, the flood, the locusts, the lice, the frogs, blood, the lack of foodstuff and drought. (Lo! We shall be with you) We shall help you, (Hearing) what he says to you.

translation: (Allâh) said: "Nay! Go you both with Our Signs. Verily We shall be with you, listening.

metadata.arabic: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولاۤ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And come together unto Pharaoh and say: Lo! we bear a message of the Lord of the Worlds) to you and to your people,

translation: "And go both of you to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), and say: ‘We are the Messengers of the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists),

metadata.arabic: أَنْ أَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِيۤ إِسْرَائِيلَ
metadata.Tafsir: ((Saying): Let the Children of Israel go with Us) and do not torture them.

translation: "So allow the Children of Israel to go with us.’ "

metadata.arabic: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيداً وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (He said): Pharaoh looked at Moses and said: (Did we not rear thee among us as a child?) O Moses (And thou didst dwell many years of your life among us) and stayed with us for 30 years,

translation: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said [to Mûsâ (Moses)]: "Did we not bring you up among us as a child? And you did dwell many years of your life with us.

metadata.arabic: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِي فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَافِرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And thou didst that thy deed which thou didst) and you killed the person that you killed, (and thou wast one of the ingrates) and you are now ungrateful for my kindness,

translation: "And you did your deed, which you did (i.e. the crime of killing a man) while you were one of the ingrates."

metadata.arabic: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذاً وَأَنَاْ مِنَ ٱلضَّالِّينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (He said) Moses said: (I did it then, when I was of those who are astray) when I was ungrateful for your kindness.

translation: Mûsâ (Moses) said: "I did it then, when I was ignorant (as regards my Lord and His Message).

metadata.arabic: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِي رَبِّي حُكْماً وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then I fled from you when I feared you) when I feared that you would kill me, (and my Lord vouchsafed me a command) understanding, knowledge and prophethood (and appointed me (of the number) of those sent (by Him)) He made me a Messenger to you and to your people.

translation: "So I fled from you when I feared you. But my Lord has granted me Hukm (i.e. religious knowledge, right judgement of the affairs and Prophethood), and made me one of the Messengers.

metadata.arabic: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And this is the past favour wherewith) with which (thou reproachest me) O Pharaoh, but you do not recall your aloofness towards me: (that thou hast enslaved the Children of Israel.

translation: "And this is the past favour with which you reproach me: that you have enslaved the Children of Israel."

metadata.arabic: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَا رَبُّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Pharaoh said) to Moses: (And what is the Lord of the Worlds) who is the Lord of the Worlds? Is it me you are referring to?

translation: Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) said: "And what is the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)?"

metadata.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِن كُنتُمْ مُّوقِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: ((Moses) said: Lord of the heavens and the earth) the Lord of the Worlds is the Lord of the heavens and the earth (and all that is between them) of created beings and marvels, (if ye had but sure belief) that Allah has created them.

translation: [Mûsâ (Moses)] said: "The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, if you seek to be convinced with certainty."

metadata.arabic: قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهُ أَلاَ تَسْتَمِعُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: ((Pharaoh) said unto those around him) of attendants: (Hear ye not) what Moses says? There were around Pharaoh at that time 250 men wearing attires made of silk brocade plaited with gold. These men were Pharaoh's closest courtiers, and they asked Moses: who is this Lord of the heavens and the earth to whom you are calling us?

translation: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said to those around: "Do you not hear (what he says)?"

metadata.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ آبَآئِكُمُ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (He said) Moses said: (Your Lord) He is your Lord (and the Lord of your fathers.

translation: [Mûsâ (Moses)] said: "Your Lord and the Lord of your ancient fathers!"

metadata.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِيۤ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Pharaoh) said: Lo! your messenger who hath been sent unto you is indeed a madman!) They said: who is this that you are calling us to? And who is this Lord of ours who is also the Lord of our fathers, O Moses?

translation: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said: "Verily, your Messenger who has been sent to you is a madman!"

metadata.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (He said) Moses said: (Lord of the East) He is the Lord of the East (and the West) and the Lord of the West (and all that is between them, if ye did but understand) if you did but believe.

translation: [Mûsâ (Moses)] said: "Lord of the east and the west, and all that is between them, if you did but understand!"

metadata.arabic: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذْتَ إِلَـٰهَاً غَيْرِي لأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَسْجُونِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: ((Pharaoh) said: If thou choosest) if you worship (a god other than me) O Moses, (I assuredly shall place thee among the prisoners) his prisons were worse than death, for he used to put people in complete isolation, unable to see or hear anyone.

translation: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said: "If you choose an ilâh (god) other than me, I will certainly put you among the prisoners."

metadata.arabic: قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكَ بِشَيءٍ مُّبِينٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (He said) Moses said: (Even though I show thee) O Pharaoh (something plain) a sign that serves as proof for what I say?

translation: [Mûsâ (Moses)] said: "Even if I bring you something manifest (and convincing)?"

metadata.arabic: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّادِقِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: ((Pharaoh) said: Produce it then) O Moses, (if thou art of the Truthful) that you are a Messenger to me and to my people!

translation: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said: "Bring it forth then, if you are of the truthful!"

metadata.arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then he) Moses (flung down his staff and it became a serpent) a yellow, male serpent (manifest) as huge as any serpent can be,

translation: So [Mûsâ (Moses)] threw his stick, and behold, it was a serpent, manifest.

metadata.arabic: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّاظِرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: Pharaoh then said: “this is a manifest sign, do you have any other signs?” (And he drew forth his hand) from his armpit (and lo! it was white to the beholders) his hand had a light like the light of the sun, and whoever looked at it liked it.

translation: And he drew out his hand, and behold, it was white to all beholders!

metadata.arabic: قَالَ لِلْمَلإِ حَوْلَهُ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَسَاحِرٌ عَلِيمٌ
metadata.Tafsir: ((Pharaoh) said unto the chiefs about him: Lo, this) messenger (is verily a knowing wizard) who is very skilful in magic,

translation: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said to the chiefs around him: "Verily! This is indeed a well-versed sorcerer.

metadata.arabic: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُمْ مِّنْ أَرْضِكُمْ بِسِحْرِهِ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Who would drive you out of your land) Egypt (by his magic. Now what counsel ye) what do you suggest that I should do?

translation: "He wants to drive you out of your land by his sorcery: what is it then that you command?"

metadata.arabic: قَالُوۤاْ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِي ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَاشِرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (They said: Put him off) retain him, ((him) and his brother) and do not kill them, (and send them) i.e. the police (into the cities) the cities where the wizards are found (summoners) to summon these wizards,

translation: They said: "Put him off and his brother (for a while), and send callers to the cities;

metadata.arabic: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Who shall bring unto thee every knowing wizard) who is skilful in magic so that they can do what Moses did.

translation: "To bring up to you every well-versed sorcerer."

metadata.arabic: فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَاتِ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (So the wizards were gathered together) there were 72 of them (at a set time on a day appointed) which was the day of the market, and it also said that it was the day of their festival, and it is also said that it was the day of their new year.

translation: So the sorcerers were assembled at a fixed time on a day appointed.

metadata.arabic: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنتُمْ مُّجْتَمِعُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And it was said unto the people: Are ye (also) gathering?

translation: And it was said to the people: "Are you (too) going to assemble?

metadata.arabic: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلْغَالِبِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (They said): Aye, so that we may follow the wizards) that we may follow the religion of the wizards (if they are the winners) against Moses.

translation: "That we may follow the sorcerers [who were on Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) religion of disbelief] if they are the winners."

metadata.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُواْ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَإِنَّ لَنَا لأَجْراً إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَالِبِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And when the wizards came they said unto Pharaoh: Will there surely be a reward for us if we are the winners) against Moses?

translation: So when the sorcerers arrived, they said to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh): "Will there surely be a reward for us if we are the winners?"

metadata.arabic: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذاً لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (He said) Pharaoh said: (Aye) you will have that, (and ye will then surely be of those brought near) in terms of status, position and attending my assembly.

translation: He said: "Yes, and you shall then verily be of those brought near (to myself)."

metadata.arabic: قَالَ لَهُمْ مُّوسَىٰ أَلْقُواْ مَآ أَنتُمْ مُّلْقُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Moses said unto them) he said to the wizards: (Throw what ye are going to throw!

translation: Mûsâ (Moses) said to them: "Throw what you are going to throw!"

metadata.arabic: فَأَلْقَوْاْ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُواْ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَونَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَالِبُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: Then they threw down their cords and their staves) 72 ropes and 72 staffs (and said) i.e. the wizards said: (By Pharaoh's might, lo! we verily are the winners) against Moses.

translation: So they threw their ropes and their sticks, and said: "By the might of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), it is we who will certainly win!"

metadata.arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then Moses threw his staff and lo! it swallowed that which they did falsely show) of wizardry.

translation: Then Mûsâ (Moses) threw his stick, and behold, it swallowed up all that they falsely showed!

metadata.arabic: فَأُلْقِيَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَاجِدِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And the wizards were flung prostrate) they fell prostrate so fast that it looked that they were thrown to the floor, because when they saw their ropes and staffs disappear, they knew that what Moses brought was from Allah,

translation: And the sorcerers fell down prostrate.

metadata.arabic: قَالُواْ آمَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Crying: We believe in the Lord of the Worlds) upon which Pharaoh said: are you referring to me?

translation: Saying: "We believe in the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

metadata.arabic: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: They said: (The Lord of Moses and Aaron.

translation: "The Lord of Mûsâ (Moses) and Hârûn (Aaron)."

metadata.arabic: قَالَ آمَنتُمْ لَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ آذَنَ لَكُمْ إِنَّهُ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ لأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُمْ مِّنْ خِلاَفٍ وَلأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Pharaoh) said, You put your faith in him) you believed in him (before I give you leave) I commanded you to do so. (Lo! He) i.e. Moses (doubtless is your chief) your master wizard (who taught you magic! But verily ye shall come to know) what I will do to you. (Verily I will cut off your hands and your feet alternately) the right hand with the left leg, (and verily I will crucify you everyone) on the bank of the river of Egypt.

translation: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said: "You have believed in him before I give you leave. Surely, he indeed is your chief, who has taught you magic! So verily, you shall come to know. Verily, I will cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you all."

metadata.arabic: قَالُواْ لاَ ضَيْرَ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (They said: It is no hurt) what you do with us in this worldly life will not harm us in the Hereafter, (for lo! unto our Lord we shall return) we shall return to Allah and His reward.

translation: They said: "No harm! Surely, to our Lord (Allâh) we are to return.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَايَانَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! we ardently hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins) our idolatry (because we are the first of the believers) in Moses.

translation: "Verily we really hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins, as we are the first of the believers [in Mûsâ (Moses) and in the Monotheism which he has brought from Allâh]."

metadata.arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِيۤ إِنَّكُم مّتَّبَعُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And We inspired Moses, saying: Take away My slaves by night) take by night whoever believes in you from among the Children of Israel, (for ye will be pursued) Pharaoh and his people will catch up with you.

translation: And We revealed to Mûsâ (Moses), saying: "Depart by night with My slaves, verily you will be pursued."

metadata.arabic: فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَونُ فِي ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَاشِرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then Pharaoh sent into the cities summoners) he summoned his police force,

translation: Then Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) sent callers to (all) the cities.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰؤُلاۤءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِيلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: ((Who said): Lo! These) the followers of Moses (indeed are but a little troop) a small group,

translation: (Saying): "Verily these indeed are but a small band.

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo! they are offenders against us) they have caused our fury and anger.

translation: "And verily, they have done what has enraged us.

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَاذِرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo! we are a ready host) we are in doubt, and we will supply weapons.

translation: "But we are a host all assembled, amply fore-warned."

metadata.arabic: فَأَخْرَجْنَاهُمْ مِّن جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Thus did We take them away from gardens and water springs) pure water,

translation: So, We expelled them from gardens and springs,

metadata.arabic: وَكُنُوزٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And treasures) wealth (and a fair estate) beautiful houses.

translation: Treasures, and every kind of honourable place.

metadata.arabic: كَذَلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَاهَا بَنِيۤ إِسْرَائِيلَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Thus) I do with the ones who disobey Me, (and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit them) to inherit Egypt after their destruction.

translation: Thus [We turned them (Pharaoh’s people) out] and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit them.

metadata.arabic: فَأَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And they overtook them at sunrise.

translation: So they pursued them at sunrise.

metadata.arabic: فَلَمَّا تَرَاءَى ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَابُ مُوسَىٰ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And when the two hosts) the group of Moses and that of Pharaoh (saw each other, those with Moses said: Lo! we are indeed caught) O Moses, they have caught up with us.

translation: And when the two hosts saw each other, the companions of Mûsâ (Moses) said: "We are sure to be overtaken."

metadata.arabic: قَالَ كَلاَّ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (He said) Moses said: (Nay) they have not, (verily! for lo! my Lord is with me. He will guide me) He will save me from them and guide me to the right way.

translation: [Mûsâ (Moses)] said: "Nay, verily with me is my Lord. He will guide me."

metadata.arabic: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then We inspired Moses, saying: Smite the sea with thy staff. And) when he hit it (it parted) into 12 roads, (and each part) and each road (was as a mountain vast) like a huge mountain.

translation: Then We revealed to Mûsâ (Moses) (saying): "Strike the sea with your stick." And it parted, and each separate part (of that sea water) became like huge mountain.

metadata.arabic: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ ٱلآخَرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then brought We near the others to that place) then We kept Pharaoh and his people in the cloud, and it is said in the sea, and all of them were disbelievers.

translation: Then We brought near the others [Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) party] to that place.

metadata.arabic: وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And We saved Moses and those with him, every one) from drowning;

translation: And We saved Mûsâ (Moses) and all those with him.

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلآخَرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (We drowned the others) Pharaoh and his host in the sea.

translation: Then We drowned the others.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! Herein) in that which We did to them (is indeed a portent) a sign and an admonition, (yet most of them are not believers) most of them were not believers.

translation: Verily in this is indeed a sign (or a proof), yet most of them are not believers.

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty) in retribution against the disbelievers, (the Merciful) towards the believers, since He saved them from drowning.

translation: And verily your Lord, He is truly the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

metadata.arabic: وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Recite unto them) unto Quraysh, your people (the story of Abraham) the event of Abraham in the Qur'an:

translation: And recite to them the story of Ibrâhîm (Abraham).

metadata.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (When he said unto his father) Azar (and his folk) the idol worshippers: (What worship ye) Abraham said to them: what do you worship?

translation: When he said to his father and his people: "What do you worship?"

metadata.arabic: قَالُواْ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَاماً فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَاكِفِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (They said: We worship idols) deities, (and are ever devoted unto them) we worship them and remain devoted to their worship.

translation: They said: "We worship idols, and to them we are ever devoted."

metadata.arabic: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (He said) Abraham said to them: (Do they hear you when ye cry) do these deities answer you when you call upon them?

translation: He said: "Do they hear you, when you call on (them)?

metadata.arabic: أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Or do they benefit) you in your livelihood when you obey them (or harm you) in your livelihood when you disobey them?

translation: "Or do they benefit you or do they harm (you)?"

metadata.arabic: قَالُواْ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ آبَآءَنَا كَذَلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (They said: Nay, but we found our fathers acting on this use) we found our fathers worshipping these deities, and we have emulated them.

translation: They said: "(Nay) but we found our fathers doing so."

metadata.arabic: قَالَ أَفَرَأَيْتُمْ مَّا كُنْتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (He said) Abraham said: (See now that which ye worship,

translation: He said: "Do you observe that which you have been worshipping -

metadata.arabic: أَنتُمْ وَآبَآؤُكُمُ ٱلأَقْدَمُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: Ye and your forefathers!) before you,

translation: "You and your ancient fathers?

metadata.arabic: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِيۤ إِلاَّ رَبَّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: Lo! they are (all) an enemy unto me) and I disassociate myself from them, (save the Lord of the Worlds) except the worship of the Lord of the Worlds.

translation: "Verily they are enemies to me, save the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists),

metadata.arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَنِي فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Who created me) from a sperm drop, (and He doth guide me) He preserves me on the right religion and guides me to the Truth and guidance,

translation: "Who has created me, and it is He Who guides me.

metadata.arabic: وَٱلَّذِي هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِي وَيَسْقِينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And Who feedeth me) He provides for me and gives me my full when I am hungry (and watereth me) and gives me to drink when I am thirsty.

translation: "And it is He Who feeds me and gives me to drink.

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And when I sicken, then He healeth me) He cures me from sickness when I am sick,

translation: "And when I am ill, it is He who cures me.

metadata.arabic: وَٱلَّذِي يُمِيتُنِي ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And Who causeth me to die) in this worldly life, (then giveth me life (again)) on the Day of Judgement,

translation: "And Who will cause me to die, and then will bring me to life (again).

metadata.arabic: وَٱلَّذِيۤ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِي خَطِيئَتِي يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And Who, I ardently hope, will forgive me my sin on the Day of Judgement) on the Day of Reckoning. His sins being his pretending that he was sick, and claiming that it was the biggest idol that smashed the smaller ones and also that his wife was his sister.

translation: "And Who, I hope, will forgive me my faults on the Day of Recompense, (the Day of Resurrection).

metadata.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْماً وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِٱلصَّالِحِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (My Lord! Vouchsafe me wisdom) understanding and knowledge (and unite me to the righteous) to my forefathers, the messengers, in Paradise.

translation: My Lord! Bestow Hukm (religious knowledge, right judgement of the affairs and Prophethood) on me, and join me with the righteous.

metadata.arabic: وَٱجْعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي ٱلآخِرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And give unto me a good report) a good mention (in later generations) those who come after me.

translation: And grant me an honourable mention in later generations.

metadata.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْنِي مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Delight) and make me among the dwellers of the Garden of Bliss,

translation: And make me one of the inheritors of the Paradise of Delight.

metadata.arabic: وَٱغْفِرْ لأَبِيۤ إِنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And forgive my father) and guide my father through me. (Lo! he is of those who err) he is in error, a disbeliever.

translation: And forgive my father, verily he is of the erring.

metadata.arabic: وَلاَ تُخْزِنِي يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And abase me not) and do not chastise me (on the day when they are raised) from the graves,

translation: And disgrace me not on the Day when (all the creatures) will be resurrected.

metadata.arabic: يَوْمَ لاَ يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلاَ بَنُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (The day when wealth) the abundance of wealth (and sons) and abundance of sons (avail not (any man),

translation: The Day whereon neither wealth nor sons will avail,

metadata.arabic: إِلاَّ مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: Save him who bringeth unto Allah a whole heart) a heart free of sins and love for this worldly life; it is also said that this means: a heart free of hatred for the Companions of the Prophet (pbuh).

translation: Except him who brings to Allâh a clean heart [clean from Shirk (polytheism) and Nifâq (hypocrisy)]."

metadata.arabic: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And the Garden will be brought nigh for those who ward off (evil)) disbelief, idolatry, and indecencies, becoming thus their abode.

translation: And Paradise will be brought near to the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2).

metadata.arabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And hell will appear plainly to the erring) to the disbelievers, becoming thus their abode.

translation: And the (Hell) Fire will be placed in full view of the erring.

metadata.arabic: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And it will be said unto them) it will be said to the idol worshippers: (Where is (all) that ye used to worship) of idols in the life of the world,

translation: And it will be said to them: "Where are those (the false gods whom you used to set up as rivals with Allâh) that you used to worship.

metadata.arabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Instead of Allah? Can they help you) can they help you to avoid Allah's chastisement (or help themselves) or help themselves to avoid Allah's chastisement?

translation: "Instead of Allâh? Can they help you or (even) help themselves?"

metadata.arabic: فَكُبْكِبُواْ فِيهَا هُمْ وَٱلْغَاوُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then they will be hurled therein) they will be cast all together in hell, (they) the disbelievers of Mecca and all the disbelievers among human beings (and the seducers) the disbelievers of the jinn and their deities,

translation: Then they will be thrown on their faces into the (Fire), they and the Ghâwûn (devils, and those who were in error).

metadata.arabic: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And the hosts of Iblis) the offspring of Iblis, (together) who are the satans.

translation: And the whole hosts of Iblîs (Satan) together.

metadata.arabic: قَالُواْ وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And they) i.e. the disbelievers (will say, when they are quarrelling) with their deities, leaders and the offspring of Iblis (therein) in hell:

translation: They will say while contending therein,

metadata.arabic: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِي ضَلاَلٍ مُّبِينٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (By Allah, of a truth we were in error manifest) in the life of the world,

translation: By Allâh, we were truly in a manifest error,

metadata.arabic: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُمْ بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (When we made you equal with the Lord of the Worlds) in relation to worship.

translation: When We held you (false gods) as equals (in worship) with the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists);

metadata.arabic: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلاَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (It was but the guilty) the idolaters who came before us and whom we emulated (who misled us) who turned us away from faith and obedience.

translation: And none has brought us into error except the Mujrimûn [Iblîs (Satan) and those of human beings who commit crimes, murderers, polytheists, oppressors].

metadata.arabic: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَافِعِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Now we have no intercessors) from amongst the angels, prophets or righteous people who may intercede for us,

translation: Now we have no intercessors,

metadata.arabic: وَلاَ صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Nor any loving friend) nor anyone close who might be interested in our plight.

translation: Nor a close friend (to help us).

metadata.arabic: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Oh, that we had another turn) in the life of the world, (that we might be of the believers!

translation: (Alas!) If we only had a chance to return (to the world), we shall truly be among the believers!

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: Lo! Herein) in that which I have mentioned of their states (is indeed a portent) a sign and an admonition, (yet most of them are not believers!) that is, if they were to have another turn in the life of the world; it is also said that this means: they were not believers and most of them were disbelievers.

translation: Verily in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo, thy Lord! He is Indeed the Mighty) in retribution against them, (the Merciful) towards the believers.

translation: And verily, your Lord, He is truly the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

metadata.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Noah's folk denied the messengers (of Allah)) i.e. they denied Noah and all the other messengers who were mentioned by Noah,

translation: The people of Nûh (Noah) belied the Messengers.

metadata.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلاَ تَتَّقُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (When their brother) their Prophet; he was not their brother in religion but only in kinship (Noah said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)) the worship of other than Allah?

translation: When their brother Nûh (Noah) said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh and obey Him?

metadata.arabic: إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! I am a faithful messenger) faithful in conveying the message; it is also said that this means: I was deemed very trustworthy in your eyes before this, so how could you doubt me today, (unto you) from Allah,

translation: "I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

metadata.arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
metadata.Tafsir: (So keep your duty to Allah) so fear Allah regarding that which He has commanded you of repentance and faith, (and obey me) and follow my way and religion.

translation: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

metadata.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلاَّ عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And I ask of you no wage) no provision (therefore) in exchange for the profession of Allah's divine Oneness; (my wage) my provision (is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

translation: "No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islâmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

metadata.arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
metadata.Tafsir: So keep your duty to Allah) so fear Allah regarding that which He has commanded you of repentance and faith, (and obey me) and follow my advice.

translation: "So keep your duty to Allâh, fear Him and obey me."

metadata.arabic: قَالُوۤاْ أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلأَرْذَلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (They said: Shall we put faith in thee) shall we believe in you, O Noah, (when the lowest (of the people) follow thee) when our most lowly and weak have followed you? We will not believe in you until you repulse them.

translation: They said: "Shall we believe in you, when the meanest (of the people) follow you?"

metadata.arabic: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِي بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (He said) Noah said: (And what knowledge have I of what they may have been doing (in the past)) I do not know whether it is you or them who will agree with me?

translation: He said: "And what knowledge have I of what they used to do?

metadata.arabic: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلاَّ عَلَىٰ رَبِّي لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! their reckoning) their reward and sustenance (is my Lord's concern, if ye but knew) this;

translation: "Their account is only with my Lord, if you could (but) know.

metadata.arabic: وَمَآ أَنَاْ بِطَارِدِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And I am not (here) to repulse believers) from the worship of Allah.

translation: "And I am not going to drive away the believers.

metadata.arabic: إِنْ أَنَا إِلاَّ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (I am only a plain warner) I am only a Messenger warning you of a curse that you know well.

translation: I am only a plain warner."

metadata.arabic: قَالُواْ لَئِنْ لَّمْ تَنْتَهِ يٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (They said: If thou cease not) from what you are saying, (O Noah, thou wilt surely be among those stoned (to death)) we will kill you just as we killed the strangers who believed in you.

translation: They said: "If you cease not, O Nûh (Noah) you will surely be among those stoned (to death)."

metadata.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِي كَذَّبُونِ
metadata.Tafsir: (He said) Noah said: (My Lord! Lo! my own folk deny me) regarding the message, and have killed those strangers who believed in me.

translation: He said: "My Lord! Verily, my people have belied me.

metadata.arabic: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحاً وَنَجِّنِي وَمَن مَّعِي مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Therefore judge Thou between us, a (conclusive) judgement) a fair judgement, (and save me and those believers who are with me) from their torment.

translation: Therefore judge You between me and them, and save me and those of the believers who are with me."

metadata.arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَاهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُ فِي ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And We saved him and those with him) among the believers (in the laden ship) and it was only waiting to sail away.

translation: And We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then afterward We drowned the others) i.e. the rest of his people, after Noah boarded the ship.

translation: Then We drowned the rest (disbelievers) thereafter.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! Herein) in that which We did with them (is indeed a portent) a sign and an admonition to those who came after them, (yet most of them are not believers) they were not believers and most of them were disbelievers.

translation: Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo, thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty) in retribution against them when He drowned them, (the Merciful) towards the believers when He saved them from drowning.

translation: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

metadata.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: ((The tribe of) 'Aad denied the messengers (of Allah)) the people of Hud denied Hud as well as all the messenger whom Hud had mentioned to them,

translation: ‘Âd (people) belied the Messengers.

metadata.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلاَ تَتَّقُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (When their brother) their Prophet (Hud said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)) the worship of other than Allah?

translation: When their brother Hûd said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh and obey Him?

metadata.arabic: إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! I am a faithful messenger) I am faithful regarding the message (unto you) from Allah,

translation: "Verily I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

metadata.arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
metadata.Tafsir: (So keep your duty to Allah) so obey Allah regarding that which He has commanded you of repentance and faith (and obey me) in that which I command you.

translation: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

metadata.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلاَّ عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And I ask of you no wage) no payment (therefore) for professing Allah's divine Oneness; (my wage) my reward (is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

translation: "No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islâmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn, and all that exists).

metadata.arabic: أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ آيَةً تَعْبَثُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: Build ye on every high place a monument for vain delight?) you beat up any stranger who passes by you and steal his clothes; this can also be understood in this manner: do you build in every marketplace a sign by means of which you scoff at whoever passes by you?

translation: "Do you build high palaces on every high place, while you do not live in them?

metadata.arabic: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And seek ye out strongholds) houses, palaces and pools, (that haply ye may last for ever) in this worldly life? Nay, you will not last for ever!

translation: "And do you get for yourselves palaces (fine buildings) as if you will live therein for ever.

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُمْ بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And if ye seize by force, seize ye as tyrants?) And when you punish, you do so in the manner of the tyrants: you beat up and kill in a state of anger.

translation: "And when you seize (somebody), seize you (him) as tyrants?

metadata.arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Rather keep your duty to Allah) rather, fear Allah regarding that which He has commanded you of repentance and faith, (and obey me) and follow my way.

translation: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

metadata.arabic: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱلَّذِيۤ أَمَدَّكُمْ بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Keep your duty towards Him) fear Him (who hath aided) provided (you with (the good things) that ye know),

translation: "And keep your duty to Him, fear Him Who has aided you with all (good things) that you know.

metadata.arabic: أَمَدَّكُمْ بِأَنْعَامٍ وَبَنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: Then He explained what He provided them with, saying: (Hath aided ye with cattle and sons) He gave you cattle and sons.

translation: "He has aided you with cattle and children.

metadata.arabic: وَجَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And gardens and water springs) and pure water.

translation: "And gardens and springs.

metadata.arabic: إِنِّيۤ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! I fear for you) I know you will be visited by (the retribution of an awful day) in the Fire, if you do not repent of disbelief, idolatry and idol worship.

translation: "Verily, I fear for you the torment of a Great Day."

metadata.arabic: قَالُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُنْ مِّنَ ٱلْوَاعِظِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (They said: It is all one to us whether thou preachest) you warn us (or art not of those who preach) or you are a warner to us;

translation: They said: "It is the same to us whether you preach or be not of those who preach.

metadata.arabic: إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلاَّ خُلُقُ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (This) that in which we are now (is but a fable of the men of old) the religion of the people of old; the religion of our forefathers; it is also said that this means: what you say is nothing but the invention of the people of old,

translation: "This is no other than the false tales and religion of the ancients, [Tafsir At-Tabarî]

metadata.arabic: وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And we shall not be doomed) for adhering to this religion, as you claim.

translation: "And we are not going to be punished."

metadata.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And they denied him) they disbelieved in his message and in what he said to them; (therefore We destroyed them) by the wind. (Lo! Herein) in that which We did to them (is indeed a portent) a sign and an admonition to those who came after them, (yet most of them are not believers) they were not believers and most of them were disbelievers.

translation: So they belied him, and We destroyed them. Verily in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty) in retribution against the disbelievers, (the Merciful) towards the believers, for He saved them from the wind.

translation: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

metadata.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: ((The tribe of) Thamud denied the messengers (of Allah)) the people of Salih denied Salih just as they denied all the messengers that Salih mentioned to them.

translation: Thamûd (people) belied the Messengers.

metadata.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَالِحٌ أَلا تَتَّقُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (When their brother) their Prophet (Salih said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)) the worship of other than Allah?

translation: When their brother Sâlih said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh and obey Him?

metadata.arabic: إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you) I am a Messenger from Allah to you, and I am faithful as regards the message I bring,

translation: "I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

metadata.arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
metadata.Tafsir: (So keep your duty to Allah) so fear Allah regarding that which He commanded you of repentance and faith (and obey me) and follow my way and religion.

translation: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

metadata.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلاَّ عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And I ask of you no wage) no payment or provision (therefore) in exchange for the profession of Allah's divine Oneness; (my wage) my reward (is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

translation: "No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islâmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

metadata.arabic: أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِي مَا هَاهُنَآ آمِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: Will ye be left secure) from death, cessation or punishment (in that which is here before us) of bounties,

translation: "Will you be left secure in that which you have here?

metadata.arabic: فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (In gardens and water springs) pure water

translation: "In gardens and springs.

metadata.arabic: وَزُرُوعٍ وَنَخْلٍ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (And tilled fields and heavy sheathed palm-trees) bearing ripe and seemly fruits,

translation: And green crops (fields) and date-palms with soft spadix.

metadata.arabic: وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتاً فَارِهِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Though ye hew out dwellings in the mountain, being skilful?) it is also said that this means: feeling proud of, and haughty about, your farms.

translation: "And you hew out in the mountains, houses with great skill.

metadata.arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Therefore keep your duty to Allah) fear Allah regarding that which He commanded you (and obey me) and follow my way and advice,

translation: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

metadata.arabic: وَلاَ تُطِيعُوۤاْ أَمْرَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And obey not the command of the prodigal) and obey not the words of the idolaters,

translation: "And follow not the command of Al-Musrifûn [i.e. their chiefs: leaders who were polytheists, criminals and sinners],

metadata.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِي ٱلأَرْضِ وَلاَ يُصْلِحُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Who spread corruption in the earth) through disbelief, idolatry and calling to the worship of other than Allah, (and reform not) they do not command righteousness.
