translation: "Who make mischief in the land, and reform not."

metadata.arabic: قَالُوۤاْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (They said: thou art but one of the bewitched) you are neither an angel nor a prophet;

translation: They said: "You are only of those bewitched!

metadata.arabic: مَآ أَنتَ إِلاَّ بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِآيَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّادِقِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Thou art but a mortal) a human being (like us) you eat and drink just like we do. (So bring some token) a sign to prove what you claim (if thou art of the truthful) that the punishment is coming and that you are a Messenger to us.

translation: "You are but a human being like us. Then bring us a sign if you are of the truthful."

metadata.arabic: قَالَ هَـٰذِهِ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (He said) Salih said to them: ((Behold) this she-camel) she is a sign that I am sent as a prophet to you. (She hath the right to drink (at the well)) one day, (and ye have the right to drink) another day, ((each) on an appointed day) i.e. in alternate days: one day for you and one day for her.

translation: He said: "Here is a she-camel: it has a right to drink (water), and you have a right to drink (water) (each) on a day, known.

metadata.arabic: وَلاَ تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوۤءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And touch her not with ill) do not hamstrung her (lest there come on you the retribution of an awful day.

translation: "And touch her not with harm, lest the torment of a Great Day should seize you."

metadata.arabic: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُواْ نَادِمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: But they hamstrung her) they killed her, (and then were penitent) and they regretted killing her.

translation: But they killed her, and then they became regretful.

metadata.arabic: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (So the retribution came on them) after three days. (Lo! Herein) in that which We did to them (is indeed a portent) a sign and an admonition for those who came after them, (yet most of them are not believers) they were not believers and were all disbelievers.

translation: So the torment overtook them. Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo! thy Lord) O Muhammad! (He is indeed the Mighty) in retribution against the disbelievers, (the Merciful) towards the believers.

translation: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

metadata.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (The folk of Lot denied the messengers (of Allah)) the people of Lot denied Lot and they also denied all the messengers mentioned to them by Lot,

translation: The people of Lût (Lot) (-who dwelt in the town of Sodom in Palestine) belied the Messengers.

metadata.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلا تَتَّقُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (When their brother) their Prophet (Lot said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)) will you not ward off the worship of other than Allah?

translation: When their brother Lût (Lot) said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh and obey Him?

metadata.arabic: إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you) from Allah and I am faithful regarding the message I have brought to you,

translation: "Verily I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

metadata.arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
metadata.Tafsir: (So keep your duty to Allah) so fear Allah in that which He commanded you regarding repentance and faith (and obey me) follow my way and religion.

translation: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

metadata.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلاَّ عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And I ask of you no wage) no payment (therefore) for professing Allah's divine Oneness; (my wage) my reward (is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

translation: "No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islâmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

metadata.arabic: أَتَأْتُونَ ٱلذُّكْرَانَ مِنَ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: What! Of all creatures do ye come unto the males) for sexual intercourse,

translation: "Go you in unto the males of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind),

metadata.arabic: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ مِّنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And leave the wives) and avoid having sex with your wives (your Lord created for you) that your Lord made lawful for you? (Nay, but ye are froward folk) who transgress from the lawful to the unlawful.

translation: "And leave those whom Allâh has created for you to be your wives? Nay, you are a trespassing people!"

metadata.arabic: قَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْرَجِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (They said: If thou cease not, O Lot) from what you say, (thou wilt soon be of the outcast) you will be expelled from our land, Sodom.

translation: They said: "If you cease not O Lût (Lot)! verily, you will be one of those who are driven out!"

metadata.arabic: قَالَ إِنِّي لِعَمَلِكُمْ مِّنَ ٱلْقَالِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (He said) Lot said: (I am in truth of those who hate your conduct) your evil conduct.

translation: He said: "I am, indeed, of those who disapprove with severe anger and fury your (this evil) action (of sodomy).

metadata.arabic: رَبِّ نَّجِنِي وَأَهْلِي مِمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (My Lord! Save me and my household from what they do.

translation: "My Lord! Save me and my family from what they do."

metadata.arabic: فَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: So We saved him and his household, every one,

translation: So We saved him and his family, all,

metadata.arabic: إِلاَّ عَجُوزاً فِي ٱلْغَابِرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: Save an old woman) his hypocrite wife (among those who stayed behind) to be destroyed.

translation: Except an old woman (his wife) among those who remained behind.

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلآخَرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then afterward We destroyed the others) We destroyed the remainder of his people.

translation: Then afterward We destroyed the others.

metadata.arabic: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَراً فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And We rained on them) on their sodomites and travellers (a rain) of stones. (And dreadful is the rain of those who have been warned) evil is the rain of stones for those who were warned by Lot but did not believe.

translation: And We rained on them a rain (of torment). And how evil was the rain of those who had been warned!

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! Herein) in that which We did to them (is indeed a portent) a sign and an admonition for those who came after them, (yet most of them are not believers) they were not believers and most of them were disbelievers.

translation: Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty) in retribution against the disbelievers, (the Merciful) towards the believers.

translation: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

metadata.arabic: كَذَّبَ أَصْحَابُ لْئَيْكَةِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (The dwellers in the wood (of Midian) denied the messengers (of Allah)) the people of Shu'ayb denied Shu'ayb just as they denied all the messengers mentioned to them by Shu'ayb,

translation: The dwellers of Al-Aikah [near Madyan (Midian)] belied the Messengers.

metadata.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلاَ تَتَّقُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (When Shu'ayb said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)) will you not ward off the worship of other than Allah?

translation: When Shu‘aib said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh (and obey Him)?

metadata.arabic: إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you) from Allah and I am faithful regarding the message I convey to you,

translation: "I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

metadata.arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
metadata.Tafsir: (So keep your duty to Allah) so fear Allah in that which He commanded you regarding repentance and faith (and obey me) and follow my way and religion.

translation: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

metadata.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلاَّ عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And I ask of you no wage) no payment (for it) for the profession of Allah's divine Oneness; (my wage) my reward (is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

translation: "No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islâmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

metadata.arabic: أَوْفُواْ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلاَ تَكُونُواْ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: Give full measure) when you measure or weigh, (and be not of those who give less (than the due)) in measurement and weighing; this is because they were well known for giving less than what is due in measurement.

translation: "Give full measure, and cause no loss (to others).

metadata.arabic: وَزِنُواْ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And weigh with the true balance) and weigh with the balance of justice.

translation: "And weigh with the true and straight balance.

metadata.arabic: وَلاَ تَبْخَسُواْ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلاَ تَعْثَوْاْ فِي ٱلأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Wrong not mankind in their goods) do not diminish people's due in measurement and weight, (and do not evil, making mischief, in the earth) do not commit transgressions and corruption in the land by giving less in measurement and weight and calling to the worship of other than Allah.

translation: "And defraud not people by reducing their things, nor do evil, making corruption and mischief in the land.

metadata.arabic: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلْجِبِلَّةَ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And keep your duty unto) and fear (Him Who created you and the generations of the men of old) He created the people of old before you.

translation: "And fear Him Who created you and the generations of the men of old."

metadata.arabic: قَالُوۤاْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (They said: thou art but one of the bewitched) you are neither an angel nor a Prophet;

translation: They said: "You are only one of those bewitched!

metadata.arabic: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلاَّ بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَاذِبِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Thou art but a mortal) a human being (like us) you eat and drink just as we do, (and lo! we deem thee of the liars) in what you claim.

translation: "You are but a human being like us and verily, we think that you are one of the liars!

metadata.arabic: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفاً مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّادِقِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then make fragments of the heaven fall upon us) as punishment, (if thou art of the Truthful) that the punishment is coming.

translation: "So cause a piece of the heaven to fall on us, if you are of the truthful!"

metadata.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّيۤ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (He said) Shu'ayb said: (My Lord is best aware of what ye do) in your state of disbelief, and He is more aware of you and your punishment.

translation: He said: "My Lord is the Best Knower of what you do."

metadata.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (But they denied him) they denied his message, (so there came on them the retribution of the day of gloom) the punishment came in the form of a cloud that stopped above them and burned them with its heat. (Lo! it was the retribution of an awful day) it was a severe day of chastisement for them.

translation: But they belied him, so the torment of the day of shadow (a gloomy cloud) seized them. Indeed that was the torment of a Great Day.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! Herein) in that which We did to them (is indeed a portent) a sign and an admonition for those who came after them; (yet most of them are not believers) they were not believers and most of them were disbelievers.

translation: Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty) in retribution against the disbelievers, (the Merciful) towards the believers.

translation: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّهُ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo! it is) i.e. the Qur'an (a revelation) an address (of the Lord of the Worlds),

translation: And truly, this (the Qur’ân) is a revelation from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists),

metadata.arabic: نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلأَمِينُ
metadata.Tafsir: (Which the True Spirit hath brought down) Allah sent down Gabriel, the trustworthy Gabriel, to convey the message to His prophets,

translation: Which the trustworthy Rûh [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] has brought down

metadata.arabic: عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنْذِرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Upon your heart) according to your memorisation; it is also said that this means: when it was recited to you, (that thou mayst be (one) of the warners) by means of the Qur'an,

translation: Upon your heart (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) that you may be (one) of the warners,

metadata.arabic: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِيٍّ مُّبِينٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (In plain Arabic speech) He says: the Qur'an is in the Arabic usage; it is also said that this means: inform them, O Muhammad, using their own language.

translation: In the plain Arabic language.

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّهُ لَفِي زُبُرِ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo, it is) i.e. the description of the Qur'an and Muhammad (pbuh) (in the Scriptures of the men of old) is written in the Scriptures of the prophets who came before you.

translation: And verily, it (the Qur’ân, and its revelation to Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is (announced) in the Scriptures [i.e. the Taurât (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel)] of former people.

metadata.arabic: أَوَ لَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ آيَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُ عُلَمَاءُ بَنِيۤ إِسْرَائِيلَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Is it not a token) a sign for the prophethood of Muhammad, Allah bless him and give peace, (for them) for the people of Mecca (that the doctors of the Children of Israel know it?) That is, when they asked them about Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an and they informed them about both.

translation: Is it not a sign to them that the learned scholars (like ‘Abdullâh bin Salâm رضي الله عنه who embraced Islâm) of the Children of Israel knew it (as true)?

metadata.arabic: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَاهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ ٱلأَعْجَمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And if We had revealed it) and if We sent Gabriel with the Qur'an (unto one of any other nation than the Arabs) to a person who spoke no Arabic,

translation: And if We had revealed it (this Qur’ân) unto any of the non-Arabs,

metadata.arabic: فَقَرَأَهُ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا بِهِ مُؤْمِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And he had read it unto them) unto Quraysh, (they would not have believed in it) i.e. in the Qur'an, because they did not believe in what was in their own language, so how were they to believe in something which is in a different language?

translation: And he had recited it unto them, they would not have believed in it.

metadata.arabic: كَذَلِكَ سَلَكْنَاهُ فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Thus do We make it) the denial (traverse the hearts of the guilty) the idolaters: Abu Jahl and his host.

translation: Thus have We caused it (the denial of the Qur’ân) to enter the hearts of the Mûjrimûn (criminals, polytheists, sinners).

metadata.arabic: لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُاْ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلأَلِيمَ
metadata.Tafsir: (They will not believe in it) so that they do not believe in Muhammad (pbuh) or in the Qur'an (till they behold the painful doom,

translation: They will not believe in it until they see the painful torment.

metadata.arabic: فَيَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لاَ يَشْعُرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: So that it) the torment (will come upon them suddenly, when they perceive not) the coming of the punishment upon them.

translation: It shall come to them of a sudden, while they perceive it not.

metadata.arabic: فَيَقُولُواْ هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then they will say) when the punishment comes upon them: (Are we to be reprieved) from the punishment?

translation: Then they will say: "Can we be respited?"

metadata.arabic: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Would they (now) hasten on Our doom) the coming of Our punishment?

translation: Would they then wish for Our Torment to be hastened on?

metadata.arabic: أَفَرَأَيْتَ إِن مَّتَّعْنَاهُمْ سِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Hast thou then seen) O Muhammad, (We content them for (long) years) in their state of disbelief,

translation: Tell Me, (even) if We do let them enjoy for years,

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And then cometh that which they were promised) of punishment,

translation: And afterwards comes to them that (punishment) which they had been promised,

metadata.arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُواْ يُمَتَّعُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: ((How) that wherewith) Allah's punishment (they were contented) because of the reprieve (naught availeth them) from Allah's punishment?

translation: All that with which they used to enjoy shall not avail them.

metadata.arabic: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلاَّ لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And We destroyed no township) no inhabitants of any township (but it had its warners) warning messengers,

translation: And never did We destroy a township but it had its warners

metadata.arabic: ذِكْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (For reminder) they remind them of Allah's punishment, (for We never were oppressors) by destroying them.

translation: By way of reminder, and We have never been unjust.

metadata.arabic: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَاطِينُ
metadata.Tafsir: (The devils) at the time of the Prophet (pbuh) (did not bring it down) did not bring the Qur'an down.

translation: And it is not the Shayâtîn (devils) who have brought it (this Qur’ân) down.

metadata.arabic: وَمَا يَنبَغِي لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (It is not meet for them) the devils are not fit to do so, (nor is it in their power) nor could they do this,

translation: Neither would it suit them, nor they can (produce it).

metadata.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! verily they) i.e. the devils (are banished from the hearing) they are prevented from hearing the revelation.

translation: Verily, they have been removed far from hearing it.

metadata.arabic: فَلاَ تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهاً آخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Therefore invoke not) worship not (with Allah another god) among the idols, (lest thou be one of the doomed) in the Fire.

translation: So invoke not with Allâh another ilâh (god) lest you should be among those who receive punishment.

metadata.arabic: وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلأَقْرَبِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And warn thy tribe of near kindred) your blood relations,

translation: And warn your tribe (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) of near kindred.

metadata.arabic: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lower thy wing (in kindness) unto those believers who follow thee) be kind to the believers.

translation: And be kind and humble to the believers who follow you.

metadata.arabic: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّي بَرِيۤءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And if they) the Quraysh (disobey thee, say: Lo! I am innocent of what they do) and say.

translation: Then if they disobey you, say: "I am innocent of what you do."

metadata.arabic: وَتَوكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And put thy trust in the Mighty) in His retribution against His enemies, (the Merciful) towards you and all believers.

translation: And put your trust in the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful,

metadata.arabic: ٱلَّذِي يَرَاكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
metadata.Tafsir: (Who seeth thee when thou standest up) in prayer,

translation: Who sees you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) when you stand up (alone at night for Tahajjud prayers).

metadata.arabic: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِي ٱلسَّاجِدِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And (seeth) thine abasement among those who fall prostrate (in worship)) among those who pray in their bowing, prostration and standing up; it is also said that this means: in the loins of your forefathers.

translation: And your movements among those who fall prostrate (to Allâh in the five compulsory congregational prayers).

metadata.arabic: إِنَّهُ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer) of what they say, (the Knower) of them and of their works.

translation: Verily He, only He, is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower.

metadata.arabic: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَاطِينُ
metadata.Tafsir: (Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend) with fortune telling?

translation: Shall I inform you (O people!) upon whom the Shayâtîn (devils) descend?

metadata.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (They descend on every sinful, false one) they descend on every sinful fortune teller: Musaylimah the liar and Talhah.

translation: They descend on every lying, sinful person.

metadata.arabic: يُلْقُونَ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ كَاذِبُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (They listen eagerly) the devils listen eagerly to the speech of the angels, (but most of them are liars) the devils are liars because they hear one thing and convey instead 100 things to fortune tellers.

translation: Who gives ear (to the devils and they pour what they may have heard of the Unseen from the angels), and most of them are liars.

metadata.arabic: وَٱلشُّعَرَآءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ ٱلْغَاوُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (As for poets) 'Abdullah Ibn al-Zib'ari and his host who composed poetry, (the erring follow them) those who transmit poetry relate it from them.

translation: As for the poets, the erring ones follow them,

metadata.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِي كُلِّ وَادٍ يَهِيمُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Hast thou not seen how they) the poets (stray) they come and go, sometimes eulogizing and sometimes satirizing (in every valley) in every genre and theme,

translation: See you not that they speak about every subject (praising people - right or wrong) in their poetry?

metadata.arabic: وَأَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا لاَ يَفْعَلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And how they say) in their poetry (that which they do not?) they keep mentioning “I” and “I” when things are not as they say; it is also said that this means: they say things which they cannot do; and hence both poet and narrator are in error.

translation: And that they say what they do not do.

metadata.arabic: إِلاَّ ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّالِحَاتِ وَذَكَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيراً وَٱنتَصَرُواْ مِن بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُواْ وَسَيَعْلَمْ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوۤاْ أَيَّ مُنقَلَبٍ يَنقَلِبُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Save those who believe) in Muhammad (pbuh) and in the Qur'an, like Hassan Ibn Thabit and his fellow believing poets (and do good works) between them and their Lord, (and remember Allah much) in their poetry, (and vindicate themselves) through Muhammad (pbuh) and his Companions by answering back the disbelievers (after they have been wronged) after being satirized by the disbelievers. (Those who do wrong) those who satirized the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions (will come to know by what a (great) reverse they will be overturned!) what kind of destination they will return to in the Hereafter, i.e. the Fire, if they do not believe. And Allah knows best the secrets of His Book'.

translation: Except those who believe (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) and do righteous deeds, and remember Allâh much, and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged [by replying back in poetry to the unjust poetry (which the pagan poets utter against the Muslims)]. And those who do wrong will come to know by what overturning they will be overturned.

metadata.arabic: طسۤ تِلْكَ آيَاتُ ٱلْقُرْآنِ وَكِتَابٍ مُّبِينٍ
metadata.Tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (Ta. Sin.): '(Ta. Sin.) He says: the (Ta) stands for His might (tawluh) and the (Sin) stands for His majesty (sana'uh); it is also said that it is an oath by which Allah swore. (These are revelations of the Qur'an and a Scripture that maketh plain) this surah consists of verses of the Qur'an and it is a Book that makes plain the lawful and the unlawful;

translation: Tâ-Sîn. [These letters are one of the miracles of the Qur’ân, and none but Allâh (Alone) knows their meanings]. These are the Verses of the Qur’an, and (it is) a Book (that makes things) clear:

metadata.arabic: هُدًى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (A guidance) from error (and good tidings) that they will gain Paradise (for believers) who are true in their faith.

translation: A guide (to the Right Path) and glad tidings for the believers [who believe in the Oneness of Allâh (i.e. Islâmic Monotheism)].

metadata.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلاَةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَاةَ وَهُم بِٱلآخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: Allah then showed the attributes of these true believers, saying: (Who establish worship) those who complete the five daily prayers along with their necessary ritual ablution, bowing, prostrating and all that which is obligated in their due times (and pay the poor-due) from their wealth (and are sure of) they believe in (the Hereafter) resurrection after death, Paradise and hell.

translation: Those who perform As-Salât (Iqâmat-as-Salât) and give Zakât and they believe with certainty in the Hereafter (resurrection, recompense of their good and bad deeds, Paradise and Hell).

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلآخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمْ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَهُمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! as for those who believe not in the Hereafter) those who do not believe in resurrection after death: Abu Jahl and his host, (We have made their works fair-seeming unto them) in their state of disbelief (so that they are all astray) so they proceed blindly, unable to see.

translation: Verily, those who believe not in the Hereafter, We have made their deeds fair-seeming to them, so that they wander about blindly.

metadata.arabic: أُوْلَـٰئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَهُمْ سُوۤءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَهُمْ فِي ٱلآخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلأَخْسَرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Those) who have this attribute (are they for whom is the worst of punishment) a severe chastisement in the Fire, (and in the Hereafter) on the Day of Judgement (they will be the greatest losers) they will loose Paradise and enter the Fire.

translation: They are those for whom there will be an evil torment (in this world). And in the Hereafter they will be the greatest losers.

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى ٱلْقُرْآنَ مِن لَّدُنْ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! as for thee) O Muhammad, (thou verily receivest the Qur'an) He says: Gabriel comes down to you with the Qur'an (from the presence of One Wise) in His command and judgement, (Aware) of His created beings.

translation: And verily, you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are being taught the Qur’ân from One, All-Wise, All-Knowing.

metadata.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لأَهْلِهِ إِنِّيۤ آنَسْتُ نَاراً سَآتِيكُمْ مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ آتِيكُمْ بِشِهَابٍ قَبَسٍ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: ((Remember) when Moses said unto his household) when he became unsure about the way: (Lo! I spy afar off a fire) on the left side of the road; stay here (I will bring you tidings thence) news about the right way to take, (or bring to you a borrowed flame that ye may warm yourselves) because this happened in a cold winter.

translation: (Remember) when Mûsâ (Moses) said to his household: "Verily I have seen a fire; I will bring you from there some information, or I will bring you a burning brand, that you may warm yourselves."

metadata.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُودِيَ أَن بُورِكَ مَن فِي ٱلنَّارِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَسُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (But when he reached it, he was called, saying: Blessed is whosoever is in the Fire) blessed is the Fire (and whosoever is round about it) of angels! This is the reading of Ubayy and 'Abdullah Ibn Mas'ud; it is also said that this means: blessed is He Who lightened this light; and it also said that this means: blessed is he who is seeking, i.e. Moses and whoever is around him of angels, (And glorified be Allah) He exonerated Himself, (the Lord of the Worlds!) the Master of the jinn and human beings.

translation: But when he came to it, he was called: "Blessed is whosoever is in the fire, and whosoever is round about it! And glorified be Allâh, the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

metadata.arabic: يٰمُوسَىٰ إِنَّهُ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
metadata.Tafsir: (O Moses! Lo! it is I) Who is calling you, (Allah, the Mighty) in retribution against those who do not believe in Me, (the Wise) in My command and judgement, I command that none should be worshipped besides Me.

translation: "O Mûsâ (Moses)! Verily it is I, Allâh, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

metadata.arabic: وَأَلْقِ عَصَاكَ فَلَمَّا رَآهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنٌّ وَلَّىٰ مُدْبِراً وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ يٰمُوسَىٰ لاَ تَخَفْ إِنِّي لاَ يَخَافُ لَدَيَّ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And throw down thy staff) from your hand! And he threw it, (But when he saw it writhing) moving (as it were a demon) like a serpent which is neither big nor small, (he turned to flee headlong) from it and did not look back out of fear; but Allah said to him: (O Moses! Fear not! Lo! the emissaries fear not in My presence,

translation: "And throw down your stick!" But when he saw it moving as if it were a snake, he turned in flight, and did not look back. (It was said:) "O Mûsâ (Moses)! Fear not: verily the Messengers fear not in front of Me.

metadata.arabic: إِلاَّ مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسْناً بَعْدَ سُوۤءٍ فَإِنِّي غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
metadata.Tafsir: Save him who hath done wrong and afterward hath changed evil for good. And lo! I am Forgiving) I forgive the one who repents, (Merciful) I show mercy towards he who dies in a state of repentance.

translation: "Except him who has done wrong and afterwards has changed evil for good; then surely, I am Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

metadata.arabic: وَأَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ فِي جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوۤءٍ فِي تِسْعِ آيَاتٍ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَقَوْمِهِ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ قَوْماً فَاسِقِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And put thy hand into the bosom of thy robe) in your armpit, (it will come forth white but unhurt) without having contracted leprosy. Go! ((This will be one) among nine tokens) go with nine signs (unto Pharaoh and his people) the Copts. (Lo! they were ever evil-living folk) they were disbelievers.

translation: "And put your hand into your bosom, it will come forth white without hurt. (These are) among the nine signs (you will take) to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and his people. Verily they are a people who are Fâsiqûn (rebellious, disobedient to Allâh).

metadata.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ آيَاتُنَا مُبْصِرَةً قَالُواْ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (But when Our tokens came unto them) when Moses went with our tokens to them, (plain to see) demonstrating, one after the other, (they said: This is mere magic) what you have brought us, O Moses, is a manifest lie,

translation: But when Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) came to them, clear to see, they said: "This is a manifest magic."

metadata.arabic: وَجَحَدُواْ بِهَا وَٱسْتَيْقَنَتْهَآ أَنفُسُهُمْ ظُلْماً وَعُلُوّاً فَٱنْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And they denied them) they denied the tokens, (though their souls acknowledged them) after being accepted by their souls that they were from Allah, (for spite) out of opposition and enmity (and arrogance) and haughtiness and pride. (Then see) O Muhammad (the nature of the consequence for the wrong-doers) how was the end result of the idolaters, Pharaoh and his people, how We destroyed them in the sea!

translation: And they belied them (those Ayât) wrongfully and arrogantly, though their ownselves were convinced thereof [i.e. those (Ayât ) are from Allâh, and Mûsâ (Moses) is the Messenger of Allâh in truth, but they disliked to obey Mûsâ (Moses), and hated to believe in his Message of Monotheism]. So see what was the end of the Mufsidûn (disbelievers, disobedient to Allâh, evil-doers and liars.).

metadata.arabic: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا دَاوُودَ وَسُلَيْمَانَ عِلْماً وَقَالاَ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍ مِّنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And We verily gave knowledge) and understanding through prophethood and judgeship (unto David) the son of Jesse (and Solomon) the son of David, (and they said) both of them: (Praise be to Allah) thanks and gratitude to Allah, (Who hath preferred us) through knowledge and prophethood (above many of His believing slaves!

translation: And indeed We gave knowledge to Dâwûd (David) and Sulaimân (Solomon), and they both said: "All the praises and thanks be to Allâh, Who has preferred us above many of His believing slaves!"

metadata.arabic: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَانُ دَاوُودَ وَقَالَ يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنطِقَ ٱلطَّيْرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
metadata.Tafsir: And Solomon was David's heir) as king instead of all the other sons of David who were 19 in number. (And he said) Solomon said: (O mankind! Lo! we have been taught) we were given the understanding of (the language of birds, and have been given (abundance) of all things) and we were given the knowledge of everything in my kingdom. (This surely is evident favour) this is surely a great blessing from Allah.

translation: And Sulaimân (Solomon) inherited (the knowledge of) Dâwûd (David). He said: "O mankind! We have been taught the language of birds, and on us have been bestowed all things. This, verily, is an evident grace (from Allâh)."

metadata.arabic: وَحُشِرَ لِسْلَيْمَانَ جُنُودُهُ مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلإِنْس وَٱلطَّيْرِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And there were gathered together) and made subservient (unto Solomon his armies of the jinn and humankind, and of the birds, and they were set in battle order) they were all retained from the first to the last until they were gathered together;

translation: And there were gathered before Sulaimân (Solomon) his hosts of jinn and men, and birds, and they all were set in battle order (marching forward).

metadata.arabic: حَتَّىٰ إِذَآ أَتَوْا عَلَىٰ وَادِ ٱلنَّمْلِ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌ يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّمْلُ ٱدْخُلُواْ مَسَاكِنَكُمْ لاَ يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمَانُ وَجُنُودُهُ وَهُمْ لاَ يَشْعُرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Till, when they reached the Valley of the Ants) in Historic Syria, (an ant exclaimed: O ants! Enter your dwellings lest Solomon and his armies crush you) step on you, (unperceiving) unaware of you.

translation: Till, when they came to the valley of the ants, one of the ants said: "O ants! Enter your dwellings, lest Sulaimân (Solomon) and his hosts should crush you, while they perceive not."

metadata.arabic: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكاً مِّن قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِيۤ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِيۤ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحاً تَرْضَاهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّالِحِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And (Solomon) smiled, laughing) in amazement (at her speech) because he heard her speech while his army did not, (and said: My Lord, arouse me) inspire in me (to be thankful for Thy favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me) you have blessed me with the profession of Allah's divine Oneness (and my parents) whom you also blessed with the profession of Allah's divine Oneness, (and to do good) in all sincerity (that shall be pleasing unto Thee) that you would accept (and include me in (the number of) Thy righteous slaves) and include me with Your righteous slaves in Paradise.

translation: So he [Sulaimân (Solomon)] smiled, amused at her speech and said: "My Lord! Grant me the power and ability that I may be grateful for Your Favours which You have bestowed on me and on my parents, and that I may do righteous good deeds that will please You, and admit me by Your Mercy among Your righteous slaves."

metadata.arabic: وَتَفَقَّدَ ٱلطَّيْرَ فَقَالَ مَالِيَ لاَ أَرَى ٱلْهُدْهُدَ أَمْ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْغَآئِبِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And he sought among the birds) he inspected the birds (and said) when he could not see the hoopoe among them: (How is it that I see not the hoopoe) in his place, (or is he among the absent?)

translation: He inspected the birds, and said: "What is the matter that I see not the hoopoe? Or is he among the absentees?

metadata.arabic: لأُعَذِّبَنَّهُ عَذَاباً شَدِيداً أَوْ لأَاْذبَحَنَّهُ أَوْ لَيَأْتِيَنِّي بِسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
metadata.Tafsir: He said: if he is among the absent, then (I verily will punish him with hard punishment) I will pluck out his feathers; such was the punishment of the birds, (or I verily will slay him, or he verily shall bring me a plain excuse) an acceptable excuse.

translation: "I will surely punish him with a severe torment, or slaughter him, unless he brings me a clear reason."

metadata.arabic: فَمَكَثَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ فَقَالَ أَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِ وَجِئْتُكَ مِن سَبَإٍ بِنَبَإٍ يَقِينٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (But he was not long in coming, and he said: I have found out (a thing) that thou apprehendest not) O king! I reached a place that you have not reached and have come to know that which you do not, (and I come unto thee from Sheba) the city of Sheba (with sure tidings) with an amazing, true information.

translation: But the hoopoe stayed not long: he (came up and) said: "I have grasped (the knowledge of a thing) which you have not grasped and I have come to you from Saba’ (Sheba) with true news.

metadata.arabic: إِنِّي وَجَدتُّ ٱمْرَأَةً تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! I found a woman ruling over them) whose name is Balqis, (and she hath been given (abundance) of all things) she has been given the knowledge of all things in her country, (and hers is a mighty throne) adorned with gems, pearls, gold and silver.

translation: "I found a woman ruling over them: she has been given all things that could be possessed by any ruler of the earth, and she has a great throne.

metadata.arabic: وَجَدتُّهَا وَقَوْمَهَا يَسْجُدُونَ لِلشَّمْسِ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ فَهُمْ لاَ يَهْتَدُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (I found her and her people worshipping the sun instead of Allah; and Satan maketh their works) their worship of the sun (fair-seeming unto them, and debarreth them from the way (of Truth)) the devil has barred them from the way of Truth and guidance, (so that they go not aright) to the way of truth and guidance:

translation: "I found her and her people worshipping the sun instead of Allâh, and Shaitân (Satan) has made their deeds fair-seeming to them, and has barred them from (Allâh’s) Way: so they have no guidance."

metadata.arabic: أَلاَّ يَسْجُدُواْ للَّهِ ٱلَّذِي يُخْرِجُ ٱلْخَبْءَ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُخْفُونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (So that they worship not Allah) and I said to them: “O you, prostrate to Allah” it is also said that it is Solomon who said: “why do they not prostrate to Allah?” (Who bringeth forth the hidden in the heavens) the rain (and the earth) vegetation, (and knoweth what ye hide) of good and evil (and what ye proclaim) of good and evil,

translation: [As Shaitân (Satan) has barred them from Allâh’s Way] so they do not worship (prostrate themselves before) Allâh, Who brings to light what is hidden in the heavens and the earth, and knows what you conceal and what you reveal. [Tafsir At-Tabarî]

metadata.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلَـٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Allah; there is no God save Him, the Lord of the tremendous Throne.

translation: Allâh, Lâ ilâha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He), the Lord of the Supreme Throne!

metadata.arabic: قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَاذِبِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Solomon) said) to the hoopoe: (We shall see whether thou speakest truth or whether thou art of the liars.

translation: [Sulaimân (Solomon)] said: "We shall see whether you speak the truth or you are (one) of the liars.

metadata.arabic: ٱذْهَب بِّكِتَابِي هَـٰذَا فَأَلْقِهْ إِلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَٱنْظُرْ مَاذَا يَرْجِعُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: Go with this my letter and throw it down unto them; then turn away) then move away such that they do not see you (and see what (answer) they return) when they read my letter,

translation: "Go you with this letter of mine, and deliver it to them, then draw back from them, and see what (answer) they return."

metadata.arabic: قَالَتْ يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلأُ إِنِّيۤ أُلْقِيَ إِلَيَّ كِتَابٌ كَرِيمٌ
metadata.Tafsir: He did as Solomon commanded, and Balqis took the letter and went to meet her entourage. ((The Queen of Sheba) said: O chieftains! Lo! there hath been thrown unto me a noble letter) a sealed letter.

translation: She said: "O chiefs! Verily! Here is delivered to me a noble letter,

metadata.arabic: إِنَّهُ مِن سُلَيْمَانَ وَإِنَّهُ بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! it is from Solomon, and lo! it is) the first line of it is: (In the name of Allah the Beneficent, the Merciful;

translation: "Verily it is from Sulaimân (Solomon), and verily, it (reads): In the Name of Allâh, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful:

metadata.arabic: أَلاَّ تَعْلُواْ عَلَيَّ وَأْتُونِي مُسْلِمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: Exalt not yourselves against me) feel not too haughty towards me, (but come unto me as those who surrender) and seek peace; as well as demanding other things which were mentioned in the letter.

translation: "Be you not exalted against me, but come to me as Muslims (true believers who submit to Allâh with full submission).’ "

metadata.arabic: قَالَتْ يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلأُ أَفْتُونِي فِيۤ أَمْرِي مَا كُنتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمْراً حَتَّىٰ تَشْهَدُونِ
metadata.Tafsir: (She said: O chieftains! Pronounce for me in my case) inform me about what I should do; it is also said that this means: advise me about what to do. (I decide no case) I will not do anything (till ye are present with me) and advise me.

translation: She said: "O chiefs! Advise me in (this) case of mine. I decide no case till you are present with me (and give me your opinions)."

metadata.arabic: قَالُواْ نَحْنُ أُوْلُو قُوَّةٍ وَأُولُو بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ وَٱلأَمْرُ إِلَيْكِ فَٱنظُرِي مَاذَا تَأْمُرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (They said: We are lords of might) we have weapons (and lords of great prowess) in war, (but it is for thee to command) we shall follow your command; (so consider what thou wilt command) and we will do it.

translation: They said: "We have great strength, and great ability for war, but it is for you to command: so think over what you will command."

metadata.arabic: قَالَتْ إِنَّ ٱلْمُلُوكَ إِذَا دَخَلُواْ قَرْيَةً أَفْسَدُوهَا وَجَعَلُوۤاْ أَعِزَّةَ أَهْلِهَآ أَذِلَّةً وَكَذٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: Then she pronounced words of wisdom. (She said: Lo! Kings) worldly kings, (when they enter a township) by force in instances of war and fighting, (ruin it) destroy it (and make the honour of its people shame) by beating, killing and exposing them to other things. (Thus will they do) Allah said: this is how worldly kings behave because of arrogance.

translation: She said: "Verily kings, when they enter a town (country), they despoil it and make the most honourable amongst its people the lowest. And thus they do.

metadata.arabic: وَإِنِّي مُرْسِلَةٌ إِلَيْهِمْ بِهَدِيَّةٍ فَنَاظِرَةٌ بِمَ يَرْجِعُ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (But lo! I am going to send a present unto them) to Solomon, (and to see with what (answer) the messengers return.

translation: "But verily! I am going to send him a present, and see with what (answer) the messengers return."

metadata.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ سُلَيْمَانَ قَالَ أَتُمِدُّونَنِ بِمَالٍ فَمَآ آتَانِيَ ٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّآ آتَاكُمْ بَلْ أَنتُمْ بِهَدِيَّتِكُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: So when (the envoy) came unto Solomon) when her envoy went to Solomon, ((the King) said: What! Would ye help me with wealth) with a gift? (But that which Allah hath given me) of prophethood and kingship (is better than that which He hath given you) of wealth. (Nay it is ye (and not I) who exult in your gift) if it were to be returned to you.

translation: So when (the messengers with the present) came to Sulaimân (Solomon), he said: "Will you help me in wealth? What Allâh has given me is better than that which He has given you! Nay, you rejoice in your gift!"

metadata.arabic: ٱرْجِعْ إِلَيْهِمْ فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّهُم بِجُنُودٍ لاَّ قِبَلَ لَهُمْ بِهَا وَلَنُخْرِجَنَّهُم مِّنْهَآ أَذِلَّةً وَهُمْ صَاغِرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Return unto them) with their gift. (We verily shall come unto them with hosts) armies (that they cannot resist) which they have no power to stop, (and we shall drive them out from thence) from Sheba (with shame) with their hands tied to their necks, (and they will be abased) humiliated.

translation: [Then Sulaimân (Solomon) said to the chief of her messengers who brought the present]: "Go back to them. We verily shall come to them with hosts that they cannot resist, and we shall drive them out from there in disgrace, and they will be abased."

metadata.arabic: قَالَ يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلأُ أَيُّكُمْ يَأْتِينِي بِعَرْشِهَا قَبْلَ أَن يَأْتُونِي مُسْلِمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (He said) Solomon said: (O chiefs! Which of you will bring me her throne before they come unto me, surrendering) and seeking peace?

translation: He said: "O chiefs! Which of you can bring me her throne before they come to me surrendering themselves in obedience?"

metadata.arabic: قَالَ عِفْرِيتٌ مِّن ٱلْجِنِّ أَنَاْ آتِيكَ بِهِ قَبْلَ أَن تَقُومَ مِن مَّقَامِكَ وَإِنِّي عَلَيْهِ لَقَوِيٌّ أَمِينٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (A) mighty (stalwart of the jinn) called 'Amr (said: I will bring it thee before thou canst rise from your place) before you leave your seat of judgement, for he used to sit for judgements until noon. (Lo! I verily am strong and trusty for such work) even though it is adorned with gems, pearls, gold and silver.

translation: A ‘Ifrît (strong one) from the jinn said: "I will bring it to you before you rise from your place (council). And verily, I am indeed strong, and trustworthy for such work."

metadata.arabic: قَالَ ٱلَّذِي عِندَهُ عِلْمٌ مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَابِ أَنَاْ آتِيكَ بِهِ قَبْلَ أَن يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ فَلَمَّا رَآهُ مُسْتَقِرّاً عِندَهُ قَالَ هَـٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّي لِيَبْلُوَنِيۤ أَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّي غَنِيٌّ كَرِيمٌ
metadata.Tafsir: Solomon said: I want it even quicker than that. (One with whom was knowledge of the Scripture) one who knew Allah's greatest name, O Living, O Subsistent, who was called Asaf Ibn Barkhiyya (said: I will bring it thee before thy gaze returneth unto thee) before that thing which you see from far reaches you. (And when he saw it set in his presence) i.e. when he saw her throne next to his, (Solomon said) to Asaf: (This is of the bounty of my Lord) this is of the favour of my Lord, (that He may try me whether I give thanks) for his blessings (or am ungrateful) or whether I abstain from being grateful for His blessings. (Whosoever giveth thanks) for Allah's blessings (he only giveth thanks for (the good of) his own soul) for the reward of his Lord: (and whosoever is ungrateful) for the blessing of His Lord, he harms only his soul. (For lo! my Lord is Absolute in independence) of his gratitude, (Bountiful) He forgives whoever repents, and He does not hasten his punishment.

translation: One with whom was knowledge of the Scripture said: "I will bring it to you within the twinkling of an eye!" Then when he [Sulaimân (Solomon)] saw it placed before him, he said: "This is by the Grace of my Lord - to test me whether I am grateful or ungrateful! And whoever is grateful, truly, his gratitude is for (the good of) his ownself; and whoever is ungrateful, (he is ungrateful only for the loss of his ownself). Certainly my Lord is Rich (Free of all needs), Bountiful."

metadata.arabic: قَالَ نَكِّرُواْ لَهَا عَرْشَهَا نَنظُرْ أَتَهْتَدِيۤ أَمْ تَكُونُ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ لاَ يَهْتَدُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (He said: Disguise her throne for her) add to her throne and take away from it (that we may see whether she will go aright) whether she will know (or be of those not rightly guided) or whether she will not know.

translation: He said: "Disguise her throne for her that we may see whether she will be guided (to recognise her throne), or she will be one of those not guided."

metadata.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَكَذَا عَرْشُكِ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُ هُوَ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (So, when she came, it was said (unto her)) Solomon said to her: (Is thy throne like this? She said: (It is) as though it were the very one. And (Solomon said): We were given the knowledge before her) Allah has given me [knowledge], by changing her throne and bringing to me, even before she arrived, (and we had surrendered (to Allah)) and we were sincere before she arrived.

translation: So when she came, it was said (to her): "Is your throne like this?" She said: "(It is) as though it were the very same." And [Sulaimân (Solomon) said]: "Knowledge was bestowed on us before her, and we were submitted to Allâh (in Islâm as Muslims before her)."

metadata.arabic: وَصَدَّهَا مَا كَانَت تَّعْبُدُ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّهَا كَانَتْ مِن قَوْمٍ كَافِرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And (all) that she was wont to worship) the sun (instead of Allah hindered her) Solomon stopped her; it is also said that this means: Allah stopped her, (for she came of disbelieving folk) her folk were Zoroastrians.

translation: And that which she used to worship besides Allâh has prevented her (from Islâm), for she was of a disbelieving people.

metadata.arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِي ٱلصَّرْحَ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا قَالَ إِنَّهُ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوارِيرَ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَانَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (It was said unto her: Enter the hall) enter the castle. (And when she saw it she deemed it a pool and bared her legs) she lifted her dress above her legs. ((Solomon) said: Lo! it is a hall, made smooth, of glass) beneath which there is water, so do not be afraid of getting wet. (She said: My Lord! Lo! I have wronged myself) by worshipping the sun, (and I surrender with Solomon) at the hand of Solomon (unto Allah, the Lord of the Worlds) the master of the jinn and human beings.

translation: It was said to her: "Enter As-Sarh" (a glass surface with water underneath it or a palace): but when she saw it, she thought it was a pool, and she (tucked up her clothes) uncovering her legs. (Sulaimân (Solomon)) said: "Verily, it is a Sarh (a glass surface with water underneath it or a palace)." She said: "My Lord! Verily, I have wronged myself, and I submit [in Islâm, together with Sulaimân (Solomon)] to Allâh, the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)."

metadata.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَالِحاً أَنِ ٱعْبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And We verily sent until Thamud their brother) their Prophet (Salih, saying: Worship Allah) that you should say to them: profess Allah's divine Oneness, and repent to Him from disbelief and idolatry. (And lo! they (then) became two parties) one believing and the other disbelieving, (quarrelling) regarding Religion.

translation: And indeed We sent to Thamûd their brother Sâlih, saying: "Worship Allâh (Alone and none else). Then look! They became two parties (believers and disbelievers) quarreling with each other."

metadata.arabic: قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ لِمَ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ لَوْلاَ تَسْتَغْفِرُونَ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (He said) Salih said to the disbelieving party: (O my people! Why will ye hasten on the evil) the torment (rather than the good) rather than well-being and mercy? (Why will ye not ask pardon of Allah) why do you not repent of idolatry and denial and profess Allah's divine Oneness, (that ye may receive mercy) and escape the torment.

translation: He said: "O my people! Why do you seek to hasten the evil (torment) before the good (Allâh’s Mercy)? Why seek you not the Forgiveness of Allâh, that you may receive mercy?"

metadata.arabic: قَالُواْ ٱطَّيَّرْنَا بِكَ وَبِمَن مَّعَكَ قَالَ طَائِرُكُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ تُفْتَنُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (They said: We augur evil of thee and those with thee) they meant: the hardship that we face is due to your evil omen and the evil omen of those who believed in you. (He said) Salih said: (Your evil augury) your hardship as well as your comfort (is with Allah) are from Allah. (Nay, but ye are folk that are being tested) by hardship and comfort; it is also said that this means: you are forsaken rather than being given success.

translation: They said: "We augur ill omen from you and those with you." He said: "Your ill omen is with Allâh; nay, but you are a people that are being tested."

metadata.arabic: وَكَانَ فِي ٱلْمَدِينَةِ تِسْعَةُ رَهْطٍ يُفْسِدُونَ فِي ٱلأَرْضِ وَلاَ يُصْلِحُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And there were in the city nine persons) nine sinful people among the sons of their chieftains: Qaddar Ibn Salif, Masda' Ibn Dahw and their host (who made mischief in the land) through their transgressions (and reformed not) they did not enjoy righteousness nor practised it.

translation: And there were in the city nine men (from the sons of their chiefs), who made mischief in the land, and would not reform.

metadata.arabic: قَالُواْ تَقَاسَمُواْ بِٱللَّهِ لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهُ وَأَهْلَهُ ثُمَّ لَنَقُولَنَّ لِوَلِيِّهِ مَا شَهِدْنَا مَهْلِكَ أَهْلِهِ وَإِنَّا لَصَادِقُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (They said: Swear one to another by Allah that we verily will attack him and his household by night) and kill them all, (and afterward we will surely say unto his friend) to his inheritors and relatives: (We witnessed not the destruction of his household) we did not witness the killing of Salih and his household. (And lo! we are truth tellers) they will believe us and no one will reject what we say.

translation: They said: "Swear one to another by Allâh that we shall make a secret night attack on him and his household, and thereafter we will surely say to his near relatives: ‘We witnessed not the destruction of his household, and verily we are telling the truth.’"

metadata.arabic: وَمَكَرُواْ مَكْراً وَمَكَرْنَا مَكْراً وَهُمْ لاَ يَشْعُرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (So they plotted a plot) they planned to kill Salih and all those who believed with him: (and We plotted a plot) and We wanted to kill them, (while they perceived not) Our plotting; it is also said that this means: the angels killed them in the house of Salih by hailing stones at them without them perceiving it.

translation: So they plotted a plot, and We plotted a plot, while they perceived not.

metadata.arabic: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ مَكْرِهِمْ أَنَّا دَمَّرْنَاهُمْ وَقَوْمَهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then see) O Muhammad (the nature of the consequence of their plotting) the punishment for their plan to kill Salih, (for lo! We destroyed them) through raining stones on them (and their people, every one) and We destroyed every one of their people.

translation: Then see how was the end of their plot! Verily! We destroyed them and their nation, all together.

metadata.arabic: فَتِلْكَ بُيُوتُهُمْ خَاوِيَةً بِمَا ظَلَمُوۤاْ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لآيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (See, yonder are their dwellings empty and in ruins because they did wrong) because of their idolatry. (Lo! Herein) in that which We did to them (is indeed a portent) a sign and an admonition (for a people who have knowledge) who believe in that which was done to them.

translation: These are their houses in utter ruin, for they did wrong. Verily, in this is indeed an Ayâh (a lesson or a sign) for people who know.

metadata.arabic: وَأَنجَيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ وَكَانُواْ يَتَّقُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And we saved those who believed) in Salih (and used to ward off (evil)) and used to ward off disbelief, idolatry and indecencies.

translation: And We saved those who believed, and used to fear Allâh, and keep their duty to Him.

metadata.arabic: وَلُوطاً إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ أَتَأْتُونَ ٱلْفَاحِشَةَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And Lot!) We sent him to his people (when he said unto his folk: will you commit abomination) sodomy (knowingly) while knowing it to be an abomination?

translation: And (remember) Lût (Lot)! When he said to his people. Do you commit Al-Fâhishah (evil, great sin, every kind of unlawful sexual intercourse, sodomy) while you see (one another doing evil without any screen)?"

metadata.arabic: أَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةً مِّن دُونِ ٱلنِّسَآءِ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ تَجْهَلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Must ye needs lust after men instead of women? Nay, but ye are folk who act senselessly) you are folk who ignore Allah's command.

translation: "Do you practise your lusts on men instead of women? Nay, but you are a people who behave senselessly."

metadata.arabic: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِ إِلاَّ أَن قَالُوۤاْ أَخْرِجُوۤاْ آلَ لُوطٍ مِّن قَرْيَتِكُمْ إِنَّهمْ أُنَاسٌ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (But the answer of his folk was naught save that they said: Expel the household of Lot) Lot and his two daughters: Za'ura and Raytha (from your township) Sodom, (for they (forsooth) are folk who would keep clean) they exonerate themselves from sodomy!

translation: There was no other answer given by his people except that they said: "Drive out the family of Lût (Lot) from your city Verily, these are men who want to be clean and pure!"

metadata.arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ إِلاَّ ٱمْرَأَتَهُ قَدَّرْنَاهَا مِنَ ٱلْغَابِرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then we saved him and his household) his daughters (save his wife) the hypocrite; (We destined her to be of those who stayed behind) We decreed that she would stay behind to be destroyed.

translation: So We saved him and his family, except his wife. We destined her to be of those who remained behind.

metadata.arabic: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَراً فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And We rained a rain) stones (upon them) upon their sodomites and travellers. (Dreadful) evil (is the rain of those who have been warned) by Lot but did not believe in him.

translation: And We rained down on them a rain (of stones). So evil was the rain of those who were warned.

metadata.arabic: قُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَسَلاَمٌ عَلَىٰ عِبَادِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصْطَفَىٰ ءَآللَّهُ خَيْرٌ أَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Say) O Muhammad: (Praise be to Allah) thanks and gratitude to Allah for their destruction, (and peace) happiness and safety (be on His slaves whom He hath chosen!) whom He selected for prophethood; it is also said that this means: Allah selected them for Islam, and these are the community of Muhammad (pbuh) (Is Allah best) say, O Muhammad, to the people of Mecca: is the worship of Allah better, (or (all) that ye ascribe as partners (unto Him)) or the worship of the idols which they associate with Allah?

translation: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Praise and thanks be to Allâh, and peace be on His slaves whom He has chosen (for His Message)! Is Allâh better, or (all) that you ascribe as partners (to Him)?" (Of course, Allâh is Better).

metadata.arabic: أَمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضَ وَأَنزَلَ لَكُمْ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَنبَتْنَا بِهِ حَدَآئِقَ ذَاتَ بَهْجَةٍ مَّا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَن تُنبِتُواْ شَجَرَهَا أَإِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ يَعْدِلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Is not He (best) who created the heavens and the earth, and sendeth down for you water) rain (from the sky wherewith) by means of the rain (We cause to spring forth joyous) seemly (orchards) that which surrounds them of palm-trees and trees, (whose trees it never hath been yours to cause to grow) you never had the power to grow its trees. (Is there any God beside Allah) who has done this? (Nay, but they are folk who ascribe equals (unto Him)) they make the idols as equals to Him!

translation: Is not He (better than your gods) Who created the heavens and the earth, and sends down for you water (rain) from the sky, whereby We cause to grow wonderful gardens full of beauty and delight? It is not in your ability to cause the growth of their trees. Is there any ilâh (god) with Allâh? Nay, but they are a people who ascribe equals (to Him)!

metadata.arabic: أَمَّن جَعَلَ ٱلأَرْضَ قَرَاراً وَجَعَلَ خِلاَلَهَآ أَنْهَاراً وَجَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ حَاجِزاً أَإِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱلله بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Is not He (best) Who made the earth a fixed abode, and placed rivers in the folds thereof) in the middle thereof, (and placed firm hills therein) on earth, (and hath set a barrier) preventing mixture (between the two seas) the sweet and salty seas? (Is there any God beside Allah) who has done this? (Nay, but most of them know not) most of them believe not!

translation: Is not He (better than your gods) Who has made the earth as a fixed abode, and has placed rivers in its midst, and has placed firm mountains therein, and has set a barrier between the two seas (of salt and sweet water)? Is there any ilâh (god) with Allâh? Nay, but most of them know not!

metadata.arabic: أَمَّن يُجِيبُ ٱلْمُضْطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكْشِفُ ٱلسُّوۤءَ وَيَجْعَلُكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ ٱلأَرْضِ أَإِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ قَلِيلاً مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Is not He (best) who answereth the wronged one) in his distress (when he crieth unto Him) to drive away his misfortune (and removeth the evil) by removing misfortunes, (and hath made you vicegerents of the earth) the dwellers of the earth after the destruction of its people? (Is there any God beside Allah) who did this? (Little do they reflect!) they derive no admonition at all from this.

translation: Is not He (better than your gods) Who responds to the distressed one, when he calls on Him, and Who removes the evil, and makes you inheritors of the earth, generations after generations? Is there any ilâh (god) with Allâh? Little is that you remember!

metadata.arabic: أَمَّن يَهْدِيكُمْ فِي ظُلُمَاتِ ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ وَمَن يُرْسِلُ ٱلرِّيَاحَ بُشْرَاً بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ أَإِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ تَعَالَى ٱللَّهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Is not He (best) Who guideth you) Who saves you (in the darkness of the land and the sea) from the turmoil of the land and the sea when you travel, (He Who sendeth the winds as heralds of His mercy) announcing the rain? (Is there any God beside Allah) who does this? (High exalted be Allah) Allah absolves Himself (from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)) of idols!

translation: Is not He (better than your gods) Who guides you in the darkness of the land and the sea, and Who sends the winds as heralds of glad tidings, going before His Mercy (rain)? Is there any ilâh (god) with Allâh? High Exalted be Allâh above all that they associate as partners (to Him)!

metadata.arabic: أَمَّن يَبْدَؤُاْ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعيدُهُ وَمَن يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وٱلأَرْضِ أَإِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ قُلْ هَاتُواْ بُرْهَانَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Is not He (best), Who produceth creation) He Who begins creation from a sperm drop, (then reproduceth it) after death, (and Who provideth for you from the heaven) through rain (and the earth) through vegetation? (Is there any God beside Allah) who has done this? (Say: Bring your proof, if ye are truthful) that there is any other god beside Allah!

translation: Is not He (better than your so-called gods) Who originates creation, and shall thereafter repeat it, and Who provides for you from heaven and earth? Is there any ilâh (god) with Allâh? Say: "Bring forth your proofs, if you are truthful."

metadata.arabic: قُل لاَّ يَعْلَمُ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوٰتِ وٱلأَرْضِ ٱلْغَيْبَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Say) O Muhammad, to the people of Mecca: (None in the heavens) among angels (and the earth) among created beings (knoweth the Unseen) the appointed time for the advent of the Hour and descent of torment (save Allah; and they know not) and created beings know not (when they will be raised (again)) from the graves.

translation: Say: "None in the heavens and the earth knows the Ghaib (Unseen) except Allâh, nor can they perceive when they shall be resurrected."

metadata.arabic: بَلِ ٱدَّارَكَ عِلْمُهُمْ فِي ٱلآخِرَةِ بَلْ هُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِّنْهَا بَلْ هُم مِّنْهَا عَمُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Nay, but doth their knowledge reach to the Hereafter) their knowledge is in consensus that there is no Hereafter? (Nay, for they are in doubt concerning it) concerning the coming of the Hour. (Nay, for they cannot see it) they are blind, unable to see.

translation: Nay, they have no knowledge of the Hereafter. Nay, they are in doubt about it. Nay, they are in complete blindness about it.

metadata.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوۤاْ أَإِذَا كُنَّا تُرَاباً وَآبَآؤُنَآ أَإِنَّا لَمُخْرَجُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Yet those who disbelieve) the disbelievers of Mecca (say: when we have become) scattered (dust like our fathers) before us, (shall we verily be brought forth (again)) given life again and brought out of the graves?

translation: And those who disbelieve say: "When we have become dust - we and our fathers - shall we really be brought forth (again)?

metadata.arabic: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا هَـٰذَا نَحْنُ وَآبَآؤُنَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلاَّ أَسَاطِيرُ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (We were promised this) which you are promising us, (forsooth, we and our fathers) before us. ((All) this) which you are promising us, O Muhammad, (is naught but fables) tales (of the men of old.

translation: "Indeed we were promised this - we and our forefathers before (us), verily, these are nothing but tales of ancients."

metadata.arabic: قُلْ سِيرُواْ فِي ٱلأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُواْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: Say) O Muhammad, to the people of Mecca: (Travel in the land and see) and take admonition from (the nature of the sequel for the guilty) how was the end of the idolaters!

translation: Say to them (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) "Travel in the land and see how has been the end of the Mujrimûn (criminals, those who denied Allâh’s Messengers and disobeyed Allâh)."

metadata.arabic: وَلاَ تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلاَ تَكُن فِي ضَيْقٍ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And grieve thou not) O Muhammad (for them) if they do not believe; it is also said that this means: do not grieve for their destruction, (nor be in distress because of what they plot (against you)) and do not be grieved because of what they do and say against you.

translation: And grieve you not over them, nor be straitened (in distress) because of what they plot.

metadata.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And they say: When (will) this promise (be fulfilled)) when will come this promise that you so often promised us, (if ye are truthful) that the torment is coming?

translation: And they (the disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh) say: "When (will) this promise (be fulfilled), if you are truthful?"

metadata.arabic: قُلْ عَسَىٰ أَن يَكُونَ رَدِفَ لَكُم بَعْضُ ٱلَّذِي تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Say) to them, O Muhammad: (It may be) and “may be” when it comes from Allah denotes necessity (that a part of that which ye would hasten on) of punishment at the Day of Badr (is close behind you) is coming soon.

translation: Say: "Perhaps that which you wish to hasten on, may be close behind you.

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لاَ يَشْكُرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! thy Lord) O Muhammad (is full of bounty for mankind) for deferring His punishment, (but most of them do not give thanks) for the deferment of punishment.

translation: "Verily, your Lord is full of Grace for mankind, yet most of them do not give thanks."

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! thy Lord) O Muhammad (knoweth surely all that their bosoms hide) of hatred and enmity, (and all that they proclaim) and all that they display of disbelief, idolatry and aggression.

translation: And verily, your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they reveal.

metadata.arabic: وَمَا مِنْ غَآئِبَةٍ فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلأَرْضِ إِلاَّ فِي كِتَابٍ مُّبِينٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And there is nothing hidden) secret (in the heaven or the earth) from the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth (but it is in a clear Record) recorded in the Preserved or Guarded Tablet.

translation: And there is nothing hidden in the heaven and the earth but it is in a Clear Book (i.e. Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz).

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْآنَ يَقُصُّ عَلَىٰ بَنِيۤ إِسْرَائِيلَ أَكْثَرَ ٱلَّذِي هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! this Qur'an) which you recite to them, O Muhammad, (narrateth unto the Children of Israel) explains to Jews and Christians (most of that concerning which they differ) most of that which they oppose concerning Religion.

translation: Verily, this Qur’ân narrates to the Children of Israel most of that in which they differ.

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّهُ لَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤمِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo! It) i.e. the Qur'an (is a guidance) from error (and a mercy) shielding from the torment (for believers) in Muhammad (pbuh) and in the Qur'an.

translation: And truly, it (this Qur’ân) is a guide and a mercy for the believers.

metadata.arabic: إِن رَبَّكَ يَقْضِي بَيْنَهُم بِحُكْمِهِ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! thy Lord will judge between them) between the Jews and Christians (of His wisdom) by His judgement and decree on the Day of Judgement, (and He is the Mighty) in retribution against them, (the Knower) He knows them and knows their punishment.

translation: Verily, your Lord will decide between them (various sects) by His Judgement. And He is the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing.

metadata.arabic: فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ إِنَّكَ عَلَى ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلْمُبِينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Therefore) O Muhammad (put thy trust in Allah, for thou (standest) on the plain Truth) Islam.

translation: So put your trust in Allâh; surely, you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are on manifest truth.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّكَ لاَ تُسْمِعُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَلاَ تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْاْ مُدْبِرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! thou canst not) O Muhammad (make the dead) of hearts; and it is said: those who are like the dead, (to hear, nor canst thou make the deaf) those whose hearts are dead; it is also said that this means: those who pretend to be deaf (to hear the call) your call to the Truth and guidance (when they have turned) turn away (to flee) from the Truth and guidance;

translation: Verily, you cannot make the dead to hear nor can you make the deaf to hear the call (i.e. benefit them and similarly the disbelievers), when they flee, turning their backs.

metadata.arabic: وَمَآ أَنتَ بِهَادِي ٱلْعُمْيِ عَن ضَلالَتِهِمْ إِن تُسْمِعُ إِلاَّ مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِآيَاتِنَا فَهُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Nor canst thou) O Muhammad (lead the blind out of their error) to guidance. (Thou canst make none to hear) your call, (save those who believe Our revelations) Our Scripture and Messenger (and who have surrendered) and are sincere in their worship and profession of Allah's divine Oneness.

translation: Nor can you lead the blind out of their error. You can only make to hear those who believe in Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), and who have submitted (themselves to Allâh in Islâm as Muslims).

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا وَقَعَ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِم أَخْرَجْنَا لَهُمْ دَآبَّةً مِّنَ ٱلأَرْضِ تُكَلِّمُهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ كَانُوا بِآيَاتِنَا لاَ يُوقِنُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And when the word) bringing curse and torment upon them (is fulfilled concerning them, We shall bring forth a beast of the earth) between the Safa and al-Marwah, and this is the staff of Moses; it is also said that this beast will come with the staff of Moses (to speak unto them because mankind had not faith) they did not believe (in Our revelations) i.e. in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an; and it is also said that this means: they did not believe in the advent of the beast.

translation: And when the Word (of torment) is fulfilled against them, We shall bring out from the earth a beast for them, to speak to them because mankind believed not with certainty in Our Ayât (Verses of the Qur’ân and Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم).

metadata.arabic: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ فَوْجاً مِّمَّن يُكَذِّبُ بِآيَاتِنَا فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And (remind them of) the Day) which is the Day of Judgement (when We shall gather out of every nation) from the adherents of every religion (a host) a group (of those who denied Our revelations) Our Book and Messenger, (and they will be set in array) they will be stopped from the first to the last, one after the other;

translation: And (remember) the Day when We shall gather out of every nation a troop of those who denied Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), and (then) they (all) shall be driven (to the place of reckoning),

metadata.arabic: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا جَآءُو قَالَ أَكَذَّبْتُم بِآيَاتِي وَلَمْ تُحِيطُواْ بِهَا عِلْماً أَمَّا ذَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Till, when they come (before their Lord)) gathered all together, (He will say) Allah will say to them: (Did ye deny My revelations) My Book and Messenger (when ye could not compass them in knowledge) He says: you denied them while you knew not that they did not come from Me, (or what was it that ye did) in your disbelief and idolatry?

translation: Till, when they come (before their Lord at the place of reckoning), He will say: "Did you deny My Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) whereas you comprehended them not by knowledge (of their truth or falsehood), or what (else) was it that you used to do?"

metadata.arabic: وَوَقَعَ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَيهِم بِمَا ظَلَمُواْ فَهُمْ لاَ يَنطِقُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And the Word will be fulfilled concerning them) that they will incur a punishment and a curse (because they have done wrong) because of their disbelief and idolatry, (and they will not speak) they will not answer back.

translation: And the Word (of torment) will be fulfilled against them, because they have done wrong, and they will be unable to speak (in order to defend themselves).

metadata.arabic: أَلَمْ يَرَوْاْ أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا ٱلْلَّيْلَ لِيَسْكُنُواْ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبْصِراً إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Have they not) the disbelievers of Mecca (seen how We have appointed the night that they may rest therein, and the day sight giving) and the day bright, so that they seek their livelihood? (Lo! Therein) in that which We have done to them (verily are portents) signs (for a people who believe) for people who have faith.

translation: See they not that We have made the night for them to rest therein, and the day sight-giving? Verily, in this are Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) for the people who believe.

metadata.arabic: وَيَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَفَزِعَ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِي ٱلأَرْضِ إِلاَّ مَن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ وَكُلٌّ أَتَوْهُ دَاخِرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And (remind them of) the Day when the Trumpet will be blown) this is the blowing of death, (and all who are in the heavens) the angels (and the earth) of created beings (will start in fear) will die, (save him whom Allah wills) from among the dwellers of heaven: Gabriel, Michael, Seraphiel and the angel of death, for these will not die upon the first blowing of the Trumpet, but they will die after that. (And all) i.e. the dwellers of the heavens and earth (come unto Him, humbled) they will come to Allah on the Day of Judgement abased and humbled.

translation: And (remember) the Day on which the Trumpet will be blown - and all who are in the heavens and all who are on the earth, will be terrified except him whom Allâh will (exempt). And all shall come to Him, humbled.

metadata.arabic: وَتَرَى ٱلْجِبَالَ تَحْسَبُهَا جَامِدَةً وَهِيَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ ٱلسَّحَابِ صُنْعَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِيۤ أَتْقَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ إِنَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَفْعَلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And thou seest) O Muhammad upon the first blow of the trumpet (the hills thou deemest solid) and still (flying with the flight of clouds) in the air: (the doing of Allah) this is the doing of Allah with His creation (Who perfecteth all things) of creation. (Lo! He is Informed) Aware (of what ye do) of good or evil.

translation: And you will see the mountains and think them solid, but they shall pass away as the passing away of the clouds. The Work of Allâh, Who perfected all things, verily He is Well-Acquainted with what you do.

metadata.arabic: مَن جَآءَ بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهَا وَهُمْ مِّن فَزَعٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ آمِنُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Whoso bringeth a good deed) whoever comes on the Day of Judgement with “there is no god save Allah” sincerely believing in it (will have better than its worth) all his goodness derives from it; (and such are safe from fear that Day) they are safe from fear and torment when the Fire is closed.

translation: Whoever brings a good deed (i.e. Belief in the Oneness of Allâh along with every deed of righteousness), will have better than its worth; and they will be safe from the terror on that Day.

metadata.arabic: وَمَن جَآءَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ فَكُبَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِي ٱلنَّارِ هَلْ تُجْزَوْنَ إِلاَّ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And whoso bringeth an ill-deed) associating partners with Allah, (such will be flung down on their faces in the Fire. Are ye rewarded) in the Hereafter (aught save what ye did) in this worldly life?

translation: And whoever brings an evil deed (i.e. Shirk - polytheism, disbelief in the Oneness of Allâh and every evil sinful deed), they will be cast down (prone) on their faces in the Fire. (And it will be said to them) "Are you being recompensed anything except what you used to do?"

metadata.arabic: إِنَّمَآ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ رَبَّ هَذِهِ ٱلْبَلْدَةِ ٱلَّذِي حَرَّمَهَا وَلَهُ كُلُّ شَيءٍ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
