translation: (It will be said to them): Salâm (peace be on you) - a Word from the Lord (Allâh), Most Merciful.

metadata.arabic: وَٱمْتَازُواْ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (But avaunt ye) Allah will say to them: disperse today, (O ye guilty, this day) O you who ascribed partners to Me! Thus He distinguished them from the believers.

translation: (It will be said): "And O you Mujrimûn (criminals, polytheists, sinners, disbelievers in the Islâmic Monotheism, wicked evil ones)! Get you apart this Day (from the believers).

metadata.arabic: أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يٰبَنِيۤ ءَادَمَ أَن لاَّ تَعْبُدُواْ ٱلشَّيطَانَ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
metadata.Tafsir: He will also say to them: (Did I not charge you) did I not present to you, in the Scripture brought by the Messenger, (O ye sons of Adam, that ye worship not the devil) that you should not obey the devil. (Lo! he is your open foe) whose enmity is quite manifest!

translation: Did I not command you, O Children of Adam, that you should not worship Shaitân (Satan). Verily, he is a plain enemy to you.

metadata.arabic: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِي هَـٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (But that ye worship Me) but that you should believe in My divine Oneness? (That) the profession of Allah's divine Oneness (was the right path) a straight, true religion.

translation: And that you should worship Me [Alone - Islâmic Monotheism, and set up not rivals, associate-gods with Me]. That is the Straight Path.

metadata.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنْكُمْ جِبِلاًّ كَثِيراً أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُواْ تَعْقِلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Yet he) the devil (hath led astray of you) O children of Adam (a great multitude) of people before you. (Had ye then no sense) did you not know what he did to them, and hence avoid following their path?

translation: And indeed he (Satan) did lead astray a great multitude of you. Did you not, then, understand?

metadata.arabic: هَـٰذِهِ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (This is hell which you were promised) in the life of the world.

translation: This is Hell which you were promised!

metadata.arabic: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Burn therein this day for that you disbelieved) in it and also because of your denial of the Scriptures and the messengers.

translation: Burn therein this Day, for that you used to disbelieve.

metadata.arabic: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰ أَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُمْ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكْسِبُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (This day) which is the Day of Judgement (We seal up mouths) We prevent them from talking because of their denial, (and hands speak out) revealing what they had struck (and feet bear witness) testify about where they went and their limbs testify (as to what they used to earn) of evil.

translation: This Day, We shall seal up their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their legs will bear witness to what they used to earn. (It is said that one’s left thigh will be the first to bear the witness). [Tafsir At-Tabarî,]

metadata.arabic: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُواْ ٱلصِّرَاطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And had We willed, We verily could have quenched their eyesight) verily, We would have quenched the eyes of their error (so that they should struggle for the way) so that they would see the way. (Then how could they have seen) how could they see the way when their error has not been removed?

translation: And if it had been Our Will, We would surely have wiped out (blinded) their eyes, so that they would struggle for the Path, how then would they see?

metadata.arabic: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَاهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَـانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَاعُواْ مُضِيّاً وَلاَ يَرْجِعُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And had We willed, We verily could have fixed them in their place) We could have turned them into apes and swine in their own homes, (making them powerless to go forward) making them unable to come and go (or turn back) to their initial state.

translation: And if it had been Our Will, We could have transformed them (into animals or lifeless objects) in their places. Then they would have been unable to go forward (move about) nor they could have turned back.

metadata.arabic: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّـسْهُ فِي ٱلْخَلْقِ أَفَلاَ يَعْقِلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (He whom We bring unto old age, We reverse him in creation (making him go back to weakness after strength)) until he becomes like a little child, possessing no teeth or power, he urinates and defecates on himself like a young child. (Have ye then no sense) do you then not believe in this?

translation: And he whom We grant long life - We reverse him in creation (weakness after strength). Will they not then understand?

metadata.arabic: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَاهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنبَغِي لَهُ إِنْ هُوَ إِلاَّ ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْآنٌ مُّبِينٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (And we have not taught him) i.e. Muhammad (pbuh) (poetry, nor is it meet for him) poetry is not appropriate for him. (This is) i.e. the Qur'an (naught else than a Reminder) an admonition (and a Lecture making plain) the lawful and unlawful, the commands and prohibitions,

translation: And We have not taught him (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) poetry, nor is it suitable for him. This is only a Reminder and a plain Qur’ân.

metadata.arabic: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيّاً وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَافِرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (To warn) so that Muhammad (pbuh) warns by means of the Qur'an (whosoever liveth) whoever has an intellect, (and that the word) enjoining wrath and punishment (may be fulfilled against the disbelievers) of Mecca such that they do not believe in Muhammad (pbuh) or in the Qur'an.

translation: That he or it (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم or the Qur’ân) may give warning to him who is living (a healthy minded - the believer), and that Word (charge) may be justified against the disbelievers (dead, as they reject the warnings).

metadata.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْاْ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعاماً فَهُمْ لَهَا مَالِكُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Have they not seen) have they not been informed (how We have created for them) for the people of Mecca (of Our handiwork) by means of Our power (the cattle, so that they are their owners) and controllers,

translation: Do they not see that We have created for them of what Our Hands have created the cattle, so that they are their owners.

metadata.arabic: وَذَلَّلْنَاهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And have subdued them unto them) and made the cattle subservient to them, (so that some of them they have for riding, some for food) their meat is food for them?

translation: And We have subdued them unto them so that some of them they have for riding and some they eat.

metadata.arabic: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَافِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ أَفَلاَ يَشْكُرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Benefits) carrying their loads and trading through them (and (divers) drinks) from their milk (have they) i.e. the people of Mecca (from them) from the cattle. (Will they not then give thanks) to He Who did this for them and, thus, believe in Him?

translation: And they have (other) benefits from them, and they get (milk) to drink. Will they not then be grateful?

metadata.arabic: وَٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ آلِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And they have) and the disbelievers of Mecca worshipped ((other) gods) idols (beside Allah, in order that they may be helped) so that they may save them from Allah's punishment.

translation: And they have taken besides Allâh âlihah (gods), hoping that they might be helped (by those so-called gods).

metadata.arabic: لاَ يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌ مُّحْضَرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (It is not in their power to help them) the idols are unable to save them from Allah's chastisement; (but they) i.e. the disbelievers of Mecca (are unto them) in falsehood (a host in arms) like slaves standing before the idols.

translation: They cannot help them, but they will be brought forward as a troop against those who worshipped them (at the time of Reckoning).

metadata.arabic: فَلاَ يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (So let not their speech) their denial (grieve thee) O Muhammad. (Lo! We know what they conceal) of plotting and treachery (and proclaim) of enmity.

translation: So let not their speech, then, grieve you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم). Verily, We know what they conceal and what they reveal.

metadata.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلإِنسَانُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Hath not man seen) does not Ubayy Ibn Khalaf know (that We have created him from a drop of seed) of a weak and stinking sperm drop? (Yet lo! he is an open opponent) he openly argues in falsehood.

translation: Does not man see that We have created him from Nutfah (mixed male and female sexual discharge - semen drops). Yet behold he (stands forth) as an open opponent.

metadata.arabic: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلاً وَنَسِيَ خَلْقَهُ قَالَ مَن يُحيِي ٱلْعِظَامَ وَهِيَ رَمِيمٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (And he hath coined for Us a similitude) he gave Us a similitude regarding bones, (and hath forgotten the fact of his creation) he left out the mention of his initial creation, (saying: Who will revive these bones when they have rotted away) who will revive these bones when they become dust?

translation: And he puts forth for Us a parable, and forgets his own creation. He says: "Who will give life to these bones after they are rotten and have become dust?"

metadata.arabic: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِيۤ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Say) to him, O Muhammad: (He will revive them Who produced them) Who created them (at the first) from a sperm drop, (for He is Knower of every creation) He is Knower of the creation of everything,

translation: Say: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) "He will give life to them Who created them for the first time! And He is the All-Knower of every creation!"

metadata.arabic: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلأَخْضَرِ نَاراً فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْه تُوقِدُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Who hath appointed for you fire) other than the Fire of punishment (from the green tree, and behold! Ye) O people of Mecca (kindle from it) you derive from the green tree fire.

translation: He Who produces for you fire out of the green tree, when behold you kindle therewith.

metadata.arabic: أَوَلَـيْسَ ٱلَذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَاواتِ وَٱلأَرْضَ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَىٰ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلاَّقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
metadata.Tafsir: (Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth Able to create) to revive (the like of them? Aye that He is!) He is Able to do so, (for He is the All-Wise Creator) Who will resurrect the dead,

translation: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth, Able to create the like of them? Yes, indeed! He is the All-Knowing Supreme Creator.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْئاً أَن يَقُولَ لَهُ كُن فَيَكُونُ
metadata.Tafsir: (But His command) regarding the resurrection, (when He intends a thing) when He wishes the resurrection to take place, (is only that he says unto it: Be! and it is) and the coming of the Hour happens.

translation: Verily, His Command, when He intends a thing, is only that He says to it, "Be!" - and it is!

metadata.arabic: فَسُبْحَانَ ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Therefore glory be to Him) Allah glorified Himself (in Whose hand is the dominion over all things) the stores of all things and the creating of all things! (Unto Him you will be brought back) after death and He will requite you each according to his works'.

translation: So glorified be He and exalted above all that they associate with Him, and in Whose Hands is the dominion of all things: and to Him you shall be returned.

metadata.arabic: وَٱلصَّافَّاتِ صَفَّا
metadata.Tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (By those who set the ranks in battle order): '(By those who set the ranks in battle order) Allah swore by the angels who are, in heaven, aligned in rows like the rows of the believers in prayer.

translation: By those (angels) ranged in ranks (or rows).

metadata.arabic: فَٱلزَّاجِرَاتِ زَجْراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And those who drive away with reproof) He also swore by the angels who drive away the clouds and bring them together.

translation: By those (angels) who drive the clouds in a good way.

metadata.arabic: فَٱلتَّٰلِيَٰتِ ذِكْراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And those who read (the Word) for a reminder) He swore by the angels who recite the Qur'an; it is also said that He swore by the reciters of the Qur'an,

translation: By those (angels) who bring the Book and the Qur’ân from Allâh to mankind [Tafsir Ibn Kathîr].

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ إِلَـٰهَكُمْ لَوَاحِدٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! thy Lord is surely One) without a son or partner; this oath says: O people of Mecca, your Lord is One, He has no son or partner.

translation: Verily your Ilâh (God) is indeed One (i.e. Allâh):

metadata.arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَارِقِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lord of the heavens and of the earth) the Creator of the heavens and of the earth (and all that is between them) of created beings and marvels, (and Lord of the sun's risings) the risings of winter and summer.

translation: Lord of the heavens and of the earth, and all that is between them, and Lord of every point of the sun’s risings.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! We have adorned the lowest heaven) the first heaven (with an ornament, the planets) He says: the first heaven is adorned with planets:

translation: Verily We have adorned the near heaven with the stars (for beauty).

metadata.arabic: وَحِفْظاً مِّن كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ مَّارِدٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (With security) He says: they are made safe (from every froward devil) from every tough, rebellious devil.

translation: And to guard against every rebellious devil.

metadata.arabic: لاَّ يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَىٰ ٱلْمَلإِ ٱلأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (They cannot listen) so that they do not listen (to the Highest Chiefs) to the speech of the angels, i.e. the guardian angels, regarding that which is communicated amongst them (for they are pelted from every side) they rise up to,

translation: They cannot listen to the higher group (angels) for they are pelted from every side.

metadata.arabic: دُحُوراً وَلَهُمْ عَذابٌ وَاصِبٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Outcast) they are driven away from heaven and from listening to the angels, (and theirs is a perpetual torment) by means of the stars; and it is also said that this means: in the Fire;

translation: Outcast, and theirs is a constant (or painful) torment.

metadata.arabic: إِلاَّ مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Save him who snatcheth a fragment) save him who snatches a little of the words of the angels, (and there pursueth him a piercing flame) and is chased by a bright star which burns him.

translation: Except such as snatch away something by stealing, and they are pursued by a flaming fire of piercing brightness.

metadata.arabic: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقاً أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُم مِّن طِينٍ لاَّزِبٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then ask them (O Muhammad)) ask the people of Mecca: (Are they stronger as a creation) as a resurrected people, (or those (others) whom We have created) of angels and all other people? (Lo! We created them of plastic) sticking (clay) We created them from Adam and Adam is from clay.

translation: Then ask them (i.e. these polytheists, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Are they stronger as creation, or those (others like the heavens and the earth and the mountains) whom We have created?" Verily, We created them of a sticky clay.

metadata.arabic: بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Nay, but thou dost) O Muhammad (marvel) their denial of you (when they mock) you and your Scripture.

translation: Nay, you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) wondered (at their insolence) while they mock (at you and at the Qur’ân).

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُواْ لاَ يَذْكُرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And heed not) and take no admonition (when they are reminded) by the Qur'an,

translation: And when they are reminded, they pay no attention.

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْاْ آيَةً يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And seek to scoff when they) the people of Mecca (behold a portent) a sign such as the splitting of the moon and the eclipse of the sun.

translation: And when they see an Ayâh (a sign, or an evidence) from Allâh, they mock at it.

metadata.arabic: وَقَالُوۤاْ إِن هَـٰذَآ إِلاَّ سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (And they say: lo! This) which Muhammad (pbuh) brought us (is mere magic) a manifest lie;

translation: And they say: "This is nothing but evident magic!

metadata.arabic: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَاباً وَعِظَاماً أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (When we are dead and have become dust and) withered (bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised (again)) shall we then be brought back to life after we die? Say to them, O Muhammad: indeed you shall.

translation: "When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we (then) verily be resurrected?

metadata.arabic: أَوَ آبَآؤُنَا ٱلأَوَّلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: They asked: (And our forefathers) shall they be raised again?

translation: "And also our fathers of old?"

metadata.arabic: قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنتُمْ دَاخِرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Say (O Muhammad): Yea, in truth; and ye) and them (will be brought low) abased and humiliated.

translation: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Yes, and you shall then be humiliated."

metadata.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجْرَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (There is but one Shout) it is but one single blow, which is the blowing of the Resurrection, (and lo!) they emerge from the graves and (they behold) what they will be commanded to do.

translation: It will be a single Zajrah [shout (i.e. the second blowing of the Trumpet)], and behold, they will be staring!

metadata.arabic: وَقَالُواْ يٰوَيْلَنَا هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And say) when they come forth from their graves: (Ah, woe for us! This is the Day of Judgement) this is the Day of Reckoning.

translation: They will say: "Woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense!"

metadata.arabic: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِي كُنتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: And the angels will say to them: (This is the Day of Separation) the Day of Judgement between you and the believers, (which ye used to deny) in the life of this world.

translation: (It will be said): "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."

metadata.arabic: ٱحْشُرُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ وَأَزْوَاجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُواْ يَعْبُدُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: Allah would then say to the angels: (Assemble those who did wrong) assemble those who associated partners with Allah, (together with their wives) with their friends and those who are of their calibre from among the jinn, humans and satans (and what they used to worship) of idols

translation: (It will be said to the angels): "Assemble those who did wrong, together with their companions (from the devils) and what they used to worship,

metadata.arabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Instead of Allah, and lead them to the path to hell) to the middle of hell;

translation: "Instead of Allâh, and lead them on to the way of flaming Fire (Hell);

metadata.arabic: وَقِفُوهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ مَّسْئُولُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: Allah would also say to the angels: (And stop them) detain them in hell, (for they must be questioned) about this claim; it is also said that this means: they will be questioned about their rejection of “there is no deity except Allah”.

translation: "But stop them, verily they are to be questioned.

metadata.arabic: مَا لَكُمْ لاَ تَنَاصَرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (What aileth you that ye help not one another?) how is it that you do not save yourselves from Allah's chastisement, or help one another to avoid Allah's chastisement?

translation: "What is the matter with you? Why do you not help one another (as you used to do in the world)?"

metadata.arabic: بَلْ هُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Nay, but this day) which is the Day of Judgement (they make full submission) the worshipper and the worshipped submitted to Allah and knew that the Truth is with Allah.

translation: Nay, but that Day they shall surrender.

metadata.arabic: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And some of them draw near unto others) the humans go to the satans and the lowly among people go to the leaders, (mutually questioning) reproaching one another and arguing.

translation: And they will turn to one another and question one another.

metadata.arabic: قَالُوۤاْ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (They say) i.e. the humans say to the satans: (Lo! ye used to come unto us, imposing, (swearing that ye spoke the Truth)) and enticing us to reject Religion.

translation: They will say: "It was you who used to come to us from the right side [i.e. from the right side of one of us and beautify for us every evil, enjoin on us polytheism, and stop us from the truth i.e. Islâmic Monotheism and from every good deed]."

metadata.arabic: قَالُواْ بَلْ لَّمْ تَكُونُواْ مُؤْمِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (They answer) the satans would answer the humans: (Nay, but ye (yourselves) were not believers) in Allah.

translation: They will reply: "Nay, you yourselves were not believers.

metadata.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُمْ مِّن سُلْطَانٍ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْماً طَاغِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (We had no power over you) we had no reason or proof to win you over, (but ye were wayward folk) but you were disbelievers in Allah.

translation: "And we had no authority over you. Nay! But you were Tâghûn (transgressing) people (polytheists, and disbelievers).

metadata.arabic: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Now the Word of our Lord) that His chastisement and wrath will be enjoined upon us (hath been fulfilled concerning us. Lo! we are about to taste (the doom)) of the Fire.

translation: "So now the Word of our Lord has been justified against us, that we shall certainly (have to) taste (the torment).

metadata.arabic: فَأَغْوَيْنَاكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَاوِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Thus we misled you) from Religion. (Lo! we were (ourselves) astray) from Religion.

translation: "So we led you astray because we were ourselves astray."

metadata.arabic: فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ فِي ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then lo! this day) which is the Day of Judgement (they (both) are sharers in the doom) the worshipper and those worshipped.

translation: Then verily, that Day, they will (all) share in the torment.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! thus deal We with the guilty) thus We deal with the idolaters.

translation: Certainly, that is how We deal with Al-Mujrimûn (polytheists, sinners, disbelievers, criminals, the disobedient to Allâh).

metadata.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوۤاْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لاَ إِلَـٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (For when it was said unto them) in the life of the world, say: (There is no god save Allah, they were scornful) they were too proud to say it

translation: Truly, when it was said to them: Lâ ilâha illallâh "(none has the right to be worshipped but Allâh)," they puffed themselves up with pride (i.e. denied it).

metadata.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوۤاْ آلِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَّجْنُونٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And said: Shall we forsake our gods) shall we leave the worship of our gods (for a mad poet) who invents lies? Meaning the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh).

translation: And (they) said: "Are we going to abandon our âlihah (gods) for the sake of a mad poet?"

metadata.arabic: بَلْ جَآءَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Nay, but he) Muhammad (pbuh) (brought the Truth) he brought the Qur'an and the profession of Allah's divine Oneness, (and he confirmed those sent (before him)) and he brought a confirmation of the messengers who were sent before him.

translation: Nay! he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) has come with the truth (i.e. Allâh’s religion - Islâmic Monotheism and this Qur’ân) and he confirms the Messengers (before him who brought Allâh’s religion - Islâmic Monotheism).

metadata.arabic: إِنَّكُمْ لَذَآئِقُو ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلأَلِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! (now) verily ye) O people of Mecca (taste the painful doom) in the Fire.

translation: Verily, you (pagans of Makkah) are going to taste the painful torment;

metadata.arabic: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلاَّ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Ye are requited) in the Hereafter (naught save what ye did) in the life of the world in your state of idolatry and disbelief.

translation: And you will be requited nothing except for what you used to do (evil deeds, sins, and Allâh’s disobedience which you used to do in this world)

metadata.arabic: إِلاَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Save single minded slaves of Allah) who are protected from disbelief and idolatry; it is also said that its meaning is: save those who are chosen for worship and for the profession of Allah's divine Oneness;

translation: Save the chosen slaves of Allâh (i.e. the true believers of Islâmic Monotheism).

metadata.arabic: أُوْلَئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (For them there is a known provision) in measure for the morning and evening of the life of this world, except that over there there is no morning or evening.

translation: For them there will be a known provision (in Paradise),

metadata.arabic: فَوَاكِهُ وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Fruits) they have different kinds of fruit. (And they will be honoured) with gifts

translation: Fruits; and they shall be honoured,

metadata.arabic: فِي جَنَّاتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: (In the Gardens of Delight) whose delight is endless,

translation: In the Gardens of delight (Paradise),

metadata.arabic: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَابِلِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (On couches facing one another) upon visitation

translation: Facing one another on thrones.

metadata.arabic: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِكَأْسٍ مِّن مَّعِينٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (A cup) of wine (from a gushing spring) of pure wine (is brought round for them) as service,

translation: Round them will be passed a cup of pure wine -

metadata.arabic: بَيْضَآءَ لَذَّةٍ لِّلشَّارِبِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (White, delicious to the drinkers,

translation: White, delicious to the drinkers.

metadata.arabic: لاَ فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلاَ هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: Wherein) in drinking this wine (there is no headache) stomach-ache, drunkenness, harm or sinning (nor are they made mad thereby) because of intoxication; it is also said that this means: they never run out of it.

translation: Neither will they have Ghoul (any kind of hurt, abdominal pain, headache, a sin) from that, nor will they suffer intoxication therefrom.

metadata.arabic: وَعِندَهُمْ قَاصِرَاتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ عِينٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (And with them) in Paradise (are those of modest gaze) wives who lower their gaze, content with their husbands and wish no man instead of their husband, (with lovely eyes) and beautiful faces,

translation: And beside them will be Qâsirât-at-Tarf [chaste females (wives), restraining their glances (desiring none except their husbands)], with wide and beautiful eyes.

metadata.arabic: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (As they were hidden eggs) in their purity, in both heat and cold.

translation: (Delicate and pure) as if they were (hidden) eggs (well) preserved.

metadata.arabic: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning) conversing with one another.

translation: Then they will turn to one another, mutually questioning.

metadata.arabic: قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّي كَانَ لِي قَرِينٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (A speaker of them saith) one of the inhabitants of Paradise, Yehuda the believer, says: (Lo! I had a comrade) whose name was Abu Qutrus, who was actually his brother.

translation: A speaker of them will say: "Verily, I had a companion (in the world),

metadata.arabic: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصَدِّقِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Who used to say: Art thou in truth of those who put faith (in his words)) do you really believe those messengers?

translation: Who used to say: "Are you among those who believe (in resurrection after death).

metadata.arabic: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَاباً وَعِظَاماً أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Can we, when we are dead and have become mere dust and) rotten (bones, can we (then) verily be brought to book) because he denied resurrection after death?

translation: "(That) when we die and become dust and bones, shall we indeed (be raised up) to receive reward or punishment (according to our deeds)?"

metadata.arabic: قَالَ هَلْ أَنتُمْ مُّطَّلِعُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (He saith) to his brothers in Paradise: (Will ye look) in the Fire that haply you may find out about his state?

translation: (The speaker) said: "Will you look down?"

metadata.arabic: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَآهُ فِي سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then looketh he and seeth him) and sees his disbelieving brother (in the depth of hell) in the middle of hell.

translation: So he looked down and saw him in the midst of the Fire.

metadata.arabic: قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرْدِينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (He saith: By Allah, thou verily didst all but cause my ruin) you almost led me away from Religion and you would have certainly destroyed me if I obeyed you,

translation: He said: "By Allâh! You have nearly ruined me.

metadata.arabic: وَلَوْلاَ نِعْمَةُ رَبِّي لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And had it not been for the favour of my Lord) Who bestowed faith upon me and protected me from disbelief, (I too had been of those haled forth (to doom)) I too would be tormented with you in the Fire.

translation: "Had it not been for the Grace of my Lord, I would certainly have been among those brought forth (to Hell)."

metadata.arabic: أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: Then he heard a crier saying: " O people of Paradise death is slain and from now on there is no death ". Upon which he will say to his brothers: (Are we then not to die) after the slaying of death

translation: (The dwellers of Paradise will say) "Are we then not to die (any more)?

metadata.arabic: إِلاَّ مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Saving our former death) after our death in the life of the world. They would say to him: “Yes, indeed!” Thereupon he will hear a crier crying: “O people of hell! The fire is now closed; none will enter it or leave it”, and he will say to his brothers: (and are we not to be punished) after the Fire is closed? And their answer will be in the affirmative.

translation: Except our first death, and we shall not be punished? (after we have entered Paradise)."

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! this is the Supreme Triumph) this is the ultimate safety; we gained Paradise and all that which is in it and were saved from hell and all that which is in it. The story of these two brothers is the same story of the two brothers mentioned in surah al-Kahf, one of whom was a believer, this is Yehuda, and the other an unbeliever, Abu Qutrus.

translation: Truly, this is the supreme success!

metadata.arabic: لِمِثْلِ هَـٰذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ ٱلْعَامِلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: Then Allah will say to him: (For the like of this, then) eternity in Paradise and its bliss, (let the workers work) let those who hasten to do righteous works hasten to do them; it is also said that this means: for the like of this let those who compete to spend in the way of Allah spend their wealth; and it is also said that this means: for the like of this let those who strive in seeking knowledge and worship strive.

translation: For the like of this let the workers work.

metadata.arabic: أَذَلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُّزُلاً أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Is this) which I have mentioned for the inhabitants of Paradise of food and drink (better as a welcome) better as food, drink and reward for the believers, (or the tree of Zaqqum) for Abu Jahl and his host?

translation: Is that (Paradise) better entertainment or the tree of Zaqqûm (a horrible tree in Hell)?

metadata.arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاهَا فِتْنَةً لِّلظَّالِمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! We have appointed it) We mentioned it as (a torment) a trial (for wrong-doers) Abu Jahl and his host, for they said: the Zaqqum is nothing but dates and butter.

translation: Truly We have made it (as) a trail for the Zâlimûn (polytheists, disbelievers, wrong-doers).

metadata.arabic: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِيۤ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! it is a tree that springeth) grows (in the heart of hell) in the middle of hell.

translation: Verily, it is a tree that springs out of the bottom of Hell-fire,

metadata.arabic: طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَاطِينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Its crop) its fruit (is as it were the heads of devils) the heads of snakes which resemble devils. This kind of snakes is found near Yemen.

translation: The shoots of its fruit-stalks are like the heads of Shayâtîn (devils);

metadata.arabic: فَإِنَّهُمْ لآكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِئُونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo! They) i.e. the people of Mecca as well as all the disbelievers (verily must eat thereof) of the tree of Zaqqum, (and fill (their) bellies therewith) and fill their bellies of it.

translation: Truly, they will eat thereof and fill their bellies therewith.

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْباً مِنْ حَمِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And afterward, lo! thereupon they have a drink of boiling water) to go with the Zaqqum.

translation: Then on the top of that they will be given boiling water to drink so that it becomes a mixture (of boiling water and Zaqqûm in their bellies).

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لإِلَى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And afterward, lo! their return) their destination (is surely unto hell) the middle of hell.

translation: Then thereafter, verily, their return is to the flaming fire of Hell.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْاْ آبَآءَهُمْ ضَآلِّينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (They indeed found their fathers) in the life of this world (astray) from the Truth and guidance,

translation: Verily, they found their fathers on the wrong path;

metadata.arabic: فَهُمْ عَلَىٰ آثَارِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (But they make haste (to follow) in their footsteps) they hasten to follow their religion, and do as they did.

translation: So they (too) hastened in their footsteps!

metadata.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And verily most of the men of old) of past generations, (went astray before them) before your folk, O Muhammad.

translation: And indeed most of the men of old went astray before them;

metadata.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ مُّنذِرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And verily We sent among them warners) but they disbelieved in them and, as a result, We destroyed them.

translation: And indeed We sent among them warners (Messengers);

metadata.arabic: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then see) O Muhammad (the nature of the consequence for) the requital of (those warned) of those who were warned by the messenger, but chose to disbelieve, how we destroyed them,

translation: Then see what was the end of those who were warned (but heeded not).

metadata.arabic: إِلاَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: Allah then made an exception, saying: (Save singled minded slaves of Allah) who are protected from disbelief and idolatry; and it is said that this means according to a variant reading: except those chosen for worship and the profession of Allah's divine Oneness. The latter did not disbelieve and therefore We did not destroy them.

translation: Except the chosen slaves of Allâh (faithful, obedient, and true believers of Islâmic Monotheism).

metadata.arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَادَانَا نُوحٌ فَلَنِعْمَ ٱلْمُجِيبُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And Noah verily prayed unto Us) Noah prayed against his folk, saying: (My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers in the land…) [Noah, 71: 26-27], (and gracious was the Hearer of his prayer) by destroying his folk.

translation: And indeed Nûh (Noah) invoked Us, and We are the Best of those who answer (the request).

metadata.arabic: وَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And We saved him and his household) and all those who believed in him (from the great distress) i.e. drowning,

translation: And We rescued him and his family from the great distress (i.e. drowning),

metadata.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُ هُمُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And made his seed the survivors) until the Day of Judgement. Noah had three sons: Shem, Ham and Yapheth. Shem is the father of the Arabs and those people surrounding them; Ham is the father the Abyssinians, Berbers and inhabitants of Sind; and Yapheth is the father of the rest of people,

translation: And, his progeny, them We made the survivors (i.e. Shem, Ham and Japheth).

metadata.arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي ٱلآخِرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And left for him) for Noah good praise (among the later folk) who remained after him:

translation: And left for him (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations:

metadata.arabic: سَلاَمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍ فِي ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Peace be unto Noah) safety and happiness from Us unto Noah (among the peoples) of his time!

translation: "Salâm (peace) be upon Nûh (Noah) (from Us) among the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)!"

metadata.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! thus do We reward the good) in words and works by bestowing upon them good praise and safety.

translation: Verily, thus We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers - See V.2:112).

metadata.arabic: إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves.

translation: Verily, he [Nûh (Noah)] was one of Our believing slaves.

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلآخَرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: Then We did drown the others) those who remained after him.

translation: Then We drowned the others (disbelievers and polytheists).

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِ لإِبْرَاهِيمَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo! of his persuasion) of Noah's persuasion; and it is also said this means: of Muhammad's persuasion (verily was Abraham) He says: Abraham followed the religion and way of Noah and Muhammad (pbuh) followed Abraham's religion and way.

translation: And, verily, among those who followed his [Nûh’s (Noah)] way (Islâmic Monotheism) was Ibrâhîm (Abraham).

metadata.arabic: إِذْ جَآءَ رَبَّهُ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (When he came unto his Lord) He says: when Abraham betook himself to worshipping his Lord (with a whole heart) with a heart free from any blemish;

translation: When he came to his Lord with a pure heart [attached to Allâh Alone and none else, worshipping none but Allâh Alone - true Islâmic Monotheism, pure from the filth of polytheism].

metadata.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (When he said unto his father) Azar (and his folk) the idol worshippers: (What is it that you worship) beside Allah?

translation: When he said to his father and to his people: "What is it that which you worship?

metadata.arabic: أَإِفْكاً آلِهَةً دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: They replied: " we worship idols " , to which Abraham said: (Is it a falsehood gods beside Allah that ye desire) do you then worship false deities?

translation: "Is it a falsehood - âlihah (gods) other than Allâh - that you desire?

metadata.arabic: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (What then is your opinion of the Lord of the Worlds) what do you think He will do to you if you worship other than Him?

translation: "Then what think you about the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn, and all that exists)?"

metadata.arabic: فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةً فِي ٱلنُّجُومِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And he glanced a glance at the stars) it is also said that this means: he reflected for a while,

translation: Then he cast a glance at the stars,

metadata.arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَقِيمٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then said: Lo! I feel sick!) so that they leave him alone.

translation: And he said: "Verily, I am sick (with plague). [He did this trick to remain in their temple of idols to destroy them and not to accompany them to the pagan feast)]."

metadata.arabic: فَتَوَلَّوْاْ عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And they turned their backs and went away from him) they went to their festival and left him alone.

translation: So they turned away from him, and departed (for fear of the disease).

metadata.arabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰ آلِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلا تَأْكُلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then turned he) i.e. Abraham (to their gods and said) to them: (Will ye not eat) the honey you have on you?

translation: Then he turned to their âlihah (gods) and said: "Will you not eat (of the offering before you)?

metadata.arabic: مَا لَكُمْ لاَ تَنطِقُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: When they did not answer him, he said: (What aileth you that ye speak not) why do you not answer me?

translation: "What is the matter with you that you speak not?"

metadata.arabic: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْباً بِٱلْيَمِينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then he attacked them striking with his right hand) with an axe; it is also said that he fulfilled his oath.

translation: Then he turned upon them, striking (them) with (his) right hand.

metadata.arabic: فَأَقْبَلُوۤاْ إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And (his people) came towards him, hastening) from their festival.

translation: Then they (the worshippers of idols) came, towards him, hastening.

metadata.arabic: قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (He said) Abraham said to them: (Worship ye that which ye yourselves do carve) with your own hands from stones and wood,

translation: He said: "Worship you that which you (yourselves) carve?

metadata.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (When Allah hath created you) and leave the worship of Allah Who created you (and what ye make) and He also created your act of carving as well as that which you carve?

translation: "While Allâh has created you and what you make!"

metadata.arabic: قَالُواْ ٱبْنُواْ لَهُ بُنْيَاناً فَأَلْقُوهُ فِي ٱلْجَحِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: (They said: Build for him a building) a furnace (and fling him in the red hot fire.

translation: They said: "Build for him a building (it is said that the building was like a furnace) and throw him into the blazing fire!"

metadata.arabic: فَأَرَادُواْ بِهِ كَيْداً فَجَعَلْنَاهُمُ ٱلأَسْفَلِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: And they designed a snare for him) to burn him in the Fire, (but We made them the undermost) of those who dwell in the bottom of the Fire; it is also said that this means: We made them of the losers by subjecting them to chastisement.

translation: So they plotted a plot against him, but We made them the lowest.

metadata.arabic: وَقَالَ إِنِّي ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And he said) Abraham said to Lot: (Lo! I am going unto my Lord) I am going to worship my Lord (Who will guide me) who will save me from them.

translation: And he said (after his rescue from the fire): "Verily, I am going to my Lord. He will guide me!"

metadata.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ ٱلصَّالِحِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: Then he said: (My Lord! Vouchsafe me of the righteous) a son who is among the messengers.

translation: "My Lord! Grant me (offspring) from the righteous."

metadata.arabic: فَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِغُلاَمٍ حَلِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (So We gave him tidings of a gentle son) a son who is knowledgeable in his youth, gentle in his old age.

translation: So We gave him the glad tidings of a forbearing boy.

metadata.arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْيَ قَالَ يٰبُنَيَّ إِنِّيۤ أَرَىٰ فِي ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّي أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ قَالَ يٰأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤمَرُ سَتَجِدُنِيۤ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّابِرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And when (his son) was old enough to walk with him) when his son was old enough to strive for Allah and obey Him; it is also said that this means: when his son was old enough to walk with him in the mountains, ((Abraham) said) to his son Ishmael; and it is also said: to his son Isaac: (O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice thee) I am commanded in a dream vision to sacrifice you. (So look, what thinkest thou) what do you say? (He said: O my father! Do that which thou art commanded) of sacrificing me. (Allah willing, thou shalt find me of the steadfast) in the face of this sacrifice.

translation: And, when he (his son) was old enough to walk with him, he said: "O my son! I have seen in a dream that I am slaughtering you (offering you in sacrifice to Allâh). So look what you think!" He said: "O my father! Do that which you are commanded, Inshâ’ Allâh (if Allâh wills), you shall find me of As-Sâbirûn (the patient)."

metadata.arabic: فَلَمَّا أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُ لِلْجَبِينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then, when they had both surrendered (to Allah)) when they both agreed and consigned the matter to Allah, (and he had flung him down upon his face) and it is said: on his side,

translation: Then, when they had both submitted themselves (to the Will of Allâh), and he had laid him prostrate on his forehead (or on the side of his forehead for slaughtering);

metadata.arabic: وَنَادَيْنَاهُ أَن يٰإِبْرَاهِيمُ
metadata.Tafsir: (We called unto him: O Abraham:

translation: We called out to him: "O Abraham!

metadata.arabic: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّؤْيَآ إِنَّا كَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: Thou hast already fulfilled the vision) you have fulfilled what you were commanded in the dream vision. (Lo! thus do We reward the good) in their words and works.

translation: You have fulfilled the dream!" Verily thus do We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers - See 2:112).

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْبَلاَءُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! that verily was a clear test) that was a manifest trial.

translation: Verily, that indeed was a manifest trial.

metadata.arabic: وَفَدَيْنَاهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then We ransomed him with a tremendous victim) We ransomed him with a fat ram.

translation: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice (i.e. كبش - a ram);

metadata.arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي ٱلآخِرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And We left for him among the later folk (the salutation)) We left Abraham with good praise among the people who came after him:

translation: And We left for him (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations.

metadata.arabic: سَلاَمٌ عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Peace be unto Abraham) bliss and safety from Us unto Abraham!

translation: "Salâm (peace) be upon Ibrâhîm (Abraham)!"

metadata.arabic: كَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Thus do We reward the good) with good praise and safety.

translation: Thus indeed do We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers - See V.2:112).

metadata.arabic: إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! He) i.e. Abraham (is one of Our believing slaves) who are true in their faith.

translation: Verily, he was one of Our believing slaves.

metadata.arabic: وَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِإِسْحَاقَ نَبِيّاً مِّنَ ٱلصَّالِحِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And We gave him tidings of the birth of Isaac, a Prophet of the righteous) of the messengers.

translation: And We gave him the glad tidings of Ishâq (Isaac) - a Prophet from the righteous.

metadata.arabic: وَبَارَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰ إِسْحَاقَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِ مُبِينٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (And We blessed him) with good praise and righteous offspring (and Isaac. And of their seed) and of the offspring of Abraham and Isaac (are some who do good) who believe in Allah's divine Oneness, (and some who plainly wrong themselves) through disbelief.

translation: We blessed him and Ishâq (Isaac). And of their progeny are (some) that do right, and some that plainly wrong themselves.

metadata.arabic: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And We verily gave grace unto Moses and Aaron) by bestowing upon them prophethood and complete surrender unto Him,

translation: And, indeed We gave Our Grace to Mûsâ (Moses) and Hârûn (Aaron).

metadata.arabic: وَنَجَّيْنَاهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And saved them and their people) who believed in them (from the great distress) from drowning,

translation: And We saved them and their people from the great distress,

metadata.arabic: وَنَصَرْنَاهُمْ فَكَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And helped them) against Pharaoh and his host (so that they became the victors) by means of proof.

translation: And helped them, so that they became the victors;

metadata.arabic: وَآتَيْنَاهُمَا ٱلْكِتَابَ ٱلْمُسْتَبِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And We gave them the clear Scripture) We gave them the Torah which made clear the lawful and the unlawful,

translation: And We gave them the clear Scripture;

metadata.arabic: وَهَدَيْنَاهُمَا ٱلصِّرَاطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And showed them the right path) We confirmed them on the true, straight religion.

translation: And guided them to the Right Path.

metadata.arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِي ٱلآخِرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And We left for them) for Moses and Aaron, (among the later folk (the salutation)) good praise among the people who came after them:

translation: And We left for them (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations.

metadata.arabic: سَلاَمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Peace be unto Moses and Aaron) bliss and safety from Us unto Moses and Aaron!

translation: "Salâm (peace) be upon Mûsa (Moses) and Hârûn (Aaron)!"

metadata.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! thus do We reward the good) with words, deeds and good praise.

translation: Verily, thus do We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers - See V.2:112).

metadata.arabic: إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! they are two of our believing slaves) who are true in their faith.

translation: Verily, they were two of Our believing slaves.

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo! Elias was of those sent (to warn)) his folk.

translation: And verily, Iliyâs (Elias) was one of the Messengers.

metadata.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ أَلاَ تَتَّقُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (When he said unto his folk: Will ye not ward off (evil)) the worship of other than Allah?

translation: When he said to his people: "Will you not fear Allâh?

metadata.arabic: أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلاً وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْخَالِقِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Will ye cry unto Baal) will you worship other deities beside Allah; it is also said that this means: will you worship a bull instead of worshipping Allah; it is also said that his people had an idol called Baal which was 30 cubits tall and had four faces (and forsake the best of Creators) and forsake the worship of the greatest of Creators, such that you do not worship him at all,

translation: "Will you call upon Ba‘l (a well known idol of his nation whom they used to worship) and forsake the Best of creators,

metadata.arabic: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ آبَآئِكُمُ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Allah, your Lord) your Creator (and Lord of your forefathers) and the Creator of your forefathers before you?

translation: "Allâh, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?"

metadata.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (But they denied him) they denied his message, (so they surely will be haled forth (to the doom)) they will be brought in order to be tormented in the Fire,

translation: But they denied him [Iliyâs (Elias)], so they will certainly be brought forth (to the punishment),

metadata.arabic: إِلاَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Save single minded slaves of Allah) save the salves of Allah who are sincere in their worship and have faith in Allah's divine Oneness; these will not be tormented.

translation: Except the chosen slaves of Allâh.

metadata.arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي ٱلآخِرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And we left for him among the later folk (the salutation)) We left for Elias good praise among the people who came after him:

translation: And We left for him (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations.

metadata.arabic: سَلاَمٌ عَلَىٰ إِلْ يَاسِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Peace be) bliss and safety from Us (unto Elias!) who is none other than Idris the Prophet!

translation: "Salâm (peace) be upon Ilyâsîn (Elias)!"

metadata.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! thus do We reward the good) with words, deeds and good praise.

translation: Verily, thus do We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers, who perform good deeds totally for Allâh’s sake only - See V.2:112).

metadata.arabic: إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves) who are true in their faith.

translation: Verily, he was one of Our believing slaves.

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّ لُوطاً لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo! Lot verily was of those sent (to warn)) his folk,

translation: And verily, Lût (Lot) was one of the Messengers.

metadata.arabic: إِذْ نَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (When We saved him and his household) his two daughters: Za'ura and Raytha, (every one,

translation: When We saved him and his family, all,

metadata.arabic: إِلاَّ عَجُوزاً فِي ٱلْغَابِرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: Save an old woman among those who stayed behind) except his hypocrite wife who stayed behind with those who were destroyed;

translation: Except an old woman (his wife) who was among those who remained behind.

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلآخَرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then We destroyed the others) We destroyed those who remained behind after the departure of Lot and his daughters.

translation: Then We destroyed the rest (the town of Sodom at the place of the Dead Sea now in Palestine).

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّكُمْ لَّتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِمْ مُّصْبِحِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo! Ye) O people of Mecca (verily pass by (the ruin of) them) by the towns of Lot: Sodom, 'Amura, Sabura and Daduma (in the morning

translation: Verily, you pass by them in the morning

metadata.arabic: وَبِٱلَّيلِ أَفَلاَ تَعْقِلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: And at night time; have ye then no sense) do you not believe in what was done to them, such that you do not follow their example?

translation: And at night; will you not then reflect?

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo! Jonah verily was of those sent (to warn)) his folk,

translation: And, verily, Yûnus (Jonah) was one of the Messengers.

metadata.arabic: إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
metadata.Tafsir: (When he fled) from his folk; and it is said: when he abandoned his folk (unto the laden ship) which was about to sail,

translation: When he ran to the laden ship:

metadata.arabic: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُدْحَضِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And then drew lots and was of those rejected) he lost and threw himself in the sea;

translation: Then he (agreed to) cast lots, and he was among the losers.

metadata.arabic: فَٱلْتَقَمَهُ ٱلْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (And the fish swallowed him while be was blameworthy) he reproached himself for fleeing from his folk;

translation: Then a (big) fish swallowed him as he had done an act worthy of blame.

metadata.arabic: فَلَوْلاَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَبِّحِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And had he not been one of those who glorify (Allah)) had he not been of those who prayed before that

translation: Had he not been of them who glorify Allâh,

metadata.arabic: لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطْنِهِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (He would have tarried in its belly) he would have remained in the belly of the fish (till the day when they are raised) from the graves;

translation: He would have indeed remained inside its belly (the fish) till the Day of Resurrection.

metadata.arabic: فَنَبَذْنَاهُ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then We cast him on a desert shore while he was sick) he was as weak as a little child;

translation: But We cast him forth on the naked shore while he was sick,

metadata.arabic: وَأَنبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِّن يَقْطِينٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And We caused a tree of gourd to grow above him;

translation: And We caused a plant of gourd to grow over him.

metadata.arabic: وَأَرْسَلْنَاهُ إِلَىٰ مِئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: And We sent him to a hundred thousand (folk) or more) 20,000 more,

translation: And We sent him to a hundred thousand (people) or even more.

metadata.arabic: فَآمَنُواْ فَمَتَّعْنَاهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And they believed) in him, (therefore We gave them comfort for a while) until the time of death without punishing them.

translation: And they believed; so We gave them enjoyment for a while.

metadata.arabic: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Now ask them (O Muhammad)) ask the people of Mecca, and specifically the Banu Malih: (Hath thy Lord daughters) females (whereas they have sons) males? They said: " yes! " And the Prophet (pbuh) said to them: " do you wish for Allah what you do not wish for yourselves? "

translation: Now ask them (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Are there (only) daughters for your Lord and sons for them?"

metadata.arabic: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلاَئِكَةَ إِنَاثاً وَهُمْ شَاهِدُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Or created We the angels females) as you claim (while they were present?

translation: Or did We create the angels female while they were witnesses?

metadata.arabic: أَلاَ إِنَّهُم مِّنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: Lo! it is of their falsehood) it is due to their denial (that they say:

translation: Verily, it is of their falsehood that they (Quraish pagans) say:

metadata.arabic: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: Allah hath begotten) for they claimed the angels were Allah's daughters. (And lo! verily they tell a lie) in what they say.

translation: "Allâh has begotten [offspring - the angels being the daughters of Allâh)?" And, verily, they are liars!

metadata.arabic: أَصْطَفَى ٱلْبَنَاتِ عَلَىٰ ٱلْبَنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: ((And again of their falsehood): He hath preferred daughters to sons

translation: Has He (then) chosen daughters rather than sons?

metadata.arabic: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: What aileth you? How judge ye?) evil is what you choose for yourselves; you choose for Allah what you would not accept for yourselves,

translation: What is the matter with you? How do you decide?

metadata.arabic: أَفَلاَ تَذَكَّرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Will ye not then reflect?) will you not take heed from what you say?

translation: Will you not then remember?

metadata.arabic: أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Or have ye) O people of Mecca (a clear warrant) a Scripture stating the angels are Allah's daughters?

translation: Or is there for you a plain authority?

metadata.arabic: فَأْتُواْ بِكِتَابِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then produce your writ, if ye are truthful) that the angels are Allah's daughters.

translation: Then bring your Book if you are truthful!

metadata.arabic: وَجَعَلُواْ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَباً وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And they) the disbelievers of Mecca, and the Banu Malih specifically (imagine kinship between him and the jinn) they claimed that there is a kinship between Allah and the angels when they said that the angels are Allah's daughters; it is also said that this was revealed about the dualists who claimed that Iblis, may Allah curse him, is Allah's partner in that Allah created good while Iblis created evil, (whereas the jinn) the angels (know well that they) i.e. the disbelievers of Mecca: the Banu Malih (will be brought before (Him)) will be chastised in hell.

translation: And they have invented a kinship between Him and the jinn, but the jinn know well that they have indeed to appear (before Him) (i.e. they will be called to account).

metadata.arabic: سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Glorified be Allah) Allah exonerates Himself (from that which they attribute (unto Him)) from the lies they attribute to Him,

translation: Glorified be Allâh! (He is free) from what they attribute unto Him!

metadata.arabic: إِلاَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Save single minded slaves of Allah) save the slaves of Allah who are sincere in their profession of Allah's divine Oneness and in their worship: these slaves do not invent lies about Allah; it is also said that this verse should be understood as follows: those who claim that there is a kinship between Allah and the angels will be tormented and none of them will escape this torment except the sincere slaves of Allah who are protected from disbelief, idolatry and indecencies.

translation: Except the slaves of Allâh, whom He chooses (for His Mercy i.e. true believers of Islâmic Monotheism who do not attribute false things unto Allâh).

metadata.arabic: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! verily, ye) O people of Mecca (and that which ye worship) beside Allah,

translation: So, verily you (pagans) and those whom you worship (idols)

metadata.arabic: مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَاتِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Ye cannot excite (anyone) against Him) you cannot lead anyone astray from His worship

translation: Cannot lead astray [turn away from Him (Allâh) anyone of the believers],

metadata.arabic: إِلاَّ مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Save him who is to burn in hell) save him who will enter hell with you, i.e. Iblis; it is also said that this means: except he whom I decreed that he will enter hell with you.

translation: Except those who are predestined to burn in Hell!

metadata.arabic: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلاَّ لَهُ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (There is not one of us) said Gabriel (pbuh) (but hath his known position) a known position in heaven.

translation: And there is not one of us (angels) but has his known place (or position);

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! we, even we, are they who set the ranks) in prayer.

translation: And verily, we (angels), we stand in rows (for the prayers as you Muslims stand in rows for your prayers);

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْمُسَبِّحُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! we, even we, are they who hymn His praise) who pray to Him

translation: And verily, we (angels), indeed are those who glorify (Allâh’s Praises i.e. perform prayers).

metadata.arabic: وَإِن كَانُواْ لَيَقُولُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And indeed they) the people of Mecca (used to say) before the coming of Muhammad (pbuh) to them:

translation: And indeed they (Arab pagans) used to say:

metadata.arabic: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْراً مِّنَ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (If we had but a reminder from the men of old) if we had a messenger as the people of old had.

translation: "If we had a reminder as had the men of old (before the coming of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم as a Messenger of Allâh),

metadata.arabic: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (We would be single minded slaves of Allah) who believe in Allah's divine Oneness.

translation: "We would have indeed been the chosen slaves of Allâh (true believers of Islâmic Monotheism)!"

metadata.arabic: فَكَفَرُواْ بِهِ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Yet (now that it is come) the, disbelieve therein) they disbelieve in Muhammad (pbuh) and in the Qur'an when they came to them: (but they will come to know) what will be done to them when they die, in the grave and on the Day of Judgement.

translation: But (now that the Qur’ân has come) they disbelieve therein (i.e. in the Qur’ân and in Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم , and all that he brought, - the Divine Revelation), so they will come to know!

metadata.arabic: وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And verily Our word went forth of old) was enjoined that victory and the upper hand will be given (unto Our bondmen sent (to warn)

translation: And, verily, Our Word has gone forth of old for Our slaves, the Messengers,

metadata.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ ٱلْمَنصُورُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: That they verily would be helped) with proof and reason,

translation: That they verily would be made triumphant,

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلْغَالِبُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And that Our host) the messengers and believers, (they verily would be the victors) by means of proof and numbers until the Day of Judgement.

translation: And that Our hosts! they verily would be the victors.

metadata.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (So withdraw) O Muhammad (from them) from the disbelievers of Mecca (awhile) until the time of their destruction at Badr,

translation: So turn away (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) from them for a while,

metadata.arabic: وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And watch) inform them about Allah's punishment, (for they will (soon) see) what will be done to them.

translation: And watch them and they shall see (the punishment)!

metadata.arabic: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Would they hasten on Our doom) is it something like Our punishment that they are hastening before its appointed time?

translation: Do they seek to hasten on Our Torment?

metadata.arabic: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنْذَرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (But when it cometh home to them, then it will be a hapless morn for those who have been warned) when the punishment comes, what an evil morning it is for those whom the messengers warned but rejected faith.

translation: Then, when it descends in their courtyard (i.e. near to them), evil will be the morning for those who had been warned!

metadata.arabic: وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Withdraw from them) turn away from, O Muhammad, (awhile) until they are destroyed at Badr.

translation: So turn (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) away from them for a while,

metadata.arabic: وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And watch) and be aware, (for they will (soon) see) they will soon know what will be done to them.

translation: And watch and they shall see (the torment)!

metadata.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Glorified be thy Lord) Allah exonerated Himself from having a son or partner, (the Lord of Majesty) the Lord of might and power, (from that which they attribute (unto Him)) from the lies they invent about Him.

translation: Glorified be your Lord, the Lord of Honour and Power! (He is free) from what they attribute unto Him!

metadata.arabic: وَسَلاَمٌ عَلَىٰ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And peace) from Us (be unto those sent (to warn)) because they conveyed the message.

translation: And peace be on the Messengers!

metadata.arabic: وَٱلْحَمْدُ للَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And praise be to Allah) thanks and divine Oneness belong to Allah for the safety of the messenger and destruction of their folks, (Lord of the Worlds) the Master of the jinn and human beings!'

translation: And all the praises and thanks be to Allâh, Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

metadata.arabic: صۤ وَٱلْقُرْآنِ ذِي ٱلذِّكْرِ
metadata.Tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said upon the interpretation of Allah's saying (Sad.): '(Sad.) He says: Sad by the Qur'an, i.e. repeat the Qur'an until you distinguish between faith and disbelief, the prophetic wont and blameworthy innovation, truthfulness and lying, the lawful and the unlawful, good and evil; it is also said that Sad stands for barring (sadd) from the guidance, i.e. the barring of the people of Mecca from the Truth and guidance; it is also said that it stands for Abu Jahl; and it is also said that it stands for truthful (sadiq) in his speech; and it is also said that Sad is one of Allah's names; and it is also said that it is an oath by which Allah swore (By the renowned Qur'an) by the Qur'an which possesses honour and clarity of exposition; it is an honour to those who believe in it and it is a clear exposition of the people of old as well as of future generations of people. Allah swore by the Qur'an,

translation: Sâd. [These letters (Sâd etc.) are one of the miracles of the Quran and none but Allah (Alone) knows their meanings]. By the Quran full of reminding.

metadata.arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Nay, but those who disbelieve) the disbelievers of Mecca (are in false pride and schism) dispute and enmity, and it is for this that Allah swore.

translation: Nay, those who disbelieve are in false pride and opposition.

metadata.arabic: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَواْ وَّلاَتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (How many a generation) past generation (We destroyed before them) before the Quraysh, (and they cried out when it was no longer the time for escape!) the angels cried out to them upon their destruction: this is no context for attacking or fleeing; stop! And they stopped until Allah destroyed all of them. This is because before this, upon fighting an enemy, they used to say: attack all together! (Manas! Manas!). Some would therefore survive and others die. But when they were defeated by the enemy they used to cry: flee! Flee! (Manasa! Manasa!), and so they used to flee all together from the battlefield. These were two different signs whenever they engaged in fighting either to attack or to flee from the enemy. When Allah wished to destroy them, the angels cried out to them: this is no context for attacking or fleeing.

translation: How many a generation have We destroyed before them! And they cried out when there was no longer time for escape.

metadata.arabic: وَعَجِبُوۤاْ أَن جَآءَهُم مٌّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَافِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَاحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (And they) i.e. the Quraysh (marvel that a warner) a warning messenger (from among themselves) from their own lineage (hath come unto them, and the disbelievers) the disbelievers of Mecca (say: This) meaning Muhammad (pbuh) (is a wizard) who sows dispute between people, (a charlatan) who lies about Allah.

translation: And they (Arab pagans) wonder that a warner (Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) has come to them from among themselves. And the disbelievers say: "This (Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is a sorcerer, a liar.

metadata.arabic: أَجَعَلَ ٱلآلِهَةَ إِلَـٰهاً وَاحِداً إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَيْءٌ عُجَابٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Maketh he the gods One God) could one God be sufficient to fulfil all our needs, as Muhammad claims? (Lo! That) which Muhammad (s)ays (is an astounding thing) is a bizarre thing.

translation: "Has he made the âlihah (gods) (all) into One Ilâh (God - Allâh). Verily, this is a curious thing!"

metadata.arabic: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُواْ وَاْصْبِرُواْ عَلَىٰ آلِهَتِكُمْ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَيْءٌ يُرَادُ
metadata.Tafsir: (The chiefs among them) among the Quraysh: 'Utbah and Shaybah the sons of Rabi'ah, Ubayy Ibn Khalaf al-Jumahi and Abu Jahl Ibn Hisham (go about, exhorting) Abu Jahl said to them: (Go) to your deities (and be staunch to your gods) and persevere in the worship of your deities! (Lo! This) meaning Muhammad (pbuh) (is a thing designed) to perish; it is also said that this means: that which Muhammad is saying is designed to spread to all people of the earth.

translation: And the leaders among them went about (saying): "Go on, and remain constant to your âlihah (gods)! Verily, this is a thing designed (against you)!

metadata.arabic: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلآخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلاَّ ٱخْتِلاَقٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (We have not heard of this) which Muhammad (s)ays (in later religion) in Judaism and Christianity; they mean to say: we did not hear from the Jews or Christian that God is One. (This) which Muhammad (s)ays (is naught but an invention) which Muhammad has invented.

translation: "We have not heard (the like) of this in the religion of these later days (i.e. Christianity). This is nothing but an invention! [Tafsir Al-Qurtubi]

metadata.arabic: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِن بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُمْ فَي شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِي بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Hath the reminder been revealed unto him (alone) among us) has he been selected from among us to have prophethood and the Scripture? (Nay, but they) the disbelievers of Mecca (are in doubt concerning My reminder) concerning My Scripture and the prophethood of My Prophet; (nay but they have not yet tasted My doom) they have not tasted My chastisement, this is why they lie about Me.

translation: "Has the Reminder been sent down to him (alone) from among us?" Nay, but they are in doubt about My Reminder (this Qur’ân)! Nay, but they have not tasted (My) Torment!

metadata.arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Or are theirs the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord, the Mighty, the Bestower) He says: or do they have in their hands prophethood and the Scriptures such that they bestow them upon whomever they wish, when He is the Mighty in retribution against whoever does not believe in Him, the Bestower Who has bestowed prophethood and the Scripture upon Muhammad (pbuh)?

translation: Or have they the treasures of the Mercy of your Lord, the All-Mighty, the Real Bestower?

metadata.arabic: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَلْيَرْتَقُواْ فِى ٱلأَسْبَابِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Or is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them theirs?) Or do they have power over the heavens and the earth and over all created beings and marvels that are between the heavens and the earth? (Then let them ascend by ropes) to the gates of heavens! And if they have that power, then let them see whether or not He bestowed upon him prophethood and the Scripture.

translation: Or is it that the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them is theirs? If so, let them ascend up with means (to the heavens)!

metadata.arabic: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّن ٱلأَحَزَابِ
metadata.Tafsir: (A defeated) and slain (host are (all) the factions) of disbelievers: the disbelievers of Mecca (that are there) they were defeated and killed on the Day of Badr when they intended to kill the Prophet (pbuh).

translation: (As they denied Allâh’s Message) they will be a defeated host like the Confederates of the old times (who were defeated).

metadata.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلأَوْتَادِ
metadata.Tafsir: (The folk of Noah before them) before your folk, O Muhammad (denied) Noah (and (so did the tribe of) 'Aad) the folk of Hud deny Hud, (and Pharaoh) denied Moses (firmly planted) who had an established kingdom; and it is said that this means: the one who tortured using posts; this is because whenever he got angry against someone he tortured him using four posts,

translation: Before them (were many who) belied (Messengers) - the people of Nûh (Noah); and ‘Âd; and Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) the man of stakes (with which he used to punish the people),

metadata.arabic: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَابُ لْئَيْكَةِ أُوْلَـٰئِكَ ٱلأَحْزَابُ
metadata.Tafsir: (And (the tribe of) Thamud) the folk of Salih denied Salih; (and the folk of Lot) denied Lot, (and the dwellers in the wood) the folk of Shu'ayb also denied Shu'ayb: (these were the factions) these were the disbelievers.

translation: And Thamûd, and the people of Lût (Lot), and the Dwellers of the Wood: such were the Confederates.

metadata.arabic: إِن كُلٌّ إِلاَّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Not one of them but did deny the messengers) He says: all these folks denied the messengers just as the Quraysh deny you, (therefore My doom was justified) therefore My chastisement is enjoined upon them,

translation: Not one of them but belied the Messengers; therefore My Torment was justified,

metadata.arabic: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰؤُلآءِ إِلاَّ صَيْحَةً واحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (These) i.e. your folk, in case they deny you (wait for but one Shout) which is not followed by a second: this is the blow of the Resurrection, (there will be no second thereto) there will be no respite or return.

translation: And these only wait for a single Saihah [shout (i.e. the blowing of the Trumpet by the angel Isrâfil -)] there will be no pause or ending thereto [till everything will perish except Allâh (the only God full of Majesty, Bounty and Honour)].

metadata.arabic: وَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
metadata.Tafsir: (They say) i.e. the disbelievers of Mecca said upon hearing Allah's saying (Then, as for him who is given his record in his right hand, he will say: Take, read my book! … But as for him who is given his record in his left hand) [al-Haqqah: 69:19-25], they said: (Our Lord!) O our Lord! (Hasten on for us our fate) our records, they mean the registers of their deeds (before the Day of Reckoning) so that we know what is in them.

translation: They say: "Our Lord! Hasten to us Qittanâ (i.e. our Record of good and bad deeds so that we may see it) before the Day of Reckoning!"

metadata.arabic: ٱصْبِر عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُودَ ذَا ٱلأَيْدِ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Bear) O Muhammad (with what they say) in your rejection, (and remember Our bondman David) He says: mention to them the event of Our slave David, (lord of might) who had strength for our worship. (Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (towards Allah)) he was obedient, always engaged in the worship of Allah.

translation: Be patient (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) of what they say, and remember Our slave Dâwûd (David), endued with power. Verily, he was ever oft-returning in all matters and in repentance (toward Allâh).

metadata.arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلجِبَالَ مَعَهُ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِيِّ وَٱلإِشْرَاقِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! We subdued) We made subservient (the hills to hymn) with him (the praises (of their Lord) with him at nightfall and sunrise) in the morning and evening,

translation: Verily, We made the mountains to glorify Our Praises with him [Dâwûd (David)] in the ‘Ashî (i.e. after the mid-day till sunset) and Ishrâq (i.e. after the sunrise till mid-day).

metadata.arabic: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً كُلٌّ لَّهُ أَوَّابٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (And the birds assembled; all were turning unto Him) obedient to Him.

translation: And (so did) the birds assembled: all obedient to him [Dâwûd (David)] [i.e. they came and glorified Allâh’s Praises along with him]. (Tafsir Al-Qurtubi ).

metadata.arabic: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُ وَآتَيْنَاهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ
