metadata.Tafsir: (And the agony of death) the pangs of death (cometh in truth) heralding either damnation or felicity. (This) child of Adam (is that which thou wast wont to shun) and dislike.

translation: And the stupor of death will come in truth: "This is what you have been avoiding!"

metadata.arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ ذَلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And the trumpet is blown) this is the blowing of the resurrection. (This is the threatened Day) the threatened Day of the first and latter nations.

translation: And the Trumpet will be blown - that will be the Day whereof warning (had been given) (i.e. the Day of Resurrection).

metadata.arabic: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (And every soul cometh, along with it a driver) leading it to its Lord; this driver is the angel who recorded the evil deeds it had committed (and a witness) before its Lord; this is the angels who recorded its good deeds; and it is also said that this witness is man's works.

translation: And every person will come forth along with an (angel) to drive (him) and an (angel) to bear witness.

metadata.arabic: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِي غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Thou wast) O child of Adam (in heedlessness) in ignorance and oblivion (of this) Day. (Now We have removed from thee your covering) your works, that which was concealed from you in the life of the world, (and piercing is your sight this day) and it is also said that this means: your knowledge is thorough this day.

translation: (It will be said to the sinners): "Indeed you were heedless of this. Now We have removed from you your covering, and sharp is your sight this Day!"

metadata.arabic: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُ هَـٰذَا مَا لَدَيَّ عَتِيدٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (And (unto the evil-doer) his comrade) the angel who recorded his good deeds; and it is said: the angel who recorded his evil works (saith: This is that which I have) this is that which with you have entrusted me (ready (as testimony)).

translation: And his companion (angel) will say: "Here is (this Record) ready with me!"

metadata.arabic: أَلْقِيَا فِي جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ
metadata.Tafsir: And Allah would say to him: (Do ye twain hurl to hell each rebel) who turns away from faith (ingrate) and who disbelieves in Allah, i.e. al-Walid Ibn al-Mughirah al-Makhzumi,

translation: (Allah will say to the angels): "Both of you throw into Hell every stubborn disbeliever (in the Oneness of Allâh, in His Messengers).

metadata.arabic: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُّرِيبٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Hinderer of good) i.e. Islam, he hindered his sons and his grandchildren and brother's children and family, relatives and kinsfolk, (transgressor) oppressor, (doubter) whose doubt is quite manifest and who further lies against Allah,

translation: "Hinderer of good, transgressor, doubter,

metadata.arabic: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهاً آخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِي ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Who setteth up another god along with Allah) who claims that Allah has a son and a partner. (Do ye twain hurl him to the dreadful doom) Allah would say to the angels who recorded his deeds: cast him in the severe torment.

translation: "Who set up another ilâh (god) with Allâh. Then both of you cast him in the severe torment."

metadata.arabic: قَالَ قرِينُهُ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُ وَلَـٰكِن كَانَ فِي ضَلاَلٍ بَعِيدٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (His comrade) the angel who recorded his evil deeds (saith: Our Lord! I did not cause him to rebel) “I did not hasten to record his evil deeds nor did I record that which he has never said or done”; this will be said when the disbeliever will claim that the angel hastened to write his evil deeds and recorded that which he never said or did. it is also said that his comrade is his devil who will plead with Allah that he did not cause him to rebel or err (but be was (himself) far gone in error) far from the Truth and guidance.

translation: His companion (Satan - devil)] will say: "Our Lord! I did not push him to transgression, (in disbelief, oppression, and evil deeds) but he was himself in error far astray."

metadata.arabic: قَالَ لاَ تَخْتَصِمُواْ لَدَيَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ
metadata.Tafsir: (He saith) Allah says to them: (Contend not in My presence, when I had already proffered unto you the warning) I have informed you in the Scripture with which the Messenger was sent about this Day.

translation: Allâh will say: "Dispute not in front of Me, I had already in advance sent you the threat.

metadata.arabic: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَيَّ وَمَآ أَنَاْ بِظَلاَّمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
metadata.Tafsir: (The sentence that cometh from Me cannot be changed) My words cannot be changed through lying; and it is also said that this means: My decree concerning My salves will not be changed this Day; and it is also said that this means: words cannot be twisted in My presence, (and I am in nowise a tyrant unto the slaves) such that I would punish them without them having committed a crime.

translation: The Sentence that comes from Me cannot be changed, and I am not unjust to the slaves."

metadata.arabic: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلأَتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (On the day) this is the Day of Judgement (when We say unto hell: Art thou filled) as I have promised? (and it saith: Can there be more to come?) and it will have more; and it is also said that hell will say: I am quite full, I do not have room even for one extra man.

translation: On the Day when We will say to Hell: "Are you filled?" It will say: "Are there any more (to come)?"

metadata.arabic: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And the Garden is brought nigh for those who kept from evil) those who warded off disbelief, idolatry and indecencies, (no longer distant) from them.

translation: And Paradise will be brought near to the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2), not far off.

metadata.arabic: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍ
metadata.Tafsir: ((And it is said): That) reward and honour (is that which ye were promised) in the life of the world. ((It is) for every penitent) who turns to Allah and His obedience (and heedful one) observant of Allah's command in his private moment; and it is also said: in his prayers,

translation: (It will be said): "This is what you were promised - (it is) for those oft-returning (to Allâh) in sincere repentance, and those who preserve their covenant with Allâh (by obeying Him in all what He has ordered, and worshipping none but Allâh Alone, i.e. follow Allâh’s religion - Islâmic Monotheism).

metadata.arabic: مَّنْ خَشِيَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُّنِيبٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Who feareth the Beneficent in secret) who strives for the Beneficent even he has not seen Him (and cometh with a contrite heart) sincere in his worship and profession of Allah's divine Oneness.

translation: "Who feared the Most Gracious (Allâh) in the Ghaib (Unseen) and brought a heart turned in repentance (to Him and absolutely free from each and every kind of polytheism).

metadata.arabic: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلاَمٍ ذَلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلُخُلُودِ
metadata.Tafsir: Allah will say to them: (Enter it) i.e. Paradise (in peace) in safety from Allah's chastisement. (This is the day of immortality) the day when the dwellers of Paradise will enter Paradise to abide therein for eternity.

translation: "Enter you therein in peace and security - this is a Day of eternal life!"

metadata.arabic: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (There) in Paradise (they have all that they desire, and there is more with Us) i.e. beholding Allah's Countenance; and it is said that this means: in every hour and in every day, they have with Us an increase in honour and reward.

translation: There they will have all that they desire - and We have more (for them, i.e. a glance at the All-Mighty, All-Majestic جل جلاله).

metadata.arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشاً فَنَقَّبُواْ فِي ٱلْبِلاَدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And how many a generation) past generation (We destroyed before them) before your folk, (who were mightier than these) than your folk (in prowess) in physical strength (so that they overran the lands!) they moved about and travelled for their trade (Had they any place of refuge) or escape from Our chastisement? And it is also said this means: is there anyone of them left?

translation: And how many a generation We have destroyed before them who were stronger in power than they. And (when Our Torment came), they ran for a refuge in the land! Could they find any place of refuge (for them to save themselves from destruction)?

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! Therein) in that which was done with them (verily is a reminder) for your folk (for him who hath a heart) a living heart, (or giveth ear) or listens to the Qur'an (with full intelligence) with focus and not absentmindedly.

translation: Verily, therein is indeed a reminder for him who has a heart or gives ear while he is heedful.

metadata.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And verily We created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them) of created beings and marvels, (in six Days) of the days of the beginning of the life of the world, each day the equivalent of 1,000 years of present days, the first day being Sunday and the last Friday, (and naught of weariness touched Us) We were not tired as claimed by the Jews who said: when Allah finished the creation of the heavens and earth, he put one leg on the other and rested on Saturday. The enemies of Allah have lied against Allah.

translation: And indeed We created the heavens and the earth and all between them in six Days and nothing of fatigue touched Us.

metadata.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Therefore) O Muhammad (bear with what they say) bear with the lies of the Jews; it is also said this means: bear with what the deriders say; these are five people whom we have already mentioned somewhere else: (and hymn the praise of thy Lord) pray by the command of your Lord (before the rising) this is the morning prayer (and before the setting of the sun) these are the Zuhr and 'Asr prayers;

translation: So bear with patience (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) all that they say, and glorify the Praises of your Lord, before the rising of the sun and before (its) setting (i.e. the Fajr, Zuhr, and ‘Asr prayers).

metadata.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱللَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَارَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And in the night time hymn His praise) pray for Him the prayers of Maghrib and 'Isha' or the prayer of tahajjud: (And after the (prescribed) prostrations) two units of prayer after the Maghrib.

translation: And during a part of the night (also) glorify His praises (i.e. Maghrib and ‘Isha prayers) and (so likewise) after the prayers [As-Sunnah, Nawâfil - optional and additional prayers. And also glorify, praise and magnify Allâh - Subhân Allâh, Alhamdu lillâh, Allâhu-Akbar].

metadata.arabic: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And listen on) O Muhammad, so that you can hear the description of it; it is also said that this means: strive, O Muhammad, for the day when the angel blows the Trumpet (the day when the crier crieth from a near place) close to heaven, from the dome of Jerusalem, which is the closest spot on earth to heaven by about 12 miles; and it is also said this means: from a close distance from which they can hear from beneath their feet.

translation: And listen on the Day when the caller will call from a near place.

metadata.arabic: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ذَلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
metadata.Tafsir: (The day when they will hear the (Awful) Cry in truth) coming forth from the graves. (That is the day of coming forth (from the graves)) which is the Day of Judgement.

translation: The Day when they will hear As-Saihah (shout) in truth: that will be the Day of coming out (from the graves, i.e. the Day of Resurrection).

metadata.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْيِـي وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! We it is Who quicken) for the resurrection (and give death) in the life of the world, (and unto Us is the journeying) after death.

translation: Verily, We it is Who give life and cause death; and to Us is the final return.

metadata.arabic: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعاً ذَلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (On the day when the earth spliteth asunder from them, hastening forth (they come)) out of the graves. (That is a gathering easy for Us (to make).

translation: On the Day when the earth shall be cleft, from off them, (they will come out) hastening forth. That will be a gathering, quite easy for Us.

metadata.arabic: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِجَبَّارٍ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْآنِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
metadata.Tafsir: We are best aware of what they say) concerning the resurrection; and it is said: of what they say in the life of the world, (and thou) O Muhammad (art in nowise a compeller over them) such that you force them to accept faith; but later on Allah commanded him to fight them. (But warn) admonish (by the Qur'an him who feareth My threat) for only he who fears My chastisement in the Hereafter will accept your admonition'.

translation: We know best what they say. And you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are not the one to force them (to Belief). But warn by the Qur’an; him who fears My Threat.

metadata.arabic: وَٱلذَّارِيَاتِ ذَرْواً
metadata.Tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said in the interpretation of Allah's saying (By those that winnow with a winnowing): '(By those that winnow with a winnowing) He says: Allah swears by the blowing winds and that which they carry into the homes of people,

translation: By (the winds) that scatter dust.

metadata.arabic: فَٱلْحَامِلاَتِ وِقْراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And those that bear the burden (of the rain)) and He swears by the heavy clouds which carry rain,

translation: And (the clouds) that bear heavy weight of water.

metadata.arabic: فَٱلْجَارِيَاتِ يُسْراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And those that glide with ease (upon the sea)) and He swears by the ships which easily sail on the sea,

translation: And (the ships) that float with ease and gentleness.

metadata.arabic: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَاتِ أَمْراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And those who distribute (blessings) by command) and swears by the angels Gabriel, Michael, Seraphiel and the angel of death who apportion [provisions] for people: Allah swore by all these,

translation: And those (angels) who distribute (provisions, rain, and other blessings) by (Allâh’s) Command.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! that wherewith ye are threatened) regarding the resurrection (is indeed true) will indeed take place,

translation: Verily, that which you are promised (i.e. Resurrection in the Hereafter and receiving the reward or punishment of good or bad deeds) is surely true.

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٱقِعٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo! the judgement) reckoning, judgement and retaliation in it (will indeed befall) and happen.

translation: And verily, the Recompense is sure to happen.

metadata.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
metadata.Tafsir: (By the heaven full of paths) this is another oath; Allah swears by the seemly and beautiful heaven that has paths; it is also said that full of paths means: it has stars, the sun, the moon; and it is also said that full of paths means: full of waves like those of water upon being hit by the wind, or like the waves of sand upon being blown by the wind, or like the waves of curly hair or the waves of armour made of iron; and it is also said this refers to the seven heaven by which Allah has sworn.

translation: By the heaven full of paths,

metadata.arabic: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِي قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! Ye) O people of Mecca, (forsooth, are of various opinion (concerning the Truth)) some of you believe in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an and some of you disbelieve in them.

translation: Certainly, you have different ideas (about Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and the Qur’ân).

metadata.arabic: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
metadata.Tafsir: (He is made to turn away from it) he is made to turn away from Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an (who is (himself) averse) who is barred from the Truth and guidance, i.e. al-Walid Ibn al-Mughirah al-Makhzumi, Abu Jahl Ibn Hisham, Ubayy Ibn Khalaf, Umayyah Ibn Khalaf and Munbih and Nabih the sons of al-Hajjaj. They turned people away from Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an and so Allah cursed them.

translation: Turned aside therefrom (i.e. from Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and the Qur’ân) is he who is turned aside (by the Decree and Preordainment القضاء والقدر of Allâh).

metadata.arabic: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّاصُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: Allah said: (Accursed be the conjecturers) accursed are the liars of the Banu Makhzum: al-Walid Ibn al-Mughirah and his host

translation: Cursed be the liars

metadata.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Who are careless) oblivious to believing in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an (in an abyss!) in ignorance and blindness concerning the Hereafter.

translation: Who are under a cover of heedlessness (think not about the gravity of the Hereafter),

metadata.arabic: يَسْأَلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (They) the Banu Makhzum (ask) you, O Muhammad: (When is the Day of Judgement) in which we will be chastised?

translation: They ask: "When will be the Day of Recompense?"

metadata.arabic: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: Allah said: ((It is) the day) the Day of Judgement (when they will be tormented at the Fire) they will be burnt in the Fire; it is also said this means: they will be made to roast in the Fire; and it is also said that this means: they will be dragged into the Fire,

translation: (It will be) a Day when they will be tried (punished i.e. burnt) over the Fire!

metadata.arabic: ذُوقُواْ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُمْ بِهِ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: The angels of the Fire will say to them: (Taste your torment. This) chastisement (is what ye sought to hasten) in the life of the world.

translation: "Taste you your trial (punishment i.e. burning)! This is what you used to ask to be hastened!"

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
metadata.Tafsir: Then Allah explained the abode of the believers, like Abu Bakr and his fellow believers, saying: (Lo! those who keep from evil) those who ward off disbelief, idolatry and indecencies (will dwell amid Gardens and watersprings) of pure water.

translation: Verily, the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2) will be in the midst of Gardens and Springs (in the Paradise),

metadata.arabic: آخِذِينَ مَآ آتَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Taking) content and pleased with (that which their Lord giveth them) in the Garden and it is also said that this means: they act upon that which their Lord commands them in the life of the world; (for lo! aforetime) before they were given this reward and honour (they were doers of good) they were good in their speech and action in the life of the world;

translation: Taking joy in the things which their Lord has given them. Verily, they were before this Muhsinûn (good-doers. See V.2:112).

metadata.arabic: كَانُواْ قَلِيلاً مِّن ٱللَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (They used to sleep but little of the night) He says: they hardly slept at night,

translation: They used to sleep but little by night [invoking their Lord (Allâh) and praying, with fear and hope].

metadata.arabic: وَبِٱلأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And ere the dawning of each day would seek forgiveness) and at dawn they would pray,

translation: And in the hours before dawn, they were (found) asking (Allâh) for forgiveness.

metadata.arabic: وَفِيۤ أَمْوَالِهِمْ حَقٌّ لَّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And in their wealth the beggar) who asks from people (the outcast) he who does not beg from people nor is he given and nor do people realise he is in need; it is also said that the outcast means: the one whose wage and spoils are denied; and it is said that this means: the one who has a trade but whose life is hard and cannot earn his day's sufficiency (had due share) had an acknowledged right.

translation: And in their properties there was the right of the Sâ’il (the beggar who asks) and the Mahrûm (the poor who does not ask others).

metadata.arabic: وَفِي ٱلأَرْضِ آيَاتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And in the earth are portents) signs and lessons, like the trees, beasts, mountains and seas (for those whose faith is sure) for those who have certainty in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an,

translation: And on the earth are signs for those who have Faith with certainty.

metadata.arabic: وَفِيۤ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَفَلاَ تُبْصِرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And (also) in yourselves) there are signs and lessons such as pain, sickness and misfortune. A person for example administers his food and drink from one place but they come out from two different places. (Can ye then not see?) Do you then not perceive such that you reflect upon that which Allah has created?

translation: And also in your ownselves. Will you not then see?

metadata.arabic: وَفِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And in the heaven is your providence) and from the heaven comes your provision, i.e. rain (and that which ye are promised) i.e. the Garden; your provision is upon the Lord of heaven just as what you are promised of reward and punishment is upon Allah;

translation: And in the heaven is your provision, and that which you are promised.

metadata.arabic: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلأَرْضِ إِنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth) Allah swore by Himself, (it) that which I have related to you concerning provision (is the Truth) it will surely happen, (even as (it is true) that ye speak) even as you say: there is no deity except Allah.

translation: Then by the Lord of the heaven and the earth, it is the truth (i.e. what has been promised to you), just as it is the truth that you can speak.

metadata.arabic: هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Hath the story of Abraham's honoured guests) has the event of the guests of Abraham who were honoured by being offered a calf to eat (reached thee) O Muhammad?

translation: Has the story reached you, of the honoured guests [three angels; Jibrîl (Gabriel) along with another two] of Ibrâhîm (Abraham)?

metadata.arabic: إِذْ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُواْ سَلاَماً قَالَ سَلاَمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (When they) Gabriel and two other angels with him; and it is also said: Gabriel and 12 other angels with him (came in unto him) to Abraham (and said: Peace!) they gave the greetings of peace to Abraham (he answered, Peace!) Abraham answered their greetings of peace, ((and thought): Folk unknown (to me)) he did not recognize them and did not see that their greeting of peace was unknown at the time and place where he was.

translation: When they came in to him and said: "Salâm, (peace be upon you)!" He answered: "Salâm, (peace be upon you)," and said: "You are a people unknown to me."

metadata.arabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then he went apart unto his housefolk so that they brought a fatted calf) a roasted, fatted calf to his guests;

translation: Then he turned to his household, and brought out a roasted calf [as the property of Ibrâhîm (Abraham) was mainly cows].

metadata.arabic: فَقَرَّبَهُ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلاَ تَأْكُلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And he set it before them) but when he saw that they did not reach to it, (saying: Will ye not eat) the food?

translation: And placed it before them, (saying): "Will you not eat?"

metadata.arabic: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً قَالُواْ لاَ تَخَفْ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلاَمٍ عَلِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then he conceived a fear of them) Abraham concealed his fear of them when they did not eat his food. He thought they were thieves. This is because, in his time, to eat of the food of another person was a sign of coming with a good intention. When the angels realised his fear. (They said: Fear not!) Fear us not, O Abraham! We are the messengers of your Lord (and gave him tidings of (the birth of) a wise son) a son who is wise in his childhood, great when he grows older: this is Isaac.

translation: Then he conceived fear of them (when they ate not). They said: "Fear not." And they gave him glad tidings of a son having knowledge (about Allâh and His religion of True Monotheism).

metadata.arabic: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُ فِي صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then his wife came forward) his wife Sarah came, (making moan) and wailing, (and smote her face) she gathered the extremities of her fingers and hit her face and forehead, (and cried: A barren old woman!) A barren old woman giving birth, how is this possible?

translation: Then his wife came forward with a loud voice: she smote her face, and said: "A barren old woman!"

metadata.arabic: قَالُواْ كَذَلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ إِنَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
metadata.Tafsir: (They said) Gabriel and the angels with him said: (Even so) just as we have said to you, O Sarah, (saith thy Lord. Lo! He is the Wise) He decrees the birth of children from those who are barren and those who are not, (the Knower) what will come out of both you in the future.

translation: They said: "Even so says your Lord. Verily, He is the All-Wise, the All-Knower."

metadata.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: ((Abraham) said: And (afterward) what is your errand) what is happening and why have you come, (O ye sent (from Allah)?

translation: [Ibrâhîm (Abraham)] said: "Then for what purpose you have come, O Messengers?"

metadata.arabic: قَالُوۤاْ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (They said: Lo! we are sent unto a guilty folk) idolatrous folk who brought ruin upon themselves because of engaging in an abominable act; referring here to the folk of Lot,

translation: They said: "We have been sent to a people who are Mujrimûn (polytheists, sinners, criminals, disbelievers in Allâh)

metadata.arabic: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (That we may send upon them stones of clay) cooked like bricks,

translation: To send down upon them stones of baked clay.

metadata.arabic: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Marked) black in red (by thy Lord) these stones will come from your Lord (for (the destruction of) the wanton) for the destruction of the idolatrous folk.

translation: Marked by your Lord for the Musrifûn (polytheists, criminals, sinners - those who trespass Allâh’s set limits in evil-doings by committing great sins).

metadata.arabic: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (You We brought forth) from the townships of Lot's folk (such believers as were there) who believed in Allah's divine Oneness.

translation: So We brought out from therein the believers.

metadata.arabic: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (But We found there) in the townships of Lot's folk (but one house) but the inhabitants of one house (of those surrendered (to Allah)) of those close to Allah: Lot and his two daughters, Za'ura and Raytha.

translation: But We found not there any household of the Muslims except one [of Lût (Lot) and his two daughters].

metadata.arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ آيَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلأَلِيمَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And We left behind therein) in the townships of Lot's folk (a portent) a sign and lesson (for those who fear a painful doom) in the Hereafter such that they do not emulate their abominable act.

translation: And We have left there a sign (i.e. the place of the Dead Sea in Palestine) for those who fear the painful torment.

metadata.arabic: وَفِي مُوسَىٰ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَاهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And in Moses (too, there is a portent) when We sent him unto Pharaoh with clear warrant) with clear proof: the hand and the staff,

translation: And in Mûsâ (Moses) (too, there is a sign), when We sent him to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) with a manifest authority.

metadata.arabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِ وَقَالَ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (But he withdrew (confiding) in his might) pharaoh refused to believe in the proof or in Moses, relying instead on his troops, (and said: A wizard or a madman) bewitched.

translation: But [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] turned away (from Belief in might) along with his hosts, and said: "A sorcerer, or a madman."

metadata.arabic: فَأَخَذْنَاهُ وَجُنُودَهُ فَنَبَذْنَاهُمْ فِي ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (So We seized him and his hosts and flung them) and drowned them (in the sea, for he was reprobate) blameworthy in the sight of Allah, and he will also blame himself.

translation: So We took him and his hosts, and dumped them into the sea, for he was blameworthy.

metadata.arabic: وَفِي عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And in (the tribe of) 'Aad) the people of Hud ((there is a portent) when We sent) We set on them (the fatal wind against them) the severe wind in which there was no comfort for them, this is the west wind.

translation: And in ‘Âd (there is also a sign) when We sent against them the barren wind;

metadata.arabic: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَيْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: (It spared naught) neither them nor their belongings (that it reached) that the wind reached to, (but made it (all) as dust.

translation: It spared nothing that it reached, but blew it into broken spreads of rotten ruins.

metadata.arabic: وَفِي ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُواْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
metadata.Tafsir: And in (the tribe of) Thamud) the folk of Salih ((there is a portent) when it was told them) Salih told them after they hamstrung the she-camel: (Take your ease awhile) enjoy your life until the advent of the chastisement.

translation: And in Thamûd (there is also a sign), when they were told: "Enjoy yourselves for a while!"

metadata.arabic: فَعَتَوْاْ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّاعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (But they rebelled against their Lord's decree) they refused to comply to their Lord's command, (and so the thunderbolt) the cry of doom (overtook them even while they gazed) while looking at the torment descending upon them;

translation: But they insolently defied the Command of their Lord, so the Sâ‘iqah overtook them while they were looking.

metadata.arabic: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَاعُواْ مِن قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنتَصِرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And they were unable to rise up) following Allah's chastisement, (nor could they help themselves) nor could their bodies avert the chastisement.

translation: Then they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves.

metadata.arabic: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ قَوْماً فَاسِقِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And the folk of Noah) We had also destroyed them (aforetime) before the folk of Salih. (Lo! they were licentious folk) they were disbelieving folk.

translation: (So were) the people of Nûh (Noah) before them. Verily, they were a people who were Fâsiqûn (rebellious, disobedient to Allâh).

metadata.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا بِأَييْدٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (We have built) created (the heaven with might, and We it is who make the vast extent (thereof)) as We will; it is also said that this means: we expand the provision thereof.

translation: With power did We construct the heaven. Verily, We are Able to extend the vastness of space thereof.

metadata.arabic: وَٱلأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَاهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَاهِدُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And the earth have We laid out) on water, (how gracious was the Spreader (thereof)!

translation: And We have spread out the earth: how Excellent Spreader (thereof) are We!

metadata.arabic: وَمِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: And all things We have created by pairs) in the earth, (that haply ye may reflect) on the creation of Allah.

translation: And of everything We have created pairs, that you may remember (the Grace of Allâh).

metadata.arabic: فَفِرُّوۤاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ إِنِّي لَكُمْ مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Therefore flee unto Allah) flee from Allah unto Allah; it is also said that this means: flee from contravening against Allah to obeying Him; (lo! I am a plain warner unto you from Him) I am a warning messenger who explains matters to you in a language you understand.

translation: So flee to Allâh (from His Torment to His Mercy - Islâmic Monotheism). Verily, I (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) am a plain warner to you from Him.

metadata.arabic: وَلاَ تَجْعَلُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهاً آخَرَ إِنِّي لَكُمْ مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (And set not any other god along with Allah) refrain from saying: Allah has a son or partner; (lo! I am a plain warner) in a language you understand (unto you from Him) from Allah.

translation: And set not up (or worship not) any other ilâh (god) along with Allâh [Glorified be He (Alone), Exalted above all that they associate as partners with Him]. Verily, I (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) am a plain warner to you from Him.

metadata.arabic: كَذَلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلاَّ قَالُواْ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Even so) just as your own people accused you of being a wizard and madman (there came no messenger) calling to Allah (unto those before them) before your people (but they said) to that messenger: (A wizard or a madman!

translation: Likewise, no Messenger came to those before them but they said: "A sorcerer or a madman!"

metadata.arabic: أَتَوَاصَوْاْ بِهِ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: Have they handed down (the saying) as an heirloom one unto another) did all these folks conspire to say to their respective messenger: you are a wizard or madman? (Nay, but they are froward folk) disbelieving folk.

translation: Have they (the people of the past) transmitted this saying to these (Quraish pagans)? Nay, they are themselves a people transgressing beyond bounds (in disbelief)!

metadata.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (So withdraw from them) so turn away from them, O Muhammad, (for thou art in nowise blameworthy) in Our sight; you have left them with no excuse and you have indeed conveyed the message. After this, Allah commanded him to fight them

translation: So turn away (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) from them (Quraish pagans), you are not blame-worthy (as you have conveyed Allâh’s Message).

metadata.arabic: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And warn) admonish by means of the Qur'an, (for warning) admonition by means of the Qur'an (profiteth believers) increases the righteousness of the believers.

translation: And remind (by preaching the Qur’ân, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), for verily, the reminding profits the believers.

metadata.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلإِنسَ إِلاَّ لِيَعْبُدُونِ
metadata.Tafsir: (I created the jinn and humankind only that they might worship Me) to worship me; this concerns only His obedient servants; and it is also said: had Allah created them for worship, they would not have disobeyed him for a blink of an eye. 'Ali Ibn Abi Talib said: I have not created them except to command them and entrust them with legal responsibility; and it is also said that this means: I created the jinn and humankind only that they might declare My divine Oneness and worship Me.

translation: And I (Allâh) created not the jinn and mankind except that they should worship Me (Alone).

metadata.arabic: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ
metadata.Tafsir: (I seek no livelihood from them) I have not made them responsible to provide sustenance for themselves, (nor do I ask that they should feed Me) nor do I ask them to help Me to provide their provisions.

translation: I seek not any provision from them (i.e. provision for themselves or for My creatures) nor do I ask that they should feed Me (i.e. feed themselves or My creatures).

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! Allah! He it is that giveth livelihood) to His slaves, (the Lord of unbreakable might) against His enemies, Who has in store a severe chastisement for them.

translation: Verily, Allâh is the All-Provider, Owner of Power, the Most Strong.

metadata.arabic: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ذَنُوباً مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَابِهِمْ فَلاَ يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo! for those who (now) do wrong) the disbelievers of Mecca (there is an evil day) torment after torment (like unto the evil day (which came for) their likes (of old)) like the torment which befell the nations who came before them; (so let them not ask Me to hasten) chastisement and destruction (on (that day).

translation: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a portion of torment like to the evil portion of torment (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not ask Me to hasten on!

metadata.arabic: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: And woe) severe punishment (unto those who disbelieve) in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an, (from (that) their day which they are promised) from the torment with which they are threatened and which was explained in surah the Mount (al-Tur)'.

translation: Then woe to those who disbelieve (in Allâh and His Oneness - Islâmic Monotheism) from their Day which they have been promised (for their punishment).

metadata.arabic: وَٱلطُّورِ
metadata.Tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said concerning the interpretation of Allah's saying (By the Mount (wa't-Tur)): '(By the Mount) He says: Allah swears by the mount of Zubayr and every mount is a Tur as in the Syriac and Coptic languages, but Allah means here the mount whereon Allah spoke with Moses, and this mount is called the mount of Midian or Zubayr.

translation: By the Tûr (Mount)

metadata.arabic: وَكِتَابٍ مَّسْطُورٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And a Scripture inscribed) and He swore by the Guarded Tablet wherein all the works of the Children of Adam are registered

translation: And by a Book Inscribed

metadata.arabic: فِي رَقٍّ مَّنْشُورٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (On fire parchment unrolled) which the Children of Adam will read on the Day of Judgement; this is the scroll of the guardian angels (al-hafazah),

translation: In parchment unrolled.

metadata.arabic: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And the House frequented) and Allah swore by the House which is filled with the angels. This House is in the sixth heaven opposite to the Ka'bah. There is between it and the Ka'bah, through the borderline of the seventh earth, a Sacred Precinct which is visited every single day by 70,000 angels who never return to visit it. This is the House that Adam built and was raised to the seventh heaven because of the flood, it is called al-dirah and is opposite of the Ka'bah.

translation: And by Al-Bait-ul-Ma‘mûr (the house over the heavens parallel to the Ka‘bah at Makkah, continuously visited by the angels).

metadata.arabic: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And the roof exalted) and He swore by the heaven which is raised above everything,

translation: And by the roof raised high (i.e. the heaven).

metadata.arabic: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And the sea kept filled) and He swore by the full sea which is above the seventh heaven under the Throne of the Beneficent and which is called Life (al-Hayawan). Through it Allah will bring to life, on the Day of Judgement, all created beings. It is also said that 'the sea kept filled' is a hot sea which will become fire and will be opened in Gehenna on the Day of Judgement. Allah swore by all these things,

translation: And by the sea kept filled (or it will be fire kindled on the Day of Resurrection).

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَاقِعٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! the doom of thy Lord) on the Day of Judgement (will surely come to pass) will surely take place in relation to Quraysh;

translation: Verily, the Torment of your Lord will surely come to pass.

metadata.arabic: مَّا لَهُ مِن دَافِعٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (There is none that can ward it off) there is none that can prevent this torment.

translation: There is none that can avert it.

metadata.arabic: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْراً
metadata.Tafsir: (On the day when the heaven will heave) will rotate (with (awful) heaving) with its inhabitants on like the rotation of a millstone, and created beings will surge on each other because of the terror they see.

translation: On the Day when the heaven will shake with a dreadful shaking,

metadata.arabic: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And the mountains move away) on the surface of the earth (with (awful) movement) like the movement of the clouds in the sky,

translation: And the mountains will move away with a (horrible) movement.

metadata.arabic: فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then woe) then severe chastisement (that day) which is the Day of Judgement (unto the deniers) of Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an; the reference here is to Abu Jahl and his host

translation: Then woe that Day to the beliers.

metadata.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Who play in talk of grave matters) who engage in falsehood;

translation: Who are playing in falsehood.

metadata.arabic: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
metadata.Tafsir: (The day when they are thrust with a (disdainful) thrust into the Fire of hell) the angels drag them on their faces and thrust them in Gehenna.

translation: The Day when they will be pushed down by force to the Fire of Hell, with a horrible, forceful pushing.

metadata.arabic: هَـٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: The angels in-charge of hell will say to them: (This is the Fire which ye were wont to deny) in the life of the world.

translation: This is the Fire which you used to belie.

metadata.arabic: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَـٰذَا أَمْ أَنتُمْ لاَ تُبْصِرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Is this magic) is this Day and its torment magic, since you said in the life of the world to the messengers that they were wizards, (or do ye not see) or do you not perceive?

translation: Is this magic, or do you not see?

metadata.arabic: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوۤاْ أَوْ لاَ تَصْبِرُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: Allah will say: (Endure the heat thereof) enter the Fire, (and whether ye are patient of it) of its torment (or impatient of it is all one for you) anxiety or patience is all one for you. (Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do) and say in the life of the world.

translation: Taste you therein its heat and whether you are patient of it or impatient of it, it is all the same. You are only being requited for what you used to do.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: Allah then showed the abode of the believers, Abu Bakr and his fellow believers, saying: (Lo! those who kept their duty) those who ward off disbelief, idolatry and indecencies (dwell in Gardens and delight) eternally,

translation: Verily, the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2) will be in Gardens (Paradise), and Delight.

metadata.arabic: فَاكِهِينَ بِمَآ آتَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Happy because of what your Lord hath given them) in the Garden, (and (because) their Lord hath warded off from them the torment of hellfire).

translation: Enjoying in that which their Lord has bestowed on them, and (the fact that) their Lord saved them from the torment of the blazing Fire.

metadata.arabic: كُلُواْ وَٱشْرَبُواْ هَنِيئَاً بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: Allah will then say to them: (Eat) of the fruits of the Garden (and drink) of its rivers (in health) suffering no illness, sin or death ((as reward) for what ye used to do) and say in the life of the world,

translation: "Eat and drink with happiness because of what you used to do."

metadata.arabic: مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوفَةٍ وَزَوَّجْنَاهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Reclining) sitting (on ranged couches) ranged close to each other. (And We wed them) in the Garden (unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.

translation: They will recline (with ease) on thrones arranged in ranks. And We shall marry them to Hûr: (female, fair ones) with wide lovely eyes.

metadata.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَانٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَاهُمْ مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَيْءٍ كُلُّ ٱمْرِىءٍ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهَينٌ
metadata.Tafsir: And they who believe) in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an and are true in their faith (and whose seed follow them in faith) in the life of the world, (We cause their seed to join them (there)) in the Hereafter, enjoying the same rank as that of their fathers; it is also said that this means: and those who believe in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an, We will enter them into the Garden along with their young children, thus enjoying the same rank, because these offspring had already believed on the Day of the Primordial Covenant. We made their fathers follow them. It is also said that this means: We make the offspring attain to the same rank as that of the fathers, if the ranks of the fathers are higher, (and We deprive them of naught of their (life's) work) He says: We do not diminish the reward of the fathers at all upon making their offspring join them. (Every man is a pledge) such that Allah does with him as He will (for that which he hath earned) of sins.

translation: And those who believe and whose offspring follow them in Faith: to them shall We join their offspring, and We shall not decrease the reward of their deeds in anything. Every person is a pledge for that which he has earned.

metadata.arabic: وَأَمْدَدْنَاهُم بِفَاكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And We provide them) i.e. We provided the inhabitants of the Garden in the Garden (with fruit) with different kinds of fruit (and meat) i.e. birds' meat (such as they desire.

translation: And We shall provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire.

metadata.arabic: يَتَنَازَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْساً لاَّ لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلاَ تَأْثِيمٌ
metadata.Tafsir: There) in the Garden (they pass from hand to hand a cup) of wine (wherein is neither vanity) stomach-ache because of drinking it (nor cause of sin) from drinking it; it is also said that " vanity " means: falsehood and oaths, and " cause of sin " means: abusing and lying to each other, which means: in the Garden there is neither falsehood and oaths nor abuse and lying.

translation: There they shall pass from hand to hand a (wine) cup, free from any Laghw (dirty, false, evil vain talk between them), and free from sin (because it will be lawful for them to drink).

metadata.arabic: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (And there go round) to serve them, (waiting on them menservants of their own), in their limpidity they (as they were hidden pearls) hidden from heat and cold.

translation: And there will go round boy-servants of theirs, to serve them as if they were preserved pearls.

metadata.arabic: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And some of them draw near unto others) upon visiting, (questioning) talking about the life of the world,

translation: And some of them draw near to others, questioning.

metadata.arabic: قَالُوۤاْ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِيۤ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Saying: Lo! of old) before entering the Garden, (when we were with our families) in the life of the world, (we were ever anxious) we were fearful of Allah's chastisement;

translation: Saying: "Aforetime, we were afraid (of the punishment of Allâh) in the midst of our families.

metadata.arabic: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَانَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
metadata.Tafsir: (But Allah hath been gracious unto us) with forgiveness, mercy and entry into the Garden (and hath preserved us from) and has driven away from us (the torment of the breath of Fire) the chastisement of the Fire.

translation: "So Allâh has been gracious to us, and has saved us from the torment of the Fire.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! we used to pray unto Him) we used to worship Him and declare His divine Oneness (of old) before this forgiveness, mercy and entry into the Garden. (Lo! He is the Benign) He is Truthful in His word regarding that which He promised us, (the Merciful) towards His believing slaves, since He hath shown mercy towards us.

translation: "Verily, We used to invoke Him (Alone and none else) before. Verily, He is Al-Barr (the Most Subtle, Kind, Courteous, and Generous), the Most Merciful."

metadata.arabic: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلاَ مَجْنُونٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Therefore warn) therefore, admonish by means of the Qur'an, O Muhammad. (By the grace of Allah) prophethood and Islam (thou art neither soothsayer) foretelling the future (nor madman) bewitched.

translation: Therefore, remind (mankind of Islâmic Monotheism, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم). By the Grace of Allâh, you are neither a soothsayer, nor a madman.

metadata.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Or say they) in fact, the disbelievers of Mecca-Abu Jahl, al-Walid Ibn al-Mughirah and their hosts-say: ((he is) a poet) who invents things, ((one) for whom we may expect the accident of time) we wait to see him suffer the pangs of death?

translation: Or do they say: "(Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is a poet! We await for him some calamity by time!"

metadata.arabic: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُواْ فَإِنِّي مَعَكُمْ مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Say) O Muhammad, to Abu Jahl, al-Walid Ibn al-Mughirah and their hosts: (Expect (your fill)) wait for my death! (Lo! I am with you among the expectant) I will also wait for your chastisement; and they were indeed punished on the Day of Badr.

translation: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم to them): "Wait! I am with you among the waiters!"

metadata.arabic: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلاَمُهُمْ بِهَـٰذَآ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Do their minds command them to do this) denial, abuse and harm of Muhammad (pbuh). This was said as an attack against them, (or are they) they are indeed (an outrageous folk) disbelievers and arrogant folk with regard to transgressing against Allah?

translation: Do their minds command them this [i.e. to tell a lie against you (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)] or are they people transgressing all bounds?

metadata.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُ بَل لاَّ يُؤْمِنُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Or say they) indeed the disbelievers of Mecca say: (He hath invented it?) Muhammad lies and has invented the Qur'an. (Nay, but they will not believe) in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an as in Allah's pre-eternal knowledge!

translation: Or do they say: "He (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) has forged it (this Qur’ân)?" Nay! They believe not!

metadata.arabic: فَلْيَأْتُواْ بِحَدِيثٍ مِّثْلِهِ إِن كَانُواْ صَادِقِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then let them produce speech the like thereof) let them produce a Qur'an like the Qur'an of Muhammad (pbuh) (if they are truthful) that Muhammad has invented the Qur'an:

translation: Let them then produce a recital like unto it (the Qur’ân) if they are truthful.

metadata.arabic: أَمْ خُلِقُواْ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَيْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَالِقُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Or were they created out of naught) without a father; and it is also said: without a Lord? (Or are they the creators) rather than being the created?

translation: Were they created by nothing? Or were they themselves the creators?

metadata.arabic: أَمْ خَلَقُواْ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلأَرْضَ بَل لاَّ يُوقِنُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Or did they create the heavens and the earth?) It is Allah Who created them. (Nay, but they are sure of nothing!) but they deny Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an.

translation: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they have no firm Belief.

metadata.arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَيْطِرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Or do they own the treasures of thy Lord) or do they possess the stores of your Lord through rain, provision, vegetation and prophethood? (Or have they been given charge (thereof)?

translation: Or are with them the treasures of your Lord? Or are they the tyrants with the authority to do as they like?

metadata.arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
metadata.Tafsir: Or have they any stairway (unto heaven) by means of which they overhear (decrees). Then let their listener produce warrant manifest) let their listener produce a clear proof for what they say!

translation: Or have they a stairway (to heaven), by means of which they listen (to the talks of the angels)? Then let their listener produce some manifest proof.

metadata.arabic: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Or hath He daughters) or are you pleased for attributing daughters to Him while you yourselves dislike them (whereas ye have sons) whereas you chose sons?

translation: Or has He (Allâh) only daughters and you have sons?

metadata.arabic: أَمْ تَسْأَلُهُمْ أَجْراً فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Or askest thou) O Muhammad (a fee from them) in exchange for their faith (so that they are plunged in debt) so that they are drowned in debt if they accept to give you a fee?

translation: Or is it that you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) ask a wage from them (for your preaching of Islâmic Monotheism) so that they are burdened with a load of debt?

metadata.arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Or possess they the Unseen) and therefore know that they will not be resurrected (so that they can write (it) down?) that is to say, or do they have a book in which they write whatever they will from the Guarded Tablet, such that they write down what they say and do?

translation: Or that the Ghaib (Unseen) is with them, and they write it down?

metadata.arabic: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْداً فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Or seek they) indeed they seek (to ensnare (the messenger)) to kill you, O Muhammad? (But those who disbelieve) the disbelievers of Mecca: Abu Jahl and his host who planned to kill the Prophet (pbuh) (they are the ensnared!) they are the ones who will be killed on the Day of Badr!

translation: Or do they intend a plot (against you O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)? But those who disbelieve (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) are themselves plotted against!

metadata.arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Or have they any god beside Allah) who will save them from Allah's torment? (Glorified be Allah) Allah exonerates Himself (from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)) of idols!

translation: Or have they an ilâh (a god) other than Allâh? Glorified be Allâh from all that they ascribe as partners (to Him)

metadata.arabic: وَإِن يَرَوْاْ كِسْفاً مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطاً يَقُولُواْ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (And if they) the disbelievers of Mecca (were to see a fragment of the heaven falling, they would say: A heap of clouds) because of their denial.

translation: And if they were to see a piece of the heaven falling down, they would say: "Clouds gathered in heaps!"

metadata.arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُواْ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then let them be) leave them, O Muhammad, (till they meet) until they behold (their day, in which they will be thunder-stricken) they will die,

translation: So leave them alone till they meet their Day, in which they will sink into a fainting (with horror).

metadata.arabic: يَوْمَ لاَ يُغْنِي عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْئاً وَلاَ هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (A day) which is the Day of Judgement (in which their guile will naught avail them) the doing of Abu Jahl and his host will not benefit them at all against Allah's chastisement, (nor will they be helped) nor will they be prevented from what is wanted with them.

translation: The Day when their plotting shall not avail them at all nor will they be helped (i.e. they will receive their torment in Hell).

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ عَذَاباً دُونَ ذَلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And verily, for those who do wrong) the idolaters: the disbelievers of Mecca, (there is a punishment) in the grave (beyond that) other than the chastisement of Gehenna. (But most of them) all of them (know not) this nor believe in it.

translation: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is another punishment (i.e. the torment in this world and in their graves) before this; but most of them know not. (Tafsir At-Tabarî).

metadata.arabic: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
metadata.Tafsir: (So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for your Lord's decree) upon conveying the message of your Lord; and it is said this means: be content with the decree of your Lord regarding that which befalls you in the course of obeying your Lord, (for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord) pray by the command of your Lord (when thou uprisest) from your bed for the Fajr prayer.

translation: So wait patiently (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) for the Decision of your Lord, for verily, you are under Our Eyes; and glorify the Praises of your Lord when you get up from sleep.

metadata.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱللَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَارَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And in the night time) upon the advent of the night (also hymn His praise) pray for Him the prayer of Zuhr, 'Asr, Maghrib and 'Isha', (and at the setting of the stars) two units of prayers after Fajr, and the setting of the star when it goes down'.

translation: And in the nighttime also glorify His Praises - and at the setting of the stars.

metadata.arabic: وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (By the Najm when it setteth): '(By the Najm when it setteth) He says: Allah swears by the Qur'an when Gabriel takes it down to Muhammad in instalments (nujuman): one, two, three or four verses at a time. There was a 20 years interval between the first and last verses. When this verse was revealed, 'Utbah Ibn Abi Lahab heard that the Prophet (pbuh) swore by the revelation of the Qur'an in instalment and so he said: “Tell Muhammad that I disbelieve in the instalments of the Qur'an”. When the Prophet (pbuh) was informed of this, he prayed: “O Allah! Set on him one of Your wild beasts”. Later, Allah set on him a lion near Harran that snatched him from among his friends and took him to a place nearby. It tore him apart from head to foot but did not eat him because of his impurity, just as the Prophet (pbuh) had prayed against him. It is also said here Allah swore by the stars when they set,

translation: By the star when it goes down (or vanishes).

metadata.arabic: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (Your comrade erreth not) this is the reason why Allah made the above oath: your Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) did not lie about what he said to you, (nor is deceived) he is not wrong nor did he err in what he said;

translation: Your companion (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) has neither gone astray nor has erred.

metadata.arabic: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (Nor doth he speak of (his own) desire) he did not utter the Qur'an of his own desire.

translation: Nor does he speak of (his own) desire.

metadata.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلاَّ وَحْيٌ يُوحَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (It is) i.e. the Qur'an (naught save an inspiration) from Allah (that is inspired) to him through Gabriel who comes and recites it to him,

translation: It is only a Revelation revealed.

metadata.arabic: عَلَّمَهُ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (Which one of mighty powers hath taught him) Gabriel taught him,

translation: He has been taught (this Qur’ân) by one mighty in power [Jibrîl (Gabriel)]

metadata.arabic: ذُو مِرَّةٍ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (One vigorous) one strong; it is also said this means: one mighty, for his strength was such that he put his hand under the townships of Lot and pulled them out, raised them to the sky and threw them upside down to the ground. His strength was also such that he seized the sides of the gate of Antioch and cried one cry that killed all the living creatures in it. It is also said that his strength was such that he spread one of his feathers on a hill in Jerusalem and struck with it Iblis who was at the farthest corner of India; (and he grew clear to view) Gabriel appeared in the form in which Allah created it him; and it is also said: he appeared in a beautiful form.

translation: One free from any defect in body and mind then he (Jibrîl - Gabriel in his real shape as created by Allah) rose and became stable.

metadata.arabic: وَهُوَ بِٱلأُفُقِ ٱلأَعْلَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (When he was on the uppermost horizon) at the setting place of the sun; and it is said: at the seventh heaven.

translation: While he [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] was in the highest part of the horizon, (Tafsir Ibn Kathir)

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then he drew nigh) Gabriel drew near Muhammad (pbuh); and it is said: Muhammad (pbuh) drew near to his Lord (and came down) closer,

translation: Then he [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] approached and came closer,

metadata.arabic: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (Till he was (distant) two bows length) of the bows used by the Arabs (or even nearer) nearer by half a bow length,

translation: And was at a distance of two bows’ length or (even) nearer.

metadata.arabic: فَأَوْحَىٰ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ مَآ أَوْحَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (And He revealed unto His slave) Gabriel (that which He revealed) to His slave Muhammad (pbuh); and it is said this means: and He revealed to His slave Muhammad (pbuh) that which He revealed.

translation: So (Allâh) revealed to His slave [Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم through Jibrîl (Gabriel) عليه السلام] whatever He revealed.

metadata.arabic: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (The heart) of Muhammad (pbuh) (lied not (in seeing) what it saw) when he saw his Lord with his heart; it is also said that he saw his Lord with his eyes. This is why Allah made His oath.

translation: The (Prophet’s) heart lied not in what he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) saw.

metadata.arabic: أَفَتُمَارُونَهُ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: When the Prophet (pbuh) informed them of what he saw, they disbelieved him. And so Allah said: (Will ye then dispute with him concerning) will you then disbelieve (what he seeth) what Muhammad (pbuh) saw?

translation: Will you then dispute with him (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) about what he saw [during the Mi‘râj: (Ascent of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم to the seven heavens)]

metadata.arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَآهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (And verily he saw him) i.e. Muhammad (pbuh) saw Gabriel; and it is said he saw his Lord with his heart; and it is said he saw his Lord with his eyes, (yet another time) other than the time about which he informed you,

translation: And indeed he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) saw him [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] at a second descent (i.e. another time).

metadata.arabic: عِندَ سِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (By the lote tree of the utmost boundary) at which point every close angel and sent prophet stops; it is also said that this means: the knowledge of every close angel and sent prophet and firm-footed scholar stops at this point,

translation: Near Sidrat-ul-Muntaha (a lote-tree of the utmost boundary over the seventh heaven beyond which none can pass).

metadata.arabic: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (Nigh unto which is the Garden of Abode) wherein the spirits of martyrs abide.

translation: Near it is the Paradise of Abode.

metadata.arabic: إِذْ يَغْشَىٰ ٱلسِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (When that which shroudeth did enshroud the lote tree) when the angels enshroud the lote tree; and it is said this means: when the light enshrouds the lote tree; and it is also said that this means: when a canopy of gold enshrouds the lote tree,

translation: When that covered the lote-tree which did cover it!

metadata.arabic: مَا زَاغَ ٱلْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (The eye turned not aside) the sight of Muhammad (pbuh) did not turn right or left because of what he saw (nor yet was overbold) due to what he saw; he saw that Gabriel had 600 wings.

translation: The sight (of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) turned not aside (right or left), nor it transgressed beyond the limit (ordained for it).

metadata.arabic: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ آيَاتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (Verily he) i.e. Muhammad (pbuh) (saw one of the greater revelations of his Lord) he saw one of the greatest marvels of his Lord.

translation: Indeed he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) did see of the Greatest Signs, of his Lord (Allâh).

metadata.arabic: أَفَرَأَيْتُمُ ٱللاَّتَ وَٱلْعُزَّىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (Have ye) O people of Mecca (thought upon al-Lat and al-'Uzza

translation: Have you then considered Al-Lât, and Al-‘Uzzâ (two idols of the pagan Arabs)

metadata.arabic: وَمَنَاةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلأُخْرَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: And Manat, the third, the other) will benefit you in the Hereafter? It will not benefit them. It is also said that the verse means: do you deem that your worship of al-Lat, al-'Uzza and Manat in the life of the world will benefit you in the Hereafter. No, it will surely not benefit you. As for al-Lat it was an idol which was worshipped in Thaqif; al-'Uzza was a tree in Batn al-Nakhlah which Ghatafan worshipped; while Manat was an idol in Mecca which was worshipped beside Allah by Hudhayl and Khuza'ah.

translation: And Manât (another idol of the pagan Arabs), the other third?

metadata.arabic: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلأُنْثَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (Are yours the males) O people of Mecca, whom you are pleased to have for yourselves (and His the females) despite the fact that you dislike them and will not be pleased to have them for yourselves?

translation: Is it for you the males and for Him the females?

metadata.arabic: تِلْكَ إِذاً قِسْمَةٌ ضِيزَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (That indeed were an unfair division!

translation: That indeed is a division most unfair!

metadata.arabic: إِنْ هِيَ إِلاَّ أَسْمَآءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَآبَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَانٍ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلاَّ ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلأَنفُسُ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: They are) i.e. al-Lat, al-'Uzza and Manat (but names) idols (which ye have named ye and your fathers) you have appointed them as deities; it is also said that this means: you and your forefathers have made them, (for which Allah hath revealed) regarding their worship or naming (no warrant) no Scripture wherein is found your proof. (They follow) they do not worship al-Lat, al-'Uzza and Manat or that which they call deities (but a guess) except through surmise and have no certainty about their worship (and that which (they) themselves desire) and they also worship them because they follow their own desires. (And now the guidance from their Lord) the explanation in the Qur'an that Allah has no son or partner (hath come unto them) to the people of Mecca.

translation: They are but names which you have named - you and your fathers - for which Allâh has sent down no authority. They follow but a guess and that which they themselves desire, whereas there has surely come to them the Guidance from their Lord!

metadata.arabic: أَمْ لِلإِنسَانِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (Or shall man) the people of Mecca (have what he coveteth) i.e. that the idols and angels will intercede for them?

translation: Or shall man have what he wishes?

metadata.arabic: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلآخِرَةُ وٱلأُولَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (But Unto Allah belongeth the after (life)) through the bestowal of reward, honour and intercession, (and the former) by giving knowledge and success.

translation: But to Allâh belongs the last (Hereafter) and the first (the world).

metadata.arabic: وَكَمْ مِّن مَّلَكٍ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لاَ تُغْنِي شَفَاعَتُهُمْ شَيْئاً إِلاَّ مِن بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (And how many angels are in the heavens) whom you claim are Allah's daughters (whose intercession availeth naught) who intercede for no one (save after Allah giveth leave) except after Allah commands them to intercede (to whom He chooseth) to whoever deserves it from among the believers (and accepteth) them through the profession of Allah's divine Oneness!

translation: And there are many angels in the heavens, whose intercession will avail nothing except after Allâh has given leave for whom He wills and is pleased with.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلآخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلاَئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلأُنْثَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! it is those who disbelieve in the Hereafter) in resurrection after death, i.e. the disbelievers of Mecca (who name the angels with the names of females) they make them Allah's daughters.

translation: Verily, those who believe not in the Hereafter, name the angels with female names.

metadata.arabic: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلاَّ ٱلظَّنَّ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لاَ يُغْنِي مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْئاً
metadata.Tafsir: (And they have no knowledge thereof) they have no proof or elucidation about what they say. (They follow but a guess) they lie out of surmise and do not have any certainty, (and lo! a guess) and worship based on guess and claims based on guess (can never take the place of the Truth) cannot spare one from Allah's chastisement.

translation: But they have no knowledge thereof. They follow but a guess, and verily, guess is no substitute for the truth.

metadata.arabic: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلاَّ ٱلْحَيَاةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
metadata.Tafsir: (Then withdraw) then turn your face, O Muhammad, (from him who fleeth) from him who turns away (from Our remembrance) from Our divine Oneness and Scripture (and desireth) of his works (but the life of the world) but that which is in the life of the world, i.e. Abu Jahl and his host.

translation: Therefore withdraw (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) from him who turns away from Our Reminder (this Qur’ân) and desires nothing but the life of this world.

metadata.arabic: ذَلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُمْ مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (Such is their sum of knowledge) such is the extent at which their knowledge, intellect and opinion end, since they claimed that the angels are Allah's daughters and that there is no Hereafter. (Lo! thy Lord) O Muhammad (is best aware of him who strayeth) from His religion, in reference here to Abu Jahl, (and He is best aware of him who goeth right) to His religion, in reference here to Abu Bakr.

translation: That is what they could reach of knowledge. Verily, your Lord it is He Who knows best him who goes astray from His Path, and He knows best him who receives guidance.

metadata.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَاءُواْ بِمَا عَمِلُواْ وَيَجْزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُواْ بِٱلْحُسْنَى
metadata.Tafsir: (And Unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens) of creation (and whatsoever is in the earth) of created beings; they are all slaves of Allah, (that He may reward those who do evil) those ascribe partners to Allah (with that which they have done) in their state of idolatry, (and reward those who do good) those who believe in Allah's divine Oneness (with goodness) with the Garden.

translation: And to Allâh belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, that He may requite those who do evil with that which they have done (i.e. punish them in Hell), and reward those who do good, with what is best (i.e. Paradise).

metadata.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَائِرَ ٱلإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَاحِشَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّمَمَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَاسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُمْ مِّنَ ٱلأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ فَلاَ تُزَكُّوۤاْ أَنفُسَكُمْ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: Allah then showed their works in the life of the world, saying: (Those who avoid enormities of sin) i.e. idolatry and the major sins (and abominations) adultery and transgressions, (save the unwilled offences) except a furtive look, a taunt, a censure which they then blame themselves for committing and repent of doing; it is also said that this means: except marrying ((for them) lo! thy Lord is of vast mercy) towards he who repents of major and minor sins. (He is best aware of you) than your own selves (when He created you from the earth) He created you from Adam and Adam is from dust and dust is from the earth, (and when ye were) small (hidden in the bellies of your mothers) Allah knew in these circumstances what will ensue from you. (Therefore ascribe not purity unto yourselves) do not absolve yourselves from committing sins. (He is best aware of him who wardeth off (evil)) transgression and does good.

translation: Those who avoid great sins (See the Qur’ân, Verses: 6:152,153) and Al-Fawâhish (illegal sexual intercourse) except the small faults, - verily, your Lord is of Vast Forgiveness. He knows you well when He created you from the earth (Adam), and when you were fetuses in your mothers’ wombs. So ascribe not purity to yourselves. He knows best him who fears Allâh and keeps his duty to Him [i.e. those who are Al-Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2)].

metadata.arabic: أَفَرَأَيْتَ ٱلَّذِي تَوَلَّىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (Didst thou (O Muhammad) observe him who turned away) from spending and giving alms to the poor among the Companions of the Prophet (pbuh)

translation: Did you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) observe him who turned away (from Islâm).

metadata.arabic: وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلاً وَأَكْدَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (And gave a little) for the sake of Allah, (then was grudging) then stopped his spending and almsgiving in the way of Allah?

translation: And gave a little, then stopped (giving)?

metadata.arabic: أَعِندَهُ عِلْمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (Hath he knowledge of the Unseen) the Guarded Tablet (so that he seeth) his doing in it that it is indeed as he did? This verse was revealed about 'Uthman Ibn 'Affan who was of the habit of spending a great deal on, and gives alms to, the Companions of the Prophet (pbuh) but then he met 'Abdullah Ibn Sa'd Ibn Abi Sarh. The latter said to him: " I see that you spend a great deal on these, and I fear that you may be left with nothing ". 'Uthman said to him: " I have faults and sins which I want to expiate and I also want to obtain Allah's good pleasure ". 'Abdullah said: " Give me the halter of your camel and I will bear your sins and faults in this life and in the Hereafter ". As a result, he gave him the halter of his camel and confided himself to spending on him. It is because of this that this verse was revealed.

translation: Is with him the knowledge of the Unseen so that he sees?

metadata.arabic: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِي صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (Or hath he not had news) has he not been informed in the Qur'an (of what is in the books of Moses) He says: in the Torah and the scrolls of Abraham.

translation: Or is he not informed with what is in the Pages (Scripture) of Mûsâ (Moses),

metadata.arabic: وَإِبْرَاهِيمَ ٱلَّذِي وَفَّىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (And Abraham who paid his debt) i.e. he conveyed the message of his Lord and acted upon that which Allah had commanded him; it is also said that this means: he did as he was told in his dream vision:

translation: And of Ibrâhîm (Abraham) who fulfilled (or conveyed) all that (Allâh ordered him to do or convey):

metadata.arabic: أَلاَّ تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (That no laden one shall bear another's load) that no bearer shall bear the sins of another; it is also said that this means: no soul shall be tormented for the sins of another soul,

translation: That no burdened person (with sins) shall bear the burden (sins) of another.

metadata.arabic: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلإِنسَانِ إِلاَّ مَا سَعَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (And that man) on the Day of Judgement (hath only that for which he maketh effort) he has only that which he has earned of good or evil in the life of the world,

translation: And that man can have nothing but what he does (good or bad).

metadata.arabic: وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (And that his effort will be seen) and that his works will be seen,

translation: And that his deeds will be seen.

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ يُجْزَاهُ ٱلْجَزَآءَ ٱلأَوْفَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (And afterward he will be repaid for it with fullest payment) good with good and evil with evil;

translation: Then he will be recompensed with a full and the best recompense.

metadata.arabic: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (And that thy Lord, He is the goal) to your Lord is the return of all created beings after they die and their destination will be to Him in the Hereafter;

translation: And that to your Lord (Allâh) is the End (Return of everything).

metadata.arabic: وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (And that He it is Who maketh laugh) the people of the Garden when they see what pleases them in terms of the honour that is bestowed upon them, (and maketh weep) the people of the Fire when they see what grieves them in terms of humiliation,

translation: And that it is He (Allâh) Who makes (whom He wills) laugh, and makes (whom He wills) weep.

metadata.arabic: وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا
metadata.Tafsir: (And that He it is Who giveth death) in the life of the world (and giveth life) for the resurrection; it is also said that this means: He gives death to fathers and life to sons;

translation: And that it is He (Allâh) Who causes death and gives life.

metadata.arabic: وَأَنَّهُ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلأُنثَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (And that He createth the two spouses) a pair, (the male and the female,

translation: And that He (Allâh) creates the pairs, male and female,

metadata.arabic: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: From a drop (of seed) when it is poured forth) in the womb of the woman; it is also said that this means: when it is created;

translation: From Nutfah (drops of semen - male and female discharges) when it is emitted.
