metadata.arabic: وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلأُخْرَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (And that He hath ordained the second bringing forth) the other creation after the resurrection;

translation: And that upon Him (Allâh) is another bringing forth (Resurrection).

metadata.arabic: وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (And that He it is Who enricheth) He made Himself independent of the need for created beings (and contenteth) and He made His slaves needy for Him; it is also said that this means: He made some rich with gold and silver and others content with the possession of camels, bovines and sheep.

translation: And that it is He (Allâh) Who gives much or a little (of wealth and contentment)

metadata.arabic: وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعْرَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (And that He it is Who is the Lord of Sirius) which was worshipped by Khuza'ah;

translation: And that He (Allâh) is the Lord of Sirius (the star which the pagan Arabs used to worship).

metadata.arabic: وَأَنَّهُ أَهْلَكَ عَاداً ٱلأُولَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (And that He destroyed the former (tribe of) 'Aad) the folk of Hud,

translation: And that it is He (Allâh) Who destroyed the former ‘Âd (people),

metadata.arabic: وَثَمُودَ فَمَآ أَبْقَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (And (the tribe of) Thamud) the folk of Salih (He spared not) a single one of them;

translation: And Thamûd (people): He spared none of them.

metadata.arabic: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (And the folk of Noah) and He also destroyed the folk of Noah (aforetime) before the folk of Salih, (lo! They) i.e. the folk of Noah (were more unjust) more intense in their disbelief (and more rebellious) in their transgression and sinning;

translation: And the people of Nûh (Noah) aforetime. Verily, they were more unjust and more rebellious and transgressing [in disobeying Allâh and His Messenger Nûh (Noah) عليه السلام].

metadata.arabic: وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (And al-Mu'tafikah He destroyed) and He destroyed the townships of the folk of Lot: Sodom, Sadum, Gomorrah and Sawa'im; al-Mu'tafikat means those that were swallowed up by the earth.

translation: And He destroyed the overthrown cities [of Sodom to which Prophet Lût (Lot) was sent].

metadata.arabic: فَغَشَّاهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (So that there covered them that which did cover) i.e. stones covered them.

translation: So there covered them that which did cover (i.e. torment with stones).

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (Concerning which then, of the bounties of thy Lord) which of the blessings of your Lord, O man-this refers to all human beings except Muhammad (pbuh)-(canst thou dispute) can you deny that it is not from your Lord?

translation: Then which of the Graces of your Lord (O man!) will you doubt?

metadata.arabic: هَـٰذَا نَذِيرٌ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلأُوْلَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (This is a warner) i.e. Muhammad (pbuh) is a warning Messenger (of the warners of old) like the earlier messengers whom We sent to their folks; it is also said that this means: this is a messenger among the messengers of old whom it is written, in the Guarded Tablet, that We would sent to their folks.

translation: This (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is a warner (Messenger) of the (series of) warners (Messengers) of old.

metadata.arabic: أَزِفَتِ ٱلآزِفَةُ
metadata.Tafsir: (The threatened Hour is nigh) the advent of the Hour is close.

translation: The Day of Resurrection draws near.

metadata.arabic: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (None beside Allah can disclose it) none except Allah can reveal its advent and exact time.

translation: None besides Allâh can avert it (or advance it or delay it).

metadata.arabic: أَفَمِنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Marvel ye then at this statement) He says: are you mocking-and it is said: are you denying-this Qur'an which Muhammad (pbuh) recites to you, O people of Mecca,

translation: Do you then wonder at this recitation (the Qur’ân)?

metadata.arabic: وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلاَ تَبْكُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And laugh) at out of derision (and not weep) because of what it contains of rebuke, threats and warning,

translation: And you laugh at it and weep not,

metadata.arabic: وَأَنتُمْ سَامِدُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (While ye amuse yourselves) while you are heedless of it and disbelieve in it?

translation: Wasting your (precious) lifetime in pastime and amusements (singing, etc.).

metadata.arabic: فَٱسْجُدُواْ لِلَّهِ وَٱعْبُدُواْ
metadata.Tafsir: (Rather prostrate yourselves before Allah) rather submit to Him through declaring His divine Oneness and also by repenting (and serve Him) and testify that there is only one God Who has no partner, solely for Allah's sake, for the Hour is nigh'.

translation: So fall you down in prostration to Allâh and worship Him (Alone).

metadata.arabic: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
metadata.Tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said in the interpretation of Allah's saying (The hour drew nigh): '(The hour drew nigh) He says: the coming of the Hour drew nigh by the advent of Muhammad (pbuh) and the coming down of the smock (and the moon was rent in twain) this is also another sign of the closeness of the Day of Judgement.

translation: The Hour has drawn near, and the moon has been cleft asunder (the people of Makkah requested Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم to show them a miracle, so he showed them the splitting of the moon).

metadata.arabic: وَإِن يَرَوْاْ آيَةً يُعْرِضُواْ وَيَقُولُواْ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ
metadata.Tafsir: (And if they behold a portent) like the splitting of the moon (they turn away) they deny the sign (and say:) this sign is nothing but (Prolonged illusion) which will vanish.

translation: And if they see a sign, they turn away, and say: "This is continuous magic."

metadata.arabic: وَكَذَّبُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُوۤاْ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
metadata.Tafsir: (They denied) the sign and the coming of the Hour (and followed their own lusts) in denying the sign, the coming of the Hour and worshipping idols. (Yet everything will come to a decision) every word from Allah or His Messenger regarding promise, threat, tidings of Paradise or hell, mercy or punishment is true, some of this will happen in the life of the world, for all to see, and some of it will happen in the Hereafter and everything there will be manifest. It is also said that this means: every action and word that ensue from the slaves has a reality and this reality is in the heart.

translation: They belied (the Verses of Allâh - this Qur’ân), and followed their own lusts. And every matter will be settled (according to the kind of deeds: good deeds will take their doers to Paradise, and similarly evil deeds will take their doers to Hell).

metadata.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلأَنبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (And surely there hath come unto them) unto the people of Mecca in the Qur'an (news) of the nations of old, how they were destroyed when they disbelieved (whereof the purport should deter) and take admonition,

translation: And indeed there has come to them news (in this Qur’ân) wherein there is (enough warning) to check (them from evil),

metadata.arabic: حِكْمَةٌ بَالِغَةٌ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
metadata.Tafsir: (Effective) is the (wisdom) of the Qur'an; it is wisdom from Allah which they were conveyed on behalf of Allah; (but warnings) i.e. the messengers (avail not) the people who disbelieve in Allah as it is in His preeternal knowledge.

translation: Perfect wisdom (this Qur’ân), but (the preaching of) warners benefit them not.

metadata.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَيْءٍ نُّكُرٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (So withdraw from them) so turn away from them, O Muhammad-but he was later commanded to fight them-(on the day) which is the Day of Judgement (when the Summoner summoneth unto a painful thing) a tremendous and frightful thing whereby the dwellers of Paradise will be taken to Paradise and the dwellers of hell to hell.

translation: So (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) withdraw from them. The Day that the caller will call (them) to a terrible thing.

metadata.arabic: خُشَّعاً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (With downcast eyes) humbled, (they come forth from the graves) upon the first blow of the Trumpet (as they were locusts spread abroad) He says: they fall on each other like locusts,

translation: They will come forth, with humbled eyes from (their) graves as if they were locusts spread abroad,

metadata.arabic: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Hastening towards the Summoner) to find out about what he is going to command them; (the disbelievers say) on the Day of Judgement: (This is a hard day) on them, that is.

translation: Hastening towards the caller. The disbelievers will say: "This is a hard Day."

metadata.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُواْ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُواْ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
metadata.Tafsir: (The folk of Noah denied) Noah (before them) before your folk, O Muhammad, (yea, they denied Our slave) Noah (and said: A madman) bewitched; (and he was repulsed) he was deterred from what he brought to them, crying in his face: " you have lost your mind! ".

translation: The people of Nûh (Noah) denied (their Messenger) before them. They rejected Our slave, and said: "A madman!" and he was insolently rebuked and threatened.

metadata.arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ
metadata.Tafsir: (So he cried unto his Lord, saying: I am vanquished) I am oppressed, (so give help) by punishing them.

translation: Then he invoked his Lord (saying): "I have been overcome, so help (me)!"

metadata.arabic: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَابَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَاءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then opened We the gates of heaven) for 40 days (with pouring water) with pouring rain.

translation: So We opened the gates of the heaven with water pouring forth.

metadata.arabic: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلأَرْضَ عُيُوناً فَالْتَقَى ٱلمَآءُ عَلَىٰ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And caused the earth to gush forth springs) for 40 days, (so that the waters) of the heaven and the earth (met for a predestined purpose) met for a measure that We have appointed: the rain of heaven and the water of springs; it is also said that this means: the waters met for a decreed purpose to destroy the folk of Noah.

translation: And We caused springs to gush forth from the earth. So the waters (of the heaven and the earth) met for a matter predestined.

metadata.arabic: وَحَمَلْنَاهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَاحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And We carried him) i.e. Noah and those who believed in him (upon a thing of planks and nails) an ark,

translation: And We carried him on a (ship) made of planks and nails,

metadata.arabic: تَجْرِي بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
metadata.Tafsir: (That ran (upon the waters) in Our sight) under Our protection, (as a reward for him who was rejected) He says: this is as a reward for the folk of Noah as a result of their disbelief.

translation: Floating under Our Eyes: a reward for him who had been rejected!

metadata.arabic: وَلَقَدْ تَّرَكْنَاهَا آيَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And verily We left it as a token) as a sign for people, i.e. We left the ark of Noah, after the death of Noah, as a sign for people; it is also said that this means: We left the similitude of Noah as a sign for people; (but is there any that remembereth) is there any that will take admonition from what was done to the folk of Noah and, hence, desist from transgression?

translation: And indeed, We have left this as a sign. Then is there any that will remember (or receive admonition)?

metadata.arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!) See, O Muhammad, how My punishment of these folk and how the state of those warned became, when Noah warned them but they rejected faith.

translation: Then how (terrible) was My Torment and My Warnings?

metadata.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember) recite and write; it is also said that this means: We have made the recitation of the Qur'an easy; (but is there any that remembereth) is there any that seeks knowledge and hence be helped to acquire it?

translation: And We have indeed made the Qur’ân easy to understand and remember; then is there any one who will remember (or receive admonition)?

metadata.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
metadata.Tafsir: ((The tribe of) 'Aad rejected warnings) the folk of Hud denied Hud. (Then how dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings) see, O Muhammad, how the state of those warned by Hud became when they disbelieved in him.

translation: ‘Âd (people) belied (their Prophet, Hûd); then how (terrible) was My Torment and My Warnings?

metadata.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحاً صَرْصَراً فِي يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! We let loose on them a raging wind) a cold wind, which is the west wind (on a day of constant calamity) a day of continuous calamity upon the young and the old,

translation: Verily, We sent against them a furious wind of harsh voice on a day of evil omen and continuous calamity.

metadata.arabic: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Sweeping men away as though they were uprooted trunks of palm-trees.

translation: Plucking out men as if they were uprooted stems of date-palms.

metadata.arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
metadata.Tafsir: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!) See, O Muhammad, how was My punishment of them, and how was the state of those who were warned by Hud but did not believe him.

translation: Then, how (terrible) was My Torment and My Warnings?

metadata.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember) and to recite; (but is there any that remembereth) is there any that takes admonition from what was done to the people of Hud and therefore abstain from transgression?

translation: And We have indeed made the Qur’ân easy to understand and remember; then is there any that will remember (or receive admonition)?

metadata.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
metadata.Tafsir: ((The tribe of) Thamud) the folk of Salih (rejected warnings) disbelieved in Salih as well as in all the messengers.

translation: Thamûd (people also) belied the warnings.

metadata.arabic: فَقَالُوۤاْ أَبَشَراً مِّنَّا وَاحِداً نَّتَّبِعُهُ إِنَّآ إِذاً لَّفِي ضَلاَلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (For they said: Is it a mortal man) he is a human being like us, (alone among us, that we are to follow) his matter and religion? (Then) if we follow him (indeed we should fall into error) in manifest error (and madness) tiredness and toil.

translation: And they said: "A man, alone among us - shall we follow him? Truly then we should be in error and distress (or madness)!"

metadata.arabic: أَءُلْقِيَ الذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِن بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Hath the remembrance) prophethood (been given unto him alone among us) when we are nobler than him? (Nay, but he is a rash liar) Salih is a vain liar who lies against Allah.

translation: "Is it that the Reminder is sent to him [Prophet Sâlih عليه السلام] alone from among us? Nay, he is an insolent liar!"

metadata.arabic: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَداً مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلأَشِرُ
metadata.Tafsir: Salih said to them: (Tomorrow) on the Day of Judgement (they will know who is the rash liar) who is the vain liar who lies against Allah.

translation: Tomorrow they will come to know who is the liar, the insolent one!

metadata.arabic: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُواْ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
metadata.Tafsir: Then Allah said to Salih: (Lo! We are sending the she-camel) We shall bring forth the she-camel from the rock (as a test for them) as a trial for your folk; (so watch them) wait until the she-camel is brought forth (and have patience) for the harm coming to you and for the killing of the she-camel;

translation: Verily, We are sending the she-camel as a test for them. So watch them [O Sâlih عليه السلام], and be patient!

metadata.arabic: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌ بَيْنَهُمْ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (And inform them that the water) of the well (is to be shared between (her and) them) one day for her and one day for them. (Every drinking will be witnessed) Salih informed them of this. They agreed to comply and observed this for a while but then their wretchedness overtook them.

translation: And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them, each one’s right to drink being established (by turns).

metadata.arabic: فَنَادَوْاْ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
metadata.Tafsir: (But they called their comrade) he called Masda' and Qudar Ibn Salif after Masda' Ibn Dahr shot her with an arrow (and he took) and Qudar took another arrow (and hamstrung (her)) killing the she-camel and dividing her meat.

translation: But they called their comrade and he took (a sword) and killed (her).

metadata.arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then see) O Muhammad (how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!) and how was the state of those warned by Salih but who rejected faith

translation: Then, how (terrible) was My Torment and My Warnings?

metadata.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً فَكَانُواْ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! We sent upon them one Shout) the shout of Gabriel three days after the killing of the she-camel, (and they became as the dry twigs (rejected by) the builder of a cattle fold) they became like the things in the cattle fold on which the cattle step.

translation: Verily, We sent against them a single Saihah (torment - awful cry), and they became like the stubble of a fold-builder.

metadata.arabic: وَلَقَد يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember) easy to take admonition from, and easy to memorise and recite; (but is there any that remembers) but is there any that takes admonition from what was done to the folk of Salih and, as a result, desist from transgression? It is also said that this means: is there any that seeks knowledge such that he is helped to acquire it?

translation: And indeed, We have made the Qur’ân easy to understand and remember; then is there any that will remember (or receive admonition)?

metadata.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
metadata.Tafsir: (The folk of Lot rejected warnings) they rejected Lot as well as all the messengers.

translation: The people of Lût (Lot) belied the warnings.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِباً إِلاَّ آلَ لُوطٍ نَّجَّيْنَاهُم بِسَحَرٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! We sent a storm of stones upon them (all) save the family of Lot) save Lot and his two daughters: Za'ura and Raytha, (whom We rescued in the last watch of the night) We rescued them at dawn,

translation: Verily, We sent against them a violent storm of stones (which destroyed them all), except the family of Lût (Lot), them We saved in the last hour of the night,

metadata.arabic: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا كَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي مَن شَكَرَ
metadata.Tafsir: (As grace from Us) as mercy from Us. (Thus We reward him who gives thanks) thus We save he who believes in Our divine Oneness and gives thanks for Our bounty.

translation: As a Favour from Us. Thus do We reward him who gives thanks (by obeying Us).

metadata.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُمْ بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْاْ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And he) Lot (indeed had warned them of Our blow) of Our chastisement, (but they did doubt the warnings) but they rejected what Lot said to them.

translation: And he [Lût (Lot)] indeed had warned them of Our Seizure (punishment), but they did doubt the warnings!

metadata.arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَاوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
metadata.Tafsir: (They even asked of him his guests for an ill purpose) they wanted his guests, Gabriel and the angels who were with him, for their abominable deed. (Then We blinded their eyes) Gabriel blinded their eyes ((and said): Taste now My punishment after My warnings!) And I said to them: taste now My punishment and the warning of My warners!

translation: And they indeed sought to shame his guest (by asking to commit sodomy with them). So We blinded their eyes, (saying) "Then taste you My Torment and My Warnings."

metadata.arabic: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
metadata.Tafsir: (And in truth the punishment decreed befell them early in the morning) and this punishment is connected with the punishment of the Hereafter.

translation: And verily, an abiding torment seized them early in the morning.

metadata.arabic: فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Now taste My punishment after My warnings!) And I said to them: taste My punishment and the warning of My warners; those whom Lot warned but did not believe him.

translation: "Then taste you My Torment and My Warnings."

metadata.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُدَّكِرٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember) to memorise, recite and write down; (but is there any that remembereth) but is there any that takes admonition from what was done to the folk of Lot and, hence, desist from transgression?

translation: And indeed, We have made the Qur’ân easy to understand and remember; then is there any that will remember (or receive admonition)?

metadata.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
metadata.Tafsir: (And warnings came in truth unto the house of Pharaoh) Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and his folk

translation: And indeed, warnings came to the people of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) [through Mûsâ (Moses) and Hârûn (Aaron)].

metadata.arabic: كَذَّبُواْ بِئَايَاتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ أَخْذَ عِزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Who denied Our revelations, every one) of the nine signs. (Therefore We grasped them with the grasp of the Mighty) by means of punishment, (the Powerful) to inflict punishment.

translation: (They) belied all Our Signs, so We seized them with a Seizure of the All-Mighty, All-Capable (Omnipotent).

metadata.arabic: أَكُفَّٰرُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُوْلَٰئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Are your disbelievers) O Muhammad; and it is said: O people of Mecca (better than those) We related to you, (or have ye some immunity in the Scriptures) from punishment?

translation: Are your disbelievers (O Quraish!) better than these [nations of Nûh (Noah), Lût (Lot), Sâlih, and the people of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) who were destroyed)? Or have you an immunity (against Our Torment) in the Divine Scriptures?

metadata.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Or say they) i.e. the disbelievers of Mecca: (We are a host victorious) and immune from punishment?

translation: Or say they: "We are a great multitude, victorious?"

metadata.arabic: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
metadata.Tafsir: (The hosts) the hosts of the disbelieving (will all be routed) on the Day of Badr (and will turn and flee) defeated; this refers to Abu Jahl and his host, some of whom were killed on the Day of Badr and others defeated.

translation: Their multitude will be put to flight, and they will show their backs.

metadata.arabic: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
metadata.Tafsir: (Nay, but the Hour (of doom)) the advent of the Hour (is their appointed tryst) of punishment, (and the Hour) of punishment (will be more wretched) more tremendous (and more bitter) than the punishment they suffered on the Day of Badr.

translation: Nay, but the Hour is their appointed time (for their full recompense), and the Hour will be more grievous and more bitter.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِي ضَلاَلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! the guilty) the idolaters: Abu Jahl and his host (are in error) in manifest error in the life of the world (and madness) toil and tiredness in hell.

translation: Verily the Mujrimûn (polytheists, disbelievers, sinners, criminals) are in error (in this world) and will burn (in the Hell-fire in the Hereafter).

metadata.arabic: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِي ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُواْ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
metadata.Tafsir: (On the day) which is the Day of Judgement (when they are dragged into the Fire) the angels of the Fire will drag them (upon their faces) and these angels will say to them: (Feel the touch of hell) taste the punishment of the Fire.

translation: The Day they will be dragged on their faces into the Fire (it will be said to them): "Taste you the touch of Hell!"

metadata.arabic: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَاهُ بِقَدَرٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! We have created every thing) of your works (by measure) by you rejected this. This verse was revealed about those who argued about destiny.

translation: Verily, We have created all things with Qadar (Divine Preordainments of all things before their creation as written in the Book of Decrees Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz).

metadata.arabic: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلاَّ وَاحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And Our commandment) concerning the coming of the Hour (is but one (commandment)) is but one word, (as the twinkling of an eye) in its swiftness. It is also said that (We have created every thing) means: We have created for everything something similar to it and also that which agrees with it of clothes and things.

translation: And Our Commandment is but one as the twinkling of an eye.

metadata.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And verily We have destroyed your fellows) We have destroyed the like of you and those who followed your religion, O people of Mecca; (but is there any that remembereth) is there any that takes admonition from what was done with them and, thus, desist from transgression?

translation: And indeed, We have destroyed your likes; then is there any that will remember (or receive admonition)?

metadata.arabic: وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And every thing they did) of transgression in their state of idolatry and opposition of the prophets (is in the Scriptures) written down; and it is said this means: it is written in the Guarded Tablet. This also was revealed about those who disputed about fate.

translation: And everything they have done is noted in (their) Records (of deeds).

metadata.arabic: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (And every small and great thing) of good or evil (is recorded) in the Guarded Tablet; this was revealed about the people who disputed about fate and who denied that everything is recorded in the Guarded Tablet.

translation: And everything, small and big, is written down (in Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz already beforehand i.e. before it befalls, or is done by its doer: الإيمان بالقدر) (See the Qur’ân V.57:22 and its footnote).

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! the righteous) those who ward off disbelief, idolatry and indecencies (will dwell among Gardens and rivers) many rivers; and it is said: in vast meadows,

translation: Verily, The Muttaqûn (the pious - see V.2:2), will be in the midst of Gardens and Rivers (Paradise).

metadata.arabic: فِي مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Firmly established) they are in an honoured place in Paradise (in the favour of a Mighty King) Who is able to dispense both reward and punishment to His slaves'.

translation: In a seat of truth (i.e. Paradise), near the Omnipotent King (Allâh, the One, the All-Blessed, the Most High, the Owner of Majesty and Honour).

metadata.arabic: ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ
metadata.Tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said: “When the verse (Say (unto mankind): Cry unto Allah, or cry unto the Beneficent) [17:111] was revealed, the disbelievers of Mecca-Abu Jahl, al-Walid, 'Utbah and Shaybah and their hosts-said: we know no one called the Beneficent except Musaylimah the liar who lives in Yamamah. So he is this Beneficent one, O Muhammad?” And so Allah revealed this: (The Beneficent

translation: The Most Gracious (Allâh)!

metadata.arabic: عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْآنَ
metadata.Tafsir: Hath made known the Qur'an) to Gabriel and the latter to Muhammad, and Muhammad to his nation. Allah sent Gabriel with the Qur'an to Muhammad (pbuh) and the Prophet taught it to his nation.

translation: He has taught (you mankind) the Qur’ân (by His Mercy).

metadata.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلإِنسَانَ
metadata.Tafsir: (He hath created man) i.e. Adam from the surface of the earth.

translation: He created man.

metadata.arabic: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلبَيَانَ
metadata.Tafsir: (He hath taught him utterance) Allah inspired him with the exposition of everything as well as with the names of every beast on the surface of the earth.

translation: He taught him eloquent speech.

metadata.arabic: ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (The sun and the moon are made punctual) their orbits are measured; and it is also said that this means: they are suspended half way between heaven and earth; and it is also said that this means: they both will be taken to task and have a lifespan like the lifespan of human beings.

translation: The sun and the moon run on their fixed courses (exactly) calculated with measured out stages for each (for reckoning).

metadata.arabic: وَٱلنَّجْمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: (The najm and the trees adore) the stars and the trees prostrate to the Beneficent; and it is also said that najm refers to vegetation that has no stalks.

translation: And the herbs (or stars) and the trees both prostrate themselves (to Allah - See V.22:18) (Tafsir Ibn Kathir)

metadata.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And the sky He hath uplifted) above everything; such that nothing touches it; (and He hath set the measure) on the earth; He explained fair measure through the scale,

translation: And the heaven: He has raised it high, and He has set up the Balance.

metadata.arabic: أَلاَّ تَطْغَوْاْ فِي ٱلْمِيزَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: (That ye exceed not the measure) that you do not transgress or be unjust in measure,

translation: In order that you may not transgress (due) balance.

metadata.arabic: وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلاَ تُخْسِرُواْ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
metadata.Tafsir: (But observe the measure strictly) keep the balance of the scale justly; and it is also said that this means: observe your tongues by saying only the Truth, (nor fall short thereof) do not weigh less for the people such that you take away their rights.

translation: And observe the weight with equity and do not make the balance deficient.

metadata.arabic: وَٱلأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلأَنَامِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And the earth hath He appointed) He spread it on the water (for (His) creatures) for all created beings whether dead or alive,

translation: And the earth: He has put down (laid) for the creatures.

metadata.arabic: فِيهَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَٱلنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ ٱلأَكْمَامِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Wherein) in the earth (are fruit) different kind of fruits (and sheathed palm-trees) which has foreskin or shells, or anything that has not sprouted up.

translation: Therein are fruits and date-palms producing sheathed fruit-stalks (enclosing dates).

metadata.arabic: وَٱلْحَبُّ ذُو ٱلْعَصْفِ وَٱلرَّيْحَانُ
metadata.Tafsir: (Husked grain) all kind of grain (and scented herb) spikes of grain and fruits.

translation: And also corn, with (its) leaves and stalk for fodder, and sweet-scented plants.

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny) and claim that they are not from Allah, O jinn and humans? This is addressed to all human beings except Muhammad (pbuh).

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلإِنسَانَ مِن صَلْصَالٍ كَٱلْفَخَّارِ
metadata.Tafsir: (He created man) i.e. Adam (of clay like the potter's) out of which pottery is made,

translation: He created man (Adam) from sounding clay like the clay of pottery.

metadata.arabic: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍ مِّن نَّارٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And the jinn) the father of the jinn and satans (did He create of smokeless fire.

translation: And the jinn: He created from a smokeless flame of fire.

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny) which of the blessings of your Lord do you deny?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lord of the two Easts) the East of winter and the East of summer, (and Lord of the two Wests) the West of winter and the West of summer! There are two Easts and two Wests. The East of winter and the East of summer have 180 phases just as the two Wests and the moon have 180 phases. It is also said that the Easts of summer and winter have 177 phases and the Wests of summer and winter as well as the moon have 177 phases. The sun rises throughout the year two days in the same phase and it also sets two days in the same phase.

translation: (He is) the Lord of the two easts (places of sunrise during early summer and early winter) and the Lord of the two wests (places of sunset during early summer and early winter).

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: He hath loosed the two seas) the sweet and the salty. (They meet) without mixing.

translation: He has let loose the two seas (the salt and fresh water) meeting together.

metadata.arabic: بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌ لاَّ يَبْغِيَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: (There is a barrier) from Allah (between them) between the sweet and salty seas. (They encroach not (one upon the other)) nor does any one of them change the taste of the other.

translation: Between them is a barrier which none of them can transgress.

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord: that you deny?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا ٱلُّلؤْلُؤُ وَٱلمَرْجَانُ
metadata.Tafsir: There cometh forth from both of them) but especially from the salty one (the pearl) big in size (and coral stone) small in size.

translation: Out of them both come out pearl and coral.

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاَءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَئَاتُ فِي ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلأَعْلاَمِ
metadata.Tafsir: His are the ships displayed) floating (upon the sea, like banners) like mountains, that is when the ships raise their sails.

translation: And His are the ships going and coming in the seas, like mountains.

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍ
metadata.Tafsir: Everyone that is thereon) on the face of the earth (will pass away) will die; it is also said that this means: everyone upon it will vanish; and it is also said that this means: every act that is done for other than Allah will perish;

translation: Whatsoever is on it (the earth) will perish.

metadata.arabic: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلاَلِ وَٱلإِكْرَامِ
metadata.Tafsir: (There remaineth but the Countenance of thy Lord) dies not; and it is also said that this means: the righteous works which are performed for the sake of Allah's Countenance will not perish (of Might) Who possesses might and sovereignty (and Glory) and who also possesses forgiveness and beneficence.

translation: And the Face of your Lord full of Majesty and Honour will remain forever.

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: يَسْأَلُهُ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأْنٍ
metadata.Tafsir: All that are in the heavens) among the angels (and the earth) among the believers. The inhabitants of the earth ask Him forgiveness, success, preservation from sin, bestowal of honour and provision (entreat Him. Every day He exerciseth (universal) power) He gives life, He takes life, He raises, He abases, He brings into the world a new born baby, He releases a prisoner; and the things He exercises are beyond count.

translation: Whosoever is in the heavens and on earth begs of Him (its needs from Him). Every day He is (engaged) in some affair (such as giving honour or disgrace to some, life or death to some, etc.)!

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلاَنِ
metadata.Tafsir: We shall dispose of you) We shall record the works that you do in the life of the world and take you to task for them on the Day of Judgement, (O ye two dependents) human beings and the jinn.

translation: We shall attend to you, O you two classes (jinn and men)!

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: يٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُواْ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُواْ لاَ تَنفُذُونَ إِلاَّ بِسُلْطَانٍ
metadata.Tafsir: O company of jinn and men, if ye have power) if you are able (to penetrate (all)) to break free from (regions) the extremities (of the heavens and the earth) and from the rows of angels; (then penetrate (them)) then break free and flee! (You will never penetrate them) you will not be able to break free (save with (Our) sanction) save with a reason and proof.

translation: O assembly of jinn and men! If you have power to pass beyond the zones of the heavens and the earth, then pass beyond (them)! But you will never be able to pass them, except with authority (from Allâh)!

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌ مِّن نَّارٍ وَنُحَاسٌ فَلاَ تَنتَصِرَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: There will be sent, against you both) when you emerge from the graves, O humans and jinn, (heat of fire) of smokeless fire (and flash of brass) and smoke which will lead you to the place of assembly, (and ye will not escape) you will not refuse to be led.

translation: There will be sent against you both, smokeless flames of fire and (molten) brass, and you will not be able to defend yourselves.

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةً كَٱلدِّهَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: And when the heaven splitteth asunder) because of the descent of the angels and awe towards the Lord (and becometh rosy) and become coloured (like red hide) like different kinds of paint; and it is said: like the different colours of roses; and it is also said: red in black

translation: Then when the heaven is rent asunder, and it becomes rosy or red like red-oil, or red hide - [See V.70:8]

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لاَّ يُسْأَلُ عَن ذَنبِهِ إِنسٌ وَلاَ جَآنٌّ
metadata.Tafsir: On that day) which is the Day of Judgement; after the end of reckoning (neither man nor jinn will be questioned of his sin) his works; the believer will be known with his blooming, white face; it is also said that this means: the sins of human beings and the jinn will not be asked about.

translation: So on that Day no question will be asked of man or jinns as to his sin, [because they have already been known from their faces either white (dwellers of Paradise - true believers of Islamic Monotheism) or black (dwellers of Hell - polytheists; disbelievers, criminals)].

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَاهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَاصِي وَٱلأَقْدَامِ
metadata.Tafsir: The guilty will be known by their marks) the idolaters will be known by their dark faces and bluish eyes, (and will be taken by the forelocks and the feet) and cast in the Fire.

translation: The Mujrimûn (polytheists, criminals, sinners) will be known by their marks (black faces), and they will be seized by their forelocks and their feet.

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?)

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: هَـٰذِهِ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِي يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: The angels in-charge of the Fire will say to them: (This is hell which the guilty deny) the idolaters, that is during the life of the world and claimed that it does not exist.

translation: This is the Hell which the Mujrimûn (polytheists, criminals, sinners) denied.

metadata.arabic: يَطُوفُونَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ حَمِيمٍ آنٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (They go circling round between it) i.e. the Fire (and fierce, boiling water) water as hot as can be.

translation: They will go between it (Hell) and the fierce boiling water!

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: وَلِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ جَنَّتَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: (But for him who feareth the standing before his Lord) but he who fears standing before his Lord upon being on the verge of committing a transgression and thus desists from it (there are two Gardens) the Garden of Eden and the Firdaws.

translation: But for him who fears the standing before his Lord, there will be two Gardens (i.e. in Paradise).

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: ذَوَاتَآ أَفْنَانٍ
metadata.Tafsir: Of spreading branches) and different kinds.

translation: With spreading branches.

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny) regarding the Gardens?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ تَجْرِيَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Wherein are two fountains flowing) for the dwellers of Paradise containing goodness, mercy, bestowal of honour, grace and more from Allah.

translation: In them (both) will be two springs flowing (free).

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny) regarding the Gardens?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: فِيهِمَا مِن كُلِّ فَاكِهَةٍ زَوْجَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Wherein is every kind of fruit in pairs) both with regard to shape and taste.

translation: In them (both) will be every kind of fruit in pairs.

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَى فُرُشٍ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍ وَجَنَى ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍ
metadata.Tafsir: Reclining upon couches) sitting in comfort upon couches (lined with silk brocade) their outside is made of thick silk brocade while their inside is of soft silk brocade, (the fruit of both Gardens near to hand.

translation: Reclining upon the couches lined with silk brocade, and the fruits of the two Gardens will be near at hand.

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny) regarding all the Gardens?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: فِيهِنَّ قَاصِرَاتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلاَ جَآنٌّ
metadata.Tafsir: (Therein are those of modest gaze) modest maiden who are content with their husbands and who do not look at other than their own husbands, (whom neither man nor jinn will have touched before them) before their husbands,

translation: Wherein both will be Qâsirât-ut-Tarf [chaste females (wives) restraining their glances, desiring none except their husbands], with whom no man or jinni has had tamth before them.

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: كَأَنَّهُنَّ ٱلْيَاقُوتُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ
metadata.Tafsir: (In beauty) like the jacynth and the coral stone.

translation: (In beauty) they are like rubies and coral.

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: هَلْ جَزَآءُ ٱلإِحْسَانِ إِلاَّ ٱلإِحْسَانُ
metadata.Tafsir: Is the reward of goodness aught save goodness?) He says: is the reward of he whom We have blessed with the profession of Allah's divine Oneness anything but the Garden?

translation: Is there any reward for good other than good?

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: وَمِن دُونِهِمَا جَنَّتَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: And beside them) besides the gardens mentioned earlier (are two other Gardens) which are less than the first two and which are: the Garden of Comfort (jannat al-na'im) and the Garden of Refuge (jannat al-ma'wa),

translation: And besides these two, there are two other Gardens (i.e. in Paradise).

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny) regarding the two Gardens?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: مُدْهَآمَّتَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Dark green with foliage) because of their abundant watering.

translation: Dark green (in colour).

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny) regarding these two Gardens?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ نَضَّاخَتَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Wherein) in the Gardens (are two abundant springs) and it is said: springs full of goodness, grace, mercy and bestowal of honour and much more from Allah.

translation: In them (both) will be two springs gushing forth.

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny) regarding he two Gardens?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: فِيهِمَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَنَخْلٌ وَرُمَّانٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Wherein) in the two Gardens (is fruit) different kinds of fruit, (the date-palm) different kinds of palm- trees (and pomegranate) different kinds of pomegranate in both taste and shape.

translation: In them (both) will be fruits, and date-palms and pomegranates.

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny) regarding the four Gardens; and it is said: regarding all the Gardens?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: فِيهِنَّ خَيْرَاتٌ حِسَانٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Wherein (are found) the good and beautiful) wives, i.e. good for their husbands.

translation: Therein (Gardens) will be Khairâtun-Hisân [fair (wives) good and beautiful];

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: حُورٌ مَّقْصُورَاتٌ فِي ٱلْخِيَامِ
metadata.Tafsir: Fair ones, close-guarded) for their husbands (in pavilions) of hollowed pearls.

translation: Hûr (beautiful, fair females) guarded in pavilions;

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلاَ جَآنٌّ
metadata.Tafsir: Whom neither man nor jinn will have touched before them) before their husbands

translation: With whom no man or jinni has had tamth before them.

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍ وَعَبْقَرِيٍّ حِسَانٍ
metadata.Tafsir: Reclining on green cushions) and it is also said: in meadows (and fair carpets) beautifully coloured carpets.

translation: Reclining on green cushions and rich beautiful mattresses.

metadata.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلاۤءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny) which of the blessings of your Lord, O men and jinn-here to the exception of Muhammad (pbuh)-do you reject and claim that it is not from Allah?

translation: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

metadata.arabic: تَبَارَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِي ٱلْجَلاَلِ وَٱلإِكْرَامِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Blessed be the Name of thy Lord) your Lord is the Possessor of grace and Mercy; and it is said: Allah exonerates Himself from having a son or partner, (Mighty) the Possessor of might and sovereignty (and Glorious) and the Possessor of forgiveness and beneficence upon the advent of the Day of Judgement!'

translation: Blessed be the Name of your Lord (Allâh), the Owner of Majesty and Honour.

metadata.arabic: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
metadata.Tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (When the event befalleth): '(When the event befalleth) He says: when the Day of Judgement comes.

translation: When the Event (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) befalls.

metadata.arabic: لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (There is no denying that it will befall) its coming cannot be repulsed, delayed or contain any ambiguity.

translation: And there can be no denial of its befalling.

metadata.arabic: خَافِضَةٌ رَّافِعَةٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Abasing (some)) due to their own works and, thus, sends them to the Fire, (exalting (others)) due to their own works and, thus, sends to the Garden. It is also said it is called the Event because of its sound which will be heard by the near and the far;

translation: Bringing low (some - those who will enter Hell) Exalting (others - those who will enter Paradise). [Tafsir Ibn Kathir]

metadata.arabic: إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلأَرْضُ رَجّاً
metadata.Tafsir: (When the earth is shaken with a shock) when the earth is shaken with such an earthquake that every mountain and building in it will be obliterated and turn into rubble.

translation: When the earth will be shaken with a terrible shake.

metadata.arabic: وَبُسَّتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ بَسّاً
metadata.Tafsir: (And the hills are ground to powder) and it is also said: and the hills are made to move like the passing of the clouds; and it is also said that this means: when the hills are uprooted from their spots.

translation: And the mountains will be powdered to dust,

metadata.arabic: فَكَانَتْ هَبَآءً مُّنبَثّاً
metadata.Tafsir: (So that they become a scattered dust) like the dust which sticks to the hooves of beasts or the atoms of dust which can be seen when the rays of the sun emerge from a hole in a house or a crack in a door,

translation: So that they will become floating dust particles.

metadata.arabic: وَكُنتُمْ أَزْوَاجاً ثَلاَثَةً
metadata.Tafsir: (And ye will be) on the Day of Judgement (three kinds:

translation: And you (all) will be in three groups.

metadata.arabic: فَأَصْحَابُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ مَآ أَصْحَابُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
metadata.Tafsir: (First) those on the right hand) these are the inhabitants of the Garden who will be given their scrolls in their right hands; they are the ones about whom Allah said: " These are destined for Paradise, and I care not " ; (what of those on the right hand) arousing by this expression the wonder of His Prophet: and what do you know, O Muhammad, about the bliss, happiness and honour of the people of the Garden?

translation: So those on the Right Hand (i.e. those who will be given their Records in their right hands) - how (fortunate) will be those on the Right Hand! (As a respect for them, because they will enter Paradise).

metadata.arabic: وَأَصْحَابُ ٱلْمَشْأَمَةِ مَآ أَصْحَابُ ٱلْمَشْأَمَةِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And (then) those on the left hand) these are the dwellers of the Fire who will be given their scrolls in their left hands; they are the ones about whom Allah said: “These are destined for hell, and I care not”; (what of those on the left hand) again arousing the wonder of His Prophet: and what do you know, O Muhammad, about the humiliation, punishment and chastisement suffered by the dwellers of hell?

translation: And those on the Left Hand (i.e. those who will be given their Record in their left hands) - how (unfortunate) will be those on the Left Hand! (As a disgrace for them, because they will enter Hell).

metadata.arabic: وَٱلسَّابِقُونَ ٱلسَّابِقُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And the foremost in the race) and the forerunners in the life of the world towards faith, migration, jihad, the utterance of the first “Allahu akbar” [Allah is the greatest] as well as towards all good things, these are (the foremost in the race) the forerunners in the Hereafter towards the Garden:

translation: And those foremost [(in Islâmic Faith of Monotheism and in performing righteous deeds) in the life of this world on the very first call for to embrace Islâm] will be foremost (in Paradise).

metadata.arabic: أُوْلَـٰئِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Those are they who will be brought nigh) to Allah

translation: These will be the nearest (to Allâh).

metadata.arabic: فِي جَنَّاتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: (In Gardens of Delight) whose delight is eternal;

translation: In the Gardens of Delight (Paradise).

metadata.arabic: ثُلَّةٌ مِّنَ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (A multitude of those of old) a group of people from the earlier nations before the community of Muhammad (pbuh)

translation: A multitude of those (foremost) will be from the first generations (who embraced Islâm).

metadata.arabic: وَقَلِيلٌ مِّنَ ٱلآخِرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And a few of those of later time) and a group from the later nations, which is the community of Muhammad (pbuh). It is also said that both groups are from the community of Muhammad (pbuh). When Allah's saying (A multitude of those of old), the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions were aggrieved because of it, until Allah revealed (And a few of those of later time).

translation: And a few of those (foremost) will be from the later generations.

metadata.arabic: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّوْضُونَةٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (On lined couches) sitting on couches linked to each other by branches of gold and silver, weaved with pearls and sapphires,

translation: (They will be) on thrones woven with gold and precious stones.

metadata.arabic: مُّتَّكِئِينَ عَلَيْهَا مُتَقَابِلِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Reclining) in comfort (therein) on couches (face to face) upon visitation.

translation: Reclining thereon, face to face.

metadata.arabic: يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَانٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (There wait on them) for service (immortal youths) servants; it is also said that these are the children of the disbelievers who are made servants for the people of Paradise. Another way of reading this verse is (There wait on them youths, and they are immortal): i.e. they will never die nor leave the Garden.

translation: Immortal boys will go around them (serving),

metadata.arabic: بِأَكْوَابٍ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأْسٍ مِّن مَّعِينٍ
metadata.Tafsir: The youth will go round (With bowls and ewers and a cup from a pure spring) of pure running wine

translation: With cups, and jugs, and a glass of flowing wine,

metadata.arabic: لاَّ يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنْهَا وَلاَ يُنزِفُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Wherefrom they get no aching of the head) from drinking (nor any madness) nor get intoxicated; it is also said that this means, according to another reading: their drinking is continuous,

translation: Wherefrom they will get neither any aching of the head, nor any intoxication.

metadata.arabic: وَفَاكِهَةٍ مِّمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And fruit) different kinds of fruit (that they prefer) that they desire.

translation: And with fruit that they may choose.

metadata.arabic: وَلَحْمِ طَيْرٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And flesh of fowls that they desire) and different types of birds' meat that they desire.

translation: And with the flesh of fowls that they desire.

metadata.arabic: وَحُورٌ عِينٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (And (there are) fair ones with wide, lovely eyes,

translation: And (there will be) Hûr (fair females) with wide, lovely eyes (as wives for "Al-Muttaqûn" - the pious - See V. 2:2),

metadata.arabic: كَأَمْثَالِ ٱللُّؤْلُؤِ ٱلْمَكْنُونِ
metadata.Tafsir: Like unto hidden pearls) hidden from heat and cold,

translation: Like unto preserved pearls.

metadata.arabic: جَزَآءً بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Reward) this is a reward for the inhabitants of the Garden (for what they used do) and say of good things in the life of the world.

translation: A reward for what they used to do.

metadata.arabic: لاَ يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْواً وَلاَ تَأْثِيماً
metadata.Tafsir: (There) in the Garden (hear they no vain speaking) no falsehood or lying oaths (nor recrimination) nor abuse; it is also said: there is no sin on them for it.

translation: No Laghw (dirty, false, evil vain talk) will they hear therein, nor any sinful speech (like backbiting).

metadata.arabic: إِلاَّ قِيلاً سَلاَماً سَلاَماً
metadata.Tafsir: ((Naught) but the saying: Peace, (and again) Peace) they greet each other with the greeting peace and the angels also greet them with salutations and greeting of peace from their Lord.

translation: But only the saying of: Salâm! Salâm! (greetings with peace)!

metadata.arabic: وَأَصْحَابُ ٱلْيَمِينِ مَآ أَصْحَابُ ٱلْيَمِينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And those on the right hand) the inhabitants of Paradise; (what of those on the right hand) and what do you know, O Muhammad, about the bliss and happiness of the people of Paradise?

translation: And those on the Right Hand - how (fortunate) will be those on the Right Hand?

metadata.arabic: فِي سِدْرٍ مَّخْضُودٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Among thornless lote tree) under the shade of thornless lote trees.

translation: (They will be) among thornless lote-trees,

metadata.arabic: وَطَلْحٍ مَّنضُودٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And clustered plantains) and clustered banana trees; and it is also said that this means: continuous and uninterrupted,

translation: And among Talh (banana-trees) with fruits piled one above another,

metadata.arabic: وَظِلٍّ مَّمْدُودٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And spreading shade) continuously over them, such that there is no sun,

translation: And in shade long-extended,

metadata.arabic: وَمَآءٍ مَّسْكُوبٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And water gushing) from the leg of the Throne,

translation: And by water flowing constantly,

metadata.arabic: وَفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And fruit in plenary) plenty of different kinds of fruit.

translation: And fruit in plenty,

metadata.arabic: لاَّ مَقْطُوعَةٍ وَلاَ مَمْنُوعَةٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Neither out of reach) such that they are available sometimes and unavailable at other times (nor yet forbidden) from when they look at it,

translation: Whose supply is not cut off (by change of season), nor are they out of reach,

metadata.arabic: وَفُرُشٍ مَّرْفُوعَةٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And raised couches) in the air, for its folks,

translation: And on couches or thrones, raised high.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنشَأْنَاهُنَّ إِنشَآءً
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! We have created them a (new) creation) We created the females of the life of the world; We created them again after they went through impotence, lack of vision, sickness and death.

translation: Verily, We have created them (maidens) of special creation.

metadata.arabic: فَجَعَلْنَاهُنَّ أَبْكَاراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And made them virgins

translation: And made them virgins.

metadata.arabic: عُرُباً أَتْرَاباً
metadata.Tafsir: Lovers) to their husbands and flirtatious with them, (friends) all with the same age, i.e. 33 years of age,

translation: Loving (their husbands only), (and) of equal age.

metadata.arabic: لأَصْحَابِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (For those on the right hand) for the inhabitants of Paradise and all of them are the inhabitants of Paradise;

translation: For those on the Right Hand.

metadata.arabic: ثُلَّةٌ مِّنَ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (A multitude of those of old) a group of people from among the nations which came before Muhammad (pbuh)

translation: A multitude of those (on the Right Hand) will be from the first generation (who embraced Islâm).

metadata.arabic: وَثُلَّةٌ مِّنَ ٱلآخِرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And a multitude of those of later time) a group of people from the later nations, which is the community of Muhammad (pbuh); and it is also said that both groups of people belong to the community of Muhammad (pbuh).

translation: And a multitude of those (on the Right Hand) will be from the later generations.

metadata.arabic: وَأَصْحَابُ ٱلشِّمَالِ مَآ أَصْحَابُ ٱلشِّمَالِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And those on the left hand) the inhabitants of the Fire: (What of those on the left hand) what do you know, O Muhammad, about the degradation and punishment of the people of the Fire?

translation: And those on the Left Hand - how (unfortunate) will be those on the Left Hand?

metadata.arabic: فِي سَمُومٍ وَحَمِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (In scorching wind) in the flames of the Fire; it is also said: in the scorching wind of the Fire; and it is also said that this means: in the ice-biting wind of the Fire (and scalding water) and boiling water.

translation: In fierce hot wind and boiling water,

metadata.arabic: وَظِلٍّ مِّن يَحْمُومٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And shadow of black smoke) over them in Gehenna,

translation: And shadow of black smoke,

metadata.arabic: لاَّ بَارِدٍ وَلاَ كَرِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Neither cool) to reinvigorate them (nor refreshing) nor any good for them; it is also said that this means: their drink is not refreshing nor is their punishment good.

translation: (That shadow) neither cool, nor (even) pleasant,

metadata.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! Heretofore) in the life of the world (they were effete with luxury) they were prodigal; it is also said that this means: they were immersed in comfort; and it is also said that this means: they were bewildered.

translation: Verily, before that, they indulged in luxury,

metadata.arabic: وَكَانُواْ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى ٱلْحِنثِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And used to persist) in the life of the world (in the awful sin) i.e. associating partners with Allah; and it is also said that this refers to the lying oath.

translation: And were persisting in great sin (joining partners in worship along with Allâh, committing murder and other crimes)

metadata.arabic: وَكَانُواْ يِقُولُونَ أَإِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَاباً وَعِظَاماً أَإِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And they used to say) in the life of the world: (When we are dead and have come) scattered (dust and) rotten (bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again) shall we then be given life again,

translation: And they used to say: "When we die and become dust and bones, shall we then indeed be resurrected?

metadata.arabic: أَوَ آبَآؤُنَا ٱلأَوَّلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: When the prophets answered in the affirmative, they asked the prophets: (And also our forefathers) who died before us?

translation: "And also our forefathers?"

metadata.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ وَٱلآخِرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Say) O Muhammad, to the people of Mecca: (Lo! those of old and those of later time

translation: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "(Yes) verily, those of old, and those of later times.

metadata.arabic: لَمَجْمُوعُونَ إِلَىٰ مِيقَاتِ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
metadata.Tafsir: Will all be brought together to the tryst of an appointed day) a well-known day, which is the Day of Judgement, whereby the people of old and the people of later times will be brought all together.

translation: "All will surely be gathered together for appointed Meeting of a known Day.

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلضِّآلُّونَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then lo! ye, the erring) from faith and guidance, (the deniers) of Allah, His Messenger and Scripture. This refers to Abu Jahl and his host,

translation: "Then moreover, verily you the erring-ones, the deniers (of Resurrection)!

metadata.arabic: لأَكِلُونَ مِن شَجَرٍ مِّن زَقُّومٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Ye verily will eat of a tree called Zaqqum

translation: "You verily will eat of the trees of Zaqqûm.

metadata.arabic: فَمَالِئُونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: And will fill your bellies therewith) from the trees of Zaqqum which grow inside the Fire;

translation: "Then you will fill your bellies therewith,

metadata.arabic: فَشَارِبُونَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And thereon) and upon eating from the Zaqqum (ye will drink of boiling water,

translation: "And drink boiling water on top of it.

metadata.arabic: فَشَارِبُونَ شُرْبَ ٱلْهِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: Drinking even as the camel drinketh) drinking even as a thirsty and sick camel do: it hardly gets filled; it is also said that this means: even as a thirsty camel drinks upon eating sour food.

translation: "And you will drink (that) like thirsty camels!"

metadata.arabic: هَـٰذَا نُزُلُهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (This will be their welcome) this will be their food and drink (on the Day of Judgement) on the Day of Reckoning.

translation: That will be their entertainment on the Day of Recompense!

metadata.arabic: نَحْنُ خَلَقْنَاكُمْ فَلَوْلاَ تُصَدِّقُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (We created you) O people of Mecca. (Will ye then admit the Truth) will you then believe in the Messenger?

translation: We created you: then why do you believe not?

metadata.arabic: أَفَرَأَيْتُمْ مَّا تُمْنُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Have ye seen that which ye emit) in the wombs of women?

translation: Then tell Me (about) the (human) semen that you emit.

metadata.arabic: ءَأَنتُمْ تَخْلُقُونَهُ أَم نَحْنُ ٱلْخَالِقُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Do ye) O people of Mecca (create it) as a human life, male or female, felicitous or damned (or are We the Creator)? No indeed, you are not the Creator, We are.

translation: Is it you who create it (i.e. make this semen into a perfect human being), or are We the Creator?

metadata.arabic: نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (We mete out death among you) We made you equal as far as death is concerned, such that all of you will die; it is also said that this means: We apportioned between you your lifespan until you die. Some of you will live to 100 years, others to 80, some to 50, some to more and others to less, (and We are not to be outrun) and We are capable of doing so,

translation: We have decreed death to you all, and We are not outstripped,

metadata.arabic: عَلَىٰ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمْثَـٰلَكُمْ وَنُنشِئَكُمْ فِي مَا لاَ تَعْلَمُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (That We may transfigure you) that We may destroy you and bring instead other people who are better and more obedient than you (and make you) and create you on the Day of Judgement in (what ye know not) in a form that you know not: with dark faces and bluish eyes; it is also said that this means: in the form of apes and swine; and it is also said that this means: We shall place your spirits in the Fire which you do not believe in.

translation: To transfigure you and create you in (forms) that you know not.

metadata.arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلأُولَىٰ فَلَوْلاَ تَذَكَّرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And verily ye know) O people of Mecca (the first creation) in the wombs of mothers; and it is also said: the creation of Adam. (Why, then, do ye not reflect) upon the first creation and thus believe in the second creation?

translation: And indeed, you have already known the first form of creation (i.e. the creation of Adam): why then do you not remember (or take heed)?

metadata.arabic: أَفَرَأَيْتُم مَّا تَحْرُثُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Have ye seen that which ye cultivate) of grains?

translation: Then tell Me about the seed that you sow in the ground.

metadata.arabic: ءَأَنتُمْ تَزْرَعُونَهُ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلزَّارِعُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Is it ye) O people of Mecca (who foster it) who makes it grow, (or are We the Fosterer) or are We the One to make it grow?

translation: Is it you that make it grow, or are We the Grower?

metadata.arabic: لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَاهُ حُطَاماً فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (If We willed, We verily could make it) the cultivation (chaff) and dry after being green, (then would ye cease not to exclaim) then you would wonder at its dryness and destruction, and exclaim:

translation: Were it Our Will, We could crumble it to dry pieces, and you would be regretful (or left in wonderment) [Tafsir Ibn Kathîr].

metadata.arabic: إِنَّا لَمُغْرَمُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! we are laden with debt) we are being punished by the destruction of our cultivations!

translation: (Saying): "We are indeed Mughramûn (i.e. ruined or have lost the money without any profit, or are punished by the loss of all that we spend for cultivation)! (Tafsir Al-Qurtubî)

metadata.arabic: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Nay, but we are deprived) we are deprived of our cultivations! It is also said that this means: we are being fought against!

translation: "Nay, but we are deprived!"

metadata.arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱلْمَآءَ ٱلَّذِي تَشْرَبُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Have ye) O people of Mecca (observed the) pure (water which ye drink) irrigate your fields with and give to your cattle to drink?

translation: Then tell Me about the water that you drink.

metadata.arabic: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنزَلْتُمُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُزْنِ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنزِلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Is it ye) O people of Mecca (who shed it from the rain cloud, or are We the Shedder?) Indeed, it is We Who send it down to you.

translation: Is it you who cause it from the rain-clouds to come down, or are We the Causer of it to come down?

metadata.arabic: لَوْ نَشَآءُ جَعَلْنَاهُ أُجَاجاً فَلَوْلاَ تَشْكُرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (If We willed We verily could make it) i.e. pure water (bitter. Why, then, give ye not thanks) for its purity and therefore believe?

translation: If We willed, We verily could make it salt (and undrinkable): why then do you not give thanks (to Allâh)?

metadata.arabic: أَفَرَأَيْتُمُ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِي تُورُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Have ye observed the Fire which ye strike out) from every dry twig except for the twigs of the Jujube tree;

translation: Then tell Me about the fire which you kindle.

metadata.arabic: أَأَنتُمْ أَنشَأْتُمْ شَجَرَتَهَآ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنشِئُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Was it ye) O people of Mecca (who made the tree thereof to grow) is it you who created the trees from which fire can be struck out, (or were We the Grower) or are We the Creator?

translation: Is it you who made the tree thereof to grow, or are We the Grower?

metadata.arabic: نَحْنُ جَعَلْنَاهَا تَذْكِرَةً وَمَتَاعاً لِّلْمُقْوِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (We, even We, appointed it) i.e. the Fire (a memorial) a reminder of the Fire of the Hereafter (and a comfort) a benefit (for the dwellers in the wilderness) for the travellers in the wilderness.

translation: We have made it a Reminder (of the Hell-fire in the Hereafter), and an article of use for the travellers (and all the others, in this world).

metadata.arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Therefore (O Muhammad), praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous) therefore pray in the name of your Lord, the Mighty; it is also said that this means: remember the divine Oneness of your Lord, the Mighty.

translation: Then glorify with praises the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.

metadata.arabic: فَلاَ أُقْسِمُ بِمَوَاقِعِ ٱلنُّجُومِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Nay, I swear by the places of the stars) I swear by the revelation of the Qur'an in instalments (nujuman) unto Muhammad (pbuh).

translation: So I swear by the setting of the stars.

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّهُ لَقَسَمٌ لَّوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عَظِيمٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo! That) i.e. the Qur'an (verily is a tremendous oath, if ye but knew) if you but believe.

translation: And verily that is indeed a great oath, if you but know.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّهُ لَقُرْآنٌ كَرِيمٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (That (this) is indeed a noble Qur'an) a noble and bounteous Qur'an

translation: That (this) is indeed an honourable recitation (the Noble Qur’ân).

metadata.arabic: فِي كِتَابٍ مَّكْنُونٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (In a Book kept hidden) it is written down in the Guarded Tablet; and this is why the oath was made

translation: In a Book well-guarded (with Allâh in the heaven i.e. Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz ).

metadata.arabic: لاَّ يَمَسُّهُ إِلاَّ ٱلْمُطَهَّرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Which none toucheth) i.e. the Guarded Tablet (save the purified) from ritual impurities and sins, i.e. the angels; it is also said that this means: none acts upon the Qur'an except those who are given success,

translation: Which (that Book with Allâh) none can touch but the purified (i.e. the angels).

metadata.arabic: تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (A revelation) a speech (from the Lord of the Worlds) unto Muhammad (pbuh).

translation: A Revelation (this Qur’ân) from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

metadata.arabic: أَفَبِهَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ أَنتُمْ مُّدْهِنُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Is it this Statement) is it this Qur'an which Muhammad (pbuh) recites to you, O people of Mecca, (that ye scorn) that you deny, and claim that there is no Paradise or hell, resurrection or reckoning, as the Prophet says,

translation: Is it such a talk (this Qur’ân) that you (disbelievers) deny?

metadata.arabic: وَتَجْعَلُونَ رِزْقَكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ تُكَذِّبُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And make denial thereof your livelihood) and say about the rain that you are given: we were given rain because of such-and-such a storm?

translation: And instead (of thanking Allâh) for the provision He gives you, you deny (Him by disbelief)!

metadata.arabic: فَلَوْلاَ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلْحُلْقُومَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Why, then, when (the soul) cometh up to the throat (of the dying)

translation: Then why do you not (intervene) when (the soul of a dying person) reaches the throat?

metadata.arabic: وَأَنتُمْ حِينَئِذٍ تَنظُرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: And ye) O people of Mecca (are at that moment looking) when his soul will come out

translation: And you at the moment are looking on,

metadata.arabic: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن لاَّ تُبْصِرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And We are nearer unto him) the angel of death and his aids are closer to the dying person (than ye are) than his own family, (but ye see not) the angel of death and his aids.

translation: But We (i.e. Our angels who take the soul) are nearer to him than you, but you see not, (Tafsir At-Tabarî)

metadata.arabic: فَلَوْلاَ إِن كُنتُمْ غَيْرَ مَدِينِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Why then, if ye are not in bondage (unto Us)) if you are not legally bound, rewarded or taken to task,

translation: Then why do you not - if you are exempt from the reckoning and recompense (punishment) -

metadata.arabic: تَرْجِعُونَهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Do ye not force it back) force the soul back to the body, (if ye are truthful) that you are not legally bound?

translation: Bring back the soul (to its body), if you are truthful?

metadata.arabic: فَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Thus if he is of those brought nigh) to the Garden of Eden,

translation: Then, if he (the dying person) be of the Muqarrabûn (those brought near to Allâh),

metadata.arabic: فَرَوْحٌ وَرَيْحَانٌ وَجَنَّتُ نَعِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then breath of life) then rest for them in the grave; and it is also said that this means: then there is mercy for them, (and plenty) when they come out of the grave; and it is also said this means: and provision, (and a Garden of Delight) on the Day of Judgement whose delight is perpetual.

translation: (There is for him) rest and provision, and a Garden of Delights (Paradise).

metadata.arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And if he is of those on the right hand) of the inhabitants of Paradise, and all of them are,

translation: And if he (the dying person) be of those on the Right Hand,

metadata.arabic: فَسَلاَمٌ لَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
