metadata.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لاَ تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (On that day) which is the Day of Judgement (ye will be exposed) you will stand before your Lord three times: once for reckoning and presenting excuses, once for settling disputes and retaliation and once for the handing over of the scroll of one's deeds and reading them; (not a secret of you will be hidden) none of you will be left out; it is also said this means: no one's secret will be hidden from Allah; it is also said that this means: none of your works will be hidden from Allah.

translation: That Day shall you be brought to Judgement, not a secret of you will be hidden.

metadata.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَـٰبَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُواْ كِتَـٰبيَهْ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then, as for him who is given his record in his right hand) this refers to Abu Salamah Ibn 'Abd al-Asad, the husband of Umm Salamah who was a Muslim, (he will say) to his companions: (Take, read my book!) come and see what is in my book of reward and bestowal of honour.

translation: Then as for him who will be given his Record in his right hand will say: "Here! read my Record!

metadata.arabic: إِنِّي ظَنَنتُ أَنِّي مُلاَقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ
metadata.Tafsir: (Surely I knew) and was certain (that I should have to meet my reckoning.

translation: "Surely, I did believe that I shall meet my Account!"

metadata.arabic: فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ
metadata.Tafsir: Then he will be in blissful state) he will be in a life with which he is pleased, i.e. a pleasing life.

translation: So he shall be in a life, well-pleasing.

metadata.arabic: فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (In a high Garden

translation: In a lofty Paradise,

metadata.arabic: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ
metadata.Tafsir: Whereof the clusters) its fruits (are in easy reach) are very close, such that anyone sitting or standing can reach to them.

translation: The fruits in bunches whereof will be low and near at hand.

metadata.arabic: كُلُواْ وَٱشْرَبُواْ هَنِيئَاً بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِي ٱلأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
metadata.Tafsir: Allah will say to them: (Eat) of the fruits (and drink) from the rivers (at ease) fearing no sickness or death (for that which ye sent on before you) for that which you did of righteous works; and it is also said this means: for the fasting and prayers you offered, (in past days) i.e. in the days of the life of the world.

translation: Eat and drink at ease for that which you have sent on before you in days past!

metadata.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُ بِشِمَالِهِ فَيَقُولُ يٰلَيْتَنِي لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهْ
metadata.Tafsir: (But as for him who is given his record in his left hand) this refers to al-Aswad Ibn 'Abd al-Asad, the brother of Abu Salamah who was a disbeliever, (he will say: Oh, would that I had not been given my book) this book of mine

translation: But as for him who will be given his Record in his left hand, will say: "I wish that I had not been given my Record!

metadata.arabic: وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ
metadata.Tafsir: (And knew not what my reckoning!

translation: "And that I had never known how my Account is!

metadata.arabic: يٰلَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلْقَاضِيَةَ
metadata.Tafsir: Oh, would that it had been death!) he will wish for death; he says: I wish I remained dead after my first death.

translation: "Would that it had been my end (death)!

metadata.arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّي مَالِيَهْ
metadata.Tafsir: (My wealth) which I had amassed in the life of the world (hath not availed me) from Allah's chastisement,

translation: "My wealth has not availed me;

metadata.arabic: هَّلَكَ عَنِّي سُلْطَانِيَهْ
metadata.Tafsir: (My power hath gone from me) I am without arguments or excuses.

translation: "My power (and arguments to defend myself) have gone from me!"

metadata.arabic: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ
metadata.Tafsir: Allah will then say to the angels: (Take him and fetter him

translation: (It will be said): "Seize him and fetter him;

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ
metadata.Tafsir: And then expose him to hellfire) cast him in hellfire.

translation: Then throw him in the blazing Fire.

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ فِي سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعاً فَاسْلُكُوهُ
metadata.Tafsir: (And then insert him in a chain) insert the chain in his anus and extract it from his mouth, and what remains of it turn it round his neck (whereof the length) and width (is seventy cubits) cubits of the angel; it is also said this means: 70 fathoms.

translation: "Then fasten him with a chain whereof the length is seventy cubits!"

metadata.arabic: إِنَّهُ كَانَ لاَ يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! he used not to believe in Allah the Tremendous) when he was in the life of the world,

translation: Verily, he used not to believe in Allâh, the Most Great,

metadata.arabic: وَلاَ يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And urged not on the feeding of the wretched) and did not urge on giving alms to the needy,

translation: And urged not on the feeding of Al-Miskîn (the poor).

metadata.arabic: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ ٱلْيَوْمَ هَا هُنَا حَمِيمٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Therefore hath he no lover here this day) this day he has no relative to benefit him,

translation: So no friend has he here this Day,

metadata.arabic: وَلاَ طَعَامٌ إِلاَّ مِنْ غِسْلِينٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Nor any food) in the Fire (save filth) that which spills from the bellies and skins of the people of the Fire of puss, blood and fluids

translation: Nor any food except filth from the washing of wounds.

metadata.arabic: لاَّ يَأْكُلُهُ إِلاَّ ٱلْخَاطِئُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Which none but sinners eat) which no one eats except the idolaters.

translation: None will eat it except the Khâti’ûn (sinners, disbelievers, polytheists).

metadata.arabic: فَلاَ أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (But nay! I swear by all that ye see

translation: So I swear by whatsoever you see,

metadata.arabic: وَمَا لاَ تُبْصِرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: And all that ye see not) O people of Mecca; it is also said that this means: I swear by what you see, i.e. the sky and the earth, and that which you do not see, i.e. the Garden and the Fire; and it also said that this means: I swear by what you see, the sun and the moon, and by that which you do not see, the Throne and the Stool; and it is also said that this means: I swear by what you see, i.e. Muhammad (pbuh) and that which you do not see, Gabriel. Allah swore by all these.

translation: And by whatsoever you see not,

metadata.arabic: إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (That it) i.e. the Qur'an (is indeed the speech of an illustrious messenger) He says: the Qur'an is the Word of Allah which Gabriel brought down to an illustrious messenger, i.e. Muhammad (pbuh).

translation: That this is verily, the word of an honoured Messenger [i.e. Jibrîl (Gabriel) or Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم which he has brought from Allâh].

metadata.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ قَلِيلاً مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (It) i.e. the Qur'an (is not poet's speech) that a poet composes (little is it that ye believe!) He says: you do not believe in little or much.

translation: It is not the word of a poet: little is that you believe!

metadata.arabic: وَلاَ بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ قَلِيلاً مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Nor diviner's speech) which informs about the future (little is it that ye remember!) you do not take admonition in little or much.

translation: Nor is it the word of a soothsayer (or a foreteller): little is that you remember!

metadata.arabic: تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (It is a revelation) He says: the Qur'an is a revelation to Muhammad (pbuh) (from the Lord of the Worlds.

translation: This is the Revelation sent down from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

metadata.arabic: وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلأَقَاوِيلِ
metadata.Tafsir: And if he had invented) and had Muhammad (pbuh) invented (false sayings concerning Us) lies against Us and attributed to Us that which We did not say,

translation: And if he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) had forged a false saying concerning Us (Allâh جل جلاله),

metadata.arabic: لأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِٱلْيَمِينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (We assuredly had taken him) We assuredly had taken revenge against him (by the right hand) by means of truth and proofs; it is also said this means: We assuredly had vehemently taken him.

translation: We surely would have seized him by his right hand (or with power and might),

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ ٱلْوَتِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And then severed his life artery) the life artery of Muhammad (pbuh)

translation: And then We certainly would have cut off his life artery (aorta),

metadata.arabic: فَمَا مِنكُمْ مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَاجِزِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And not one of you could have held Us off from him) He says: no one of you could have held Us back from Muhammad (pbuh).

translation: And none of you could have withheld Us from (punishing) him.

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّهُ لَتَذْكِرَةٌ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo! It) i.e. the Qur'an (is a warrant) a reminder (unto those who ward off (evil)) disbelief, idolatry and indecencies.

translation: And verily, this (Qur’an) is a Reminder for the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2).

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُمْ مُّكَذِّبِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo! We know that some among you will deny (it)) We know that some among you disbelieve in the Qur'an while others believe in it.

translation: And verily, We know that there are some among you that belie (this Qur’ân). (Tafsir At-Tabarî)

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّهُ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلْكَافِرِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo! It) i.e. the Qur'an (is indeed an anguish) a remorse (for the disbelievers) on the Day of Judgement.

translation: And indeed it (this Qur’ân) will be an anguish for the disbelievers (on the Day of Resurrection).

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّهُ لَحَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo! It) i.e. the Qur'an (is Absolute Truth) it is truly and certainly My speech which Gabriel took down to an illustrious messenger; it is also said that this means: and that which I have mentioned of the disbelievers' anguish and remorse is true and certain; such anguish and remorse on the Day of Judgement will surely take place.

translation: And verily, it (this Qur’ân) is an absolute truth with certainty.

metadata.arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: (So glorify the name of thy Tremendous Lord) so pray by the command of your Tremendous Lord; it is also said this means: mention the divine Oneness of your Tremendous Lord Who is more tremendous than all things'.

translation: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.

metadata.arabic: سَأَلَ سَآئِلٌ بِعَذَابٍ وَاقِعٍ
metadata.Tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (A questioner questioned): '(A questioner questioned) a caller, i.e. al-Nadr Ibn al-Harith, called (concerning the doom about to fall

translation: A questioner asked concerning a torment about to befall

metadata.arabic: لِّلْكَافِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُ دَافِعٌ
metadata.Tafsir: Upon the disbelievers) while he is himself a disbeliever, (which none can repel) and so he was killed in captivity on the Day of Badr,

translation: Upon the disbelievers, which none can avert,

metadata.arabic: مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذِي ٱلْمَعَارِجِ
metadata.Tafsir: (From Allah) this punishment of the disbelievers comes from Allah, (Lord of the Ascending Stairways) the Creator of the heavens

translation: From Allâh, the Lord of the ways of ascent.

metadata.arabic: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلاَئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِي يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ
metadata.Tafsir: ((Whereby) the angels and the Spirit) i.e. Gabriel (ascend unto Him) unto Allah (in a Day whereof the span) the span of ascending it for other than the angels (is fifty thousand years) it is also said that this means: it is from Allah that the punishment of the disbelievers comes in a day whose span is 50,000 years; and it is also said that this means: if anyone, other than Allah, were given the reckoning of people, such reckoning would not finish in 50,000 years.

translation: The angels and the Rûh [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] ascend to Him in a Day the measure whereof is fifty thousand years.

metadata.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ صَبْراً جَمِيلاً
metadata.Tafsir: (But be patient) O Muhammad, in the face of their harm (with a patience fair to see) i.e. without anguish or display of indecency; and it is also said this means: stay away from them and show no anguish or indecency. Later, he was commanded to fight them.

translation: So be patient (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), with a good patience.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُ بَعِيداً
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! They) i.e. the disbelievers of Mecca (behold it) i.e. the doom on the Day of Judgement (afar off) it will not happen

translation: Verily, they see it (the torment) afar off.

metadata.arabic: وَنَرَاهُ قَرِيباً
metadata.Tafsir: (While We behold it nigh) it will happen, for whatever will happen in the future is near:

translation: But We see it (quite) near.

metadata.arabic: يَوْمَ تَكُونُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ كَٱلْمُهْلِ
metadata.Tafsir: Allah then explained when they will be chastised, saying: (The day when the sky will become as molten copper) and it is said: like the sediments of olive oil,

translation: The Day that the sky will be like the boiling filth of oil, (or molten copper or silver or lead).

metadata.arabic: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And the hills become as flakes of wool,

translation: And the mountains will be like flakes of wool.

metadata.arabic: وَلاَ يَسْأَلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيماً
metadata.Tafsir: And no familiar friend will ask a question of his friend) no relative will ask about his relative

translation: And no friend will ask a friend (about his condition),

metadata.arabic: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِي مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍ بِبَنِيهِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Though they will be given sight of them) but will not recognise them as a result of their preoccupation with their own selves. (The guilty man) the idolater, i.e. Abu Jahl and his host; and it is said: al-Nadr Ibn al-Harith and his host (will long be able to ransom himself from the punishment of that day) the Day of Judgement (at the price of his children

translation: Though they shall be made to see one another [(i.e. on the Day of Resurrection), there will be none but see his father, children and relatives, but he will neither speak to them nor will ask them for any help]. The Mujrim, (criminal, sinner, disbeliever) would desire to ransom himself from the punishment of that Day by his children,

metadata.arabic: وَصَاحِبَتِهِ وَأَخِيهِ
metadata.Tafsir: And his spouse and his brother) his full brother

translation: And his wife and his brother,

metadata.arabic: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ ٱلَّتِي تُؤْوِيهِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And his kin) and his clan and relatives (that harboured him) to whom he belongs

translation: And his kindred who sheltered him,

metadata.arabic: وَمَن فِي ٱلأَرْضِ جَمِيعاً ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And all that are in the earth) and at the price of all that which is in the earth, (if then it might deliver him) if Allah might deliver him from the punishment.

translation: And all that are in the earth, so that it might save him.

metadata.arabic: كَلاَّ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (But nay!) truly this will not deliver him from the punishment-this is an answer to him-(for lo! it is the fire of hell

translation: By no means! Verily, it will be the Fire of Hell,

metadata.arabic: نَزَّاعَةً لِّلشَّوَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: Eager to roast) the entire body; it is also said that this means: it will pluck out the hands and feet as well as all the other members of the body;

translation: Taking away (burning completely) the head skin!

metadata.arabic: تَدْعُواْ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (It calleth) to itself: “come to me, O disbeliever!”, “come to me, O hypocrite” (him who turned) from Allah's divine Oneness (and fled) from faith and did not repent of disbelief,

translation: Calling (all) such as turn their backs and turn away their faces (from Faith) [picking and swallowing them up from that great gathering of mankind on the Day of Resurrection just as a bird picks up a food-grain from the earth with its beak and swallows it up] (Tafsir Al-Qurtubî)

metadata.arabic: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (And hoarded (wealth)) in the life of the world (and withheld it) he put it in a container and refused to give the right of Allah which is due from it.

translation: And collect (wealth) and hide it (from spending it in the Cause of Allâh).

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلإِنسَانَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعاً
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! Man) i.e. the disbelieving person (was created anxious) miserly, too attached and tight-fisted,

translation: Verily, man (disbeliever) was created very impatient;

metadata.arabic: إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعاً
metadata.Tafsir: (Fretful) he is not patient (when evil befalleth him) when poverty and hardship befall him

translation: Irritable (discontented) when evil touches him;

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلْخَيْرُ مَنُوعاً
metadata.Tafsir: (And, when good) wealth and abundance (befalleth him, grudging) he does not give thanks and withholds the right of Allah which is due from it;

translation: And niggardly when good touches him.

metadata.arabic: إِلاَّ ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Save worshippers) those who pray the five daily prayers for they are not like this.

translation: Except those who are devoted to Salât (prayers).

metadata.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلاَتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: Allah then explained the traits of the latter, saying: (Who are constant at their worship) they constantly perform their prescribed daily prayers, whether it is at night or in the day, and they never fail to perform them.

translation: Those who remain constant in their Salât (prayers);

metadata.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ فِيۤ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَّعْلُومٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (And in whose wealth there is a right acknowledged) they acknowledge that there is in their wealth a right other than the prescribed poor-due,

translation: And those in whose wealth there is a recognised right

metadata.arabic: لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
metadata.Tafsir: (For the beggar) who ask you to give him from your wealth (and the destitute) who is denied his wage or booty; it is also said that this refers to the artisan whose skill does not earn him enough for him to subsist; it is also said that this refers to the poor who does not beg from others and as a result no one gives or knows about him;

translation: For the beggar who asks, and for the unlucky who has lost his property and wealth, (and his means of living has been straitened).

metadata.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And those who believe in the Day of Judgement) and those who believe in the Day of Reckoning and all that which is in it,

translation: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense.

metadata.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And those who are fearful of their Lord's doom

translation: And those who fear the torment of their Lord.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍ
metadata.Tafsir: Lo! the doom of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure) no guarantee of security has come to them from their Lord.

translation: Verily, the torment of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure. -

metadata.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَافِظُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And those who preserve their chastity) they are chaste as far as what is unlawful is concerned

translation: And those who guard their chastity (i.e. private parts from illegal sexual acts).

metadata.arabic: إِلاَّ عَلَىٰ أَزْوَاجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Save with their) four (wives and those whom their right hands possess) of slaves without limitation, (for thus they are not blameworthy) nor sinful; they are not reproached for indulging in that which is lawful;

translation: Except from their wives or the (women slaves) whom their right hands possess - for (then) they are not blameworthy.

metadata.arabic: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَلِكَ فَأُوْلَـٰئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (But whoso seeketh more than that) whoever seeks more than what I have mentioned of wives and slaves, (those are they who are transgressors) from that which is lawful to that which is unlawful;

translation: But whosoever seeks beyond that, then it is those who are trespassers.

metadata.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لأَمَانَاتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَاعُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And those who keep) and those who honour, and keep to the time agreed upon regarding (their pledges) that with which they have been entrusted whether it relates to religion or other things (and their covenant) with their Lord or with other people; and it is also said this means: and their oaths.

translation: And those who keep their trusts and covenants.

metadata.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِشَهَادَاتِهِم قَائِمُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And those who stand by their testimony) before the judges when they are called to give witness, and do not refuse to testify,

translation: And those who stand firm in their testimonies.

metadata.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلاَتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And those who are attentive at their worship) they observe the prescribed times of their five daily prayers,

translation: And those who guard their Salât (prayers) well.

metadata.arabic: أُوْلَـٰئِكَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ مُّكْرَمُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (These) those who have such traits (will dwell in Gardens, honoured) with reward, presents and gifts.

translation: Such shall dwell in the Gardens (i.e. Paradise), honoured.

metadata.arabic: فَمَالِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (What aileth those who disbelieve) the disbelievers of Mecca who mock the believers as well as the other disbelievers, (that they keep staring towards thee (O Muhammad)) around you, (open eyed) looking at you without coming close to you,

translation: So what is the matter with those who disbelieve that they hasten to listen from you [O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), in order to belie you and to mock at you, and at Allâh’s Book (this Qur’ân)].

metadata.arabic: عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: Dispersed (On the right and on the left, in groups?

translation: (Sitting) in groups on the right and on the left (of you, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)?

metadata.arabic: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِىءٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: Doth every man among them hope to enter the Garden of Delight?) This is an answer from Allah to the disbelievers that He will not let them enter the Garden.

translation: Does every man of them hope to enter the Paradise of Delight?

metadata.arabic: كَلاَّ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Nay, verily. Lo! We created them) i.e. the disbelievers of Mecca (from what they know) i.e. a sperm drop.

translation: No, that is not like that! Verily, We have created them out of that which they know!

metadata.arabic: فَلآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (But nay! I swear by the Lord of the rising places) the rising places of winter and summer (and the setting places of the planets) the setting places of winter and summer. There are two rising places and two setting places. The rising place of winter and summer has 177 phases and so do the setting places of winter and summer. The sun rises, in a year, two days in the same phase, and it also sets, in a year, two days in the same phase (that We are Able) this is the reason of the above oath

translation: So I swear by the Lord of all the [three hundred and sixty-five (365)] points of sunrise and sunset in the east and the west that surely We are Able

metadata.arabic: عَلَىٰ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْراً مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (To replace them by (others) better than them) He says: We are Able to destroy them and replace them with others who are better and more obedient than them. (And We are not to be outrun) We are unable to replace them with others who are better than them.

translation: To replace them by (others) better than them; and We are not to be outrun.

metadata.arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلْعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (So let them) O Muhammad, i.e. let those who mock you and the other disbelievers (chat) about falsehood (and play) and mock you while continuing to be disbelievers (until they meet) until they behold (their Day which they are promised) in which they are promised chastisement,

translation: So leave them to plunge in vain talk and play about, until they meet their Day which they are promised -

metadata.arabic: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعاً كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: Allah then explained when this chastisement will take place, saying: (The day when they come forth from the graves in haste) in response to the sound (as racing to a goal) or a banner,

translation: The Day when they will come out of the graves quickly as racing to a goal,

metadata.arabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ذَلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (With eyes) that see no goodness (aghast) humiliated, (abasement stupefying them) grief and darkness appear on their faces: (Such is the Day which they are promised) such is the Day in which they were promised chastisement; and this day is the Day of Judgement. And this promise is like the promise and warning of Noah'.

translation: With their eyes lowered in fear and humility, ignominy covering them (all over)! That is the Day which they were promised!

metadata.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحاً إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
metadata.Tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (Lo! We sent): '(Lo! We sent Noah unto his people (saying): Warn your people) from Allah's wrath and punishment (ere the painful doom come unto them) in the form of drowning.

translation: Verily, We sent Nûh (Noah) to his people (saying): "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful torment."

metadata.arabic: قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ إِنِّي لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (He said: O my people! Lo! I am a plain warner unto you) I am a warning messenger unto you, addressing you in a language you understand.

translation: He said: "O my people! Verily, I am a plain warner to you,

metadata.arabic: أَنِ ٱعبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
metadata.Tafsir: ((Bidding you): Serve Allah) declare Allah's divine Oneness (and keep your duty unto Him) fear Him and repent of disbelief and idolatry (and obey me) and follow my matter, religion and counsel and accept my advice to you,

translation: "That you should worship Allâh (Alone), fear (be dutiful to) Him, and obey me,

metadata.arabic: يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لاَ يُؤَخَّرُ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (That He may forgive you somewhat of your sins) He will forgive your sins through your repentance and belief in Allah's divine Oneness (and respite you) without sending a punishment on you (to an appointed term) until you die. (Lo! the term of Allah) the torment of Allah, (when it cometh, cannot be delayed, if ye but knew) if you believe in what I say to you.

translation: "He (Allâh) will forgive you of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Verily, the term of Allâh when it comes, cannot be delayed, if you but knew."

metadata.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِي لَيْلاً وَنَهَاراً
metadata.Tafsir: When he despaired of them, after calling them to faith for 950 years, and they refused to believe or heed his advice, (He said: My Lord! Lo! I have called unto my people) to repent and believe in Allah's divine Oneness (night and day) at night and during the day.

translation: He said: "O my Lord! Verily, I have called to my people night and day (i.e. secretly and openly to accept the doctrine of Islâmic Monotheism),

metadata.arabic: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآئِيۤ إِلاَّ فِرَاراً
metadata.Tafsir: (But all my calling) to them to repent and believe in Allah's divine Oneness (doth but add to their repugnance) does but increase their remoteness from faith and repentance;

translation: "But all my calling added nothing but to (their) flight (from the truth).

metadata.arabic: وَإِنِّي كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوۤاْ أَصَابِعَهُمْ فِيۤ آذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْاْ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّواْ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُواْ ٱسْتِكْبَاراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo! Whenever I call unto them) to repentance and belief in Allah's divine Oneness (that Thou mayst pardon them) through their repentance and faith in Allah's divine Oneness (they thrust their fingers in their ears) so as not to hear my words and invitation (and cover themselves with their garments) and cover their heads with their garments so that they do not hear my voice or see me (and persist (in their refusal)) and they remain firm in their disbelief and worship of idols; it is also said that they all shouted in unison: “O Noah! We will not believe in you”, (and magnify themselves in pride) and feel too proud to accept faith or repent, because of their arrogance.

translation: And verily, every time I called unto them that You might forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears, covered themselves up with their garments, and persisted (in their refusal), and magnified themselves in pride.

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّي دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَاراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo! I have called unto them) to repent and believe in Allah's divine Oneness (aloud) openly, thus avoiding secrecy,

translation: "Then verily, I called to them openly (aloud).

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّيۤ أَعْلَنْتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَاراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo! I have made public proclamation unto them) I called them openly to the message and explained to them, (and I have appealed to them in private) and I called them secretly to the message.

translation: "Then verily, I proclaimed to them in public, and I have appealed to them in private.

metadata.arabic: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ غَفَّاراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And I have said) to them: (Seek pardon of your Lord) declare the divine Oneness of your Lord and repent of disbelief and idolatry. (Lo! He was ever Forgiving) of those who repent of disbelief and believe in Him.

translation: "I said (to them): ‘Ask forgiveness from your Lord, verily, He is Oft-Forgiving;

metadata.arabic: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِّدْرَاراً
metadata.Tafsir: (He will let loose the sky for you in plenteous rain) whenever you need rain. This is because Allah had withheld rain from them for 40 years,

translation: ‘He will send rain to you in abundance,

metadata.arabic: وَيُمْدِدْكُمْ بِأَمْوَالٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَاراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And will help you with wealth) camels, bovines, sheep (and sons) and daughters; this is because Allah had stopped their wives and beasts from conceiving for 40 years, (and will assign unto you Gardens and will assign unto you rivers) flowing rivers for your own benefits. This is because Allah had, before this, destroyed their fields and made their rivers dry for 40 years.

translation: ‘And give you increase in wealth and children, and bestow on you gardens and bestow on you rivers.’"

metadata.arabic: مَّا لَكُمْ لاَ تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَاراً
metadata.Tafsir: (What aileth you that ye hope not towards Allah for dignity) what ails you that you do not fear Allah's might and majesty; and it is also said that this means: what ails you that you do not magnify Allah as He deserves to be magnified and, thus, believe in His divine Oneness.

translation: What is the matter with you, that [you fear not Allâh (His punishment), and] you hope not for reward (from Allâh or you believe not in His Oneness).

metadata.arabic: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَاراً
metadata.Tafsir: (When He created you by (diverse) stages?) The stages refer to sperm drops, blood clots, small chunks of flesh and bones, etc.,

translation: While He has created you in (different) stages [i.e. first Nutfah, then ‘Alaqah and then Mudghah, see (V.23:13,14)].

metadata.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَوْاْ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقاً
metadata.Tafsir: (See ye not) have you not been informed, O disbelievers of Mecca, (how Allah hath created seven heavens in harmony) He created them one above the other like a dome whose different parts are cemented with each other,

translation: See you not how Allâh has created the seven heavens one above another?

metadata.arabic: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُوراً وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجاً
metadata.Tafsir: (And hath made the moon) along with them (a light therein) a shining light therein, (and made the sun a lamp) a radiance for the children of Adam?

translation: And has made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?

metadata.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَنبَتَكُمْ مِّنَ ٱلأَرْضِ نَبَاتاً
metadata.Tafsir: (And Allah hath caused you to grow as a growth from the earth) He created you from Adam, and Adam is created from dust and the dust is from the earth,

translation: And Allâh has brought you forth from the (dust of) earth? (Tafsir At-Tabarî)

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجاً
metadata.Tafsir: (And afterward He maketh you return thereto) He will burry you in the earth, (and He will bring you forth again) from the graves on the Day of Judgement, (a (new) forthbringing.

translation: Afterwards He will return you into it (the earth), and bring you forth (again on the Day of Resurrection)?

metadata.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلأَرْضَ بِسَاطاً
metadata.Tafsir: And Allah hath made the earth a wide expanse for you) to lay and sleep on

translation: And Allâh has made for you the earth a wide expanse.

metadata.arabic: لِّتَسْلُكُواْ مِنْهَا سُبُلاً فِجَاجاً
metadata.Tafsir: (That ye may thread the valley ways thereof) that you may follow wide ways thereof.

translation: That you may go about therein in broad roads.

metadata.arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِي وَٱتَّبَعُواْ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُ وَوَلَدُهُ إِلاَّ خَسَاراً
metadata.Tafsir: (Noah said: My Lord!) O my Lord! (They have disobeyed me) regarding repentance and faith in Allah's divine Oneness (and followed) and obeyed (one whose) abundant (wealth and children increase him in naught save ruin) in the Hereafter; this refers to the chieftains of his folk;

translation: Nûh (Noah) said: "My Lord! They have disobeyed me, and followed one whose wealth and children give him no increase but loss.

metadata.arabic: وَمَكَرُواْ مَكْراً كُبَّاراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And they have plotted a mighty plot) and they have uttered a tremendous lie,

translation: "And they have plotted a mighty plot.

metadata.arabic: وَقَالُواْ لاَ تَذَرُنَّ آلِهَتَكُمْ وَلاَ تَذَرُنَّ وَدّاً وَلاَ سُوَاعاً وَلاَ يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And they have said) i.e. the chieftains said to the communality of the people: (Forsake not your gods) forsake not the worship of your Lord. (Forsake not Wadd) forsake not the worship of Wadd, (nor Suwa') nor the worship of Suwa', (nor Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr) nor the worship of Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr. These were idols which Noah's folk worshipped.

translation: "And they have said: ‘You shall not leave your gods: nor shall you leave Wadd, nor Suwâ‘, nor Yaghûth, nor Ya‘ûq nor Nasr’ (these are the names of their idols).

metadata.arabic: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّواْ كَثِيراً وَلاَ تَزِدِ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ إِلاَّ ضَلاَلاً
metadata.Tafsir: (And they have led many astray) he says: they have misled through them many people; and it is also said: many people went astray because of them, (and Thou increasest the wrong-doers) the disbelievers and idolaters in their worship of these idols (in naught save error) loss and destruction.

translation: "And indeed they have led many astray. And (O Allâh): ‘Grant no increase to the Zâlimûn (polytheists, wrong-doers, and disbelievers) save error.’"

metadata.arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيۤئَاتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُواْ فَأُدْخِلُواْ نَاراً فَلَمْ يَجِدُواْ لَهُمْ مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَاراً
metadata.Tafsir: (Because of their sins they were drowned) by the flood in the life of the world, (then made to enter) in the Hereafter (a Fire. And they found they had no helpers in place of Allah) they had no helpers to defend them against Allah's chastisement.

translation: Because of their sins they were drowned, then were made to enter the Fire. And they found none to help them instead of Allâh.

metadata.arabic: وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ لاَ تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَافِرِينَ دَيَّاراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And Noah said) after Allah told him that none of his people will believe in him, apart from those who had already believed: (My Lord!) O my Lord! (Leave not one of the disbelievers in the land.

translation: And Nûh (Noah) said: "My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers on the earth!

metadata.arabic: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّواْ عِبَادَكَ وَلاَ يَلِدُوۤاْ إِلاَّ فَاجِراً كَفَّاراً
metadata.Tafsir: If Thou shouldst leave them, they will mislead Thy slaves) they will mislead from Your religion those who believe in You and those who wish to believe in You, (and will beget none save lewd ingrates) and will not beget save offspring who are sinful and disbelievers when they reach the age of reason; and it is also said this means: save those upon whom You have decreed disbelief and lewdness when they reach the age of reason; and it is also said that they did not have among them any children because Allah stopped their women from conceiving, and thus they had only adults amongst them, and the latter were all lewd disbelievers.

translation: "If You leave them, they will mislead Your slaves, and they will beget none but wicked disbelievers.

metadata.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِناً وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَلاَ تَزِدِ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ إِلاَّ تَبَاراً
metadata.Tafsir: (My Lord!) O my Lord! (Forgive me and my parents) and forgive my believing parents (and him who entereth my house) my religion; and it is also said: my mosque; and it is also said: my ship (believing, and believing men and believing women) who are true in their faith and who will come after me, (and increase not the wrong-doers) the disbelieving idolaters (in aught save ruin) loss and destruction, like the destruction of those people whose Prophet received the revelation but refused to believe in him'.

translation: "My Lord! Forgive me, and my parents, and him who enters my home as a believer, and all the believing men and women. And to the Zâlimûn (polytheists, wrong-doers, and disbelievers) grant You no increase but destruction!"

metadata.arabic: قُلْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوۤاْ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْآناً عَجَباً
metadata.Tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (Say (O Muhammad): It is revealed unto me): '(Say (O Muhammad): It is revealed unto me) say, O Muhammad, to the disbelievers of Mecca that Gabriel has come down and informed me (that a company of the jinn) nine of the jinn of Nusaybin which is near Yemen (gave ear, and they said) after accepting faith and returning to their folk: O our folk! (Lo! it is a marvellous Qur'an) we have listened to the recitation of a marvellous, illustrious and noble Qur'an which resembles the Scripture of Moses, this is because they were followers of the Torah,

translation: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "It has been revealed to me that a group (from three to ten in number) of jinn listened (to this Qur’ân). They said: ‘Verily, we have heard a wonderful Recitation (this Qur’ân)!

metadata.arabic: يَهْدِيۤ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَآمَنَّا بِهِ وَلَن نُّشرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَداً
metadata.Tafsir: (Which guideth unto righteousness) which guides to the Truth, guidance and right course, i.e. to “there is no deity except Allah”, (so we believe in it) we believe in Muhammad (pbuh) and we believe in the Qur'an (and we ascribe unto our Lord no partner) here meaning the devil.

translation: ‘It guides to the Right Path, and we have believed therein, and we shall never join (in worship) anything with our Lord (Allâh).

metadata.arabic: وَأَنَّهُ تَعَالَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَاحِبَةً وَلاَ وَلَداً
metadata.Tafsir: (And (we believe) that He-exalted be the glory of our Lord-) and that the dominion of our Lord is exalted; it is also said this means: the tremendousness, sovereignty, absoluteness and attributes of our Lord are far exalted, and He (hath taken neither wife nor son) as the disbelievers claim,

translation: ‘And He, exalted be the Majesty of our Lord, has taken neither a wife nor a son (or offspring or children).

metadata.arabic: وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطاً
metadata.Tafsir: (And that the foolish one among us) i.e. the devil (used to speak concerning Allah an atrocious lie.

translation: ‘And that the foolish among us [i.e. Iblîs (Satan) or the polytheists amongst the jinn] used to utter against Allâh that which was an enormity in falsehood.

metadata.arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِباً
metadata.Tafsir: And lo! we had supposed that humankind and jinn would not speak a lie concerning Allah) and we thought that what humans and the jinn said about Allah was not a lie, but we know now that it is. From the beginning of the surah up to here, Allah related what the jinn said.

translation: ‘And verily, we thought that men and jinn would not utter a lie against Allâh.

metadata.arabic: وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ ٱلإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقاً
metadata.Tafsir: Allah then said: (And indeed (O Muhammad) individuals of humankind used to invoke the protection of individuals of the jinn so that they increased them) because of that (in revolt (against Allah)) in pride, arrogance, sedition, and corruption. This is because they were afraid of them whenever they travelled, caught a game or camped in a valley. And to avoid their harm they used to say: “we seek refuge in the master of this valley from the foolish ones of his folk” after which they felt safe. As a result, the masters of these places increased in nothing but pride and arrogance towards the communality among their folk. There are three kinds of jinn: one kind flies in the air; another kind ascends and descends wherever they wish; and a third kind resembles dogs and snakes;

translation: ‘And verily, there were men among mankind who took shelter with the males among the jinn, but they (jinn) increased them (mankind) in sin and transgression.

metadata.arabic: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّواْ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَداً
metadata.Tafsir: (And indeed they) the disbelievers of the jinn before they accepted faith (supposed, even as you suppose) O people of Mecca, (that Allah would not raise anyone (from the dead)) and it is also said that this means: and they supposed just as you did that Allah will not send anyone as a messenger.

translation: ‘And they thought as you thought, that Allâh will not send any Messenger (to mankind or jinn).

metadata.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَاهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَساً شَدِيداً وَشُهُباً
metadata.Tafsir: Allah then went back to the talk of the jinn, saying: (And (the jinn who had listened to the Qur'an said): We had sought the heaven) before we accepted faith (but had found it filled with strong warders) angels (and meteors) preventing them from listening.

translation: ‘And we have sought to reach the heaven; but found it filled with stern guards and flaming fires.

metadata.arabic: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَاعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلآنَ يَجِدْ لَهُ شِهَاباً رَّصَداً
metadata.Tafsir: (And we used to sit on places (high) therein) in heaven (to listen) before the advent of Muhammad (pbuh). (But he who listened now) after the advent of Muhammad (pbuh) (findeth a flame) a shining star (in wait for him) from the angels in order to prevent them from listening;

translation: ‘And verily, we used to sit there in stations, to (steal) a hearing, but any who listens now will find a flaming fire watching him in ambush.

metadata.arabic: وَأَنَّا لاَ نَدْرِيۤ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِي ٱلأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَداً
metadata.Tafsir: (And we know not whether) in preventing us from listening (harm is boded unto all who are in the earth, or whether their Lord intendeth guidance for them) or whether their Lord intends guidance, goodness and the correct course for them; it is also said that this means: we do not know whether evil is intended for the people of the earth by the advent of Muhammad (pbuh) such that if they do not believe in him they will be destroyed or it is good, guidance and the correct course that their Lord intends for them if they believe in him.

translation: ‘And we know not whether evil is intended for those on earth, or whether their Lord intends for them a Right Path.

metadata.arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّالِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَلِكَ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَداً
metadata.Tafsir: (And among us there are righteous folk) those who believe in Allah's divine Oneness; these are those who believe in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an (and among us there are far from that) and among us there are disbelievers, the disbelieving jinn. (We are sects having different rules) we followed different religions, i.e. Judaism and Christianity, before believing in Allah.

translation: ‘There are among us some that are righteous, and some the contrary; we are groups having different ways (religious sects).

metadata.arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِي ٱلأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُ هَرَباً
metadata.Tafsir: (And we know) and are certain (that we cannot escape from Allah in the earth) for He can reach us wherever we might be, (nor can we escape by flight) nor can we escape from Him by running away.

translation: ‘And we think that we cannot escape (the punishment of) Allâh in the earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.

metadata.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰ آمَنَّا بِهِ فَمَن يُؤْمِن بِرَبِّهِ فَلاَ يَخَافُ بَخْساً وَلاَ رَهَقاً
metadata.Tafsir: (And when we heard the guidance) and when we heard the recitation of the Qur'an by Muhammad (pbuh) (we believed therein) we believed in the Qur'an and Muhammad (pbuh) (and whoso believeth in his Lord, he feareth neither loss) of all his works (nor oppression) nor decrease of his works.

translation: ‘And indeed when we heard the Guidance (this Qur’ân), we believed therein (Islâmic Monotheism), and whosoever believes in his Lord shall have no fear, either of a decrease in the reward of his good deeds or an increase in the punishment for his sins.

metadata.arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَاسِطُونَ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُوْلَـٰئِكَ تَحَرَّوْاْ رَشَداً
metadata.Tafsir: (And there are among us some who have surrendered (to Allah)) and there are among us those who are sincere in their belief in Allah's divine Oneness; these are the ones who believed in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an (and there are among us some who are unjust) i.e. disobedient ones who have deviated from the Truth and guidance; and these are the disbelievers among the jinn. (And whoso hath surrendered to Allah) and whoever is sincere in his belief in Allah's divine Oneness, (such have taken the right path purposefully) such have intended goodness and the correct course.

translation: ‘And of us some are Muslims (who have submitted to Allâh, after listening to this Qur’ân), and of us some are Al-Qâsitûn (disbelievers - those who have deviated from the Right Path)’. And whosoever has embraced Islâm (i.e. has become a Muslim by submitting to Allâh), then such have sought the Right Path."

metadata.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَاسِطُونَ فَكَانُواْ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَباً
metadata.Tafsir: (And as for those who are unjust) i.e. the disbelievers, (they are firewood for hell.

translation: And as for the Qâsitûn (disbelievers who deviated from the Right Path), they shall be firewood for Hell,

metadata.arabic: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَامُواْ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لأَسْقَيْنَاهُم مَّآءً غَدَقاً
metadata.Tafsir: If they (the idolaters) tread the right path) the path of disbelief; and it is said: the path of Islam, (We shall give them to drink of water in abundance) We shall give them abundant wealth and a comfortable life

translation: If they (non-Muslims) had believed in Allâh, and went on the Right Way (i.e. Islâm) We would surely have bestowed on them water (rain) in abundance.

metadata.arabic: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَاباً صَعَداً
metadata.Tafsir: (That We may test them thereby) in order that they may revert to that which I have ordained for them, (and whoso turneth away from the remembrance of his Lord) and whoever turns away from believing in the divine Oneness and Scripture of his Lord, i.e. the Qur'an-this refers to al-Walid Ibn al-Mughirah al-Makhzumi; (He will thrust him into ever growing torment) climbing a mountain of smooth stones; and it is said this means: climbing a mountain of copper in the Fire.

translation: That We might try them thereby. And whosoever turns away from the Reminder of his Lord (i.e. this Qur’ân, - and practise not its laws and orders), He will cause him to enter in a severe torment (i.e. Hell).

metadata.arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَاجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلاَ تَدْعُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَداً
metadata.Tafsir: (And the places of worship are only for Allah) they are built for the remembrance of Allah, (so pray not unto) so worship not (anyone along with Allah) in mosques; it is also said that the places of worship refer to the different parts of a person that touch the ground upon prostrating in prayer: the forehead, the knees, the hands and the feet.

translation: And the mosques are for Allâh (Alone): so invoke not anyone along with Allâh.

metadata.arabic: وَأَنَّهُ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُواْ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَداً
metadata.Tafsir: (And when the slave of Allah) Muhammad (pbuh) (stood up) in Batn Nakhl (in prayer to Him) to worship Allah through prayer, (they crowded on him, almost stifling) the jinn almost fell on him because of their love of the Qur'an and Muhammad (pbuh) when they heard him recite the Qur'an in Batn Nakhl.

translation: And when the slave of Allâh (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) stood up invoking Him (his Lord - Allâh) in prayer they (the jinn) just made round him a dense crowd as if sticking one over the other (in order to listen to the Prophet’s recitation).

metadata.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُواْ رَبِّي وَلاَ أُشْرِكُ بِهِ أَحَداً
metadata.Tafsir: (Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I pray unto Allah only) I worship Allah only and call people to worship none but Him, (and ascribe unto Him no partner.

translation: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "I invoke only my Lord (Allâh Alone), and I associate none as partners along with Him."

metadata.arabic: قُلْ إِنِّي لاَ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرّاً وَلاَ رَشَداً
metadata.Tafsir: Say) O Muhammad, to the people of Mecca: (Lo! I control not hurt) I cannot drive away from you harm, forsakenness or chastisement (nor benefit for you) nor can I give you benefit and guidance.

translation: Say: "It is not in my power to cause you harm, or to bring you to the Right Path."

metadata.arabic: قُلْ إِنِّي لَن يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِ مُلْتَحَداً
metadata.Tafsir: (Say) to them, O Muhammad: (Lo! none can protect me from Allah) from Allah's chastisement if I disobey Him, (nor can I find any refuge beside Him) nor can I find any escape or hiding place from Allah's chastisement if I disobey Him.

translation: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "None can protect me from Allâh’s punishment (if I were to disobey Him), nor can I find refuge except in Him.

metadata.arabic: إِلاَّ بَلاَغاً مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَالاَتِهِ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَإِنَّ لَهُ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَداً
metadata.Tafsir: ((Mine is) but conveyance (of the Truth) from Allah) he says: nothing can save me except conveyance on behalf of Allah, (and His messages; and whoso disobeyeth Allah) regarding Allah's divine Oneness (and His messenger) in his conveyance of the message, (lo! His) in the Hereafter (is fire of hell, wherein such dwell forever) never to die or leave it.

translation: "(Mine is) but conveyance (of the truth) from Allâh and His Messages (of Islâmic Monotheism), and whosoever disobeys Allâh and His Messenger, then Verily, for him is the Fire of Hell, he shall dwell therein forever."

metadata.arabic: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا رَأَوْاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِراً وَأَقَلُّ عَدَداً
metadata.Tafsir: (Till (the day)) He says: wait for them until the day (when they shall behold that which they are promised) of chastisement; (but then they will know for certain) this is a threat from Allah to them (who is weaker in allies and less in multitude) who has less helpers.

translation: Till, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who it is that is weaker concerning helpers and less important concerning numbers.

metadata.arabic: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِيۤ أَقَرِيبٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُ رَبِّيۤ أَمَداً
metadata.Tafsir: (Say) to them, O Muhammad: (I know not whether that which ye are promised) of chastisement (is nigh, or if my Lord hath set a distant term for it.

translation: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "I know not whether (the punishment) which you are promised is near or whether my Lord will appoint for it a distant term.

metadata.arabic: عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلاَ يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِ أَحَداً
metadata.Tafsir: (He is) the knower of the Unseen) He knows when the chastisement will happen, (and He revealeth unto none His secret,

translation: "(He Alone is) the All-Knower of the Ghaib (Unseen), and He reveals to none His Ghaib (Unseen)."

metadata.arabic: إِلاَّ مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُ يَسْلُكُ مِن بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ رَصَداً
metadata.Tafsir: Save unto every messenger whom he hath chosen) He reveals to them some instances of the Unseen, (and then He maketh a guard) angels (to go before him) before the messenger (and a guard behind him) to protect him from the jinn, devils and human beings so that they do not hear Gabriel reciting the revelations.

translation: Except to a Messenger (from mankind) whom He has chosen (He informs him of unseen as much as He likes), and then He makes a band of watching guards (angels) to march before him and behind him.

metadata.arabic: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُواْ رِسَالاَتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عَدَداً
metadata.Tafsir: (That He) that Muhammad (pbuh) (may know that they) i.e. the messengers (have indeed conveyed the messages of their Lord) the angels protected them just as they are protecting you; it is also said that this means: so that the messengers, Muhammad and other messengers, know that the angels have conveyed the message from Allah; and it is also said that this means: so that the jinn and human beings know that the messengers have conveyed the messages of their Lord. (He surroundeth all their doings) He has full knowledge of all the angels that surround them, (and He keepeth count of all things) it is also said that He knows their number just as He knows the state of the one who is wrapped up in his raiment'.

translation: [He (Allâh) protects them (the Messengers)], till He sees that they (the Messengers) have conveyed the Messages of their Lord (Allâh). And He (Allâh) surrounds all that which is with them, and He (Allâh) keeps count of all things (i.e. He knows the exact number of everything).

metadata.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ
metadata.Tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said concerning Allah's saying (O thou wrapped up in your raiment!): '(O thou wrapped up in your raiment!) He is referring here to Muhammad (pbuh) who wrapped himself up in his raiment in order to pray.

translation: O you wrapped in garments (i.e. Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)!

metadata.arabic: قُمِ ٱلَّيلَ إِلاَّ قَلِيلاً
metadata.Tafsir: (Keep vigil the night long) in prayer, then He said (save a little);

translation: Stand (to pray) all night, except a little -

metadata.arabic: نِّصْفَهُ أَوِ ٱنقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلاً
metadata.Tafsir: He explained further, saying: (A half thereof) i.e. pray during half of the night, (or abate a little thereof) less than half and up to a third of the night,

translation: Half of it or a little less than that,

metadata.arabic: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلْقُرْآنَ تَرْتِيلاً
metadata.Tafsir: (Or add (a little) thereto) or pray more than half of the night, up to two thirds of the night, thus giving him a choice, and then He said: (and chant the Qur'an in measure) recite the Qur'an deliberately, unhurriedly and with gravity, i.e. reciting two or three verses each time until you finish the whole recitation,

translation: Or a little more. And recite the Qur’ân (aloud) in a slow, (pleasant tone and) style.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِي عَلَيْكَ قَوْلاً ثَقِيلاً
metadata.Tafsir: (For We shall charge thee) for We shall send you Gabriel (with a word of weight) with mighty words containing commands and prohibitions, promises and threats, the lawful and unlawful; it is also said this means: with a tremendous word; and it is also said this means: a word that is heavy on whoever contravenes it; and it is also said this means: a weighty word in the prayer of the night.

translation: Verily, We shall send down to you a weighty Word (i.e. obligations, laws).

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱللَّيْلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطْأً وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلاً
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! the vigil of the night) spent in praying (is (a time) when impression is more keen) the vigil of the night and praying at this time give a person more vigour in his prayer, when he seeks by it Allah's sake alone; it is also said this means: it is gentler and milder on the heart (and speech more certain) the recitation of the Qur'an is clearer and firmer.

translation: Verily, the rising by night (for Tahajjud prayer) is very hard and most potent and good for governing oneself, and most suitable for (understanding) the Word (of Allâh).

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحَاً طَوِيلاً
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! thou hast by day) O Muhammad (a chain of business) a long period of time to attend to your needs.

translation: Verily, there is for you by day prolonged occupation with ordinary duties.

metadata.arabic: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلاً
metadata.Tafsir: (So remember the name of thy Lord) so pray by the command of your Lord; and it is also said this means: remember your Lord's divine Oneness (and devote thyself with a complete devotion) be completely sincere to Allah in your prayers, supplications and acts of worship.

translation: And remember the Name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with a complete devotion.

metadata.arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لاَ إِلَـٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلاً
metadata.Tafsir: (Lord of the East and the West) is Allah; (there is no God save Him; so choose you Him alone for thy defender) worship Him as a Lord; it is also said this means: take Him as a Guardian regarding that which He promised you of help, supremacy and reward.

translation: (He Alone is) the Lord of the east and the west; Lâ ilâha illâ Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He). So take Him Alone as Wakîl (Disposer of your affairs).

metadata.arabic: وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْراً جَمِيلاً
metadata.Tafsir: (And bear with patience) O Muhammad (what they utter) of vilification and denial, (and part from them with a fair leave-taking) steer clear of them in a fair way, neither grieving nor reciprocating with indecency.

translation: And be patient (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) with what they say, and keep away from them in a good way.

metadata.arabic: وَذَرْنِي وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُوْلِي ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلاً
metadata.Tafsir: (Leave Me to deal with the deniers) of the Qur'an-this is a threat to them; and the ones specifically meant by this threat are those who fed the army of the disbelievers on the Day of Badr-, (lords of ease and comfort (in this life)) those who have wealth and richness; (and do thou respite them awhile) until the Day of Badr.

translation: And leave Me Alone to deal with the beliers (those who deny My Verses), those who are in possession of good things of life. And give them respite for a little while.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالاً وَجَحِيماً
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! with Us) for them in the Hereafter (are heavy fetters) with which their hands will be tied to their necks and chains will also be put around their necks (and a raging fire) which they will enter,

translation: Verily, with Us are fetters (to bind them), and a raging Fire.

metadata.arabic: وَطَعَاماً ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَاباً أَلِيماً
metadata.Tafsir: (And food) the Zaqqum (which choketh (the partaker), and a painful doom) whose pain will extend to their hearts.

translation: And a food that chokes, and a painful torment.

metadata.arabic: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيباً مَّهِيلاً
metadata.Tafsir: Then Allah explained when this will take place, saying: (On the day when the earth and the hills rock) on the day when the earth and the mountains will quake, (and the hills become a heap of running sand.

translation: On the Day when the earth and the mountains will be in violent shake, and the mountains will be a heap of sand poured out.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولاً شَاهِداً عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولاً
metadata.Tafsir: Lo! We have sent unto you a messenger) i.e. Muhammad (pbuh) (as witness against you) that he has conveyed the message, (even as We sent unto Pharaoh a messenger) i.e. Moses.

translation: Verily, We have sent to you (O men) a Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) to be a witness over you, as We did send a Messenger [Mûsâ (Moses)] to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh).

metadata.arabic: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَاهُ أَخْذاً وَبِيلاً
metadata.Tafsir: (But Pharaoh rebelled against the messenger) i.e. Moses, and did not accept his call, (whereupon We seized him with no gentle grip) therefore We punished him with a severe punishment, i.e. by drowning.

translation: But Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) disobeyed the Messenger [Mûsâ (Moses)]; so We seized him with a severe punishment.

metadata.arabic: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْماً يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَانَ شِيباً
metadata.Tafsir: (Then how) will you ward off disbelief, idolatry and indecencies, O people of Mecca (if ye disbelieve) in the life of the world, (will ye protect yourselves upon the day) the Day of Judgement (which will turn children grey) when they hear Allah say to Adam: “O Adam! Send a group from your progeny to the Fire”. Adam will say: “O Lord! How many?” Allah will say: “From every one thousand, send 999 to the Fire and one person to the Garden”,

translation: Then how can you avoid the punishment, if you disbelieve, on a Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) that will make the children grey-headed?

metadata.arabic: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌ بِهِ كَانَ وَعْدُهُ مَفْعُولاً
metadata.Tafsir: (The very heaven being then) when the children turn grey; and it is said: due to the descent of the command of the Lord and the angels (rent asunder. His promise) regarding the resurrection (is to be fulfilled) is to take place.

translation: Whereon the heaven will be cleft asunder? His Promise is certainly to be accomplished.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِ تَذْكِرَةٌ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلاً
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! This) surah (is a Reminder) is an admonition and clarification for you. (Let him who will, then, choose a way unto his Lord) a way to head towards Allah; it is also said this means: let him who will use this to return to his Lord.

translation: Verily, this is an admonition: therefore whosoever will, let him take a Path to His Lord!

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَيِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُ وَثُلُثَهُ وَطَآئِفَةٌ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ فَٱقْرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْآنِ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُمْ مَّرْضَىٰ وَآخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِي ٱلأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ وَآخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱقْرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَٰوةَ وَآتُواْ ٱلزَّكَٰوةَ وَأَقْرِضُواْ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضاً حَسَناً وَمَا تُقَدِّمُواْ لأَنفُسِكُمْ مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْراً وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْراً وَٱسْتَغْفِرُواْ ٱللَّهَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! thy Lord) O Muhammad (knoweth how thou keepest vigil sometimes nearly) less than (two thirds of the night) up to half of the night, (or (sometimes) half) and sometimes you keep vigil half of the night (or a third thereof) and you keep vigil a third of the night; it is also said this means: and sometimes less than half of the night, (as do a party of those with thee) and a group of believers with you who keep vigil of the night in prayer. (Allah measureth the night and the day) Allah knows the hours of the day and night. (He knoweth that ye count it not) i.e. keep track of the hours of the night; it is also said that this means: He knows you will not be able to persevere in that which you are commanded of prayer in the night, (and turneth unto you in mercy) and so He forgives you if you do not pray at night. (Recite, then, of the Qur'an) when you perform the prayers (that which is easy for you) 100 verses and more; and it is also said this means: whatever you wish to recite of the Qur'an. (He knoweth that there are sick folk among you) wounded people among you who cannot pray at night, (while others travel in the land) fleeing from something or (in search of Allah's bounty) of Allah's provision and other things, and it is hard on them to pray at night, (and others (still) are fighting for the cause of Allah) for the obedience of Allah who will find it hard to pray at night. (So recite of it) of the Qur'an in your prayers (that which is easy (for you), and establish worship) complete the five daily prayers including what is required for its validity of ritual ablution, bowings, prostrations and the observation of their due times (and pay the poor-due) from your wealth (and (so) lend unto Allah) by giving to charity; and it is also said: by doing righteous works (a goodly loan) truly and sincerely from your hearts. (Whatsoever good) alms or righteous works (ye send before you for your souls, ye will surely find it) find its reward (with Allah) in Paradise preserved for you, neither stolen, drowned, burnt or eaten by borer, (better) than what you have left in the life of the world (and greater in the recompense) than that which you have. (And seek forgiveness of Allah) from your sins. (Lo! Allah is Forgiving) He forgives whoever repents, (Merciful) towards he who dies repentant, because of the mercy of he who is enveloped in his cloak'.

translation: Verily, your Lord knows that you do stand (to pray at night) a little less than two thirds of the night, or half the night, or a third of the night, and also a party of those with you. And Allâh measures the night and the day. He knows that you are unable to pray the whole night, so He has turned to you (in mercy). So, recite you of the Qur’ân as much as may be easy for you. He knows that there will be some among you sick, others travelling through the land, seeking of Allâh’s Bounty, yet others fighting in Allâh’s Cause. So recite as much of the Qur’ân as may be easy (for you), and perform As-Salât (Iqâmat-as-Salât ) and give Zakât, and lend to Allâh a goodly loan. And whatever good you send before you for yourselves (i.e. Nawâfil non-obligatory acts of worship: prayers, charity, fasting, Hajj and ‘Umrah), you will certainly find it with Allâh, better and greater in reward. And seek Forgiveness of Allâh. Verily, Allâh is Oft-Forgiving, Most-Merciful.

metadata.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُدَّثِّرُ
metadata.Tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (O thou enveloped in your cloak): '(O thou enveloped in your cloak) addressing the Prophet (pbuh) who had enveloped himself in his cloak to sleep

translation: O you (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) enveloped in garments!

metadata.arabic: قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ
metadata.Tafsir: (Arise and warn!) warn people and call them to profess Allah's divine Oneness.

translation: Arise and warn!

metadata.arabic: وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ
metadata.Tafsir: (Your Lord magnify) Exonerate your Lord from what the idol worshippers say about Him,

translation: And magnify your Lord (Allâh)!

metadata.arabic: وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ
metadata.Tafsir: (Your raiment purify) from filth; it is also said this means: and shorten your raiment; and it is also said this means: purify your heart from betrayal, treachery and exasperation; i.e. be pure of heart,

translation: And purify your garments!

metadata.arabic: وَٱلرُّجْزَ فَٱهْجُرْ
metadata.Tafsir: (Pollution shun!) shun all sins and do not go near them.

translation: And keep away from Ar-Rujz (the idols)!

metadata.arabic: وَلاَ تَمْنُن تَسْتَكْثِرُ
metadata.Tafsir: (And show not favour, seeking worldly gain!) such that you give a little and receive instead what is more and better in the life of the world; it is also said this means: do not deem the works you do for Allah to be too much.

translation: And give not a thing in order to have more (or consider not your deeds of obedience to Allâh as a favour to Him).

metadata.arabic: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَٱصْبِرْ
metadata.Tafsir: (For the sake of thy Lord, be patient!) Be patient in the worship and obedience of your Lord.

translation: And be patient for the sake of your Lord (i.e. perform your duty to Allâh)!

metadata.arabic: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِي ٱلنَّاقُورِ
metadata.Tafsir: (For when the trumpet shall sound) which is the sound of the Trumpet announcing the Resurrection,

translation: Then, when the Trumpet is sounded (i.e. the second blowing of the horn).

metadata.arabic: فَذَلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Surely that day) i.e. the Day of Judgement (will be a day of anguish) will be a severe day,

translation: Truly, that Day will be a Hard Day -

metadata.arabic: عَلَى ٱلْكَافِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Not of ease, for disbelievers) i.e. its horrors and torment are not easy for the disbelievers.

translation: Far from easy for the disbelievers.

metadata.arabic: ذَرْنِي وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيداً
metadata.Tafsir: (Leave Me) O Muhammad ((to deal) with him whom I created lonely) without wealth, children or spouse, this is a threat from Allah to al-Walid Ibn al-Mughirah al-Makhzumi.

translation: Leave Me Alone (to deal) with whom I created lonely (without any wealth or children etc, i.e. Al-Walîd bin Al-Mughîrah Al-Makhzûmî)!

metadata.arabic: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُ مَالاً مَّمْدُوداً
metadata.Tafsir: (And then) afterwards (bestowed upon him ample means) of all kinds, and his wealth kept increasing until he had in his possession 9,000 measures of silver,

translation: And then granted him resources in abundance.

metadata.arabic: وَبَنِينَ شُهُوداً
metadata.Tafsir: (And sons abiding in his presence) never out of his sight. He had ten sons.

translation: And children to be by his side.

metadata.arabic: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُ تَمْهِيداً
metadata.Tafsir: (And made (life) smooth for him) he had his wealth piled up just as one piles up couches on top of each other.

translation: And made life smooth and comfortable for him.

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Yet he) i.e. al-Walid (desireth that I should give more) wealth while disobeying and disbelieving in Me.

translation: After all that he desires that I should give more;

metadata.arabic: كَلاَّ إِنَّهُ كان لآيَاتِنَا عَنِيداً
metadata.Tafsir: (Nay!) I will not give him more. And since then his wealth kept decreasing. (For lo! He) i.e. al-Walid Ibn al-Mughirah (hath been stubborn to Our revelations) to Our Scripture and Messenger; he turned away from them in disbelief.

translation: Nay! Verily, he has been opposing Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations).

metadata.arabic: سَأُرْهِقُهُ صَعُوداً
metadata.Tafsir: (On him I shall impose a fearful doom) I shall make him climb a smooth rock in the Fire such that whenever he puts his hands on it, he wwould melt, and then he will be restored to how he used to be; it is also said that Allah will make him climb a rock of copper which pulls him from the front and hits him from the back.

translation: I shall oblige him to (climb a slippery mountain in the Hell-fire called As-Sa‘ûd, or) face a severe torment!

metadata.arabic: إِنَّهُ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ
metadata.Tafsir: (For lo! He) i.e. al-Walid Ibn al-Mughirah (did consider) within himself the matter of Muhammad (pbuh); (then he planned) to say that he is a wizard

translation: Verily, he thought and plotted.

metadata.arabic: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
metadata.Tafsir: ((Self) destroyed is he) cursed is he, (how he planned!) his saying about Muhammad (pbuh)

translation: So let him be cursed: how he plotted!

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Again (self) destroyed is he) again cursed is he, (how he planned!) his saying about Muhammad (pbuh)

translation: And once more let him be cursed: how he plotted!

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then looked he) he considered again his saying that the Prophet was a wizard; it is also said that this means: then he considered the words of the prophetic Companions when they said to him: “Come and join that which is good, O Ibn al-Mughirah!”,

translation: Then he thought.

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then frowned he and showed displeasure.

translation: Then he frowned and he looked in a bad tempered way;

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ
metadata.Tafsir: Then turned he away) from the Companions of the Prophet (pbuh) and returned to his family (in pride) too proud to accept faith and listen to them.

translation: Then he turned back, and was proud.

metadata.arabic: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلاَّ سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ
metadata.Tafsir: (And said: This) which Muhammad (pbuh) says (is naught else than magic from of old) magic which he took from Musaylimah the liar in al-Yamamah and he is now relating it to us; it is also said that this means: what he says is taken from Jabr and Yasar;

translation: Then he said: "This is nothing but magic from that of old,

metadata.arabic: إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلاَّ قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ
metadata.Tafsir: (This) which Muhammad (pbuh) says, is (naught else than speech of mortal man) the speech of Jabr and Yasar.

translation: "This is nothing but the word of a human being!"

metadata.arabic: سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Him) al-Walid Ibn al-Mughirah (shall I fling) in the Hereafter (unto the burning) unto the fourth gate of the Fire.

translation: I will cast him into Hell-fire.

metadata.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَاكَ مَا سَقَرُ
metadata.Tafsir: (Ah, what will convey unto thee) O Muhammad (what that burning is!

translation: And what will make you know (exactly) what Hell-fire is?

metadata.arabic: لاَ تُبْقِي وَلاَ تَذَرُ
metadata.Tafsir: It leaveth naught) any of their flesh except that it devours it; (It spareth naught) and it devours them when they are restored again to their former shape.

translation: It spares not (any sinner), nor does it leave (anything unburnt)!

metadata.arabic: لَوَّاحَةٌ لِّلْبَشَرِ
metadata.Tafsir: (It shriveleth the man) it disfigures their bodies and darkens their faces.

translation: Burning and blackening the skins!

metadata.arabic: عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Above it) above the Fire (are nineteen) angels; they are the keepers of the Fire.

translation: Over it are nineteen (angels as guardians and keepers of Hell).

metadata.arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلاَّ مَلَٰئِكَةً وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلاَّ فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوۤاْ إِيمَٰناً وَلاَ يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلاً كَذَلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِي مَن يَشَآءُ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلاَّ هُوَ وَمَا هِيَ إِلاَّ ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
metadata.Tafsir: (We have appointed) We set on the dwellers of the Fire (only angels) the keepers of the Fire (to be wardens of the Fire, and their number have We made) and We have not mentioned the fewness of the keepers of the Fire save (to be a stumbling block) except in order to be a calamity (for those who disbelieve) the disbelievers of Mecca: Abu'l-Ashadd Ibn Usayd Ibn Kildah who said: “I will take care of seventeen angels, nine on my back and eight on my chest; therefore you should take care of the other two”; (that those to whom the scripture) the Torah, i.e. 'Abdullah Ibn Salam and his followers, for it is written in the Torah that the number of the keepers of the Fire is nineteen (hath been given may have certainty, and that believers may increase in faith) when they know that what is in their Scripture is similar to that which is in the Torah; (and that those to whom the Scripture hath been given) 'Abdullah Ibn Salam and his followers, when they see that there is no difference between what is in the Qur'an and that which is in the Torah (and believers) also for the same reason (may not doubt; and that those in whose hearts there is disease) doubt and hypocrisy, (and disbelievers) the Jews and Christians; and it is said: the disbelievers of Mecca, (may say: What meaneth Allah by this similitude) when he mentioned the small number of angels who are in charge of the Fire? (Thus Allah sendeth astray) through this similitude (whom He will) whomever deserves it, (and whom He will) and whomever deserves (He guideth) by means of this similitude. (None knoweth the hosts of your Lord) among the angels (save Him. This is) i.e. Saqar, the fourth gate of the Fire (naught else than a Reminder unto mortals) an admonition to people in order to warn them.

translation: And We have set none but angels as guardians of the Fire.
