metadata.Tafsir: (Or take heed) by means of the Qur'an (and so the reminder) by means of the Qur'an (might avail him?) It is also said that this means: how do you know O Muhammad, whether or not he becomes righteous and whether or not he benefits from the admonitions of the Qur'an.

translation: Or he might receive admonition, and the admonition might profit him?

metadata.arabic: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (As for him who thinketh himself independent) of Allah, i.e. the three men mentioned above,

translation: As for him who thinks himself self-sufficient,

metadata.arabic: فَأَنتَ لَهُ تَصَدَّىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (Unto him thou payest regard) you turn your face to them.

translation: To him you attend;

metadata.arabic: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلاَّ يَزَّكَّىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (Yet it is not thy concern if he grow not (in grace)) it is not your concern if these three men do not believe in Allah's divine Oneness.

translation: What does it matter to you if he will not become pure (from disbelief: you are only a Messenger, your duty is to convey the Message of Allâh).

metadata.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (But as for him who cometh unto thee with earnest purpose) hastening for goodness

translation: But as to him who came to you running,

metadata.arabic: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (And hath fear) of Allah, and is also a Muslim; this is because Ibn Umm Maktum had accepted Islam before this incident,

translation: And is afraid (of Allâh and His punishment).

metadata.arabic: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (From him thou) O Muhammad (art distracted) being busy with those three men.

translation: Of him you are neglectful and divert your attention to another,

metadata.arabic: كَلاَّ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Nay) do not do this; He says: do not turn to those who think themselves independent of Allah and turn away from he who fears Allah. After this reminder, the Prophet (pbuh) used to honour Ibn Umm Maktum and treat him well, (but verily it) this surah (is an Admonishment) from Allah both for the rich and the poor,

translation: Nay, (do not do like this); indeed it (this Qur’ân) is an admonition.

metadata.arabic: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُ
metadata.Tafsir: (So let whosoever will pay heed to it) whoever Allah wants him to be admonished will be admonished,

translation: So whoever wills, let him pay attention to it.

metadata.arabic: فَي صُحُفٍ مُّكَرَّمَةٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (On honoured leaves) He says: the Qur'an is written on scrolls made of skin which are honoured in the sight of Allah

translation: (It is) in Records held (greatly) in honour (Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz),

metadata.arabic: مَّرْفُوعَةٍ مُّطَهَّرَةٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Exalted) in heaven, (purified) from filth and idolatry,

translation: Exalted (in dignity), purified,

metadata.arabic: بِأَيْدِي سَفَرَةٍ
metadata.Tafsir: ((Set down) by scribes) written by scribes

translation: In the hands of scribes (angels).

metadata.arabic: كِرَامٍ بَرَرَةٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Noble) in the sight of Allah and surrendered to Him (and righteous) truthful; these are the keepers of the nether heaven.

translation: Honourable and obedient.

metadata.arabic: قُتِلَ ٱلإِنسَانُ مَآ أَكْفَرَهُ
metadata.Tafsir: (Man is (self)-destroyed) the disbeliever, i.e. 'Utbah Ibn Abi Lahab, is cursed: (how ungrateful!) what has made him a disbelieve in Allah and in the stars of the Qur'an, i.e. in the star when it sets; it is also said that this means: how extreme is his disbelief.

translation: Be cursed (the disbelieving) man! How ungrateful he is!

metadata.arabic: مِنْ أَيِّ شَيءٍ خَلَقَهُ
metadata.Tafsir: (From what thing doth He create him?) He says: let him think about his own person: from what did He create him as a living being?

translation: From what thing did He create him?

metadata.arabic: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُ فَقَدَّرَهُ
metadata.Tafsir: Allah then explained and said to him: (From a drop of seed. He createth him) a living being (and proportioneth him) He proportioned his creation by giving him two hands, two feet, two eyes, two ears as well as all the other organs,

translation: From Nutfah (male and female semen drops) He created him and then set him in due proportion.

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then maketh the way easy for him) He made clear to him the way of good and the way of evil; and it is also said this means: He made easy for him to come out of the way of the womb,

translation: Then He makes the Path easy for him.

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُ فَأَقْبَرَهُ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then causeth him to die) after this, (and burieth him) and commanded to bury him;

translation: Then He causes him to die and puts him in his grave.

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then, when He will, He bringeth him again to life) i.e. He will resurrect him from the grave.

translation: Then when it is His Will, He will resurrect him (again).

metadata.arabic: كَلاَّ لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُ
metadata.Tafsir: (Nay) truly, O Muhammad, (but (man) hath not done what He commanded him) of profession of Allah's divine Oneness and other things.

translation: Nay, but (man) has not done what He commanded him.

metadata.arabic: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلإِنسَانُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Let man consider his food) let the disbelieving person, 'Utbah Ibn Abi Lahab, think about the food he eats, how it is transformed from state to state until it reaches him to eat:

translation: Then let man look at his food:

metadata.arabic: أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا ٱلْمَآءَ صَبّاً
metadata.Tafsir: Allah then explained these different states, saying: (How We pour water) i.e. rain (in showers) upon the earth

translation: We pour forth water in abundance.

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا ٱلأَرْضَ شَقّاً
metadata.Tafsir: (Then split the earth in clefts) through plants

translation: And We split the earth in clefts.

metadata.arabic: فَأَنبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبّاً
metadata.Tafsir: (And cause the grain) all kinds of grain (to grow therein) in the earth

translation: And We cause therein the grain to grow,

metadata.arabic: وَعِنَباً وَقَضْباً
metadata.Tafsir: (And grapes and green fodder

translation: And grapes and clover plants (i.e. green fodder for the cattle),

metadata.arabic: وَزَيْتُوناً وَنَخْلاً
metadata.Tafsir: And olive trees and palm-trees

translation: And olives and date-palms,

metadata.arabic: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلْباً
metadata.Tafsir: And garden closes of thick foliage

translation: And gardens dense with many trees,

metadata.arabic: وَفَاكِهَةً وَأَبّاً
metadata.Tafsir: And fruits) different kinds of fruit (and grasses) and fodder; and it also said this means: straw:

translation: And fruits and herbage

metadata.arabic: مَّتَاعاً لَّكُمْ وَلأَنْعَامِكُمْ
metadata.Tafsir: (Provision for you) the grains are of benefit to you (and your cattle) and fodder is of benefit to your cattle.

translation: (To be) a provision and benefit for you and your cattle.

metadata.arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ
metadata.Tafsir: (But when the Shout cometh) when the Hour comes, all created beings will scream and then submit and answer the call. Created being will be abased and know then that its advent is true.

translation: Then when there comes As-Sâkhkhah (the second blowing of the Trumpet on the Day of Resurrection)

metadata.arabic: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ
metadata.Tafsir: Allah then explained when this will happen, saying: (On the day when a man) the believer (fleeth from his brother) who is a disbeliever

translation: That Day shall a man flee from his brother,

metadata.arabic: وَأُمِّهِ وَأَبِيهِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And his mother) and will also flee from his mother (and his father

translation: And from his mother and his father,

metadata.arabic: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِ وَبَنِيهِ
metadata.Tafsir: And his wife and his children) it is also said this means: when Abel will flee from Cain, and Muhammad (pbuh) will flee from his mother Aminah, and Abraham from his father, and Lot from his wife Wa'ilah and Nuh from his son Canaan.

translation: And from his wife and his children.

metadata.arabic: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِىءٍ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَأْنٌ يُغْنِيهِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Every man that day) on the Day of Judgement (will have concern enough to make him heedless (of others)) to keep him preoccupied from others.

translation: Everyman that Day will have enough to make him careless of others.

metadata.arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُّسْفِرَةٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (On that day faces) the faces of the believers who are true in their faith (will be bright as dawn) will be blooming due to Allah's pleasure with them,

translation: Some faces that Day will be bright (true believers of Islâmic Monotheism),

metadata.arabic: ضَاحِكَةٌ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Laughing) pleased with Allah's bestowal of honour upon them, (rejoicing at good news) happy with Allah's reward;

translation: Laughing, rejoicing at good news (of Paradise).

metadata.arabic: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (And other faces) the faces of the hypocrites and disbelievers, (on that day) on the Day of Judgement, (with dust upon them,

translation: And other faces, that Day, will be dust-stained.

metadata.arabic: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ
metadata.Tafsir: Veiled in darkness) gloomy and dark,

translation: Darkness will cover them.

metadata.arabic: أُوْلَـٰئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَفَرَةُ ٱلْفَجَرَةُ
metadata.Tafsir: (Those) with such a trait (are the disbelievers) in Allah, (the wicked) the liars against Allah'.

translation: Such will be the Kafarah (disbelievers in Allâh, in His Oneness, and in His Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم, etc.), the Fajarah (wicked evil doers).

metadata.arabic: إِذَا ٱلشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ
metadata.Tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (When the sun is overthrown): '(When the sun is overthrown) it is also said that He says: when the sun is turned around as one turns a turban and is then thrown into the veil of light; it is also said this means: when the light of the sun vanishes.

translation: When the sun is wound round and its light is lost and is overthrown.

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتْ
metadata.Tafsir: (And when the stars fall) on the face of the earth,

translation: And when the stars fall.

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ
metadata.Tafsir: (And when the hills are moved) from above the surface of the earth

translation: And when the mountains are made to pass away;

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ
metadata.Tafsir: (And when the camels big with young are abandoned) because they are preoccupied with their own selves,

translation: And when the pregnant she-camels are neglected;

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ
metadata.Tafsir: (And when the wild beasts are herded together) for retaliation; and it is also said this means: when they are dead,

translation: And when the wild beasts are gathered together.

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ
metadata.Tafsir: (And when the seas rise) and mix with each other, the sweet seas and the salty seas, such that they become one sea; and it is also said this means: when they become a burning site,

translation: And when the seas become as blazing Fire or overflow.

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ
metadata.Tafsir: (And when souls are reunited) in pairs; it is also said this means: when souls are reunited with their companions: the believer with the maiden of Paradise and the disbeliever with Satan; the righteous with the righteous and the sinful with the sinful,

translation: And when the souls are joined with their bodies, (the good with the good and the bad with the bad).

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْمَوْءُودَةُ سُئِلَتْ
metadata.Tafsir: (And when the girl child that was buried alive is asked) i.e. when she asks her father

translation: And when the female (infant) buried alive (as the pagan Arabs used to do) is questioned:

metadata.arabic: بِأَىِّ ذَنبٍ قُتِلَتْ
metadata.Tafsir: (For what sin she was slain) for what sin did you kill me; it is also said that this means: when the one who killed her is asked: for what sin did you kill her,

translation: For what sin, was she killed?

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ
metadata.Tafsir: (And when the pages) the registers of good and bad deeds (are laid open) for reckoning; it is also said this means: when they fly about in people's hands,

translation: And when the (written) pages [of deeds (good and bad) of every person] are laid open.

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتْ
metadata.Tafsir: (And when the sky is torn away,

translation: And when the heaven is stripped off and taken away from its place;

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ
metadata.Tafsir: And when hell is lighted) for the disbelievers

translation: And when Hell-fire is set ablaze.

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ
metadata.Tafsir: (And when the Garden is brought nigh) for the believers

translation: And when Paradise is brought near.

metadata.arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّآ أَحْضَرَتْ
metadata.Tafsir: ((Then) every soul will know) every soul whether it is righteous or sinful will know at that point (what it hath made ready) what it has sent forth of good or evil.

translation: (Then) every person will know what he has brought (of good and evil).

metadata.arabic: فَلاَ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلْخُنَّسِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Oh, but I call to witness) He says: I swear by (the planets) which appear at night and disappear during the day,

translation: So verily, I swear by the planets that recede (i.e. disappear during the day and appear during the night).

metadata.arabic: ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْكُنَّسِ
metadata.Tafsir: (The stars which rise and set) they move at night in the galaxy sweeping away the day and then go back to their positions and disappear; the reference here is to five planets: Venus, Saturn, Mars, Jupiter, and Mercury;

translation: And by the planets that move swiftly and hide themselves.

metadata.arabic: وَٱللَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And the close of night,

translation: And by the night as it departs.

metadata.arabic: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
metadata.Tafsir: And the breath of morning) and when the morning and brightens come; Allah swore by all these

translation: And by the dawn as it brightens.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (That this) i.e. the Qur'an (is in truth the word of an honoured messenger) Allah says: it is brought down by Gabriel to a messenger who is honoured by Allah, i.e. Muhammad (pbuh)

translation: Verily, this is the Word (this Qur’ân brought by) a most honourable messenger [Jibrîl (Gabrîl), from Allâh to Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم].

metadata.arabic: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِي ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Mighty) against his enemies, i.e. Gabriel, (established in the presence of the Lord of the Throne) he has standing and esteem with his Lord,

translation: Owner of power, (and high rank) with (Allâh), the Lord of the Throne,

metadata.arabic: مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ
metadata.Tafsir: ((One) to be obeyed) i.e. Gabriel is obeyed in Heaven: the angels obey him, (and trustworthy) in conveying the message to the prophets;

translation: Obeyed (by the angels in the heavens), and trustworthy.

metadata.arabic: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُمْ بِمَجْنُونٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And your comrade) your Prophet Muhammad, O Quraysh (is not mad) bewitched as you claim.

translation: And (O people) your companion (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is not a madman.

metadata.arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَآهُ بِٱلأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Surely he beheld him) Muhammad (s)aw Gabriel (on the clear horizon) on the high setting of the sun.

translation: And indeed he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) saw him [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] in the clear horizon (towards the east).

metadata.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And he is not) i.e. Muhammad (pbuh) (avid of the Unseen) he is accused with regard to the revelation; and it is also said this means: he is not avaricious.

translation: And he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) withholds not a knowledge of the Unseen.

metadata.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَانٍ رَّجِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Nor is this) i.e. the Qur'an (the utterance of a devil worthy to be stoned) the utterance of an accursed, rebellious devil whose name is al-Marmi.

translation: And it (the Qur’ân) is not the word of the outcast Shaitân (Satan).

metadata.arabic: فَأيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Whither then go ye) from Allah's chastisement, commands and prohibitions, O disbelievers? It is also said this means: why do you lie? And it is also said this means: why do you deviate from the Qur'an and refuse to believe in it?

translation: Then where are you going?

metadata.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلاَّ ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَالَمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (This is) i.e. the Qur'an (naught else than a reminder) an admonition from Allah (unto creation) the jinn and humankind,

translation: Verily, this (the Qur’ân) is no less than a Reminder to (all) the ‘Âlamîn (mankind and jinn)

metadata.arabic: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Unto whomsoever of you willeth to walk straight) to whoever wills to conform to the commands of Allah: the belief in Allah's divine Oneness and other things.

translation: To whomsoever among you who wills to walk straight.

metadata.arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلاَّ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And ye will not) conform with or believe in Allah's divine Oneness, (unless (it be) that Allah willeth) it for you, (the Lord of Creation) the Lord of all that which has a soul and creeps on the face of the earth, from the inhabitants of the heaven and of the earth'.

translation: And you cannot will unless (it be) that Allâh wills - the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

metadata.arabic: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
metadata.Tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (When the heaven is cleft asunder): '(When the heaven is cleft asunder) by the descent of the Lord-a descent without modality-and the angels and whatever He wills of His command,

translation: When the heaven is cleft asunder.

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
metadata.Tafsir: (When the planets are dispersed) on the face of the earth,

translation: And when the stars have fallen and scattered.

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
metadata.Tafsir: (When the seas are poured forth) into each other, the sweet into the salty, such that they become one sea,

translation: And when the seas are burst forth.

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
metadata.Tafsir: (And the sepulchres are overturned) the dead in them are taken out,

translation: And when the graves are turned upside down (and bring out their contents)

metadata.arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
metadata.Tafsir: (A soul) every soul at that point (will know what it hath sent before (it)) of good or evil (and what left behind) of good or evil wont; it is also said this means: it will know the acts of obedience it offered and those it missed.

translation: (Then) a person will know what he has sent forward and (what he has) left behind (of good or bad deeds).

metadata.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: (O man!) i.e. O disbelieving man; here referring specifically to Kildah Ibn Usayd (What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord) when you disbelieved in Him, (the Bountiful) the Forgiving,

translation: O man! What has made you careless about your Lord, the Most Generous?

metadata.arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّاكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Who created thee) a living being from a sperm drop, (then fashioned) in the womb of your mother, (then proportioned thee) then made your stature erect?

translation: Who created you, fashioned you perfectly, and gave you due proportion.

metadata.arabic: فِيۤ أَيِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee) if He wills He makes you resemble your paternal or maternal uncles, He can make you handsome or ugly; and if He wills He can turn you into the form of an ape or swine, or the like of them.

translation: In whatever form He willed, He put you together.

metadata.arabic: كَلاَّ بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Nay) truly, (but they) the Quraysh (deny the Judgement) and the Reckoning.

translation: Nay! But you deny Ad-Dîn (i.e. the Day of Recompense).

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَافِظِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! there are above you guardians) among the angels who guard and preserve your works,

translation: But verily, over you (are appointed angels in charge of mankind) to watch you,

metadata.arabic: كِرَاماً كَاتِبِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Generous) who are honoured in the sight of Allah and completely surrendered to Him (and recording) they record your works,

translation: Kirâman (Honourable) Kâtibîn writing down (your deeds),

metadata.arabic: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Who know (all) that ye do) and say of good and evil and record all of it.

translation: They know all that you do.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلأَبْرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! the righteous) who are true in their faith: Abu Bakr and his believing brothers (verily will be in delight) in the Garden whose bliss is everlasting.

translation: Verily, the Abrâr (the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism) will be in Delight (Paradise);

metadata.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِي جَحِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And lo! the wicked) Kildah and his fellow disbelievers (verily will be in hell;

translation: And verily, the Fujjâr (the wicked, disbelievers, polytheists, sinners and evil-doers) will be in the blazing Fire (Hell),

metadata.arabic: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
metadata.Tafsir: They will burn therein) they will enter the Fire (on the Day of Judgement) on the Day of Reckoning and Judgement between created beings,

translation: Therein they will enter, and taste its burning flame on the Day of Recompense,

metadata.arabic: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And will not) i.e. the disbelievers (be absent thence) whence they enter it.

translation: And they (Al-Fujjâr) will not be absent therefrom.

metadata.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Ah, what will convey unto thee) O Muhammad (what the Day of Judgement is!) what is the Day of Reckoning. (Again, what will convey unto thee) O Muhammad

translation: And what will make you know what the Day of Recompense is?

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (what the Day of Judgement is!) what the Day of Reckoning is. He said this to arouse his astonishment, in order to magnify such a Day.

translation: Again, what will make you know what the Day of Recompense is?

metadata.arabic: يَوْمَ لاَ تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِنَفْسٍ شَيْئاً وَٱلأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلَّهِ
metadata.Tafsir: Allah the explained to him, saying: (A day on which no soul) no believing soul (hath power at all) no power to save or intercede (for any (other) soul) for any disbelieving soul. (The (absolute) command) sentencing and judging between people (on that day is Allah's) is in Allah's hands; none other than Him has that in his power and none will challenge Him about it'.

translation: (It will be) the Day when no person shall have power (to do) anything for another, and the Decision, that Day, will be (wholly) with Allâh.

metadata.arabic: وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying: (Woe unto the defrauders): '(Woe) severe punishment (unto the defrauders) in weighing and measurement; this refers to the people of Medina who used to cheat in weighing and measurement before the coming of the Prophet (pbuh) and so this surah was revealed to the Prophet (pbuh) on his way when he was migrating to Medina:

translation: Woe to Al-Mutaffifûn (those who give less in measure and weight).

metadata.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: Allah then explained who these defrauders are, saying: (Those who when they take the measure from mankind) those who, when they buy from people and weigh or measure that which they buy for themselves, (demand it full) they weigh and measure their merchandise in full,

translation: Those who, when they have to receive by measure from men, demand full measure,

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَوْ وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (But if they measure unto them) but when they measure for others (or weigh for them, they cause them loss) they decrease the measurement or the weight and behave very badly; it is also said that the above means: severe punishment on that day is unto the defrauders in the prayer, the poor-due, fasting and other acts of worship.

translation: And when they have to give by measure or weight to (other) men, give less than due.

metadata.arabic: أَلا يَظُنُّ أُوْلَـٰئِكَ أَنَّهُمْ مَّبْعُوثُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Do such (men)) those who deal in fraud in weight and measurement (not consider) not know and believe (that they will be raised again) brought back to life

translation: Do they not think that they will be resurrected (for reckoning),

metadata.arabic: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: Unto an awful Day) the Day of Judgement whose horrors are great,

translation: On a Great Day?

metadata.arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (The day when (all) mankind stand) after emerging from the graves (before the Lord of the Worlds) the Lord of every living being who walks on the earth and the Lord of the dwellers of heaven? When the Prophet (pbuh) read to them this surah, they repented and started giving full weight and measurement.

translation: The Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)?

metadata.arabic: كَلاَّ إِنَّ كِتَابَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Nay) truly, O Muhammad, (but the record of the vile) the works of the disbelievers (is in Sijjin

translation: Nay! Truly, the Record (writing of the deeds) of the Fujjâr (disbelievers, polytheists, sinners, evil-doers and the wicked) is (preserved) in Sijjîn.

metadata.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَاكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ
metadata.Tafsir: Ah! what will convey unto thee what Sijjin is) what is in Sijjin! This is mentioned by way of aggrandizement of Sijjin.

translation: And what will make you know what Sijjîn is?

metadata.arabic: كِتَابٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (A written record) He says: the works of the children of Adam are written on a green rock under the seventh earth; this is Sijjin.

translation: A Register inscribed.

metadata.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) unto the deniers of faith and the resurrection (on that day) the Day of Judgement!

translation: Woe, that Day, to those who deny.

metadata.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Those who deny the Day of Judgement) and the Reckoning which will take place in it

translation: Those who deny the Day of Recompense.

metadata.arabic: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِ إِلاَّ كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Which none denieth) i.e. none denies the Day of Judgement (save each criminal transgressor) save each sinful and unjust person who transgresses against the Truth, such as al-Walid Ibn al-Mughirah al-Makhzumi,

translation: And none can deny it except every transgressor beyond bounds, (in disbelief, oppression and disobedience to Allâh) the sinner!

metadata.arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ آيَاتُنَا قَالَ أَسَاطِيرُ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Who, when thou readest unto him) unto al-Walid Ibn al-Mughirah (Our revelations) the Qur'an explaining the commands and prohibitions, (saith: (Mere) fables of the men of old) this is nothing but the lies and idle talk of the people of old.

translation: When Our Verses (of the Qur’ân) are recited to him he says: "Tales of the ancients!"

metadata.arabic: كَلاَّ بَلْ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ مَّا كَانُواْ يَكْسِبُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Nay) truly, O Muhammad, (but that which they have earned) which they have done and said in their state of idolatry (is rust upon their hearts) Allah has sealed the hearts of those who disbelieve in the Day of Judgement; it is also said that the accumulation of sins blackens the heart and this is what is meant by the rust of hearts.

translation: Nay! But on their hearts is the Rân (covering of sins and evil deeds) which they used to earn.

metadata.arabic: كَلاَّ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Nay) truly, O Muhammad, (but surely on that day) the Day of Judgement (they) i.e. the deniers of the Day of Judgement (will be covered from (the mercy of) their Lord) they will be prevented from beholding their Lord while the believers will behold Him.

translation: Nay! Surely they (evil-doers) will be veiled from seeing their Lord that Day.

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُواْ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then lo! they verily will burn in hell) then they will enter the Fire,

translation: Then, verily, they will indeed enter (and taste) the burning flame of Hell.

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And it will be said (unto them)) the keepers of hell will say to them when they enter it: (This is that which ye used to deny) this is the chastisement which you used to claim it will never happen.

translation: Then, it will be said to them: "This is what you used to deny!"

metadata.arabic: كَلاَّ إِنَّ كِتَابَ ٱلأَبْرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Nay) truly, O Muhammad, (but the record of the righteous) the works of those who are true in their faith (is in 'Illiyyin

translation: Nay! Verily, the Record (writing of the deeds) of Al-Abrâr (the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism) is (preserved) in ‘Illiyyûn

metadata.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَاكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
metadata.Tafsir: Ah, what will convey unto thee) O Muhammad (what 'Illiyyin is!) what is in 'Illiyyin.

translation: And what will make you know what ‘Illiyyûn is?

metadata.arabic: كِتَابٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (A written record) it is said that the works of the righteous are written on tablets made of green chrysolite which are placed above the seventh heaven below the Throne of the Beneficent; this is 'Illiyyin,

translation: A Register inscribed,

metadata.arabic: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Attested by those who are brought near (unto their Lord)) the works of the righteous are attested by the dwellers of heaven who are near their Lord.

translation: To which bear witness those nearest (to Allâh, i.e. the angels).

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلأَبْرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! the righteous) those who are true in their faith, and these are the ones who do not harm even the tiniest ant (verily are in delight) in Paradise whose bliss is everlasting,

translation: Verily, Al-Abrâr (the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism) will be in Delight (Paradise).

metadata.arabic: عَلَى ٱلأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (On couches) in curtained canopies, (gazing) looking at the inhabitants of the Fire,

translation: On thrones, looking (at all things).

metadata.arabic: تَعْرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Thou wilt know) O Muhammad (in their faces) the faces of the inhabitants of Paradise (the radiance of delight

translation: You will recognise in their faces the brightness of delight.

metadata.arabic: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍ مَّخْتُومٍ
metadata.Tafsir: They are given to drink) in Paradise (of a pure wine, sealed) mixed,

translation: They will be given to drink of pure sealed wine.

metadata.arabic: خِتَامُهُ مِسْكٌ وَفِي ذَلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَافِسُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Whose seal) whose end result (is musk. For this) for what I have mentioned (let (all) those who strive for bliss) let those who work and those who strive and those who hasten and those who take the initiative take the initiative.

translation: The last thereof (that wine) will be the smell of Musk, and for this let (all) those strive who want to strive (i.e. hasten earnestly to the obedience of Allah).

metadata.arabic: وَمِزَاجُهُ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And mixed with water of Tasnim,

translation: It (that wine) will be mixed with Tasnîm:

metadata.arabic: عَيْناً يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: A spring) gushing forth for them from the Garden of Eden (whence those brought near to Allah drink) those who are near to the Garden of Eden drink from the spring of Tasnim.

translation: A spring whereof drink those nearest to Allâh.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُواْ كَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ يَضْحَكُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! the guilty) the idolaters, Abu Jahl and his host (used to laugh at those who believed) used to mock and poke fun at 'Ali and his fellow believers,

translation: Verily, (during the worldly life) those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا مَرُّواْ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And wink one to another) they slander the believers (when they passed them) when the believers passed the disbelievers in their way to the Messenger of Allah (pbuh);

translation: And, whenever they passed by them, used to wink one to another (in mockery).

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوۤاْ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُواْ فَكِهِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And when they) the disbelievers (returned to their own folk, they returned jesting) they returned happy with their idolatry and mocking the believers;

translation: And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting;

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوۤاْ إِنَّ هَـٰؤُلاَءِ لَضَالُّونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And when they saw them) and when they saw the Companions of the Prophet (pbuh) (they said) i.e. the disbelievers said: (Lo! These) the Companions of the Prophet (pbuh) (have gone astray) from true guidance.

translation: And when they saw them, they said: "Verily these have indeed gone astray!"

metadata.arabic: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُواْ عَلَيْهِمْ حَافِظِينَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Yet they were not sent) they were not set upon the believers (as guardians over them) as guardians over them or over their works.

translation: But they (disbelievers, sinners) had not been sent as watchers over them (the believers).

metadata.arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (This day) which is the Day of Judgement (it is those who believe) in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an: i.e. 'Ali and his fellow believers (who have the laugh of disbelievers) who will laugh at the disbelievers,

translation: But this Day (the Day of Resurrection) those who believe will laugh at the disbelievers

metadata.arabic: عَلَى ٱلأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (On high couches) in curtained canopies, (gazing) looking at the people of the Fire being dragged therein.

translation: On (high) thrones, looking (at all things).

metadata.arabic: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُواْ يَفْعَلُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Are not the disbelievers paid) rewarded in the Hereafter (for what they used to do) except for what they used to do and say in the life of the world?'

translation: Are not the disbelievers paid (fully) for what they used to do?

metadata.arabic: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
metadata.Tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (When the heaven is split asunder): '(When the heaven is split asunder) by the clouds because of the descent of the Lord-a descent without any modality-and the angels and whatever Allah wills of His command.

translation: When the heaven is split asunder,

metadata.arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
metadata.Tafsir: (And attentive) and it obeys and listens (to her Lord in fear) and it befits her to do so,

translation: And listens to and obeys its Lord - and it must do so.

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
metadata.Tafsir: (And when the earth is spread out) like the spreading out of a flat plain; and it is also said this means: when the earth is removed from its place and then flattened.

translation: And when the earth is stretched forth,

metadata.arabic: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
metadata.Tafsir: (And hath cast out all that was in her) of corpses and treasures, (and is empty) from all of that

translation: And has cast out all that was in it and became empty.

metadata.arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
metadata.Tafsir: (And attentive) and obeys and listens (to her Lord in fear!) and it behoves her do so.

translation: And listens to and obeys its Lord - and it must do so.

metadata.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحاً فَمُلاَقِيهِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Thou, verily, O man) O disbelieving man, in reference to Abu'l-Aswad Ibn Kildah Ibn Usayd Ibn Khalaf, (art working) He says: you are working something in your state of disbelief and shall return with it (towards thy Lord) in the Hereafter (a work which you will meet (in His presence)) whether your work is righteous or evil.

translation: O man! Verily, you are returning towards your Lord with your deeds and actions (good or bad), a sure returning, and you will meet (the results of your deeds which you did).

metadata.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَـٰبَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then whoso is given his account) the account of his good works (in his right hand) in reference here to Abu Salamah Ibn 'Abd al-Asad

translation: Then as for him who will be given his Record in his right hand,

metadata.arabic: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَاباً يَسِيراً
metadata.Tafsir: (He truly will receive an easy reckoning) this refers to his parade before Allah

translation: He surely will receive an easy reckoning,

metadata.arabic: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِ مَسْرُوراً
metadata.Tafsir: (And will return) in the Hereafter (unto his folk) whom Allah prepared for him in Paradise (in joy) with them.

translation: And will return to his family in joy!

metadata.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِ
metadata.Tafsir: (But whoso is given his account) the account of his evil deeds (behind his back) in his left hand, referring here to al-Aswad Ibn 'Abd al-Asad, the brother of Abu Salamah,

translation: But whosoever is given his Record behind his back,

metadata.arabic: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُواْ ثُبُوراً
metadata.Tafsir: (He surely will invoke destruction

translation: He will invoke (for his) destruction,

metadata.arabic: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيراً
metadata.Tafsir: And be thrown to scorching fire.

translation: And he shall enter a blazing Fire, and be made to taste its burning.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّهُ كَانَ فِيۤ أَهْلِهِ مَسْرُوراً
metadata.Tafsir: He verily lived joyous with his folk) he was happy with his folk,

translation: Verily, he was among his people in joy!

metadata.arabic: إِنَّهُ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
metadata.Tafsir: (He verily deemed that he would never return (unto Allah)) in the Hereafter.

translation: Verily, he thought that he would never come back (to Us)!

metadata.arabic: بَلَىٰ إِنَّ رَبَّهُ كَانَ بِهِ بَصِيراً
metadata.Tafsir: (Nay, but lo! his Lord) when He created him (is ever looking on him!) knew that He will raise him again after death

translation: Yes! Verily, his Lord has been ever beholding him!

metadata.arabic: فَلاَ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Oh, I swear by the afterglow of sunset,

translation: So I swear by the afterglow of sunset;

metadata.arabic: وَٱللَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
metadata.Tafsir: And by the night and all that it enshroudeth) and I swear by the night and that which returns to its place when the night falls,

translation: And by the night and whatever it gathers in its darkness,

metadata.arabic: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And by the moon when she is at the full) for three nights: the nights of the thirteenth, fourteenth and fifteenth of the lunar month

translation: And by the moon when it is at the full.

metadata.arabic: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقاً عَن طَبقٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (That ye shall journey) the whole creation shall be transformed (on from plane to plane) from one state to another; from the time He created them until the time they die, and from the time they die until they enter either Paradise or hell: in all these times Allah transforms them from one state to another; it is also said that this means: you shall journey, O Muhammad, from one heaven to another on the day of the ascent; and it is also said that this means: this denier will go from one state to another, from the time he dies until he enters the Fire.

translation: You shall certainly travel from stage to stage (in this life and in the Hereafter).

metadata.arabic: فَمَا لَهُمْ لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (What aileth them) the disbelievers of Mecca; and it is said this refers to the three sons of 'Abd Yalayl al-Thaqafi: Mas'ud, Habib and Rabi'ah, the last two had later on accepted Islam (then, that they believe not) in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an.

translation: What is the matter with them, that they believe not?

metadata.arabic: وَإِذَا قُرِىءَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْآنُ لاَ يَسْجُدُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And, when the Qur'an is recited unto them) and when Muhammad (pbuh) recites the Qur'an to them explaining the commands and prohibitions, (worship not (Allah)) do not submit to Allah by believing in Allah's divine Oneness?

translation: And when the Qur’ân is recited to them, they fall not prostrate.

metadata.arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يُكَذِّبُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Nay, but those who disbelieve) the disbelievers of Mecca and those among the sons of 'Abd Yalayl who did not believe (will deny) will disbelieve in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an;

translation: Nay, those who disbelieve belie (Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and whatever he brought, i.e. this Qur’ân and Islâmic Monotheism, etc.).

metadata.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And Allah knoweth best what they are hiding) and Allah knows best what they say and do; and it is also said this means: Allah knows best what they hear and hide in their hearts.

translation: And Allâh knows best what they gather (of good and bad deeds),

metadata.arabic: فَبَشِّرْهُمْ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (So give them) so give, O Muhammad, to those who disbelieve in Allah (tidings of a painful doom) whose pain will extend to their hearts on the Day of Badr as well as in the Hereafter,

translation: So announce to them a painful torment.

metadata.arabic: إِلاَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
metadata.Tafsir: Allah then exempted from these the believers, saying: (Save those who believe) in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an (and do good works) and do acts of obedience privately between themselves and their Lord, (for theirs is a reward) in Paradise (unfailing) undiminished and unblemished; it is also said this means: they will not be constantly reminded about the blessings bestowed upon them; and it is also said this means: their good deeds will not be decreased after they reach old age or after they die'.

translation: Save those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them is a reward that will never come to an end (i.e. Paradise).

metadata.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
metadata.Tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars): '(By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars) He says: Allah swears by the heaven which includes mansions of the stars; it is also said: He swears by the heaven which has mansions between heaven and earth; Allah knows that,

translation: By the heaven holding the big stars.

metadata.arabic: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And by the Promised Day) which is the Day of Judgement.

translation: And by the Promised Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection).

metadata.arabic: وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And by the witness) the day of Friday (and that whereunto he beareth testimony) the day of 'Arafah and it is said it is the day of immolation; it is also said that 'the witness' refers to the children of Adam while 'that whereunto he bears testimony' refers to the Day of Judgement; and it is also said that 'the witness' is Muhammad (pbuh) while 'that whereunto he bears testimony' is his community; Allah swore by all these things that His chastisement of those who disbelieve in Him is very severe,

translation: And by the Witnessing day (i.e. Friday), and by the Witnessed day [i.e. the day of ‘Arafât (Hajj) the ninth of Dhul-Hijjah];

metadata.arabic: قُتِلَ أَصْحَابُ ٱلأُخْدُودِ
metadata.Tafsir: ((Self-)destroyed were the owners of the ditch

translation: Cursed were the people of the Ditch (in the story of the Boy and the King).

metadata.arabic: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
metadata.Tafsir: Of the fuel-fed fire) slandered were the owners of the ditch; it is also said that they were believers who were killed by the disbelievers by means of fire in which they threw naphtha, oil and firewood,

translation: Of fire fed with fuel,

metadata.arabic: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (When they) i.e. the disbelievers (sat by it) by the ditch; and it is said: they sat on chairs when Allah burned them with the Fire,

translation: When they sat by it (fire),

metadata.arabic: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (And were themselves the witnesses) they used to testify that the believers were folk of error (of what they did to the believers) and it is said this means: they were present when they did this to the believers.

translation: And they witnessed what they were doing against the believers (i.e. burning them).

metadata.arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُواْ مِنْهُمْ إِلاَّ أَن يُؤْمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
metadata.Tafsir: (They had naught against them) against the believers nor did they find any fault with them (save that they believed in Allah, the Mighty) in His retribution against those who disbelieve in Him, (the Owner of Praise) for those who believe in Him,

translation: And they had no fault except that they believed in Allâh, the All-Mighty, Worthy of all Praise!

metadata.arabic: ٱلَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Him unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty) the stores (of the heavens) rain (and the earth) plants; (and Allah is of all things the Witness) He is the Witness over their works.

translation: To Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth! And Allâh is Witness over everything.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُواْ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُواْ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! they who persecute) those who burn and torture with fire (believing men) men who are true in their faith (and believing women) who are true in their faith (and repent not) from their idolatry and disbelief, (theirs verily will be the doom of hell) in the Hereafter, (and theirs the doom of burning) in the Fire; and it is also said: in the life of the world, for Allah had burned them with the Fire. These were people from Najran, and it is said from Mosul, who tortured and consequently killed a group of believers with fire in attempt to make them renounce their religion. The name of the king of these people is Yusuf, and it is said his name is Dhu'l-Nuwas.

translation: Verily, those who put into trial the believing men and believing women (by torturing them and burning them), and then do not turn in repentance (to Allâh), then they will have the torment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the burning Fire.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلأَنْهَارُ ذَلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
metadata.Tafsir: Allah then mentioned the believers who did not renounce their religion despite being tortured, saying: (Lo! those who believe) in Allah (and do good works) privately between themselves and their Lord, (theirs will be Gardens beneath which) beneath its trees and habitations (rivers flow) rivers of wine, water, honey and milk flow. (That is the Great Success) they earned the Garden and were saved from the Fire.

translation: Verily, those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them will be Gardens under which rivers flow (Paradise). That is the great success.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! the punishment of thy Lord) the seizure of your Lord of those who disbelieve in Him (is stern.

translation: Verily, (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) the Seizure (punishment) of your Lord is severe and painful. [See V.11:102].

metadata.arabic: إِنَّهُ هُوَ يُبْدِىءُ وَيُعِيدُ
metadata.Tafsir: Lo! He it is Who produceth) He it is Who begins creation from a sperm drop, (then reproduceth) a new creation after death,

translation: Verily, He it is Who begins (punishment) and repeats (punishment in the Hereafter) (or originates the creation of everything, and then repeats it on the Day of Resurrection).

metadata.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ
metadata.Tafsir: (And He is the Forgiving) He forgives he who repents of disbelief and believes in Allah, (the Loving) He loves His friends; and it is also said this means: He loves those who obey Him,

translation: And He is Oft-Forgiving, full of love (towards the pious who are real true believers of Islâmic Monotheism),

metadata.arabic: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lord of the Throne of Glory) the good and fine Throne; and it is also said this means: Lord of the glorious Throne,

translation: Owner of the throne, the Glorious,

metadata.arabic: فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
metadata.Tafsir: (Doer of what He will) as He wills, He gives life and also takes it away.

translation: (He is the) Doer of whatsoever He intends (or wills).

metadata.arabic: هَلُ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Hath there come unto thee) O Muhammad-He asked His Prophet about this because He did not inform him about it before and then He did-(the story of the hosts

translation: Has the story reached you of the hosts,

metadata.arabic: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
metadata.Tafsir: Of Pharaoh and (the tribe of) Thamud) and of those before and after them, what We did to them when they disbelieved?

translation: Of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and Thamûd?

metadata.arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي تَكْذِيبٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Nay, but those who disbelieve) the disbelievers of Mecca (live in denial) of Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an.

translation: Nay! The disbelievers (persisted) in denying (Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and his Message of Islâmic Monotheism).

metadata.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِمْ مُّحِيطٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (And Allah, all unseen, surroundeth them) He says: He is Aware of them and of their works.

translation: And Allâh encompasses them from behind! (i.e. all their deeds are within His Knowledge, and He will requite them for their deeds).

metadata.arabic: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْآنٌ مَّجِيدٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Nay, but it) i.e. the Qur'an which Muhammad (pbuh) recites to you (is a glorious Qur'an) is a noble and honoured Qur'an

translation: Nay! This is a Glorious Qur’ân,

metadata.arabic: فِي لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوظٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (On a guarded tablet) He says: it is written on a tablet that is protected from the devils'.

translation: (Inscribed) in Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz (The Preserved Tablet)!

metadata.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
metadata.Tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said concerning the interpretation of Allah's saying (By the heaven and the Morning Star): '(By the heaven and the Morning Star) He says: Allah swears by the heaven and the morning star

translation: By the heaven, and At-Târiq (the night-comer, i.e. the bright star);

metadata.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَاكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
metadata.Tafsir: (Ah, what will tell thee) O Muhammad (what the Morning Star is!) this is to arouse his astonishment.

translation: And what will make you to know what At-Târiq (night-comer) is?

metadata.arabic: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
metadata.Tafsir: Allah then explained by saying: (The piercing Star!) the bright, piercing star; this refers to the planet Saturn which shines at night and disappears during the day.

translation: (It is) the star of piercing brightness;

metadata.arabic: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (No human soul) no believing or disbelieving soul-this is why Allah swore-(but hath a guardian over it) who record its words and deeds until he drives it into the grave.

translation: There is no human being but has a protector over him (or her) (i.e. angels in charge of each human being guarding him, writing his good and bad deeds)

metadata.arabic: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلإِنسَانُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
metadata.Tafsir: (So let man) Abu Talib (consider from what he is created) from what his soul is created.

translation: So let man see from what he is created!

metadata.arabic: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍ دَافِقٍ
metadata.Tafsir: Allah then explained, saying: (He is created from a gushing fluid) into the womb of a woman

translation: He is created from a water gushing forth,

metadata.arabic: يَخْرُجُ مِن بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
metadata.Tafsir: (That issued from between the loins) of a man (and ribs) the ribs of a woman.

translation: Proceeding from between the backbone and the ribs.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّهُ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِ لَقَادِرٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! He) i.e. Allah (verily is Able to return him (unto life)) He is able to return that fluid from whence it came and He is Able to bring him back after death and revive him.

translation: Verily, (Allâh) is Able to bring him back (to life)!

metadata.arabic: يَوْمَ تُبْلَىٰ ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
metadata.Tafsir: (On the day when hidden thoughts shall be searched out) when all the secrets that a person knows, and no one else other than him knows, become manifest.

translation: The Day when all the secrets (deeds, prayers, fasting, etc.) will be examined (as to their truth).

metadata.arabic: فَمَا لَهُ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلاَ نَاصِرٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then will he) Abu Talib (have no might) to defend himself (nor any helper) to shield him from Allah's chastisement.

translation: Then he will have no power, nor any helper.

metadata.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ
metadata.Tafsir: (By the heaven which giveth the returning rain) Allah swore by the heaven which accumulates clouds after cloud, year after year,

translation: By the sky (having rain clouds) which gives rain, again and again.

metadata.arabic: وَٱلأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And the earth which splitteth (with the growth of trees and plants)) and it is also said this means: and by the earth which has firm pillars

translation: And the earth which splits (with the growth of trees and plants).

metadata.arabic: إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ
metadata.Tafsir: This is the reason why Allah swore: (Lo! this (Qur'an) is a conclusive word) a true exposition; it is also said this means: it is a judgement from Allah,

translation: Verily, this (the Qur’ân) is the Word that separates (the truth from falsehood, and commands strict laws for mankind to cut the roots of evil).

metadata.arabic: وَمَا هوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ
metadata.Tafsir: (It is no pleasantry) it is no falsehood.

translation: And it is not a thing for amusement.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْداً
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! They) i.e. the people of Mecca (plot a plot (against thee, O Muhammad)) they scheme in their state of disbelief, that is to say they bar people from Muhammad (pbuh) and from the Qur'an; it is also said this means: they plan, in Dar al-Nadwah, to kill you, O Muhammad!

translation: Verily, they are but plotting a plot (against you O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم).

metadata.arabic: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْداً
metadata.Tafsir: (And I plot a plot (against them)) and I want to kill them, O Muhammad, on the Day of Badr.

translation: And I (too) am planning a plan.

metadata.arabic: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَافِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْداً
metadata.Tafsir: (So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal thou gently with them for a while) give them a while until the Day of Badr'.

translation: So give a respite to the disbelievers; deal gently with them for a while.

metadata.arabic: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلأَعْلَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said concerning the interpretation of Allah's saying (Praise the name of thy Lord the Most High): '(Praise the name of your Lord the Most High) He says: pray, O Muhammad, by the command of your Lord the Most High, Who is Higher than all things; it is also said that this means: remember, O Muhammad, the divine Oneness of your Lord; and it is said this means: say, O Muhammad, in your prostration “praise be to my Lord the Most High”,

translation: Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High,

metadata.arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (Who createth) every thing that has a soul, (then disposeth) He created them with two hands, two feet, two eyes, two ears and with other organs too;

translation: Who has created (everything), and then proportioned it.

metadata.arabic: وَٱلَّذِي قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (Who measureth) He made every male and female, (then guideth) then He made known and inspired how the male and female come; it is also said this means: He measured a person's creation, thus making him handsome or ugly, tall or short; it is also said this means: He measured felicity and wretchedness for His created beings, and so He made plain disbelief and faith, good and evil;

translation: And Who has measured (preordainments for everything even to be blessed or wretched); and then guided (i.e. showed mankind the right as well as the wrong paths, and guided the animals to pasture).

metadata.arabic: وَٱلَّذِيۤ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (Who bringeth forth the pasturage) green pasture by means of the rain,

translation: And Who brings out the pasturage,

metadata.arabic: فَجَعَلَهُ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (Then turneth it) after being green (to russet stubble) i.e. He makes it dry and black when it exceeds a year.

translation: And then makes it dark stubble.

metadata.arabic: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلاَ تَنسَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (We shall make thee read (O Muhammad)) We shall teach, O Muhammad, the Qur'an; it is also said this means: Gabriel shall read to you the Qur'an (so that thou shalt not forget

translation: We shall make you to recite (the Qur’ân), so you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) shall not forget (it),

metadata.arabic: إِلاَّ مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: Save that which Allah willeth) and Allah willed that you do not forget; and the Prophet (pbuh) never forgot a bit of the Qur'an after this. (Lo! He knoweth the disclosed) He knows the works that are done and the words that are said in the open (and that which still is hidden) of secrets which you have thought about in yourself;

translation: Except what Allâh may will. He knows what is apparent and what is hidden.

metadata.arabic: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (And We shall ease thy way unto the state of ease) We shall make easy for you the conveyance of the message and all other acts of obedience.

translation: And We shall make easy for you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) the easy way (i.e. the doing of righteous deeds).

metadata.arabic: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (Therefore remind (men)) admonish by means of the Qur'an and through Allah, (for of use is the reminder) He says: admonition by means of the Qur'an and through Allah does not benefit except he who fears Allah, i.e. the believer.

translation: Therefore remind (men) in case the reminder profits (them).

metadata.arabic: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (He will heed) he will take admonition by means of the Qur'an and through Allah (who feareth) Allah, i.e. the Muslim,

translation: The reminder will be received by him who fears (Allâh),

metadata.arabic: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلأَشْقَى
metadata.Tafsir: (But the most hapless) the damned, as it is in Allah's foreknowledge, (will flout it) will steer away and avoid taking admonition by means of the Qur'an or through Allah,

translation: But it will be avoided by the wretched,

metadata.arabic: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (He who will be flung to the great fire) he who will enter the Fire in the Hereafter, and there is no chastisement greater than the Fire

translation: Who will enter the great Fire (and will be made to taste its burning).

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ لاَ يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلاَ يَحْيَا
metadata.Tafsir: (Wherein) in the Fire (he will neither die) and thus be put out of his misery (nor live) a beneficial life.

translation: There he will neither die (to be in rest) nor live (a good living).

metadata.arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (He is successful) and saved (who groweth) he who takes admonition by means of the Qur'an and believes in Allah's divine Oneness,

translation: Indeed whosoever purifies himself (by avoiding polytheism and accepting Islâmic Monotheism) shall achieve success,

metadata.arabic: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِ فَصَلَّىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (And remembereth the name) the command (of his Lord) regarding the five daily prayers and other things, (so prayeth) the five daily prayers in congregation; this verse can also be understood to mean: he is successful and saved he who gives the charity of Fitr before going out to pray and mentions the name of his Lord saying " there is no deity save Allah " and upon going to prayer and returning from it says " Allah is the Most Great " and then prays the 'Id prayer with the Imam.

translation: And remembers (glorifies) the Name of his Lord (worships none but Allâh), and prays (five compulsory prayers and Nawâfil - additional prayers).

metadata.arabic: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَاةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
metadata.Tafsir: But ye prefer the life of the world) you chose to strive for the life of the world and preferred the reward of the life of the world to the reward of the Hereafter.

translation: Nay, you prefer the life of this world,

metadata.arabic: وَٱلآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (Although the Hereafter) striving for the Hereafter and the reward of the Hereafter (is better) than striving for the life of the world and reward of the life of the world (and more lasting.

translation: Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَفِي ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلأُولَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: Lo! This) from His saying: (He is Successful) up to here (is in the former scrolls) in the Scriptures of the people of old,

translation: Verily, this is in the former Scriptures -

metadata.arabic: صُحُفِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (The Book of Abraham and Moses) the Scripture of Moses is the Torah and only Allah knows about the Scripture of Abraham'.

translation: The Scriptures of Ibrâhîm (Abraham) and Mûsâ (Moses) (عليهما السلام).

metadata.arabic: هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْغَاشِيَةِ
metadata.Tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said concerning the interpretation of Allah's saying (Hath there come unto you): '(Hath there come unto you) He says: it has not come unto you, O Muhammad, before but now it has; it is also said that this means: it has come unto you (tidings of the Overwhelming) the news of the coming of the Hour? It is also said the Overwhelming refers to the Fire overwhelming its dwellers.

translation: Has there come to you the narration of the overwhelming (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)?

metadata.arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَاشِعَةٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (On that day) the Day of Judgement ((many) faces) the faces of the disbelievers and hypocrites (will be downcast) abased because of the chastisement,

translation: Some faces, that Day will be humiliated (in the Hell-fire, i.e. the faces of all disbelievers, Jews and Christians).

metadata.arabic: عَامِلَةٌ نَّاصِبَةٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Toiling) dragged in the Fire, (weary) in tiredness and strife; it is also said this means: toiling in the life of the world, weary in the Hereafter, this refers to the Christian monks and anchorites, and it is also said it refers to the Kharijites.

translation: Labouring (hard in the worldly life by worshipping others besides Allâh), weary (in the Hereafter with humility and disgrace).

metadata.arabic: تَصْلَىٰ نَاراً حَامِيَةً
metadata.Tafsir: (Scorched by burning fire) they enter the Fire whose heat is extreme,

translation: They will enter in the hot blazing Fire.

metadata.arabic: تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ آنِيَةٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Drinking) in the Fire (from a boiling spring),

translation: They will be given to drink from a boiling spring,

metadata.arabic: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلاَّ مِن ضَرِيعٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (No food for them) in those abysmal pits (save bitter thorn fruit) the shabraq plant which grows in the roads of Mecca, which is eaten by camels when it is soft but when it is hard it becomes like the claws of cats.

translation: No food will there be for them but a poisonous thorny plant,

metadata.arabic: لاَّ يُسْمِنُ وَلاَ يُغْنِي مِن جُوعٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Which doth not nourish nor release from hunger) when one eats it.

translation: Which will neither nourish nor avail against hunger.

metadata.arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاعِمَةٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (In that day other faces) the faces of true believers (will be calm) beautiful and radiant,

translation: (Other) faces that Day will be joyful,

metadata.arabic: لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Glad for their effort past) He says: they are pleased with the reward of their works,

translation: Glad with their endeavour (for their good deeds which they did in this world, along with the true Faith of Islâmic Monotheism).

metadata.arabic: فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (In a high Garden) in a high rank

translation: In a lofty Paradise.

metadata.arabic: لاَّ تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لاَغِيَةً
metadata.Tafsir: (Where) in Paradise (they hear no idle speech) any oath whether it is true or false,

translation: Where they shall neither hear harmful speech nor falsehood.

metadata.arabic: فِيهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Wherein) in Paradise (is a gushing spring) gushing with goodness, grace and mercy for them,

translation: Therein will be a running spring.

metadata.arabic: فِيهَا سُرُرٌ مَّرْفُوعَةٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Wherein) in Paradise (are couches raised) in the air for as long as its owners are away; it is also said that they are raised for its people.

translation: Therein will be thrones raised high.

metadata.arabic: وَأَكْوَابٌ مَّوْضُوعَةٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (And goblets) round goblets that do not have handles, ears or nooses (set at hand) in their dwellings.

translation: And cups set at hand.

metadata.arabic: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (And cushions ranged) against each other.

translation: And cushions set in rows.

metadata.arabic: وَزَرَابِيُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (And silken carpets spread) for its owners.

translation: And rich carpets (all) spread out.

metadata.arabic: أَفَلاَ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلإِبْلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
metadata.Tafsir: When the Prophet (pbuh) informed them of this, the disbelievers of Mecca said: " Bring us a sign to prove that Allah has sent you to us as a Messenger ". Therefore Allah said: (Will they not regard the camels, how they are created) with their strength and power, carrying burdens that no one else can carry?

translation: Do they not look at the camels, how they are created?

metadata.arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
metadata.Tafsir: (And the heaven, how it is raised) how it is raised above creation, and no one can touch it?

translation: And at the heaven, how it is raised?

metadata.arabic: وَإِلَىٰ ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
metadata.Tafsir: (And the hills, how they are set up) on earth, unmoved?

translation: And at the mountains, how they are rooted (and fixed firm)?

metadata.arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
metadata.Tafsir: (And the earth, how it is spread) over water? All these are signs for them.

translation: And at the earth, how it is outspread?

metadata.arabic: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (Remind them) admonish them, (for thou art but a remembrancer) you are but a warner by means of the Qur'an; it is also said that this means: you are only an admonisher by the Qur'an and through Allah,

translation: So remind them (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) - you are only one who reminds.

metadata.arabic: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Thou art not) O Muhammad (at all a warder over them) you are not imposed on them such that you force them to accept faith.

translation: You are not a dictator over them -

metadata.arabic: إِلاَّ مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
metadata.Tafsir: Later on, Allah commanded him to fight them, saying: (But whoso is averse and disbelieveth) except he who turns away from faith and disbelieves in Allah,

translation: Save the one who turns away and disbelieves.

metadata.arabic: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلأَكْبَرَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Allah will punish him) in the Hereafter (with direst punishment) i.e. with the punishment of the Fire.

translation: Then Allâh will punish him with the greatest punishment.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! unto Us is their return) in the Hereafter.

translation: Verily, to Us will be their return;

metadata.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُمْ
metadata.Tafsir: (And Ours their reckoning) their steadfastness in the life of the world and reward and punishment in the Hereafter'.

translation: Then verily, for Us will be their reckoning.

metadata.arabic: وَٱلْفَجْرِ
metadata.Tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said concerning the interpretation of Allah's saying (By the Dawn): '(By the Dawn) He says: He swears by the dawn which is the breaking of day; it is also said it is the whole day; and it is also said that this refers to the dawn of the year.

translation: By the dawn;

metadata.arabic: وَلَيالٍ عَشْرٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (And ten nights) the first ten nights of Dhu'l-Hijjah,

translation: By the ten nights (i.e. the first ten days of the month of Dhul-Hijjah),

metadata.arabic: وَٱلشَّفْعِ وَٱلْوَتْرِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And the Even) the day of 'Arafah and the day of immolation (and the Odd) three days after the day of immolation; it is also said that the Even refers to all prayers which are made of an even number of units: two or four units of prayer-the Subh, Zuhr, 'Asr and 'Isha' prayers-while the Odd refers to the prayers which consists of an odd number of units of prayer such as the Maghrib and Witr prayers; it is also said that the Even refers to Heaven and earth, the life of the world and the Hereafter, Paradise and hell, the Throne and the Stool, the sun and the moon, while the Odd refers to everything that is odd in number; it is also said that the Even refers to the male and female, disbeliever and believer, the sincere and hypocrite, the righteous and the sinful, while the Odd refers to Allah.

translation: And by the even and the odd (of all the creations of Allâh).

metadata.arabic: وَٱلَّيلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And the night when it departeth) this refers to the night of Muzdalifah; it is also said this means: the night in which people come and go; Allah swore by all these things that: your Lord, O Muhammad, is ever Watchful. He says:

translation: And by the night when it departs.

metadata.arabic: هَلْ فِي ذَلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (There) in that which I have mentioned (surely is an oath for thinking man.

translation: There is indeed in them (the above oaths) sufficient proofs for men of understanding (and that, they should avoid all kinds of sins and disbeliefs)!

metadata.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
metadata.Tafsir: Dost thou not consider) have you not been informed, O Muhammad, in the Qur'an (how thy Lord dealt with (the tribe of) 'Aad) the people of Hud, how Allah, Exalted is He, destroyed them when they disbelieved,

translation: Saw you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) not how your Lord dealt with ‘Âd (people)

metadata.arabic: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلْعِمَادِ
metadata.Tafsir: (With many columned) powerful (Iram) the son of Iram; Iram is Shem son of Noah who had a son called Shim and the later had a son called Ham who himself had a son called 'Aad,

translation: Of Iram (who were very tall) like (lofty) pillars,

metadata.arabic: ٱلَّتِي لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِي ٱلْبِلاَدِ
metadata.Tafsir: (The like of which was not created in the lands) the like of their strength and height were not created in the land; it is also said that Iram is the name of a town built by Shadid and Shaddad whose columns were of gold and silver and the like of its beauty was not created in the land;

translation: The like of which were not created in the land?

metadata.arabic: وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُواْ ٱلصَّخْرَ بِٱلْوَادِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And with (the tribe of) Thamud) He says: and how He destroyed Thamud, the people of Salih, (who clove the rocks in the valley) of Qura;

translation: And (with) Thamûd (people), who hewed out rocks in the valley (to make dwellings)?

metadata.arabic: وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِى ٱلأَوْتَادِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And with Pharaoh) and how He destroyed Pharaoh, (firm of right) Pharaoh erected four pillars to which he tied and tortured anyone with whom he was angry until the latter died, as he did with his wife Asiyah Bint Muzahim,

translation: And (with) Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) who had the stakes (to torture men by binding them to the stakes)?

metadata.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوْاْ فِي ٱلْبِلاَدِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Who (all) were rebellious (to Allah) in these lands) they rebelled and declared their disbelief in the land of Egypt; it is also said that their transgression led them to this,

translation: Who did transgress beyond bounds in the lands (in the disobedience of Allâh).

metadata.arabic: فَأَكْثَرُواْ فِيهَا ٱلْفَسَادَ
metadata.Tafsir: (And multiplied iniquity) and multiplied killing innocent people and spread their idol worship (therein) in the land of Egypt?

translation: And made therein much mischief.

metadata.arabic: فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ
metadata.Tafsir: (Therefore thy Lord poured on them the disaster of His punishment) your Lord sent on them a severe punishment.

translation: So your Lord poured on them different kinds of severe torment.

metadata.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ
metadata.Tafsir: (Lo! thy Lord) O Muhammad (is ever watchful) He says: they, as well as all created beings, will have to go through Him; it is also said that this means: the angels of your Lord will be on the Bridge over hell stopping people at seven different stopping positions at which they will ask them about seven traits.

translation: Verily, your Lord is Ever Watchful (over them).

metadata.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلإِنسَانُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلاَهُ رَبُّهُ فَأَكْرَمَهُ وَنَعَّمَهُ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيۤ أَكْرَمَنِ
metadata.Tafsir: (As for man) the disbelieving man, in reference here to Ubayy Ibn Khalaf; and it is also said: Umayyah Ibn Khalaf, (whenever his Lord trieth him) whenever his Lord tests him with wealth, richness or means of living (by honouring him) by giving him abundant wealth, (and is gracious unto him) and expands for him his means of living, (he saith: My Lord honoureth me) by giving me wealth and means of living.

translation: As for man, when his Lord tries him by giving him honour and bounties, then he says (in exultation): "My Lord has honoured me."

metadata.arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلاَهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيۤ أَهَانَنِ
metadata.Tafsir: (But whenever He trieth him) whenever He tests him with poverty (by straitening his means of life) by tightening his means of living, (he saith: My Lord despiseth me) by giving me poverty and tightening my means of living.

translation: But when He tries him by straitening his means of life, he says: "My Lord has humiliated me!"

metadata.arabic: كَلاَّ بَل لاَّ تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
metadata.Tafsir: (Nay) this is a reply to them: No, but the honour I bestow is due to My acknowledgment of some My servants and the success I give to them, while My despising is because I turn away from some servants and completely forsake them, (but ye (for your part) honour not the orphan) you do not acknowledge the right of the orphan when he is under your care.

translation: Nay! But you treat not the orphans with kindness and generosity (i.e. you neither treat them well, nor give them their exact right of inheritance)!

metadata.arabic: وَلاَ تَحَآضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
metadata.Tafsir: (And urge not) yourselves or others (on the feeding of the poor) giving alms to the poor,

translation: And urge not one another on the feeding of Al-Miskîn (the poor)!

metadata.arabic: وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلاً لَّمّاً
metadata.Tafsir: (And ye devour heritages) inheritances (with devouring greed

translation: And you devour the inheritance all with greed.

metadata.arabic: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبّاً جَمّاً
metadata.Tafsir: And love wealth with abounding love.

translation: And you love wealth with much love.

metadata.arabic: كَلاَّ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلأَرْضُ دَكّاً دَكّاً
metadata.Tafsir: Nay) this is also a reply to them, (but when the earth is ground to atoms, grinding, grinding) He says: when the earth is quaked again and again,

translation: Nay! When the earth is ground to powder.

metadata.arabic: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفّاً صَفّاً
metadata.Tafsir: (And thy Lord shall come) a coming without any modality (with angels, rank on rank) like the ranks of the people of the life of the world when praying,

translation: And your Lord comes with the angels in rows.

metadata.arabic: وَجِيۤءَ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِجَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلإِنسَانُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
metadata.Tafsir: (And hell is brought near) with 70,000 registers, with each register 70,000 angels leading it to the place of mustering, and then they reveal them (that day) the Day of Judgement; (on that day man) the disbelieving man; i.e. Ubayy Ibn Khalaf and Umayyah Ibn Khalaf (will remember) will be admonished, (but how will the remembrance (then avail him)) when the time for being admonished has passed?

translation: And Hell will be brought near that Day. On that Day will man remember, but how will that remembrance (then) avail him?

metadata.arabic: يَقُولُ يٰلَيْتَنِي قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِي
metadata.Tafsir: (He will say: Ah, would that) wishing: if only (I had sent before me (some provision) for my life!) if only I have worked in my previous perishing life to this everlasting life.

translation: He will say: "Alas! Would that I had sent forth (good deeds) for (this) my life!"

metadata.arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لاَّ يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُ أَحَدٌ
metadata.Tafsir: (None punisheth as He will punish on that day) on the Day of Judgement!

translation: So on that Day none will punish as He will punish.

metadata.arabic: وَلاَ يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُ أَحَدٌ
